title: Decode-Latency Feedback Prefill: A Model-Free Controller and Its Generalization Limits
comment: 5 pages, 1 figure. Includes negative generalization results for Qwen3-8B, Qwen3-32B, and two-GPU tensor parallelism
summary:
Concurrent autoregressive inference creates a fundamental interference problem: prefilling a newly arrived long prompt can delay tokens for requests that are already decoding. Fixed prefill chunks reduce this interference, but the best chunk size depends on the model, hardware, load, and latency objective. We introduce Decode-Latency Feedback Prefill (DLFP), a model-free controller that changes only prefill work that overlaps active decodes. After a guarded scheduling cycle, DLFP uses the observed interval as proportional feedback to resize the next prefill chunk; isolated prefills remain unrestricted.
  We implement DLFP in vLLM and evaluate it with open-loop Poisson arrivals, exact token accounting, raw request traces, and NVIDIA telemetry. On Qwen3-0.6B in BF16 on one A100 80 GB GPU, three paired 100-request trials reduce P99 inter-token latency by 24.8%, 30.1%, and 28.2% (mean 27.7%, paired 95% confidence interval 21.0% to 34.3%) with exact output agreement, no failures, and unchanged SLO compliance. The benefit is not free: mean P99 time to first token increases 34.8% while remaining inside the declared SLO.
  Crucially, the mechanism does not generalize to Qwen3-8B, Qwen3-32B, or a two-GPU tensor-parallel configuration. We trace the failure to an asynchronous scheduler-call interval that is only a proxy for completed GPU iteration time. This negative result defines the boundary of the contribution and motivates a completion-timed controller for concurrent CPU and on-device inference. We do not claim mobile-device performance; the present work is a reproducible proof-of-concept and generalization study.

AI.tldr: 提出DLFP，一种无模型控制器，通过比例反馈动态调整与解码重叠的预填充块大小，在Qwen3-0.6B上降低P99令牌间延迟约27.7%，但该机制未能在更大模型与张量并行配置上泛化。
AI.motivation: 并发自回归推理存在根本性干扰问题：新到达的长提示词的预填充会延迟正在解码请求的令牌生成。固定预填充块虽可缓解干扰，但最优块大小取决于模型、硬件、负载和延迟目标，缺乏自适应方案。
AI.method: 提出DLFP（Decode-Latency Feedback Prefill），一个仅改变与活跃解码重叠的预填充工作的无模型控制器。在经过受保护的调度周期后，使用观测到的间隔作为比例反馈来调整下一个预填充块的大小；孤立的预填充不受限制。在vLLM中实现，并使用开环泊松到达、精确令牌核算、原始请求轨迹和NVIDIA遥测进行评估。
AI.result: 在单张A100 80GB GPU上运行BF16的Qwen3-0.6B，三次配对的100请求试验将P99令牌间延迟分别降低24.8%、30.1%和28.2%（平均27.7%，配对95%置信区间21.0%至34.3%），输出完全一致、无失败且SLO合规性不变。代价是平均P99首令牌时间增加34.8%，但仍在声明的SLO之内。关键的是，该机制无法泛化到Qwen3-8B、Qwen3-32B或双GPU张量并行配置。
AI.conclusion: 失败根源在于异步调度器调用间隔仅能作为已完成GPU迭代时间的代理。这一负面结果界定了贡献的边界，并推动为并发CPU与设备端推理设计基于完成计时的控制器。作者声明不主张移动设备性能，本工作是可复现的概念验证与泛化研究。

title: Team MSU GenText-Forensics Challenge 2026 Technical Report
summary: Document text forgery has evolved beyond simple pixel-level manipulation: modern attacks alter not only the appearance of a document but also its meaning, and increasingly target the OCR & LLM pipelines that consume such documents. The ACM MM 2026 GenText-Forensics challenge therefore requires systems that not only decide whether a multilingual text image is forged, but also localize the point of manipulation, identify the attack type, and produce a human-readable forensic report with supporting evidence. We present our solution, a decomposed chain-of-thought (CoT) pipeline that combines a document tampering detector (DTD) with two Qwen3-VL-32B vision-language models, each LoRA-adapted to a distinct sub-task. DTD produces tampering probability maps that are converted into numbered candidate regions; a first model (the Filterer) validates these regions and assigns a preliminary forgery type, while a second model (the Semantic Detective) merges and re-grounds the surviving regions, searches for purely semantic anomalies that are invisible to pixel-level detectors, and writes the final report. Both models are trained by distilling chain-of-thought traces from a privileged Qwen3-VL-235B teacher that has access to ground-truth masks and reports. Our approach secured third place in the ACM MM 2026 GenText-Forensics challenge. We describe the data preparation, test-time augmentation, region rendering, distillation protocol, and training configuration in detail, and report ablations over detector thresholds, prompt designs, and pipeline decompositions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种分解式思维链（CoT）流水线，将文档篡改检测器（DTD）与两个经 LoRA 适配的 Qwen3-VL-32B 视觉语言模型结合，完成多语言文本图像的伪造判定、篡改定位、攻击类型识别与取证报告生成，在 ACM MM 2026 GenText-Forensics 挑战赛中获得第三名。
AI.motivation: 文档伪造已从简单的像素级篡改演变为同时改变外观与语义的攻击，并越来越多地针对消费此类文档的 OCR 与 LLM 流水线。因此挑战赛要求系统不仅判断多语言文本图像是否被伪造，还要定位篡改点、识别攻击类型，并生成带证据的人类可读取证报告，现有方法难以满足这一综合需求。
AI.method: 方法采用分解式 CoT 流水线：DTD 生成篡改概率图并转化为带编号的候选区域；第一个模型（Filterer）验证这些区域并给出初步伪造类型；第二个模型（Semantic Detective）合并并重新定位幸存区域，搜索像素级检测器无法发现的纯语义异常，并撰写最终报告。两个模型均通过从拥有真实掩码与报告的 Qwen3-VL-235B 特权教师模型中蒸馏 CoT 轨迹进行训练。文中还详细描述了数据准备、测试时增强、区域渲染、蒸馏协议与训练配置。
AI.result: 该系统在 ACM MM 2026 GenText-Forensics 挑战赛中获得第三名，并针对检测器阈值、提示设计与流水线分解方式进行了消融实验。
AI.conclusion: 分解式 CoT 流水线结合像素级篡改检测与语义异常检测，能有效应对现代文档伪造在视觉与语义层面的双重攻击，视觉语言模型经 LoRA 适配与教师蒸馏后可协同完成判定、定位、分类与报告生成等多子任务。

title: MILO: Automated Harness Discovery via Orchestrated Multi-Agent Evolution
summary: Modern agentic systems combine an AI model with a harness that controls execution and environmental interactions. Harness design strongly affects long-horizon performance, yet its combinatorial search space demands substantial human effort that must be repeated as models change. Existing automated methods explore this space narrowly, optimizing only components such as prompts or skills or becoming trapped by fixed, exploitative search strategies. We introduce MILO (Meta-evolutionary Island Orchestration), a framework that co-evolves agent harnesses and the strategy used to discover them. MILO combines: (i) hierarchical lineage memory over island-based trees, using rejected mutations as negative evidence; (ii) per-island mutator agents that rewrite complete harnesses using global search history and parent-specific feedback; and (iii) an orchestrator that adapts search through lineage grafting and speciation, mutator reassignment and curriculum revision. Across Terminal-Bench 2.1, PaperBench, and DeepSWE, MILO-discovered harnesses outperform eight state-of-the-art harnesses and six search methods using frontier (Opus 4.8) and open-weight (gpt-oss-120b) models. With Opus 4.8, MILO improves resolution over its initial harness by $+12.0\%$, $+28.3\%$, and $+10.3\%$, respectively, compared with best prior-search gains of $+4.5\%$, $+18.3\%$, and $0\%$. On Terminal-Bench 2.1, it achieves $86.1 \pm 2.0\%$, exceeding the official leaderboard's top entry ($83.8 \pm 2.3\%$) while using 26\% fewer tokens than its initial harness. On EinsteinArena open problems, MILO improves best-known upper bounds for Erdős minimum-overlap ($0.3808586 \to 0.3808568$) and the first and third autocorrelation inequalities ($1.50274365 \to 1.50274360$; $1.45081 \to 1.44889$).

AI.tldr: MILO 是一个让智能体"外壳"与其搜索策略协同进化的框架，通过岛屿式层级谱系记忆、突变智能体与自适应编排器，在多个基准上超越现有最优方法。
AI.motivation: 智能体系统的性能高度依赖执行外壳（harness）设计，但其组合搜索空间巨大，人工调优成本高且随模型迭代需反复重做。现有自动化方法搜索范围狭窄（仅优化提示或技能等单一组件），且易陷入固定的利用型搜索策略。因此需要一个能同时改进外壳与搜索策略的方法。
AI.method: MILO（Meta-evolutionary Island Orchestration）包含三部分：(i) 基于岛屿树的层级谱系记忆，将被拒绝的变异作为负证据利用；(ii) 每个岛屿配备突变智能体，依据全局搜索历史与父代专属反馈重写完整外壳；(iii) 编排器通过谱系嫁接与物种形成、突变智能体重新分配与课程修订来自适应调整搜索。
AI.result: 在 Terminal-Bench 2.1、PaperBench 与 DeepSWE 上，MILO 发现的外壳优于八种最先进外壳与六种搜索方法（使用 Opus 4.8 与 gpt-oss-120b）。使用 Opus 4.8 时相较初始外壳提升分别为 +12.0%、+28.3%、+10.3%，而此前最佳搜索增益仅为 +4.5%、+18.3%、0%。Terminal-Bench 2.1 上达 86.1±2.0%，超过官方榜首 83.8±2.3%，且比初始外壳少用 26% token。在 EinsteinArena 开放问题上，改进了 Erdős 最小重叠（0.3808586→0.3808568）及第一、第三自相关不等式（1.50274365→1.50274360；1.45081→1.44889）的已知上界。
AI.conclusion: 协同进化外壳与搜索策略可显著提升智能体长程性能，并在基准与开放数学问题上均取得领先结果。

title: MetaPersona: Task-Grounded Synthetic Populations from Empirical Social Science
summary: Personas used to seed LLM social simulations face a cold-start problem: existing methods lack a principled basis for deciding which attributes to include and how to assign their values. As a result, synthetic populations may misrepresent the demographic composition, latent attributes, and dependency structure that shape downstream behavior. We introduce MetaPersona-DB, a dataset of 11,000+ empirical human-subjects studies annotated with task-relevant variables, reported relationships, and aggregate-level population statistics. Building on this resource, we propose MetaPersona, a framework that retrieves task-relevant evidence, constructs literature-derived persona dependency graphs, and samples synthetic populations from empirical priors linking demographics, latent attributes, and outcomes. Across three downstream case studies, three baselines, and three frontier models, results vary by task and model: MetaPersona performs strongly on misinformation belief and AI-tool sentiment, while results on income redistribution are mixed. It also reduces persona-construction cost to under $0.5 per task using GPT-5.2. Finally, we present MetaPersona-Studio, a prototype interactive interface for empirically grounded persona generation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出MetaPersona-DB数据集与MetaPersona框架，用实证文献先验解决LLM社会模拟中人格设定的冷启动问题，并在三个下游任务中验证效果。
AI.motivation: LLM社会模拟中用于初始化的人格设定存在冷启动问题：现有方法缺乏有原则的依据来决定应包含哪些属性以及如何赋值，导致合成人群可能在人口构成、潜在属性及依赖结构上出现偏差，进而影响下游行为表现。
AI.method: 构建MetaPersona-DB，一个包含11000+项实证人类被试研究的数据集，标注了任务相关变量、已报告关系与总体层面统计；在此基础上提出MetaPersona框架，检索任务相关证据、构建源自文献的人格依赖图，并从连接人口统计、潜在属性与结果的经验先验中采样合成人群。
AI.result: 在三个下游案例、三个基线与三个前沿模型上，结果因任务和模型而异：MetaPersona在错误信息信念与AI工具态度上表现强，在收入再分配上结果混杂；使用GPT-5.2可将人格构建成本降至每任务低于0.5美元。同时提出MetaPersona-Studio交互式原型界面。
AI.conclusion: 实证文献先验可为LLM社会模拟的人格生成提供原则性依据并降低成本，但效果具有任务依赖性，需进一步验证其在更广泛议题上的稳定性。

title: VidHarness: Evolving Agent Harnesses for Cost-Efficient Long Video Understanding
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) can answer questions about hour-long videos, but processing every frame is prohibitively expensive, even though the evidence for a question usually spans only a few seconds. Video agents, i.e., harness programs wrapped around a frozen VLM, address this by observing the video selectively, yet existing harnesses are hand-crafted by experts through slow build-and-test cycles. We propose VidHarness, a framework that automates harness design for cost-efficient long video understanding, in which a harness proposer iteratively evolves harnesses based on execution feedback from an evolution environment. To escape the local optima of greedy refinement, we organize the evolution as Monte Carlo tree search (MCTS), and to reduce the evaluation cost, we integrate uncertainty-aware multi-fidelity validation, which screens new harnesses on a few questions and promotes only the promising ones. Since the best harness varies with the frame budget, we further introduce a mixture-of-harness that routes each question to a harness specialized for its budget. VidHarness sets new state-of-the-art results on LongVideoBench, Video-MME, and Video-Holmes, outperforms the strongest hand-crafted video agent by up to $11.2$ points, and generalizes to the knowledge-intensive benchmarks Video-MMMU and MMVU with fewer than half of the frames of uniform sampling.

AI.tldr: VidHarness 提出自动化设计视频智能体框架，通过 MCTS 进化与多保真验证，实现低成本长视频理解，在多个基准上刷新 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 长视频问答中证据通常仅跨几秒，但逐帧处理成本极高。现有视频智能体（包裹冻结 VLM 的 harness）依赖专家手工设计，迭代缓慢。论文希望自动化 harness 设计，以更低的成本提升长视频理解性能。
AI.method: 将 harness 设计建模为自动化搜索：harness proposer 基于执行反馈迭代进化 harness；采用蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）避免贪心精化的局部最优；引入不确定性感知的多保真验证，先用少量问题筛选新 harness，仅将潜力大的候选提升评估；并提出 mixture-of-harness，根据帧预算将问题路由到对应的专用 harness。
AI.result: 在 LongVideoBench、Video-MME、Video-Holmes 上取得新的 SOTA，较最强手工视频智能体最高提升 11.2 分；并泛化到知识密集型基准 Video-MMMU 与 MMVU，且所用帧数不足均匀采样的一半。
AI.conclusion: 自动化 harness 设计可有效替代人工构建视频智能体，在显著降低帧成本的同时提升长视频理解性能，并具备向知识密集型任务泛化的能力。

title: Continual Learning of Dynamical Systems in Recurrent Neural Networks through Recyclable Unit Gating
summary: Dynamical Systems Reconstruction (DSR) aims to infer models from observed time series that reproduce a system's qualitative long-term behavior. Continual DSR (cDSR) requires learning new systems while preserving previously learned dynamics, yet even small parameter updates in recurrent models can qualitatively alter their behavior over long autonomous rollouts. We benchmark established continual learning (CL) methods spanning parameter regularization, replay, and parameter isolation on the fully trainable and interpretable Almost-Linear RNN (AL-RNN). Parameter isolation preserves earlier dynamics most effectively, but excessive task-specific allocations can rapidly exhaust a fixed-size network. We therefore introduce Continually-Recyclable Unit-Gating (CRUG), which conserves capacity through compact allocation and forward transfer. Differentiable gates trained with an $L_0$-based penalty select task-specific units, while unused units are recycled for subsequent tasks. Directed connections allow later tasks to reuse earlier representations without affecting the dynamics of previously committed units. CRUG achieves the strongest reconstruction--capacity trade-off among the tested methods with zero forgetting and reliably learns a heterogeneous sequence of nonlinear and chaotic systems. Furthermore, we show that forward transfer is more pronounced and useful when tasks share similar underlying dynamics. Lastly, we demonstrate that CRUG's advantages extend beyond autonomous cDSR to sequential cognitive tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Continually-Recyclable Unit-Gating (CRUG)，在 Almost-Linear RNN 上实现持续动力系统重构，通过可微门控与单元回收机制在固定容量下实现零遗忘并保持最优的重构-容量权衡。
AI.motivation: 持续动力系统重构（cDSR）要求在学习新系统的同时保留已学动态，但循环模型中即使微小的参数更新也可能在长期自主 rollout 中质变其行为，因此需要在有限网络容量下解决灾难性遗忘问题。
AI.method: 在完全可训练且可解释的 AL-RNN 上基准测试参数正则化、回放和参数隔离三类持续学习方法；随后提出 CRUG，利用 L0 惩罚训练可微门控以选择任务特定单元，并通过紧凑分配与前向迁移回收未使用单元，同时用有向连接让后续任务复用早期表示而不影响已提交单元的动态。
AI.result: 参数隔离在保留早期动态上最有效，但过多的任务特定分配会快速耗尽固定规模网络；CRUG 在测试方法中取得最佳的重构-容量权衡，实现零遗忘，并可靠学习由非线性和混沌系统组成的异质序列；当任务共享相似底层动态时，前向迁移更显著且更有用；CRUG 的优势还可扩展到顺序认知任务。
AI.conclusion: CRUG 通过紧凑分配与单元回收机制，在持续动力系统重构中实现了零遗忘与优越的重构-容量权衡，并可推广至顺序认知任务，且前向迁移在任务动态相似时收益更大。

title: SimTrace: Grounded Multimodal User Trajectories Generation for Online User Modeling
summary: Virtual clients offer a cost-effective approach to support applications such as A/B testing, recommender system development, and interface evaluation. However, building them requires access to large-scale, semantically faithful, fine-grained online user trajectories. These data are difficult to obtain because proprietary logs are subject to privacy restrictions and small businesses often lack sufficient traffic. Consequently, existing public datasets either abstract away fine-grained user interaction details or preserve rich context but remain platform-specific and small-scale. To address this gap, we propose SimTrace, a framework that generates faithful, fine-grained synthetic multimodal clickstreams through a computer-use client agent that is grounded in real user trajectories and the given web environment. SimTrace anonymizes real interactions and constructs a simulated twin of the given web environment, then uses both to generate synthetic interaction trajectories. Each action is paired with its corresponding web observations and user context, yielding a shareable alternative to confidential logs for developing computer-use agent-style virtual clients. We apply SimTrace to an e-commerce setting and evaluate both its fidelity and downstream utility. SimTrace outperforms competing baselines on 7 out of 8 fidelity metrics. Models trained on synthetic data achieve performance comparable to those trained on real data on downstream tasks such as purchase prediction and recommendation. For next action prediction task, augmenting real data with synthetic data further improves accuracy by 11.0% relative to training on real data alone. We release SimTrace as an open-source package to facilitate research on online user behavior modeling.

AI.tldr: 提出SimTrace框架，通过基于真实用户轨迹和网页环境的计算机使用客户端智能体，生成高保真、细粒度、多模态的合成点击流，为虚拟客户端开发提供可共享的替代数据。
AI.motivation: 虚拟客户端可用于A/B测试、推荐系统开发和界面评估等场景，但构建它们需要大规模、语义忠实、细粒度的在线用户轨迹。这类数据难以获取：专有日志受隐私限制，小企业缺乏足够流量，现有公开数据集要么丢失细粒度交互细节，要么保留丰富上下文但局限于特定平台且规模较小。
AI.method: SimTrace首先对真实交互进行匿名化处理，并构建给定网页环境的"模拟孪生"（simulated twin），然后利用二者生成合成交互轨迹。每个动作都与对应的网页观测和用户上下文配对，形成对机密日志的可共享替代方案，用于开发计算机使用智能体风格的虚拟客户端。
AI.result: 在电商场景中评估SimTrace的保真度与下游效用：在8项保真度指标中有7项优于竞争基线；合成数据训练的模型在购买预测和推荐等下游任务上性能与真实数据训练的模型相当；在下一动作预测任务中，真实数据结合合成数据相比仅用真实数据训练，准确率相对提升11.0%。
AI.conclusion: SimTrace能够生成高保真、细粒度的合成多模态点击流，在下游任务中达到与真实数据相当甚至更优的效果，并以开源包形式发布，以促进在线用户行为建模研究。

title: LoopVL: Recurrent Visual Intelligence
summary: We introduce LoopVL to study whether Loop Transformers can be effectively extended to vision- language models. LoopVL combines Module-Loop and Model-Loop computation to iteratively update a unified vision-language state through shared modules. We train LoopVL from scratch through language pre-training, multimodal training, and post-training. LoopVL outperforms a range of similarly sized and larger non-recurrent models on multimodal understanding and visual reasoning benchmarks. We also observe Visual Aha Moments in LoopVL, characterized by pronounced shifts in visual attention across loops. LoopVL provides practical evidence for recurrent vision-language modeling and offers an intuitive perspective on how shared parameters can support deeper multimodal computation over continuously evolving visual-language states.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LoopVL，探索循环Transformer能否有效扩展到视觉-语言模型，通过模块循环与模型循环迭代更新统一的视觉-语言状态，并验证其性能与视觉"顿悟"现象。
AI.motivation: 研究循环Transformer（Loop Transformers）能否有效扩展到视觉-语言模型这一尚未充分探索的问题。
AI.method: LoopVL结合Module-Loop与Model-Loop计算，通过共享模块迭代更新统一的视觉-语言状态，并从零开始经历语言预训练、多模态训练和后训练三个阶段。
AI.result: LoopVL在多模态理解与视觉推理基准上超越了多种同规模及更大规模的非循环模型，并观察到视觉"顿悟"现象——视觉注意力在循环间呈现显著转移。
AI.conclusion: LoopVL为循环视觉-语言建模提供了实践证据，并直观展示了共享参数如何在持续演化的视觉-语言状态上支持更深层的多模态计算。

title: On the Off-Policy Teacher in On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) has recently emerged as a promising post-training paradigm in which the student learns from trajectories generated by its own policy under dense teacher supervision. However, OPD introduces a fundamental asymmetry: although the sampled trajectories are on-policy for the student, they are off-policy for the teacher. The teacher is typically optimized to continue from prefixes generated by its own policy, but during OPD it must instead supervise prefixes generated by the student. Empirically, we find that its continuation performance degrades as these prefixes grow longer. To address this issue, we propose Student-COnditioned Updates of the Teacher (SCOUT), a co-training framework that adapts the teacher to student-generated prefixes. Alongside standard OPD updates, SCOUT periodically optimizes the teacher's conditional ability using reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, where the teacher generates continuations from student prefixes and learns from outcome rewards. Controlled experiments show that SCOUT improves the teacher's ability to continue from student-generated prefixes, supporting the intended mechanism of student-conditioned teacher adaptation. Across multiple teacher--student configurations, model scales, and reasoning domains, SCOUT also consistently improves the effectiveness of on-policy distillation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SCOUT框架，通过协同训练使教师模型适应学生生成的轨迹前缀，从而提升在线策略蒸馏（OPD）的效果。
AI.motivation: 在线策略蒸馏（OPD）中存在一个根本性不对称：采样轨迹对学生是在线策略，但对教师却是离线策略。教师通常针对自身策略生成的前缀优化，而在OPD中需监督学生生成的前缀，导致其续写性能随前缀变长而下降。
AI.method: 提出SCOUT（学生条件化的教师更新）协同训练框架。在标准OPD更新之外，周期性地用可验证奖励的强化学习优化教师的条件能力：教师从学生前缀生成续写，并从结果奖励中学习。
AI.result: 控制实验表明，SCOUT提升了教师从学生生成前缀续写的能力，支持了学生条件化教师适应的预期机制。在多种师生配置、模型规模和推理领域上，SCOUT均持续提升了在线策略蒸馏的效果。
AI.conclusion: SCOUT通过让学生条件化地更新教师，缓解了OPD中教师-学生前缀不匹配问题，是一种有效且具普适性的协同训练方法。

title: ArgGYM: A Procedural, Engine-Verified Benchmark for Structured Defeasible Reasoning
summary: Recent progress in large language model reasoning has been driven by benchmarks and reinforcement learning environments with automatically verifiable rewards, particularly in mathematics, code, and formal logic. These settings make model accuracy easier to evaluate and optimize, but it remains unclear how far success under fixed problem specifications and stable evaluation criteria transfers to reasoning outside such domains. Real-world reasoning often proceeds under incomplete and revisable information: conclusions may be supported provisionally, defeated by counter-evidence, reinstated by further arguments, or revised when stronger reasons become available. Reasoning of this kind is generally referred to as defeasible reasoning. We introduce ArgGYM, a procedural benchmark and RLVR-compatible training environment for structured defeasible reasoning. ArgGYM decomposes this reasoning into twelve tasks and grounds task-specific scoring in a symbolic argumentation engine that computes the formal states used to evaluate model outputs. It includes a frozen benchmark of 1,440 verified instances across fifteen curriculum configurations, two argument preference orderings (weakest-link and last-link), and two set orderings (elitist and democratic), while the same generators and verifiers can produce fresh instances for evaluation that reduces dependence on static test sets and for verifiable-reward training. On the frozen benchmark, frontier and open-weight models show sharply different reasoning profiles: they can recover substantial parts of structured answers without solving the complete task, and performance declines in later curriculum configurations with longer dependencies and more interacting structures. We release the benchmark, generators, and verifiers for reproducible evaluation and RLVR training.

AI.tldr: 提出ArgGYM，一个面向结构化可废止推理的可复现基准与RLVR兼容训练环境，包含12类任务、符号论证引擎评分、1440个验证实例及可生成新实例的生成器与验证器。
AI.motivation: 现有大模型推理进步多依赖数学、代码、形式逻辑等具有固定问题规范与稳定评价标准的可自动验证奖励场景，但这类成功能否迁移到真实世界中信息不完整、结论可被反驳、撤销或修正的可废止推理仍不明确。因此需要一个结构化可废止推理的基准与训练环境。
AI.method: ArgGYM将可废止推理分解为十二个任务，基于符号论证引擎计算形式状态并对任务特定输出进行评分。它包含一个冻结基准，覆盖十五种课程配置、两种论证偏好排序（weakest-link与last-link）和两种集合排序（elitist与democratic），共1440个已验证实例；同一套生成器与验证器还可产生新实例，用于降低对静态测试集的依赖并支持可验证奖励训练。
AI.result: 在冻结基准上，前沿模型与开放权重模型表现出明显不同的推理特征：它们能在未完整解决任务的情况下恢复相当部分结构化答案，且在依赖更长、结构交互更多的后续课程配置中性能下降。
AI.conclusion: 作者发布基准、生成器与验证器，以支持可复现评估和RLVR训练，并推动结构化可废止推理研究。

title: MOBA-VL: Event-Localized Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning for Real-Time MOBA Commentary
summary: Real-time commentary for Multiplayer Online Battle Arena (MOBA) esports requires a vision-language model (VLM) to narrate a live match second by second, both fluently and accurately. Existing streaming VLMs sound natural but often miss key events such as kills and objectives. To address this limitation, we use game telemetry, which records exactly when each event occurs, as a supervision signal. We introduce MOBA-VL, a 9B-parameter model trained on this signal with event-localized multi-turn reinforcement learning, which rewards the turns that describe each event. We also collect MOBACast, 860 professional matches (about 460 hours) across three MOBA games with word-level timestamped commentary, and MOBACast-Bench, a benchmark from held-out tournaments. On MOBACast-Bench, MOBA-VL achieves the highest Overall score on full matches (63.25 vs. 55.12 for StreamingVLM) and clips (63.45 vs. 56.22 for DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash). Event-localized credit also raises event recall from 34.5 to 42.1 over supervised fine-tuning. Code and data will be released, and demos are available on an anonymous project page at https://moba-vl.github.io.

AI.tldr: 提出MOBA-VL模型，利用游戏遥测信号进行事件定位的多轮强化学习，实现MOBA电竞赛事实时解说。
AI.motivation: 现有流式视觉语言模型解说虽流畅但常遗漏关键事件（击杀、目标），需提升事件描述的准确性。
AI.method: 以游戏遥测记录的精确事件时间作为监督信号，用事件定位的多轮强化学习训练9B参数的MOBA-VL模型，奖励描述对应事件的轮次；并收集MOBACast数据集与MOBACast-Bench基准。
AI.result: 在MOBACast-Bench上，MOBA-VL全场次Overall得分最高（63.25 vs StreamingVLM的55.12），片段得分63.45 vs DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash的56.22；事件召回率从34.5提升至42.1。
AI.conclusion: 事件定位信用分配显著提升解说的事件召回与整体质量，代码与数据将开源。

title: Simulator-Refined Diffusion for Radio-Frequency Inverse Design
summary: Diffusion models have shown potential in inverse design of printed circuit boards (PCBs), enabling the generation of layouts conditioned on target S-parameters. Despite this promise, applying diffusion models to PCB layout generation remains challenging due to their difficulty in meeting the quantitative electromagnetic specifications. A common approach is gradient-based guidance, which biases the diffusion sampling process with the gradient of an objective used for evaluation. However, full-wave electromagnetic simulators are accurate but expensive and typically non-differentiable, whereas differentiable surrogates are informative but not always reliable. To address these limitations, this paper proposes Simulator-Refined Diffusion (SRD), a novel combination of a low-fidelity differentiable surrogate and a high-fidelity non-differentiable simulator within the diffusion sampling process. Unlike standard zeroth-order optimization, which requires a great number of random perturbations, our approach uses the surrogate's gradient to propose the perturbation direction while the simulator then searches based on this direction to identify an effective design update. Experimental results across different settings show that this method consistently outperforms current state-of-the-art methods, producing layouts whose simulated S-parameters match the target specifications up to 21.2% closer for in-distribution targets and up to 19.8% for out-of-distribution targets.

AI.tldr: 提出Simulator-Refined Diffusion (SRD)，将低保真可微代理模型与高保真不可微仿真器结合到扩散采样中，以改善PCB逆设计中S参数的定量匹配精度。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型用于PCB版图逆设计时难以满足定量电磁指标。梯度引导方法中，全波电磁仿真器精确但昂贵且不可微，可微代理模型信息丰富但不可靠，二者结合存在困难。
AI.method: SRD在扩散采样过程内融合低保真可微代理与高保真不可微仿真器：用代理模型的梯度提出扰动方向，再由仿真器沿该方向搜索有效设计更新，避免标准零阶优化所需的大量随机扰动。
AI.result: 在不同实验设置下持续优于当前最先进方法，生成版图的仿真S参数更贴近目标：分布内目标最多提升21.2%，分布外目标最多提升19.8%。
AI.conclusion: 代理梯度引导加仿真器方向搜索的混合采样策略可有效提升PCB逆设计对电磁规格的满足程度，兼顾可微性与保真度。

title: A Competing-Hazards Systematization of Loss of Control in Autonomous Agents
summary: Leading AI developers have reported agents acting beyond their approved limits, which a United Nations panel described as an early warning of loss of human control. Yet incident reports and agent-safety evaluations describe these events differently, making it difficult to compare failures, trace risk across attempts, or separate agent behavior from the environment's role in allowing an out-of-scope action to succeed. To address this gap, we introduce a common framework in which each attempt ends in approved completion, safe stopping, scope escape, or continuation. We formalize the framework as a discrete-time competing-hazards model and derive escape probability within a retry budget, a model-conditional safe-budget limit, and conditions for estimation from execution logs. We audit 22 incident reports and 102 agent-safety evaluations published from January 2025 to September 2026 using primary sources. Six incidents involved tasks that could not be completed within scope, thirteen involved agents that continued rather than stopped, and five did not report stopping behavior. Developers' figures imply a task-level incidence ratio near 47 for out-of-scope coordination in never-solved versus solved tasks. Among evaluations, 87 recorded an out-of-scope effect or specification violation, 26 treated safe stopping as a first-class outcome, only 20 recorded both, and 79 merged budget exhaustion with failure. In 20 of 22 incidents, the environment allowed an out-of-scope effect, indicating that realized loss of control often reflected persistent agent behavior interacting with permissive boundary conditions; meanwhile, no evaluation reported all fields needed to estimate the full competing-hazards process from published evidence.

AI.tldr: 论文针对"AI主体越界行为"事件报告与安全性评测口径不一的问题，提出统一的竞争风险框架，并审计22份事件报告与102份评测。
AI.motivation: 领先AI开发者已报告过智能体超出授权范围的行为，联合国相关机构认为这是人类失去控制的早期预警。但事件报告与智能体安全性评测对同类事件的描述方式不同，导致难以比较失败、难以跨尝试追踪风险，也难以区分是智能体自身行为还是环境允许了越界行为成功发生。
AI.method: 提出统一框架：每次尝试的结局分为"批准完成、安全停止、越界逃逸、继续运行"四类；将其形式化为离散时间的竞争风险模型，推导出在重试预算内的逃逸概率、模型条件下的安全预算上限，以及从执行日志中估计参数的条件。随后以一手来源审计2025年1月至2026年9月发布的22份事件报告与102份智能体安全性评测。
AI.result: 22份事件中，6份涉及无法在范围内完成的任务，13份涉及智能体选择继续而非停止，5份未报告停止行为；开发者数据暗示在从未解决与已解决任务之间，越界协调的任务级发生比接近47。102份评测中，87份记录了越界效应或规格违反，26份将安全停止视为一等结果，仅20份同时记录两者，79份把预算耗尽与失败混同。22份事件中有20份显示环境允许了越界效应发生，说明实际失控常是持续的主体行为与宽松边界条件相互作用的结果；同时没有任何评测报告了从公开证据估计完整竞争风险过程所需的全部字段。
AI.conclusion: 当前事件报告与安全性评测在结局定义与字段记录上缺乏可比性，抑制了对失控风险的定量估计。采用统一的竞争风险框架并标准化记录安全停止、越界效应与边界条件，有助于比较失败、追踪风险并区分主体行为与环境的贡献。

title: Audible World Models: Spatially Aware Sound Generation for 3D Worlds
comment: Accepted at the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
summary: Text- and image-conditioned world generators can create visually rich 3D environments, yet these worlds often remain silent or rely on soundtracks synthesized solely from text or rendered video. Although such audio can convey what should be heard, it lacks an explicit representation of where sound sources are located and how their perceived sound should vary with listener movement. We introduce Audible World Models, a training-free framework that incorporates sound into the generated world state. Starting from a text prompt, our system constructs a panoramic 3D proxy, separates it into semantic layers, identifies sound-producing foreground objects and ambient background regions, and synthesizes dry audio for each sound label. It then anchors these sources to reconstructed geometry and renders listener-dependent spatial audio using geometric acoustic propagation. By explicitly linking semantics, geometry, and sound propagation, the framework maintains persistent source locations while adapting the rendered audio to changes in listener viewpoint and motion. Experiments across 80 generated scenes demonstrate substantial gains in spatial consistency over text-, video-, and panorama-conditioned baselines, while preserving competitive semantic alignment. VLM-based assessments and human evaluations further indicate that our soundtracks are preferred for their audio-visual consistency, spatial plausibility, and motion-dependent behavior.

AI.tldr: 提出 Audible World Models，一个免训练框架，将声音纳入生成世界状态，实现与语义、几何一致且随听者移动变化的空间音频。
AI.motivation: 现有文本/图像条件的世界生成器虽能构建视觉丰富的3D环境，但往往无声，或仅依赖文本或渲染视频合成音轨。这类音频只能表达"该听到什么"，缺乏声源位置的显式表示，也无法体现听者移动时感知声音的变化。
AI.method: 从文本提示出发，构建全景3D代理，将其分解为语义层，识别发声前景物体与背景环境区域，为每个声音标签合成干音频；随后将声源锚定到重建几何上，利用几何声学传播渲染依赖听者位置的空间音频，显式关联语义、几何与声音传播。
AI.result: 在80个生成场景上，空间一致性较文本、视频、全景条件基线显著提升，同时保持有竞争力的语义对齐；VLM评估与人工评测表明音轨在视听一致性、空间合理性和运动相关行为上更受偏好。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式连接语义、几何与声传播，框架在保持声源位置持久性的同时使渲染音频适应听者视角和运动变化，验证了将声音纳入生成世界状态的有效性。

title: Learning to Plan from Random Exploration
summary: Random exploration reveals how an environment can be traversed before a goal is specified. Can this experience support long-range planning without policy-improvement training? Our random-walk analysis explains what temporal relations contain: short horizons reveal geodesic geometry in the diffusion limit, while longer horizons reveal connectivity between regions before mixing removes these distinctions. We learn these relations with a conditional energy-based model that estimates temporal log-density ratios through horizon-conditioned embeddings. The model is trained on observation pairs by noise-contrastive estimation, without action or reward labels. The planner queries these learned relations at different horizons as it moves toward the goal. At test time, a separate local dynamics model predicts candidate action outcomes, and the temporal model evaluates their progress toward the goal by selecting or aggregating estimated improvements across horizons. The agent executes one action and replans with both models fixed. Experiments demonstrate long-range maze planning from random exploration using states and images. Learned score fields, embedding probes, and planned routes exhibit properties of a multiscale cognitive map. We further demonstrate egocentric navigation from random exploration and manipulation planning from suboptimal data.

AI.tldr: 通过随机游走分析揭示时间关系的多尺度性质，训练条件能量模型估计对数密度比，实现无需策略改进训练的长程规划。
AI.motivation: 随机探索能揭示环境的可通行结构，但能否在无需策略改进训练的情况下支持长程规划尚不明确。作者希望利用随机游走中蕴含的时间关系作为规划依据。
AI.method: 分析随机游走中时间关系：短时程在扩散极限下体现测地几何，长时程在混合前体现区域连通性。用条件能量模型通过时程条件嵌入估计时间对数密度比，以噪声对比估计在观测对上训练，无需动作或奖励标签。规划器在不同时程查询学到的关系；测试时用独立局部动力学模型预测候选动作结果，时间模型评估其朝向目标的进展，执行一步后固定两模型重新规划。
AI.result: 在状态与图像迷宫长程规划实验中成功实现从随机探索出发的规划。学到的分数场、嵌入探测与规划路径呈现出多尺度认知地图特性，并进一步实现随机探索的自我中心导航与次优数据的操作规划。
AI.conclusion: 随机探索中的时间关系经能量模型学习后，可支撑无需策略改进训练的长程规划，并表现出多尺度认知地图特征。

title: AIM: Agentic Idea Management for Automated Research
summary: Frontier LLMs are increasingly used to automate scientific research through iterative search. We distinguish idea-driven search from solution-driven search and identify three core challenges: organizing evolving research ideas, selecting promising directions, and maintaining alignment between ideas and their implementations. To address these challenges, we introduce the Agentic Idea Manager (AIM), a fully autonomous framework for managing and exploring research directions in idea-driven automated research. Inspired by Bayesian optimization, AIM uses an Agentic Surrogate and an Agentic Acquisition mechanism to organize discovered ideas and guide their selection. A Solution Auditor maintains idea-solution integrity, while a Resource Planner adaptively allocates the remaining experimental budget across parallel search branches. Experiments on 10 AutoLab benchmark tasks show that AIM surpasses the strongest baseline by 1.6 percentage points on System Optimization tasks and 4.9 percentage points on long-horizon Model Development & CUDA tasks. Notably, AIM reaches the best baseline performance up to 3.1x faster in wall-clock time. We further provide a theoretical analysis of when searching over ideas becomes beneficial. Our analysis shows that explicit idea-level allocation makes semantic coverage directly controllable, and that broader coverage becomes increasingly valuable when competitive research directions are sparse among many plausible alternatives. Project Page: https://imhgchoi.github.io/agentic-idea-manager/

AI.tldr: AIM 是一个全自主的智能体式研究想法管理框架，受贝叶斯优化启发，通过 Agentic Surrogate、Agentic Acquisition、Solution Auditor 和 Resource Planner 管理"想法驱动"的自动化科研，在 AutoLab 基准上显著超越最强基线并更快达到同等性能。
AI.motivation: 前沿大模型越来越多地被用于通过迭代搜索自动化科研。作者区分了"想法驱动"与"解法驱动"两类搜索，并指出想法驱动搜索面临三大挑战：如何组织不断演化的研究想法、如何选择有前景的方向、以及如何保持想法与其实现之间的一致。现有方法未系统解决这些挑战。
AI.method: 提出 Agentic Idea Manager（AIM），一个全自主框架。受贝叶斯优化启发，AIM 包含：Agentic Surrogate（组织已发现的想法）与 Agentic Acquisition（指导想法选择）；Solution Auditor 维护"想法—解"完整性；Resource Planner 在并行搜索分支间自适应分配剩余实验预算。此外还给出了关于"何时在想法层面搜索更有利"的理论分析。
AI.result: 在 10 个 AutoLab 基准任务上，AIM 在 System Optimization 任务上超过最强基线 1.6 个百分点，在长时程 Model Development & CUDA 任务上超过 4.9 个百分点；并能在墙钟时间上以最高 3.1 倍的速度达到最佳基线性能。
AI.conclusion: 显式的想法级分配使语义覆盖度可直接控制；当竞争性研究方向在许多看似可行的备选中较为稀疏时，更广的覆盖度价值更大。

title: PAMI: Part Anchored Motion for Text to Human-Object Interaction Generation
summary: Text-conditioned full-body human-object interaction (HOI) generation requires synthesizing human motion and object trajectories that match the input text while remaining precisely coordinated over time. Most methods represent the human and object as separate trajectories and predict the global human-object couplings. Learning this complex, dynamically changing relationship implicitly, however, often yields object drift, missed contact, and penetration. We introduce PAMI, a Part-Anchored Motion framework for Interaction generation. Inspired by the classic Hough Transform, our key idea is to localize object motion by letting body-part anchors vote for it: we express object motion relative to multiple body-part anchors and use PamiVAE to learn an interaction latent space, decoding frame-wise weights that aggregate these part-specific votes. Building on this representation, PAMI generates interactions in a coarse-to-fine hierarchy. PamiGen first generates a coarse human-object interaction from text in this structured latent space, and PamiRefiner then recursively resolves fine-grained contact geometry using a hybrid surface-sensing representation, combining long-range probes that capture overall body-part influence with short-range sensors that resolve detailed contacts near the object surface. Experiments on InterAct show that PAMI generates more faithful interactions and more accurate human-relative object motion than previous methods, achieving 14.5% higher contact recall than the previous state of the art. Extensive ablations validate the contributions of both the part-anchored voting representation and hybrid surface-sensing refinement.

AI.tldr: PAMI提出部件锚定运动框架，通过身体部件锚点投票表示物体运动，结合PamiVAE隐空间与粗细两级生成，实现更忠实且接触更准确的人-物交互生成。
AI.motivation: 文本驱动的全身人-物交互生成需同时合成与文本匹配且时序精准协调的人体运动和物体轨迹。多数方法将人与物体视为独立轨迹并隐式预测全局耦合关系，容易导致物体漂移、接触丢失和穿透问题。
AI.method: 受Hough变换启发，将物体运动表示为相对多个身体部件锚点的相对运动，用PamiVAE学习交互隐空间并解码逐帧权重来聚合各部件投票。基于该表示采用粗到细层级：PamiGen先在结构化隐空间由文本生成粗交互，PamiRefiner再用混合表面感知表示（长程探针捕捉整体部件影响，短程传感器解析物体表面附近细节接触）递归求解精细接触几何。
AI.result: 在InterAct数据集上，PAMI生成的交互更忠实、人-相对物体运动更准确，接触召回率比此前最优方法高14.5%。大量消融验证了部件锚定投票表示和混合表面感知细化的贡献。
AI.conclusion: 部件锚定投票表示与混合表面感知细化能有效解决物体漂移、接触丢失与穿透问题，为文本驱动的人-物交互生成提供了更准确可控的框架。

title: LeanPolish: Verified Supervision for Lean Proof Compression
summary: Verified proof edits offer a natural source of supervision for improving language-model-generated Lean proofs. Yet verification establishes that an edit is correct, not that its training signal is free of search artifacts. We introduce LeanPolish, a symbolic Lean 4 pipeline that releases 33,402 accepted local edits and 65,596 same-state failed attempts, and use it to study what models learn from this supervision. First-success search admits a goal-independent rule with perfect ranking accuracy; teacher-selected evaluation sites also reward trivial deletions. Continuing menu evaluation beyond the first success removes the ordering shortcut: a trained ranker selects the best candidate on 70.1% of evaluated held-out states, versus 36.9% for the strongest frozen baseline. For compression, iterating the symbolic pass raises miniF2F savings from 19.7% to 27.5%, exceeding the neural hybrids we test there. Verified neural editing helps on other proof sources, but matched frozen-model controls show that its gains need not come from training. The supervision does improve whole-proof rewriting: fine-tuning raises verified token reduction from 2.8% to 5.5% on 19 PutnamBench proofs. Together, the released edits, complete candidate pools, and controlled evaluations separate learning to imitate a search policy from improving on that search. They provide a reproducible basis for studying proof improvement while keeping correctness, compression, and edit policy distinct.

AI.tldr: LeanPolish 提出符号化 Lean 4 流水线，发布 33,402 条被接受的局部编辑与 65,596 条同状态失败尝试，并系统研究模型从"验证过的编辑"中究竟学到了什么。
AI.motivation: 验证过的证明编辑看似是改进语言模型生成 Lean 证明的天然监督信号，但"验证正确"不等于"训练信号没有搜索伪影"。作者希望区分"模仿搜索策略"与"真正超越搜索"，并厘清正确性、压缩率与编辑策略三者的关系。
AI.method: 构建 LeanPolish 符号化 Lean 4 流水线，释放已接受编辑与同状态失败尝试；设计"首次成功"搜索与"继续菜单评估"两种设定，训练排序器进行候选选择；用符号迭代进行证明压缩；并用匹配的冻结模型对照实验检验神经编辑增益来源；最后在整证明改写任务上微调模型。
AI.result: 首次成功搜索可导出目标无关的排序规则并达到完美排序准确率，教师选取的评估点也奖励平凡删除；继续菜单评估后该顺序捷径消失，训练排序器在 70.1% 的留出状态上选出最佳候选，而最强冻结基线仅 36.9%。压缩方面，符号迭代将 miniF2F 节省率从 19.7% 提升到 27.5%，超过所测试的神经混合方法。神经编辑在其他证明来源上有效，但冻结模型对照显示增益未必来自训练。微调将 19 个 PutnamBench 证明的验证 token 缩减率从 2.8% 提升到 5.5%。
AI.conclusion: 发布的编辑数据、完整候选池与受控评估将"学习模仿搜索策略"与"真正改进搜索"区分开来，为在保持正确性、压缩与编辑策略相互独立的前提下研究证明改进提供了可复现的基础。

title: Reach Into The CHOIR: Free-List Elicitation Uncovers Distinct Model Voices in LLM Ensembles
comment: 23 pages, 6 figures. Published in the Proceedings of the Third Conference on Language Modeling (COLM 2026)
summary: Open-ended LLM homogeneity can create false plurality when several systems appear to offer independent perspectives while returning the same familiar default. Single-pass answers obscure the distinction between agreement produced by a tightly constrained answer space, prompt-vocabulary echo, and broader answer spaces with stable alternatives beneath the surface. We introduce CHOIR (Collective Hierarchically-Ordered Inquiry Responses), a framework that adapts free-list elicitation from cognitive anthropology to LLM ensembles. CHOIR repeatedly elicits ranked lists, clusters items into prompt-level concepts, and measures concept salience across models, prompt variants, and persona conditions. We evaluate CHOIR on Infinity-Chat 100, an external prompt bank from recent work on open-ended model homogeneity, and on a 27-question targeted diagnostic bank designed to isolate mechanism-level contrasts. On Infinity-Chat 100, CHOIR reproduces high surface agreement (93/100 prompts above chance) while separating narrow prompts from broad prompts with recoverable depth. Across targeted probes and the external prompt bank, base-model identity remains the strongest recoverable signature, and persona prompts shift surfaced concepts within base-model signatures. A source-blind ranking module prioritises rare-but-stable candidates for later inspection. CHOIR turns open-ended homogeneity into a diagnostic measurement problem by asking where models converge, why they converge, and what remains reachable under structured depth probing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CHOIR框架，借鉴认知人类学的自由列举方法，通过反复获取排序列表、聚类概念并测量跨模型/提示/人格条件下的概念显著性，将开放式LLM同质化问题转化为可诊断的测量问题。
AI.motivation: 开放式LLM同质化会造成"虚假多元性"：多个系统看似提供独立视角，实则返回相同的默认答案。单轮回答难以区分这种一致是源于受限答案空间、提示词回声，还是背后存在稳定替代项的更广答案空间。
AI.method: CHOIR（Collective Hierarchically-Ordered Inquiry Responses）将自由列举引出法适配到LLM集成：反复引出排序列表，将条目聚类为提示级概念，并在模型、提示变体和人格条件下测量概念显著性。在Infinity-Chat 100外部提示库和27题针对性诊断库上评估，并引入来源盲排序模块识别稀有但稳定的候选。
AI.result: 在Infinity-Chat 100上复现高表面一致性（100个提示中93个高于随机水平），同时区分出狭窄提示与具有可恢复深度的宽泛提示；基础模型身份仍是最强的可恢复特征，人格提示在基础模型特征内改变表面概念；来源盲排序模块能优选出稀有但稳定的候选。
AI.conclusion: CHOIR把开放式同质化转变为诊断性测量问题，追问模型在哪里收敛、为何收敛，以及在结构化深度探测下哪些答案仍然可达。

title: Curating Synthetic Data for Task-Specific Visual Perception
summary: Synthetic data are most valuable where general-purpose datasets cannot provide the domain-specific priors a task requires, and where manual annotation is expensive, imprecise, or infeasible. In this article we argue that the central question for specialized vision systems is not how to generate more data, but which data to generate. We therefore discuss curated synthetic data, whose scene content, appearance variations, sensing characteristics, and annotations are deliberately designed around a given task. We examine three complementary curation paradigms. Procedural rendering offers explicit control over scene parameters and the annotations follow by construction. Physically-based simulation encodes the mechanism behind an observed effect and yields exactly aligned supervision pairs. Generative AI learns sensor-specific appearance from small real seed sets and attains plausible realism, though it remains prone to hallucination and to inaccurate annotation. These paradigms are illustrated with examples from industrial surface defect detection, restoration of degraded digitized autochrome plates, and 6DoF pose estimation from RGB and event data. Using these examples, we analyze different data regimes and training strategies that combine synthetic and real data across these paradigms. We conclude that curated synthetic data are best understood as a complement to real observations, and that hybrid pipelines combining controllable supervision with learned appearance are the most promising direction for reliable sim-to-real transfer.

AI.tldr: 本文主张专业视觉系统的核心问题不是"生成更多数据"，而是"生成哪些数据"，并系统讨论了面向任务的"策划型合成数据"及其三种范式。
AI.motivation: 通用数据集无法提供特定任务所需的领域先验，而人工标注昂贵、不精确或不可行；因此合成数据在专业视觉任务中价值巨大，但重点应从数据数量转向数据的选择与设计。
AI.method: 提出"策划型合成数据"概念，即围绕特定任务刻意设计场景内容、外观变化、传感特性与标注；并梳理三种互补范式：程序化渲染（显式控制场景参数、标注天然生成）、基于物理的仿真（编码效应机理、产生精确对齐的监督对）、生成式AI（从小规模真实种子集学习传感器特定外观，真实感强但易幻觉、标注不准）。
AI.result: 通过工业表面缺陷检测、退化数字化彩色干版修复、以及基于RGB与事件数据的6DoF位姿估计三个案例进行验证，分析了不同数据体制以及合成与真实数据结合的多种训练策略。
AI.conclusion: 策划型合成数据应被理解为真实观测的补充；将可控监督与学习到的外观相结合的混合流水线，是实现可靠sim-to-real迁移最有前景的方向。

title: Which Tasks Survive Self-Supervised Learning?
summary: Same-instance self-supervised learning (SSL) learns representations by enforcing consistency across two views of the same underlying instance. This principle alone, however, does not determine which downstream tasks remain recoverable from the learned representation. We study this question through \emph{semantic recoverability}, defined as the amount of a task's posterior score captured by the represented function space. We show that, for centered and whitened representations, recoverability exactly determines directional class-distance-normalized variance (CDNV), controls few-shot nearest-centroid classification, and governs the strength of task-relevant semantic directions. The population linear probe and centroid axis coincide, and multiple well-recovered tasks approach a factorial centroid geometry. We then analyze a canonical two-view SSL objective and show that its population optimum spans the leading cross-view-stable modes of the associated two-view operator. This yields a closed-form spectral characterization of semantic recoverability: a downstream task is preserved to the extent that its posterior lies in the selected spectral subspace. We validate these predictions on synthetic and real datasets across several SSL methods, testing the predicted relationships among recoverability, directional geometry, spectral structure, and few-shot transfer. Together, these results give a task-level account of what information survives same-instance SSL and how the retained information appears in downstream geometry and transfer.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"语义可恢复性"概念，用谱方法刻画同实例自监督学习(SSL)保留了下游任务的哪些信息。
AI.motivation: 同实例SSL通过强制同一实例两个视图的一致性来学习表示，但该原则本身无法确定哪些下游任务可从学到的表示中恢复。
AI.method: 定义语义可恢复性为任务后验被表示函数空间捕获的程度；对中心化白化表示，证明可恢复性决定方向CDNV、控制少样本最近质心分类、支配任务相关语义方向强度；分析典型两视图SSL目标的总体最优解，给出闭式谱刻画。
AI.result: 可恢复性恰好决定方向CDNV，总体线性探针与质心轴重合，多个恢复良好的任务趋向因子化质心几何；SSL目标总体最优张成两视图算子的前导跨视图稳定模态。
AI.conclusion: 给出了任务层面说明：同实例SSL保留何种信息，以及保留信息如何体现在下游几何与迁移中。

title: PrivMeSA: Privacy-Aware Self-Evolving Multi-Agent System for Medicine via Local-Remote LLM Collaboration
summary: Clinical large language model (LLM) agents deployed locally can consult more capable remote models, but doing so risks exposing patient information. Privacy-conscious delegation places disclosure decisions with a local agent, yet removing explicit identifiers is insufficient: quasi-identifiers can accumulate across multi-turn consultations and repeated patient visits to enable re-identification. We introduce PrivMeSA, a privacy-aware self-evolving multi-agent system that learns to control disclosure and retains remote expertise for local reuse. A local agent manages each encounter and consults remote specialists that may request additional information. Reinforcement learning balances task accuracy against direct disclosure and registry-based re-identification risk, with privacy evaluated over the complete outbound transcript of each encounter. A local lesson memory distills completed consultations into generalized clinical guidance and retrieves relevant lessons before transmission, allowing subsequent cases to reuse expertise without another remote exchange. Memory grows without additional outcome labels or parameter updates. On an emergency-department benchmark built from MIMIC-IV-ED records, PrivMeSA improves mean task accuracy over delegation by up to 15.8 percentage points. In the same setting, PrivMeSA reduces the disclosure of personal details from 98.0% to 0.2% of cases and the share of cases in which the patient can be narrowed to ten or fewer registry patients from 74% to 0%.

AI.tldr: PrivMeSA：一种隐私感知的自演化多智能体系统，通过学习控制信息披露并复用远程专家知识，在保证本地隐私的同时提升临床任务准确率。
AI.motivation: 本地部署的临床大模型智能体可咨询更强的远程模型，但会暴露患者信息。仅移除显式标识符不够，准标识符在多轮咨询和重复就诊中会累积，导致重识别风险。需要在本地智能体层面做出披露决策。
AI.method: 提出 PrivMeSA 多智能体系统：本地智能体管理每次诊疗并咨询远程专家；用强化学习在任务准确率、直接披露风险和基于登记库的重识别风险之间权衡，隐私在完整外发对话记录上评估；本地经验记忆将完成的咨询蒸馏为泛化临床指导，在传输前检索相关经验，使后续病例无需再次远程交换即可复用知识，记忆无需额外结果标签或参数更新。
AI.result: 在基于 MIMIC-IV-ED 构建的急诊科基准上，相比委托方式，PrivMeSA 的平均任务准确率提升最高达 15.8 个百分点；个人细节披露从 98.0% 降至 0.2%；可将患者缩小到十个或更少登记库患者的比例从 74% 降至 0%。
AI.conclusion: PrivMeSA 证明了隐私感知的披露控制与本地经验复用可同时显著降低重识别风险并提升任务表现，为本地临床智能体安全利用远程模型能力提供了可行方案。

title: Caption-Mediated Perceived-Safety Estimation for Pedestrian Routing
summary: This paper presents an explainable approach to pedestrian routing, in which perceived safety is estimated from street-level imagery through an explicit natural-language intermediate representation. A vision--language model caption is generated and stored before any scoring is undertaken, and the perceived-risk class is derived entirely from structured features of that stored text, so that every segment score remains inspectable by the user. Nine captioning conditions across five model families are benchmarked against a direct Contrastive Language--Image Pre-training (CLIP) image-embedding baseline under an identical downstream pipeline, and the caption-mediated representation is found to reach parity with the image embedding rather than to trail it. The approach was deployed over 654,115 images covering 36 electoral wards in two locations in Northern England (Manchester and Huddersfield). Independent field validation against 3,669 locally collected ratings of 494 images across 70 participant sessions established agreement that is statistically significant but modest, at $r=0.262$, against a measured noise ceiling of 0.737 imposed by disagreement between raters. A single-use confirmatory test then found that a pipeline 44\% stronger on the supervised benchmark did not produce measurable improvement in the field ($r=0.250$, $p=0.84$), so the benchmark gains did not predict the deployment gains in this case. Routing behaviour varies systematically with journey length. There is negligible change below 1\,km, reaching a median increase of 12.78\% in low-risk route length for a median detour of 2.73\% on journeys of 3 to 6 km.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种可解释的行人路径规划方法，通过自然语言中间表示从街景图像估计感知安全性，并在大规模部署与实地验证中考察其有效性与基准-落地差距。
AI.motivation: 行人路径规划需要感知安全性评分，但直接使用图像嵌入的模型缺乏可检查性；作者希望用显式的自然语言中间表示让每一段评分都能被用户审查，同时检验这种可解释表示是否会在性能上落后于黑箱图像嵌入基线。
AI.method: 先生成并存储视觉-语言模型的图像描述，再完全从该存储文本的结构化特征推导感知风险类别，保证评分可审查。在相同下游流程下，比较五个模型家族的九种描述条件与直接CLIP图像嵌入基线。部署覆盖英格兰北部两地（曼彻斯特与哈德斯菲尔德）36个选区的654,115张图像。用70个参与者会话、494张图像的3,669条本地评分做独立实地验证（噪声上限0.737）。再做单次确认性测试，检验在监督基准上强44%的流程是否带来实地提升。
AI.result: 描述中介表示达到与图像嵌入基线相当的水平，而非落后。实地验证相关性r=0.262，统计显著但中等偏弱，相对噪声上限0.737仍有差距。监督基准上强44%的流程在实地未产生可测量提升（r=0.250，p=0.84），基准收益未能预测部署收益。路径行为随行程长度系统性变化：1 km以下变化可忽略；3-6 km行程中，低风险路径长度中位数增加12.78%，对应绕行中位数2.73%。
AI.conclusion: 可解释的自然语言中间表示在感知安全行人路径规划中可与图像嵌入持平，但监督基准的提升不能可靠迁移到真实部署场景，提示需以实地验证而非基准分数评估此类系统，且绕行代价随行程长度非线性增长。

title: Disagreement-Regularized Imitation Learning for Image-Based Continuous Control with Gaussian and Beta Policies
summary: Purpose: Behavior cloning can accumulate errors when a learned controller visits states outside the demonstrated distribution. This study evaluates whether Disagreement-Regularized Imitation Learning (DRIL), which converts disagreement among cloned policies into a reinforcement-learning reward, improves image-based continuous control. Methods: A controlled CarRacing study combines Gaussian and Beta learner policies, demonstrations from either a clipped Gaussian expert or an intrinsically bounded Beta expert, one or 20 trajectories, deterministic and stochastic evaluation, and three retained stages: behavior cloning, the highest 10-episode training-score checkpoint, and the final DRIL checkpoint. The disagreement ensemble contains five Gaussian policies in every variant. Each retained policy is evaluated over 100 procedurally generated episodes. Results: Score-selected DRIL produced its largest gains in the few-demonstration setting, improving over the strongest behavior-cloning mean by 61% with clipped-action demonstrations and by 112% with bounded-action demonstrations. With 20 trajectories, the advantage of DRIL narrowed; in the bounded-action regime, Beta behavior cloning remained about 7% above the best DRIL checkpoint. The experiments also show that the informativeness of the disagreement reward changes with the learner representation and training stage. Conclusion: DRIL can substantially improve few-demonstration visual continuous control, while bounded Beta policies provide strong behavior-cloning performance when more demonstrations are available. The results highlight the joint importance of learner support,ensemble response, and checkpoint selection.

AI.tldr: 本研究在CarRacing图像连续控制任务中系统评估DRIL，发现分歧正则化在少样本演示时显著提升模仿学习性能，但演示增多后优势收窄，说明学习器支撑、集成响应与检查点选择共同决定成败。
AI.motivation: 行为克隆在控制器进入演示分布之外的状态时会累积误差，因此需要一种能利用策略间分歧进行强化学习奖励的机制（DRIL）来缓解该问题，但其在图像连续控制中的有效性尚不明确。
AI.method: 采用受控CarRacing实验，结合高斯与Beta学习器策略、来自裁剪高斯专家或内在有界Beta专家的演示、1条或20条轨迹、确定性与随机评估，并保留行为克隆、训练得分最高的10回合检查点和最终DRIL检查点三个阶段；分歧集成始终包含五个高斯策略，每个保留策略在100个程序生成回合上评估。
AI.result: 得分选择的DRIL在少样本设置中收益最大，相比最强行为克隆均值分别提升61%（裁剪动作演示）和112%（有界动作演示）；20条轨迹时DRIL优势收窄，有界动作情形下Beta行为克隆仍比最佳DRIL检查点高约7%；分歧奖励的信息量随学习器表示和训练阶段而变化。
AI.conclusion: DRIL能显著改善少样本视觉连续控制；当演示更多时，有界Beta策略可提供强大的行为克隆性能，研究强调学习器支撑、集成响应与检查点选择的联合重要性。

title: NAQD Env: A benchmark for selective withdrawal in language agents
comment: 16 pages. Code and evaluation artifacts: https://github.com/abouzamm/naqd
summary: Language agents must revise planned actions when evidence changes, permission is revoked, or a stop instruction arrives. A useful response is selective: suspend affected actions, preserve unaffected work, and resume only after sufficient repair. We introduce NAQD-Env, a synthetic environment that evaluates these decisions against a deterministic reference policy over explicit evidence, authorization, and constraint dependencies. Eleven dependency families support evaluation on development structures, held-out families, and held-out combinations of structures. Metrics distinguish attempted violations from violations permitted by a simulated execution gate and jointly report policy agreement, task value, withdrawal, resumption, and event reporting. We evaluate three open-weight instruction-tuned models from two families under three prompt conditions on 350 frozen scenarios, yielding 3,150 model-prompt episodes before gate replay. Across the reported conditions, withdrawal recall is at most 0.06, no valid resumption is observed at eligible opportunities, and only one episode matches the complete reference policy. Under the NAQD prompt, Qwen2.5-7B has fewer unsafe-attempt episodes than Qwen2.5-3B and Llama-3.1-8B, but also completes less useful work and preserves unaffected actions less accurately. Exploratory supervised fine-tuning probes increase Qwen2.5-3B decision accuracy from 0.45-0.54 to 0.83-0.92; separate diagnostics reveal inappropriate withdrawal after curriculum omissions and a loss of event reporting. These results motivate evaluating selective withdrawal as a distinct component of agent reliability. The setting measures policy application with trusted structured inputs and does not establish real-world containment or source-verification ability.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 NAQD-Env 合成环境，评估语言智能体在证据变化、权限撤销或停止指令下进行选择性撤回（暂停受影响动作、保留无关工作、充分修复后恢复）的能力。对三个开放权重模型在 350 个场景、三种提示条件下评测 3,150 个 episode，结果显示撤回召回率最高仅 0.06，无有效恢复，仅 1 个 episode 完全符合参考策略。
AI.motivation: 语言智能体需要在证据变化、权限被撤销或收到停止指令时修订已规划的动作。理想的响应应是选择性的：暂停受影响动作、保留不受影响的工作、并在充分修复后才恢复。然而现有评测缺乏对这类"选择性撤回"决策的显式、可判定评估手段，作者认为它应被视为智能体可靠性的独立组成部分。
AI.method: 构建 NAQD-Env 合成环境，基于显式的证据、授权与约束依赖关系，用确定性参考策略评估智能体决策。包含 11 个依赖族，支持在开发结构、留出族及留出结构组合上评测。指标区分"尝试违规"与"经模拟执行门允许的违规"，并联合报告策略一致性、任务价值、撤回、恢复与事件报告。对来自两个家族的三个开放权重指令微调模型，在三种提示条件下运行 350 个冻结场景，得到 3,150 个 model-prompt episode（执行门重放前），并进行探索性监督微调探针。
AI.result: 在所报告条件下，撤回召回率最高仅 0.06，在所有符合条件的时机均未观察到有效恢复，仅一个 episode 完全匹配参考策略。在 NAQD 提示下，Qwen2.5-7B 的不安全尝试 episode 少于 Qwen2.5-3B 和 Llama-3.1-8B，但完成的有用工作更少，保留不受影响动作的准确性也更低。探索性监督微调将 Qwen2.5-3B 的决策准确率从 0.45-0.54 提升至 0.83-0.92；单独诊断揭示课程遗漏后出现不恰当的撤回，以及事件报告能力的丧失。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持将选择性撤回作为智能体可靠性的一个独立组件来评估。该设置使用可信结构化输入衡量策略应用能力，并不确立真实世界中的遏制能力或来源验证能力。

title: Beyond Layers: Position-Resolved Gradient Conflict and Position-Aware Modulation for Unified Multimodal Models
comment: 20 pages, 10 figures, 6 tables. Code will be made publicly available upon acceptance
summary: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) train image understanding and autoregressive image generation on shared parameters, and the two objectives are known to interfere. Existing diagnoses and remedies operate at the resolution of layers or experts, measuring conflict per layer and resolving it by separating parameters. We argue that this resolution hides an orthogonal axis. Generation in a UMM is next-token prediction over a raster sequence of visual tokens whose roles vary systematically with position, so how strongly a generation gradient interferes with understanding should depend on where in the sequence it originates. We introduce a position-resolved interference map that attributes understanding-generation gradient conflict to visual-token positions within every layer, computed from a single backward pass at $1.2\times$ the cost of a standard backward pass. On Show-o and Janus-Pro, position explains a large share of conflict variance after controlling for depth (partial $η^2=0.31$ vs. $0.35$ for layer on Show-o; $0.15$ vs. $0.30$ on Janus-Pro): the first quarter of the sequence has a mean gradient cosine of $-0.18$ against understanding, the last quarter $-0.02$. The dependence survives per-position gradient-norm normalization, retaining $80%$ of its effect size, and conflict strength tracks semantic content (Spearman $ρ=0.64$). Building on the map, we propose position-aware modulation (PAM), which removes the anti-aligned component of generation gradients only at high-conflict positions without changing the architecture. Under a matched trainable-parameter budget, PAM improves over layer-wise separation by $+21$ MME and $+2.4$ GenEval points on Show-o while matching it on POPE and overall FID; a random-position control recovers about $31%$ of the gain. Position-based and layer-based separation are complementary degrees of freedom and can be combined.

AI.tldr: 本文提出位置分辨的干扰图，揭示统一多模态模型中理解-生成梯度冲突随视觉token位置系统性变化，并提出位置感知调制（PAM）缓解冲突。
AI.motivation: 统一多模态模型（UMMs）在共享参数上同时训练图像理解与自回归图像生成，两个目标相互干扰。已有的诊断与修复方法都在层或专家的粒度上操作，测量每层冲突并通过分离参数来解决。作者认为这种粒度掩盖了一个正交的维度：生成是在视觉token的栅格序列上做下一token预测，而这些token的角色随位置系统性变化，因此生成梯度对理解的干扰强度应取决于其起源于序列中的位置。
AI.method: 1）提出位置分辨的干扰图，将理解-生成梯度冲突归因到每一层内视觉token的具体位置，仅需一次反向传播即可计算，成本为标准反向传播的1.2倍。2）在Show-o和Janus-Pro上验证位置对冲突方差的解释力。3）基于该图提出位置感知调制（PAM），仅在高冲突位置移除生成梯度中与理解反对齐的分量，且不改变架构。
AI.result: 在Show-o和Janus-Pro上，控制深度后位置解释了冲突方差的很大份额（Show-o部分η²=0.31，层为0.35；Janus-Pro为0.15对0.30）：序列前四分之一对理解的梯度余弦均值为-0.18，后四分之一为-0.02。该依赖性在逐位置梯度范数归一化后依然存在，保留了80%的效应量，且冲突强度与语义内容相关（Spearman ρ=0.64）。在匹配可训练参数预算下，PAM在Show-o上相比逐层分离提升+21 MME和+2.4 GenEval，同时在POPE和整体FID上与之持平；随机位置对照仅恢复约31%的增益。
AI.conclusion: 位置是理解-生成梯度冲突的一个独立且重要的自由度，位置分辨的干扰图能有效定位高冲突位置。基于该图的PAM在参数预算匹配下优于逐层分离。基于位置与基于层的分离是互补的自由度，可以结合使用。

title: Synthesis Without Training: An Inference-Only Pipeline for Tabular, Temporal, and Relational Synthetic Data
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 workshop: Beyond Private Training: The New Landscape of AI Privacy
summary: Synthetic data generation is dominated by the fit-then-sample paradigm: a generative model is trained on a private dataset and then sampled from. Despite its widespread adoption, this paradigm faces three challenges: (1) a new training run is required for every dataset; (2) different data modalities, such as single tables, time series, and relational databases, require task-specific models and feature engineering; and (3) the resulting model is opaque, making its behavior under data constraints difficult to inspect. We propose GENSCRIPT, an inference-only pipeline that eliminates model training. GENSCRIPT computes a deterministic statistical profile of the source data (column types, ranges, missingness, categories, correlations, etc.) and passes it--rather than raw rows--to a language model to infer field semantics and cross-column integrity constraints. A coding agent then compiles the profile and constraints into an executable, auditable sampler. This unified approach supports single-table, temporal, and relational data without task-specific modeling. Across four single-table benchmarks, GENSCRIPT builds generators in 2 minutes and samples 50k rows within 6 seconds, while remaining within a few points of leading methods in marginal fidelity. Notably, it is the only method that perfectly preserves a 1-to-1 mapping between columns in the Adult dataset. On a smart-building dataset, it produces conditional time series that more closely match the real distribution than two baselines and perfectly preserves primary- and foreign-key relationships in the corresponding relational database.

AI.tldr: GENSCRIPT提出一种无需训练的推理式合成数据生成流程：用语言模型从统计画像推断语义与完整性约束，再由编码代理编译成可执行、可审计的采样器，统一支持单表、时序和关系数据。
AI.motivation: 主流"先拟合再采样"范式存在三方面问题：每个数据集都需重新训练；不同模态（单表、时序、关系数据库）需专门模型与特征工程；模型不透明，难以在数据约束下检查其行为。
AI.method: GENSCRIPT 仅做推理、不训练模型。它先计算源数据的确定性统计画像（列类型、取值范围、缺失情况、类别、相关性等），将该画像而非原始行输入语言模型，以推断字段语义与跨列完整性约束；随后由编码代理把画像和约束编译成可执行、可审计的采样器。该统一方案无需任务特定建模即可支持单表、时序与关系数据。
AI.result: 在四个单表基准上，2分钟内即可构建生成器，6秒内采样5万行，边缘保真度与领先方法相差仅几个百分点；是唯一在 Adult 数据集上完美保持列间一对一映射的方法。在智能建筑数据集上，生成的条件下时序比两个基线更贴近真实分布，并在对应的关系数据库中完美保持主键与外键关系。
AI.conclusion: 通过将统计画像与约束交给语言模型推断并由编码代理编译成可审计采样器，GENSCRIPT 以无需训练的统一方式实现了跨单表、时序和关系数据的合成数据生成，在效率与结构保真度上表现突出。

title: VAmoS Part Deux: Harder, More Realistic Voice-Agent Simulation
comment: 13 pages, 3 figures, 7 tables. Agent implementations: https://github.com/veris-ai/rory-agent
summary: Voice agents in production must handle several requests, background speech, and customers who lose patience. We introduce VAmoS Energy, a benchmark that combines these challenges in 100 calls about utility billing and payment assistance. Each caller makes two to four requests. The agent has sixteen tools backed by a stateful Stripe billing twin and the Apache Fineract loan engine, with account access blocked until caller verification succeeds. The tasks use public household electricity data and a policy based on Pennsylvania's residential billing rules. An LLM-as-a-verifier checks the agent's actions and spoken figures against explicit requirements. On a calibration run, it agrees with a code verifier on 99.1% of checks. Across fourteen voice stacks and three repeats per task, completion ranges from 17.3% to 44.7%. Grok Voice leads, and Gemini 3.8 Live and GPT-Live follow at about the same cost per call. Background television reduces pooled completion from 38.7% to 8.6%. The simulated caller often accepts an incorrect result because it hears the agent's words but cannot inspect its actions. These findings show why voice agents need evaluation across the whole call, including what they say, what they change, and how they handle competing speech.

AI.tldr: 提出 VAmoS Energy 基准，在 100 通公用事业账单与缴费语音通话中同时考察多请求、背景语音与用户耐心下降，发现 14 个语音栈完成率仅 17.3%–44.7%，背景电视使完成率从 38.7% 骤降至 8.6%。
AI.motivation: 生产环境中的语音代理需同时处理多个请求、背景人声以及失去耐心的用户，但现有评测未将这些挑战结合起来，也难以核查代理"说了什么"与"做了什么"是否一致。
AI.method: 构建含 100 通通话的 VAmoS Energy 基准，每通含 2–4 个请求；代理有 16 个工具，后端为有状态 Stripe 账单孪生与 Apache Fineract 贷款引擎，须通过来电者验证才能访问账户；任务采用公开家庭用电数据与基于宾夕法尼亚居民计费规则的政策；用 LLM-as-a-verifier 对照显式要求核查动作与口播数字，并给出与代码验证器的一致性校准。
AI.result: 校准运行中 LLM 验证器与代码验证器在 99.1% 的检查项上一致；跨 14 个语音栈、每任务 3 次重复，完成率为 17.3%–44.7%，Grok Voice 领先，Gemini 3.8 Live 与 GPT-Live 紧随且单次通话成本相近；背景电视使合并完成率由 38.7% 降至 8.6%；模拟来电者常因只听到代理话语而无法核查其动作，从而接受错误结果。
AI.conclusion: 语音代理需在整通通话层面进行评测，覆盖其所说内容、所做系统变更以及对竞争性语音的处理能力。

title: Multidimensional Observer Model and Perceptual Dimensions of Human Image Quality Assessment
summary: Judging image quality is not only ecologically relevant to everyday human tasks, but also underpins many machine vision tasks such as image generation. This paper proposes a framework to understand the inherent perceptual space underlying image quality judgment in humans. We propose a multi-dimensional observer model that represents images as distributions in a latent perceptual space and that models human judgment as comparing noisy samples. Being constrained by neural representations in the primate ventral stream and fit to large-scale behavioral data, the model enables analysis of perceptual structure while matching the predictive power of existing metrics. Using this model, we find that the perceptual spaces needed to account for image quality judgment in humans are extremely low-dimensional compared to the image space even when considering its sparsity. The exact structure of the space (e.g., dimensionalities, information encoded) varies between low-level and high-level quality judgments, suggesting that, despite a shared retinal encoding in the beginning, humans selectively construct task-dependent perceptual spaces in visual decision making.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个多维观察者模型，将图像表示为潜在感知空间中的分布，并将人类图像质量判断建模为对带噪样本的比较，从而揭示人类图像质量判断背后的感知空间结构。
AI.motivation: 图像质量判断既与人类日常任务密切相关，也是图像生成等机器视觉任务的基础。作者希望理解人类进行图像质量判断时所依赖的内在感知空间结构，而不仅仅是拟合预测性能。
AI.method: 提出多维观察者模型：将图像表示为潜在感知空间中的分布，并将人类判断建模为对带噪样本的比较；模型受灵长类腹侧流神经表征约束，并拟合大规模行为数据。
AI.result: 该模型在预测能力上可与现有指标相匹配，同时能用于分析感知结构。分析发现，解释人类图像质量判断所需的感知空间维度极低，即便考虑图像空间的稀疏性也是如此。
AI.conclusion: 感知空间的具体结构（如维度、所编码信息）在低层与高层质量判断之间存在差异，表明尽管起始阶段共享视网膜编码，人类在视觉决策中会有选择地构建任务依赖的感知空间。

title: Graph Anomaly Detection as Finite-Horizon Control: Training-Free Scoring via Empirical Bayes
summary: Node-level graph anomaly detection (GAD) identifies nodes whose attributes and interactions deviate from dominant graph regularities. Existing GAD models encode normality and anomaly scoring indirectly through architectures, message passing, reconstruction or contrastive objectives, and tuned score families. This entangles graph trust (how strongly graph structure should define normality), graph-spectral weighting, and anomaly-score choice, yielding scores that are costly, opaque, and unstable across graph regimes. We propose EB-GAD (Empirical-Bayes GAD), a training-free framework that models normality as graph-aware generalized Ornstein-Uhlenbeck (GOU) relaxation toward a graph-filtered template. Empirical Bayes fits the graph precision from the residual-field likelihood; the GOU then turns scoring into a closed-form finite-horizon control energy, the minimum effort to steer a feature-neutral node to its observed endpoint along graph-spectral relaxation. Sweeping relaxation horizon and endpoint tolerance yields a bank of scores that share one fitted prior: equilibrium Mahalanobis scoring is one limit, while finite-horizon control-energy and scale-normalized ratio scores reveal anomalies that static equilibrium scoring can mask. A label-free selector chooses the score family from feature homophily, edge density, and feature dimension, then ranks candidates by fitted-null deviation and rank stability. On 11 benchmarks and without labels at any step, EB-GAD has the best or tied-best AUROC on 9: the four financial fraud networks (up to 3.7M nodes), the YelpChi and Amazon review graphs, Weibo, Reddit and Facebook, with margins of up to 21.7 points. It is second on BlogCatalog and ACM.

AI.tldr: EB-GAD是一种无需训练的节点级图异常检测框架，将正态性建模为图感知广义Ornstein-Uhlenbeck松弛，把异常打分转化为闭式有限时域控制能量，在11个基准上无标签取得9个最优/并列最优AUROC。
AI.motivation: 现有图异常检测模型通过架构、消息传递、重构或对比损失间接编码正态性与打分，将图信任度、图谱加权与异常分数选择纠缠在一起，导致分数代价高、不透明且在跨图场景下不稳定。作者希望解耦这些因素，得到一种训练免费、可解释且稳定的打分方式。
AI.method: 提出EB-GAD：将正态性建模为向图滤波模板的图感知广义Ornstein-Uhlenbeck（GOU）松弛。用经验贝叶斯从残差场似然中拟合图精度；GOU将打分转化为闭式有限时域控制能量，即沿图谱松弛把特征中性节点引导到观测端点所需的最小努力。对松弛时域和端点容差扫描得到共享同一拟合先验的一组分数（平衡Mahalanobis打分为其一极限）。再用无标签选择器依据特征同质性、边密度与特征维度选分数族，并按拟合零假设偏差与秩稳定性对候选排序。
AI.result: 在11个基准上且全程不使用标签，EB-GAD在9个数据集上取得最优或并列最优AUROC：四个金融欺诈网络（最多3.7M节点）、YelpChi、Amazon评论图、Weibo、Reddit与Facebook，优势最高达21.7个点；在BlogCatalog与ACM上排名第二。
AI.conclusion: EB-GAD表明无需训练、基于经验贝叶斯与图谱松弛的控制能量打分可在多类图上稳定且高效地检测节点异常，并优于现有方法。该框架将图信任、图谱加权与打分选择解耦，提供可解释、低成本的统一打分视角。

title: Demographic Pluralism: Inference-Time Modeling of Pluralistic Human Preference Distributions
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in culturally sensitive settings, where alignment requires representing diverse preferences within populations. Yet existing methods model populations at coarse demographic or community levels and overlook within-group variation. We introduce Demographic Pluralism, an inference-time framework that estimates population-level opinion distributions without opinion-distribution training data or task-specific fine-tuning by generating multiple perspectives within demographically grounded groups. Across four backbones on GlobalOpinionQA and VITAL, it reduces Jensen-Shannon distance by 8.4%-26.4% over Modular Pluralism. Among weighted, equal-weighted, and inverse-weighted aggregation, equal weighting performs best overall; group-level error also increases with group weight, helping explain weighted aggregation's weaker performance.

AI.tldr: 提出Demographic Pluralism框架，在推理阶段通过人口学分组内生成多元视角来估计群体意见分布，无需意见分布训练数据或任务微调。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在粗粒度的人口或社区层面建模群体，忽略了群体内部差异，难以在文化敏感场景中表征多样偏好。
AI.method: 一个推理时框架：在基于人口学的分组内部生成多元视角，从而估计群体层面的意见分布，无需意见分布训练数据，也无需任务特定微调；并比较加权、等权、逆加权三种聚合方式。
AI.result: 在GlobalOpinionQA和VITAL上、四种骨干模型下，相比Modular Pluralism将Jensen-Shannon距离降低8.4%-26.4%；三种聚合方式中等权整体表现最佳；群体误差随群体权重增加而上升。
AI.conclusion: 关注群体内部差异有助于更准确地估计人口意见分布，且等权聚合优于加权聚合。

title: GazeFlow: From Human Gaze Behavior to Generative Egocentric Gaze Prediction
summary: Egocentric gaze prediction enables many downstream applications but remains challenging, as human gaze is inherently stochastic. This stochasticity is constrained by structured temporal dynamics alternating between fixations and saccades, top-down influences from tasks, and bottom-up visual saliency. Based on this observation, we introduce GazeFlow, a framework that directly models gaze as a joint distribution of temporal gaze positions conditioned upon both top-down and bottom-up information. In particular, GazeFlow uses conditional flow matching (CFM): a learned velocity field iteratively transports a Gaussian noise sample into a plausible gaze trajectory drawn from this joint distribution. The velocity field is conditioned on bottom-up visual features extracted by a video encoder and on top-down task information obtained by globally querying these features. On standard datasets, GazeFlow achieves state-of-the-art performance on per-frame metrics, and the generated trajectories align better with human gaze temporal dynamics.

AI.tldr: 提出GazeFlow框架，以条件流匹配将视线建模为受自上而下任务信息与自下而上视觉显著性约束的联合分布，实现自我中心视线预测。
AI.motivation: 自我中心视线预测在多领域有应用价值，但人类视线本身具有随机性，难以预测。这种随机性并非无规律，而是受注视与眼跳交替的时间动态、任务驱动的自上而下影响、以及视觉显著性驱动的自下而上影响共同约束。现有方法未能直接对这种受约束的联合分布建模。
AI.method: GazeFlow直接建模视线为以自上而下与自下而上信息为条件的时序视线位置联合分布，采用条件流匹配（CFM）：学习一个速度场，迭代地将高斯噪声样本输运为该联合分布下的一条合理视线轨迹。速度场以视频编码器提取的自下而上视觉特征为条件，并通过全局查询这些特征获得的自上而下任务信息为条件。
AI.result: 在标准数据集上，GazeFlow在逐帧指标上达到当前最优性能，且生成的轨迹与人类视线的时间动态更加吻合。
AI.conclusion: 将视线视为受任务与显著性条件约束的联合分布并用条件流匹配建模，是提升自我中心视线预测精度与时间动态一致性的有效途径。

title: What Pretraining and Midtraining Make Learnable from Rewards?
summary: A reward can identify a correct answer while leaving the computation needed for new inputs undetermined. We study how pretraining and midtraining supply the information and computation that make reward adaptation effective. In sequential state computation and contextual memory, we characterize mechanisms that agree on every training reward yet demand different held-out answers. Task-independent source observations resolve this ambiguity. We construct finite sampled Adam paths from specified random initializations through source prediction and reward adaptation in the same parameters, proving how prediction acquires execution or retrieval and rewards learn their task-specific use. Experiments with pretrained Qwen2.5 checkpoints test this division of labor. Across eight worlds, Sequential models trained with correct source and first-operation supervision reach 82.61% success, versus 44.15% for a private-random source control. Memory replay preserves retrieval during reward adaptation, and an independent eight-world confirmation achieves 75.32% task success versus 49.86% after matched alternative-retrieval training. GSM8K and HotpotQA separate accuracy at reward entry, subsequent gain and final performance. Together, these results connect information acquisition, executable computation and reward-guided task learning.

AI.tldr: 论文研究预训练与中训练如何为奖励适应提供信息与计算，通过序贯状态计算与情境记忆机制分析，并用Qwen2.5实验验证“预测获取执行/检索、奖励学习任务特定用法”的分工。
AI.motivation: 奖励信号只能标识正确答案，却无法确定新输入所需的计算过程。作者希望厘清预训练与中训练如何提供使奖励适应有效的信息与计算基础，并区分预测所获得的执行或检索能力与奖励所学的任务特定用法。
AI.method: 在序贯状态计算与情境记忆两类设定中，刻画在全部训练奖励上一致但留出答案不同的机制，用任务无关的源观测消解歧义。构造从指定随机初始化出发、经源预测与奖励适应、共享同一参数的有限采样Adam路径，并在预训练Qwen2.5检查点上进行八世界实验，含正确源与首操作监督、私有随机源对照、记忆回放及独立八世界确认，另在GSM8K与HotpotQA上分析奖励进入时的准确率、后续增益与最终表现。
AI.result: 八个世界中，采用正确源与首操作监督的Sequential模型成功率达82.61%，私有随机源对照仅44.15%；记忆回放在奖励适应中保持检索能力，独立八世界确认达75.32%，匹配的替代检索训练为49.86%。GSM8K与HotpotQA在奖励进入点、后续增益和最终性能上呈现分离。
AI.conclusion: 信息获取、可执行计算与奖励引导的任务学习三者相互关联：源预测提供执行或检索能力，奖励在此基础上学习任务特定用法，从而解释奖励适应的有效性来源。

title: Defining and Categorising Human-AI Interactions in Clinical Trials: A Multidimensional Human-AI Classification Approach
summary: This paper examines human-AI interactions (HAIIs) in clinical trials and presents a multidimensional categorisation framework that classifies interactions according to AI tasks, human-AI relationships, interaction configurations and interacting human groups. We define HAII, examine existing taxonomies and extend existing categorisation approaches through this novel multidimensional framework. We purposively sampled 15 clinical trials from a previously reported dataset. Each trial was independently categorised by two human reviewers and six large language model (LLM) classifiers. The proposed categorisation provides a structured method for the consistent identification, comparison and synthesis of human-AI interactions across clinical-trial records. The framework is intended to support more consistent comparison and synthesis of AI-related clinical trials and to make explicit the different forms of human involvement associated with AI interventions. The results demonstrate the potential for LLM-assisted categorisation while indicating the continuing importance of human judgement where trial records are incomplete or ambiguous. The principal contribution is a proposed multidimensional framework that brings together AI tasks, human-AI relationships, interaction configurations and interacting human groups within a single approach designed for clinical-trial records. Its significance lies in its potential to support more systematic identification, comparison and synthesis of how humans and AI interact in clinical trials.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个多维度框架，用于对临床试验中的人机交互（HAII）进行分类，涵盖AI任务、人机关系、交互配置和交互人群四个维度，并通过15项试验的人工与LLM分类验证其可行性。
AI.motivation: 临床试验中人机交互形式多样，但缺乏统一的识别与分类方法，导致跨试验记录难以一致地比较与综合AI相关干预及其人类参与形式。
AI.method: 定义HAII，检视现有分类法并加以扩展，提出新颖的多维度分类框架；从既有数据集中目的性抽取15项临床试验，由两名人工评审和六个大语言模型分类器分别独立分类。
AI.result: 该分类法为跨临床试验记录一致地识别、比较与综合人机交互提供了结构化方法；结果显示了LLM辅助分类的潜力，同时在试验记录不完整或模糊时人工判断仍不可或缺。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献是提出一个将AI任务、人机关系、交互配置与交互人群整合于单一方法的多维度框架，其意义在于支持更系统地识别、比较和综合临床试验中人类与AI的交互方式。

title: ThinkV2V: Unleashing the Reasoning Capability of MLLMs for Instruction-Guided Video Editing
summary: Instruction-guided video editing has made significant progress, yet existing methods use multimodal large language models (MLLMs) primarily as semantic encoders, so they often fall short in working with implicit edits that require causal or semantic reasoning. To bridge this fundamental gap in video editing, we propose ThinkV2V, a reasoning-driven framework for complex instruction-guided video editing, explicitly activating MLLM thinking before visual generation. At its core, ThinkV2V builds on a practical MLLM-to-DiT architecture to turn explicit thinking over the source video and instruction into refined conditioning signals for video editing. Further, we equip it with a dedicated training and inference recipe, combining Progressive Curriculum Training, which gradually cultivates the model from basic editing to reasoning-intensive cases, with Inference-Time Thinking Scaling, which iteratively refines candidate prompts and selects the most reliable one, to better elicit reasoning in challenging editing scenarios. We also curate the ThinkV2V-150K dataset and introduce ThinkV2V-Bench to support training and evaluation of video editing with implicit intent and causal reasoning. Experimental results demonstrate the state-of-the-art performance of ThinkV2V on both complex and standard editing scenarios, in which our 5B-scale DiT model substantially outperforms larger 10B-scale baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ThinkV2V，一种推理驱动的指令引导视频编辑框架，通过在视觉生成前显式激活MLLM思考，将思考过程转化为精炼的条件信号，在复杂与标准编辑场景中实现SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有视频编辑方法仅将多模态大语言模型（MLLM）用作语义编码器，在处理需要因果或语义推理的隐式编辑时表现不足。为弥补这一根本性差距，作者希望在视觉生成前显式激活MLLM的思考能力。
AI.method: 提出ThinkV2V框架，基于MLLM-to-DiT架构，将对源视频和指令的显式思考转化为精炼的编辑条件信号。配套训练与推理方案：渐进式课程训练（从基础编辑逐步过渡到推理密集型任务）与推理时思考扩展（迭代精炼候选提示并选择最可靠的）。同时构建ThinkV2V-150K数据集与ThinkV2V-Bench评测基准。
AI.result: 实验表明，ThinkV2V在复杂和标准编辑场景下均达到最先进性能，其5B规模的DiT模型显著优于10B规模的更大基线模型。
AI.conclusion: ThinkV2V通过激活MLLM推理能力并转化为生成条件，有效解决了隐式意图与因果推理类视频编辑难题，验证了推理驱动范式在视频编辑中的有效性与效率优势。

title: An Input-Frugal Deep Learning Framework for Weather-Driven National Crop-Yield Forecasting: A Case Study of Brazilian Soybean
summary: Reliable, timely crop-yield forecasts are essential for market stability and risk management, yet many approaches rely on costly or hard-to-scale inputs. We present a frugal, transferable, and architecture-agnostic deep learning framework that uses routine weather as the only time-varying input plus two lightweight static context inputs (crop year and an agro-environmental label) to capture long-run change and regional heterogeneity, while supporting multiple sequence encoders under identical data requirements. Using a 20-season Brazilian soybean case study (2001/02-2020/21) with leave-one-year-out cross-validation, we benchmark MLP, CNN, LSTM, CNN-LSTM, a Transformer encoder and the Mamba state-space model against linear ridge regression and a five-year moving-average "farmer" baseline. All deep learning variants outperform ridge, and all sequential encoders surpass the non-sequential MLP. The Transformer achieves the best national accuracy (RMSE 149 kg ha^-1; rRMSE 5.3%; R^2 = 0.784), reducing error by 47.6% relative to the farmer baseline. In-season forecasts improve monotonically from early- to late-season issuance, reaching approximately 50% lower error than the baseline at the latest forecast point. Ablations indicate that the agro-environmental label and spatial instance expansion (multiple grid-node weather sequences per municipality-year) contribute positively without increasing input complexity. SHAP diagnostics suggest crop year explains most of the long-run trajectory, whereas within-season weather and agro-environmental context primarily drive interannual deviations, with moisture/cloud and thermal-demand variables dominating. Overall, the framework is straightforward to deploy across other crops and geographic regions and is naturally compatible with operational weather forecasts for routine monitoring.

AI.tldr: 提出一种仅依赖常规气象数据与两个轻量静态输入的简约、可迁移、架构无关的深度学习框架，用于作物产量预测；以巴西大豆20年案例验证，Transformer表现最佳，RMSE 149 kg/ha，较农民基线误差降低47.6%。
AI.motivation: 可靠及时的作物产量预测对市场稳定与风险管理至关重要，但现有方法多依赖成本高、难以规模化的输入数据；因此需要一种低成本、易迁移的预测框架。
AI.method: 仅用常规气象作为唯一时变输入，外加两个轻量静态输入（作物年份与农业环境标签）以刻画长期变化与区域异质性；框架架构无关，支持多种序列编码器。以巴西大豆2001/02–2020/21共20季为案例，采用留一年交叉验证，对比MLP、CNN、LSTM、CNN-LSTM、Transformer编码器与Mamba状态空间模型，并与岭回归及五年移动平均"农民"基线比较；辅以消融实验与SHAP诊断。
AI.result: 所有深度学习变体均优于岭回归，所有序列编码器均优于非序列MLP；Transformer全国精度最佳（RMSE 149 kg/ha，rRMSE 5.3%，R²=0.784），较农民基线误差降低47.6%。季内预测从早期到晚期单调改善，最新预测点误差约为基线的一半。消融显示农业环境标签与空间实例扩展有正向贡献且不增加输入复杂度。SHAP表明作物年份解释长期趋势，季内气象与农业环境背景主要驱动年际偏差，其中湿度/云量与热需求变量占主导。
AI.conclusion: 该框架输入简单、易于在其它作物与地区部署，并天然兼容业务化天气预报，可用于常规监测。

title: Towards Model as a Library: Offline, Community-Sourced AI for Low-Resource African Languages
summary: Large language models are frequently proposed as a route to AI-powered services for African communities, but they are least reliable exactly where the need is greatest: all African languages remain low-resource by any standard measure, and models trained on scraped, standardised text systematically misrepresent the dialectal and regional variation of how people actually speak.
