We introduce \textbf{Model as a Library (MaaL)}, a software architecture that packages small, community-enrolled speech models as versioned on-device dependencies, enabling offline structured data collection that cannot generatively hallucinate, for populations that current language models serve worst. Rather than relying on web-scraped corpora, MaaL's vocabulary is enrolled directly from a small number of example recordings by the speakers themselves, at the point of deployment. We describe the architecture and its central mechanism - keyword spotting that turns a closed-vocabulary text form into a voice form, filled and submitted entirely on-device - and propose transpiling the closed-vocabulary elements already present in widely-deployed digital form tools into MaaL schemas, a low-friction path to voice-first, offline data collection for the low-literacy populations these tools already reach. This is a position and system-design paper: we describe the concept, the mechanism, and an analytical feasibility case, and identify what a working implementation still requires.

AI.tldr: 提出Model as a Library (MaaL)架构，将小型社区注册语音模型打包为设备端依赖，实现离线、不可生成幻觉的结构化数据采集，服务低资源非洲语言人群。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型常被视为服务非洲社区的途径，但非洲语言普遍属低资源，且基于爬取标准化文本训练的模型系统性忽视方言与地区差异，恰恰在最需要的地方最不可靠。
AI.method: MaaL将小型、社区注册的语音模型作为版本化设备端依赖打包；词表由说话者在部署现场通过少量示例录音直接注册而非依赖网络爬取语料；核心机制为关键词识别，将封闭词表文本形式转为语音形式，全程在设备端填写与提交；并提议将现有数字表单工具中的封闭词表元素转译为MaaL模式。
AI.result: 本文为立场与系统设计论文，给出了概念、机制及分析性可行性论证，并指出实现可用系统仍需哪些条件；未报告实证实验结果。
AI.conclusion: MaaL为当前语言模型服务最差的低识字率人群提供一条低门槛的语音优先、离线数据采集路径，但完整实现仍有待后续工作。

title: Detail in Context: A Dual-Scale Machine Learning Framework for Mycosis Fungoides Detection
summary: Mycosis fungoides (MF) is a rare form of cutaneous T-cell lymphoma that is often misdiagnosed in early stages due to its visual similarity to benign inflammatory dermatoses. Early and accurate diagnosis is critical for improving patient outcomes. In this paper, we propose a comprehensive diagnostic framework for automated MF detection that combines dual- scale histopathological image analysis with deep learning. To distinguish MF from other lymphoproliferative skin conditions, the proposed approach leverages a late-fusion ensemble of dual- magnification (10x and 20x) convolutional neural networks (CNNs), complemented by a random forest classifier trained on 16 clinical features. Experimental results on an expanded dataset of 6,267 images (4,306 MF; 1,961 Non-MF) across 463 patients demonstrate that strong detection performance is obtained by prioritizing higher-resolution cytological details (20x) within broader architectural context (10x). The image-based late-fusion model achieves an accuracy of 83.58% and a sensitivity of 89.13%, while the clinical random forest model achieves an accuracy of 96.6% and sensitivity of 93.8%, highlighting the po- tential of this multimodal framework as a robust clinical decision support system in dermatology. This framework addresses two distinct clinical objectives: an image-based dual-scale pipeline optimized for the early diagnostic screening of MF versus non- MF dermatoses, and a complementary clinical metadata model designed for the subsequent staging of confirmed MF cases (patch/plaque versus tumor)

AI.tldr: 提出一种结合双尺度病理图像深度学习与临床特征的多模态框架，用于蕈样肉芽肿（MF）的自动检测与分期。
AI.motivation: MF是罕见皮肤T细胞淋巴瘤，早期易与良性炎症性皮肤病混淆而误诊；早期准确诊断对改善预后至关重要，因此需要自动化诊断支持。
AI.method: 采用10x与20x双倍率CNN的晚期融合集成进行图像分析，并辅以基于16个临床特征训练的随机森林分类器，形成多模态诊断框架。
AI.result: 在扩展数据集（6,267张图像，4,306 MF、1,961 非MF，463名患者）上，图像晚期融合模型准确率83.58%、灵敏度89.13%；临床随机森林模型准确率96.6%、灵敏度93.8%，表明优先利用20x细胞学细节并结合10x架构背景效果最佳。
AI.conclusion: 该框架覆盖两个临床目标：面向MF与非MF皮肤病早期筛查的双尺度图像流程，以及用于确诊MF分期（斑片/斑块 vs 肿瘤）的临床元数据模型，展现出作为皮肤科临床决策支持系统的潜力。

title: Grokking through the Lens of Minimum-Norm Interpolation
summary: Grokking shows that fitting the training data and learning the underlying signal can occur at very different stages. However, existing theories offer limited quantitative insight into how this delayed generalization depends on inductive bias and signal structure. Our work addresses the gap by developing a statistical theory that characterizes how regularization geometry and signal sparsity govern generalization near interpolation. In particular, we focus on the prototypical setting of high-dimensional regression and identify regimes in which sparsity-promoting regularization makes exact interpolation much more accurate than approximate fitting. In strongly overparameterized noiseless problems, we prove a zero--one generalization law and construct a family of convex norms whose interpolators transition from the trivial risk of the all-zero predictor to exact recovery, while keeping the training error equal to $0$. Furthermore, when feature dimension and sample size are proportional, we provide a precise characterization of training and generalization errors along $\ell_r$-regularization paths. This in turn allows us to quantify the generalization gain that remains near interpolation: we show that this gain increases as the norm becomes more sparsity-promoting and as the target becomes sparser, with a sharp drop in generalization reached for noiseless data and $\ell_1$ regularization. Experiments on diagonal linear networks and transformers trained on modular arithmetic demonstrate the generality of our theoretical predictions. Finally, beyond grokking, our work reveals a statistical instability in minimum-norm interpolation: small perturbations in the regularization strength can lead to drastically different generalization, while preserving small training error.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了统计理论，刻画正则化几何与信号稀疏性如何控制插值附近的泛化，揭示稀疏促进正则可显著提升精确插值精度并给出零一泛化律。
AI.motivation: 现有关于 grokking（延迟泛化）的理论难以定量解释延迟泛化如何依赖归纳偏置与信号结构，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 聚焦高维回归原型设定，发展统计理论，刻画正则化几何与信号稀疏性对插值附近泛化的影响；分析强过参数化无噪声问题中的凸范数插值器，并研究特征维度与样本量成比例时 ℓ_r 正则化路径上的训练与泛化误差。
AI.result: 证明强过参数化无噪声问题中的零一泛化律，构造一类凸范数使插值器从全零预测器的平凡风险过渡到精确恢复且训练误差保持为0；给出 ℓ_r 正则化路径误差的精确刻画，表明泛化增益随范数更促进稀疏、目标更稀疏而增大，在无噪声数据与 ℓ_1 正则化时泛化出现急剧下降。对角线性网络与模算术 Transformer 实验验证了理论预测。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了最小范数插值中的统计不稳定性：正则化强度的微小扰动可在保持小训练误差的同时导致泛化性能剧变。

title: Conditional Generation of Creative Chess Puzzles with Diffusion Models
summary: While modern language models demonstrate impressive generative capabilities, they often struggle with constrained, counter-intuitive creative tasks. To address this limitation, we explore chess puzzle generation as a rigorous testbed for computational creativity and reasoning, a domain where altering a single piece can invalidate an entire solution. We propose a novel approach for conditional generation of creative chess puzzles using masked diffusion models. Unlike previous methods, our non-directional diffusion approach allows for conditioning on specific tactical themes and partial board positions. We introduce a novel auxiliary task of simultaneous best-move prediction, which improves solution uniqueness by 11.6% and theme-conditioning accuracy by 2.5%. To further optimize solution uniqueness and theme conditioning, we establish a reinforcement learning framework adapted from Denoising Diffusion Policy Optimization (DDPO). This RL training increases the yield of unique and theme-matching positions by 89.1%. Finally, we release the first open-weights models (Appendix B) for chess puzzle generation, offering a new pathway for controllable, creative generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用掩码扩散模型进行条件式国际象棋谜题生成，将其作为计算创造性与推理的严格测试平台，并引入同步最优走子预测辅助任务与基于DDPO的强化学习优化框架，显著提升了谜题解的唯一性和主题匹配度，并发布了首个开源权重的国际象棋谜题生成模型。
AI.motivation: 现代语言模型虽具备强大的生成能力，但在受约束、反直觉的创造性任务上表现不佳。国际象棋谜题生成正是这类任务的典型：改动一个棋子就可能使整个解失效。因此作者将其作为研究计算创造性与推理的严格测试平台，探索可控的创意生成方法。
AI.method: 提出一种基于掩码扩散模型的非方向性条件生成方法，可依据特定战术主题和部分棋盘局面进行条件生成。引入同步最优走子预测的辅助任务；并构建了改编自去噪扩散策略优化（DDPO）的强化学习框架，进一步优化解的唯一性与主题条件匹配度。
AI.result: 辅助的最优走子预测任务使解的唯一性提升11.6%，主题条件准确率提升2.5%；DDPO强化学习训练后，满足唯一解且主题匹配的生成局面产出率提升89.1%。
AI.conclusion: 作者发布了首个面向国际象棋谜题生成的开源权重模型（见附录B），为可控、创造性的生成提供了一条新路径，并验证了扩散模型结合强化学习在受约束创意任务上的有效性。

title: LongTake: Learning to Sustain Dynamics in Long-Horizon Video Generation
summary: World models, game simulators, and long-take video creation require coherent scene evolution and sustained dynamics over extended durations. Autoregressive (AR) video diffusion provides a natural framework for long-horizon generation, yet extended rollouts often become near-static or lose visual quality. We hypothesize that these failures reflect the limited guidance provided by short-video supervision on how ongoing scene dynamics develops over longer durations. This motivates us to introduce LongTake, a two-stage training pipeline built around Long-Horizon Teacher Forcing (TF) on curated real long videos. Long-Horizon TF trains the AR model to predict later frames conditioned on long ground-truth video prefixes, extending direct supervision beyond the short training horizon. This supervision is designed to help the model sustain dynamics and preserve visual quality during long-horizon generation. Our central finding is that this training stage strengthens direct initialization for distribution matching distillation (DMD) under student self-rollout, without the intermediate few-step distillation stage used in standard pipelines. Under the same five-second DMD training setup, our initialization yields substantially higher dynamic degree than short horizon TF initialization on 30-second rollouts at comparable aesthetic quality, and surpasses the evaluated baselines in both measures. Hybrid DMD further reuses this teacher to extend supervision to later frames of the self-rollout while retaining bidirectional joint supervision over the initial window. On long-horizon self-rollouts, LongTake lies on the Pareto front of dynamic degree and aesthetic quality, and Hybrid DMD attains the highest dynamic degree among evaluated methods at both 30s and 60s.

AI.tldr: LongTake提出两阶段训练流程，通过长时程Teacher Forcing利用真实长视频监督，提升自回归视频扩散模型长时序生成的动态性与画质，并结合Hybrid DMD实现更优表现。
AI.motivation: 自回归视频扩散适合长时序生成，但在长时间推演中常出现近乎静止或视觉质量退化。作者假设这源于短视频监督信号无法指导场景动态在更长时间尺度上的演化。
AI.method: 提出LongTake两阶段训练流程，核心为在精选真实长视频上的Long-Horizon Teacher Forcing（TF），让AR模型在长真值视频前缀条件下预测后续帧，将直接监督扩展到短训练时程之外；该初始化直接用于学生自推演下的分布匹配蒸馏（DMD），省去标准流程中的中间少步蒸馏阶段。Hybrid DMD进一步复用该teacher，将监督扩展至自推演后期帧，同时对初始窗口保留双向联合监督。
AI.result: 在相同的5秒DMD训练设置下，LongTake初始化在30秒推演中比短时程TF初始化具有显著更高的动态度，美学质量相当，并在两项指标上均超越所评估基线。长时程自推演中，LongTake位于动态度与美学质量的Pareto前沿，Hybrid DMD在30秒和60秒均取得所评估方法中最高的动态度。
AI.conclusion: 长时程Teacher Forcing为DMD提供了更强的直接初始化，可有效缓解长时序生成中的静止与质量退化问题，Hybrid DMD进一步提升长时程动态表现。

title: Does Gradient Conflict Predict the Understanding--Generation Trade-off? A Controlled Audit of Conflict-Metric Validity in Unified Multimodal Models
comment: 23 pages, 10 figures, 5 tables. Code will be made publicly available upon acceptance
summary: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) are increasingly designed around gradient conflict between understanding and generation objectives. The premise that reducing these metrics improves the downstream understanding-generation trade-off has never been tested directly. We audit it in a controlled testbed, GRIDUMM, which mirrors key structural ingredients of UMM training while making the ground-truth trade-off exactly computable. Across 63 configurations and 372 measured checkpoints, no directional conflict metric reaches an absolute Spearman correlation of 0.3 with a confidence interval excluding zero for conflict measured during training against the eventual trade-off. A dose-response intervention that monotonically suppresses conflict leaves the trade-off flat, separating correlation from causation. The norm ratio is a generation-failure detector and becomes null among configurations that master generation. Functional interference measures outperform directional conflict metrics, while training loss tracks the trade-off strongly. Our results do not show that conflict is useless; they show that its validity as a diagnostic target must be established, not assumed, and we release the audit protocol as a reusable standard.

AI.tldr: 本文通过可控测试平台GRIDUMM审计了统一多模态模型中"梯度冲突指标可预测理解-生成权衡"这一前提，发现方向性冲突指标与最终权衡无实质相关性，其作为诊断目标的有效性需被验证而非假设。
AI.motivation: 统一多模态模型（UMMs）的设计日益围绕"理解与生成目标之间的梯度冲突"展开，普遍假设降低这类冲突指标能改善下游的理解-生成权衡。然而这一前提从未被直接检验，本文旨在对此进行严格的实证审计。
AI.method: 提出可控测试平台GRIDUMM，它复现了UMM训练的关键结构要素，同时使真实的权衡可被精确计算。在此平台上进行了63种配置、372个检查点的测量，并施加了剂量-反应式干预来单调抑制冲突，以区分相关性与因果性。
AI.result: 在所有配置中，无任何方向性冲突指标与最终权衡的绝对Spearman相关系数达到0.3且置信区间排除零；剂量-反应干预单调抑制冲突后权衡仍保持平坦。范数比是生成失败的检测器，在掌握生成的配置中失效。功能性干扰度量优于方向性冲突度量，而训练损失能强预测权衡。
AI.conclusion: 结果并非表明冲突无用，而是说明冲突作为诊断目标的有效性必须被验证而非假设。作者将审计协议作为可复用的标准公开发布。

title: Sense and Sensitivity: Benchmarking LLM Clinical Triage Recommendations with Physician Experts
summary: As large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in clinical settings, it is critical to evaluate their reliability under realistic variation in clinical text. We study this question in clinical triage, comparing LLMs to practicing physicians under text perturbations that preserve the underlying clinical setting. We introduce a benchmark of over 6,000 clinical scenarios, 7,000 physician annotations, and 225,000 model responses. Using this benchmark, we make two key observations. First, LLMs are more likely than physicians to recommend unnecessary care at baseline, and this tendency increases under perturbed inputs. Further, we find that LLM recommendations are more sensitive to gender and tone perturbations than human recommendations. Together, these results demonstrate that LLMs can vary under clinically irrelevant textual changes, highlighting the need for deployment-oriented evaluations grounded in expert physician behavior.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了临床分诊基准，比较大语言模型与执业医师在文本扰动下的表现，发现LLM在基线时更倾向推荐不必要医疗，且该倾向在扰动下加剧，同时LLM对性别和语气扰动比人类更敏感。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型在临床场景中应用日益广泛，亟需评估其在真实临床文本变异下的可靠性，尤其是与执业医师行为的对比。
AI.method: 在临床分诊任务中比较LLM与执业医师，并引入保持临床情境不变的文本扰动；构建包含超过6,000个临床情景、7,000条医师标注和225,000条模型回复的基准。
AI.result: LLM比医师更易在基线时推荐不必要医疗，且在扰动输入下该倾向增强；LLM建议对性别和语气扰动比人类建议更敏感。
AI.conclusion: LLM会因临床无关的文本变化而产生输出差异，说明需要以专家医师行为为基础、面向部署的评估方法。

title: Retargeting Motions to Diverse Skeletons via Learnable Flattening
summary: Cross-structural motion retargeting aims to transfer motion between different skeletal topologies. Despite recent progress, existing state-of-the-art models struggle with reliability in zero-shot settings, i.e. skeletons with different topologies which were unseen during training, and recent Transformer-based attempts have failed to outperform specialized geometric methods. We bridge this gap with a Transformer Autoencoder that learns a topology- and translation-invariant latent space. Our core contribution is a learnable flattening of skeletal graphs that captures both local dependencies and global structure. Unlike the standard transformer architecture, which adds positional information to token content, we integrate graph-based positional encodings multiplicatively, a design choice that follows directly from our flattening formulation. The resulting model handles diverse skeletal topologies within a single unified architecture and trains in a fully unsupervised manner, requiring no paired retargeting data. Ablation studies show, that the graph encodings, multiplicative formulation, and Transformer backbone is critical for the performance. In zero-shot evaluations, our method reduces global joint position error by $43-47\%$ over current benchmarks. A user study ($n = 37$), including expert animators, further ranks our approach highest in motion alignment and physical plausibility ($p < 0.05$). These results demonstrate that our model design is key to making transformer architectures effective for motion retargeting, outperforming existing approaches.

AI.tldr: 提出一种拓扑与平移不变的Transformer自编码器，通过学习可学习的骨骼图展平表示与乘法式图位置编码，实现跨拓扑的零样本动作重定向，无需成对数据，误差降低43-47%。
AI.motivation: 跨结构动作重定向需在不同骨骼拓扑间迁移动作。现有最优模型在零样本（训练未见拓扑）场景下可靠性不足，且基于Transformer的方法性能未能超越专用几何方法，因此需要弥合这一差距。
AI.method: 构建Transformer自编码器，学习拓扑与平移不变的隐空间；核心是可学习的骨骼图展平，捕获局部依赖与全局结构；不同于标准Transformer加性位置信息，采用基于图的乘法式位置编码；单一统一架构处理多种骨骼拓扑，完全无监督训练，无需成对重定向数据。
AI.result: 消融实验表明图编码、乘法式设计与Transformer主干对性能至关重要；零样本评估中全局关节位置误差相比现有基准降低43-47%；用户研究（n=37，含专业动画师）在动作对齐与物理合理性上评分最高（p<0.05）。
AI.conclusion: 模型设计是让Transformer架构有效用于动作重定向的关键，所提方法优于现有方法。

title: RetroGEF: Dynamic Graph Edit Flow for Single-Step Retrosynthesis
summary: Retrosynthesis enables the discovery of viable synthetic routes to target molecules. It plays a central role in modern drug discovery and materials design. Retrosynthesis involves molecular graph transformations that can change both connectivity and graph size. These transformations may introduce reactant components absent from the target while revising the product-derived structure. To model these transformations, we propose RetroGEF, a flow-based generative model for single-step retrosynthesis. Starting from the target molecule, it constructs possible reactants by adding atoms and changing bonds in the molecular graph. RetroGEF models molecular transformations and changes in graph size within the same generative process, rather than relying on a fixed-size graph canvas. It learns this process directly from product--reactant pairs without requiring a prescribed edit order. Experiments on representative retrosynthesis benchmarks demonstrate that RetroGEF achieves state-of-the-art performance.

AI.tldr: 提出RetroGEF，一种基于流的单步逆合成生成模型，从目标分子出发，通过加原子和改键构造反应物，在同一生成过程中处理图变换与图规模变化，无需固定图或预设编辑顺序，在基准上达到最优性能。
AI.motivation: 逆合成对药物发现和材料设计至关重要。逆合成涉及分子图变换，会同时改变连通性和图规模，并可能引入目标分子中不存在的反应物组分；现有方法多依赖固定大小的图或预设编辑顺序，难以自然建模这些变化。
AI.method: RetroGEF是一种基于流的生成模型，用于单步逆合成。它以目标分子为起点，通过在分子图中添加原子、改变化学键来构造可能的反应物，在同一生成过程内建模分子变换与图规模变化，而非依赖固定尺寸的图容器；模型直接从产物-反应物对中学习该过程，无需规定编辑顺序。
AI.result: 在代表性逆合成基准数据集上的实验表明，RetroGEF取得了当前最优（state-of-the-art）的性能。
AI.conclusion: RetroGEF能够统一建模可变规模分子图上的逆合成变换，无需固定图或编辑顺序，验证了流式生成方法在逆合成任务上的有效性，并达到领先水平。

title: When Scientific Contradictions Are Lost in Translation
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 AI for Science Workshop: Verification in the Age of AI Scientists. This version is not included in the official NeurIPS proceedings
summary: Two scientific findings can disagree without contradicting each other. Determining whether they conflict requires knowing whether they describe comparable measurements. We study how language models behave at this decision point. In a controlled task, we generate an unsatisfiable XOR constraint system and translate its constraints into scientific reports from different laboratories. One assignment satisfies more constraints, while another satisfies fewer but better matches expected biology. This creates a simple dilemma: does the model choose the assignment that best fits the constraints, or the one that better matches biological expectations? When the constraints are stated directly, GPT-5.6 Sol and Claude Opus 5 recover the best-supported assignment in 90% and 96% of cases, respectively. In scientific prose, however, the models behave differently. Claude Opus 5 often prefers the biologically expected assignment. Removing that biological preference increases recovery of the better-supported assignment from 27% to 79% (p<.001); recovery reaches 92% when the same Biology-favored record is accompanied by a formalization request and an explicit paired-design cue (p<.001). GPT-5.6 Sol is less sensitive, with neither corresponding change reaching statistical significance. These results suggest that reliable scientific verification depends not only on formal reasoning, but also on how models decide which findings should be compared and what relations they imply.

AI.tldr: 论文通过受控的不可满足XOR约束任务研究语言模型在判断两项科学发现是否构成冲突时的行为，发现模型在科学文本表述下容易偏向符合生物学预期的结论而非约束支撑最强的结论，且可通过移除生物学偏好、要求形式化与显式配对设计提示显著改善。
AI.motivation: 两项科学发现可以不一致却并不构成矛盾，判断它们是否真正冲突，需要确定它们描述的是否为可比的测量。这一"比较决策点"是科学验证的关键环节，但语言模型在此处的行为尚未被系统研究，作者希望揭示模型在形式约束与领域先验之间的取舍机制。
AI.method: 构造一个受控任务：生成不可满足的XOR约束系统，并将其约束转写为来自不同实验室的科学报告。任务中设定两种分配——一种满足更多约束，另一种满足较少约束但更符合预期生物学。分别以直接陈述约束与科学散文两种形式呈现，测试GPT-5.6 Sol与Claude Opus 5的选择；并施加干预，如移除生物学偏好、加入形式化请求与显式配对设计提示。
AI.result: 约束直接陈述时，GPT-5.6 Sol与Claude Opus 5分别有90%和96%恢复出支撑最好的分配。在科学散文中，Claude Opus 5常偏向符合生物学预期的分配；移除该生物学偏好后，恢复更优支撑分配的比例从27%升至79%（p<.001），当同一偏向生物学的记录附带形式化请求与显式配对设计提示时，恢复率达92%（p<.001）。GPT-5.6 Sol敏感性较低，两项相应变化均未达统计显著。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的科学验证不仅依赖形式推理能力，还取决于模型如何决定哪些发现应当被比较以及它们隐含何种关系。领域先验可能干扰模型对约束支撑的判断，而形式化与显式设计提示可缓解这一偏差，不同模型间存在明显差异。

title: Restoring without Forgetting: Filter-Level Continual Image Restoration via Parameter-Space Integrated Gradients
summary: Adapting image restoration models to a stream of new tasks without revisiting past data remains challenging due to catastrophic forgetting. In this work, we propose Restoring without Forgetting (RwF), a filter-level continual adaptation framework for image restoration built upon a critical observation: task-specific knowledge is centered in a small subset of filters and can be separated from those reconstructing general content. RwF first performs parameter-space integrated gradients attribution to localize degradation-critical filters in a coarse-to-fine manner. It then adapts to new tasks by generating task-specific filters from a filter bank using compact factorized low-rank transformations, further augmented with cross-task attention and prototypical contrastive learning, and lastly assembles them back only at localized positions. Experiments on six restoration tasks show that RwF effectively avoids forgetting and achieves competitive restoration quality against all-in-one methods that have full data access, and outperforms LoRA-style adaptation with $\sim$10$\times$ fewer additional parameters. Code is available at https://github.com/funkdub/Restoring-without-Forgetting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RwF（Restoring without Forgetting），一个面向图像复原的滤波器级持续自适应框架，通过定位任务关键滤波器并仅在其位置生成任务特定滤波器，实现不遗忘过去任务的持续学习。
AI.motivation: 图像复原模型需要适应一系列新任务，但无法重访历史数据，容易发生灾难性遗忘。作者观察到任务特定知识集中在少数滤波器中，且可与重建通用内容的滤波器分离，据此设计方法以解决遗忘问题。
AI.method: RwF首先使用参数空间的积分梯度归因，以由粗到细的方式定位退化关键滤波器；然后利用紧凑的分解低秩变换从滤波器库中生成任务特定滤波器，并结合跨任务注意力与原型对比学习；最后仅在定位位置组装这些滤波器。
AI.result: 在六个复原任务上的实验表明，RwF有效避免了遗忘，复原质量可媲美拥有全部数据访问权限的all-in-one方法，并在额外参数约少10倍的情况下优于LoRA式自适应方法。
AI.conclusion: RwF通过滤波级别的持续自适应用于图像复原，在避免灾难性遗忘的同时保持竞争性的复原性能，且参数效率高于LoRA式方法，代码已开源。

title: Role-guided Speaker Deletion Verification in Clinical Psychiatry Speech Recordings with Audio Language Models
summary: Clinical research in psychiatry increasingly relies on large scale collection of spoken language data to identify acoustic and linguistic biomarkers. Yet evolving consent and protocol requirements can oblige investigators to remove a designated speaker from multi-speaker recordings and to verify said removal at a scale infeasible for manual review of entire corpora. We study this verification problem for role-driven dyadic clinical dialogue in psychiatry and investigate it with two parallel, symmetric pipelines: confirming that clinician speech has been removed from psychiatric interview recordings, and confirming that patient speech has been removed from the same recordings. Each pipeline redacts the raw audio for its target role and then scans the surviving output with audio-language and large-language models to identify missed deletions. We evaluate this approach on a corpus of 48 dyadic recordings drawn from psychiatry settings, testing four open-weight models in an inference-only setting: Gemma-4-12B, Gemma-4-31B, Nemotron-3-Nano, and Nemotron-3-Nano-Omni. A disjunctive OR ensemble over fourteen model-view configurations had a combined F1 of 0.478 (precision 0.330, recall 0.870), an improvement over individual model estimates driven by recall gains that point to substantial complementarity across models and context views.

AI.tldr: 该研究针对精神科双人临床对话录音中"指定发言人语音是否已被彻底删除"的验证难题，提出两条平行的对称流水线（验证临床医生语音已从录音中移除、验证患者语音已从录音中移除），结合音频-语言模型与大语言模型在仅推理设置下自动筛查漏删片段，并在48段真实精神科对话语料上评估了四种开放权重模型。
AI.motivation: 精神科临床研究日益依赖大规模口语数据来识别声学与语言学生物标志物，但不断变化的知情同意与协议要求，常迫使研究者从多人录音中移除某一指定说话人，并要求验证其确实被删除。然而，对整个语料库进行人工逐条复核在规模上不可行，因此需要自动化的验证方法。
AI.method: 研究将验证问题形式化为"角色驱动的双人临床对话"验证任务，构建了两条平行且对称的流水线：一条确认临床医生语音已从精神科访谈录音中移除，另一条确认患者语音已从同一批录音中移除。每条流水线先对目标角色的原始音频进行遮蔽（redact），再用音频-语言模型和大语言模型扫描剩余输出，以识别遗漏删除的片段。在48段精神科双人录音语料上，以仅推理（inference-only）方式测试了四种开放权重模型：Gemma-4-12B、Gemma-4-31B、Nemotron-3-Nano 与 Nemotron-3-Nano-Omni。
AI.result: 在十四种模型-视图配置上采用析取式 OR 集成后，综合 F1 为 0.478（精确率 0.330，召回率 0.870）。该结果优于各单模型估计，其提升主要来自召回率增益，表明不同模型与不同上下文视图之间存在显著互补性。
AI.conclusion: 自动化多模型集成方法可在人工复核不可行的规模上辅助验证指定说话人语音是否被彻底移除；尽管精确率偏低，但高召回特性使其适合作为进一步人工核查的筛查工具，且模型与视图之间的互补性值得进一步挖掘。

title: Component-Aware Feedback for Self-Evolving Programs
summary: LLM-guided evolutionary search can discover complex programs, but existing methods mostly only save candidate programs and fitness scores while discarding which component edits produced which fitness metric changes. Existing methods force the mutator LLM to infer the effect of prior edits from cluttered histories, making program search slow and unstable. This is especially true for locally servable LLMs to evolve multi-component systems. We introduce component-aware feedback, which compares each evaluated program with its parent, identifies the components that changed, and logs them with the associated metric differences into an attribution memory that later mutations read. The memory keeps each change in two reference frames, local against the parent it came from and global against the seed program, which shows both the immediate effect of a change and the cumulative progress made since the seed. We study this on LLM reranking, a multi-objective optimization problem where a multi-stage pipeline must balance quality against serving cost. Across twelve \textsc{Bright} datasets, our method reaches the strongest baseline's final quality after a median of one third of the search budget and ends 7.2\% higher in held-out nDCG@10, and under a cost-aware objective it finds pipelines that are on average more accurate while using 11\% fewer tokens per query, showing component-aware feedback to be a promising direction for more efficient self-evolving systems.

AI.tldr: 提出组件感知反馈，通过记录父程序对比中的组件编辑与指标变化，提升LLM进化搜索效率。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM引导的进化搜索只保存候选程序和适应度分数，丢弃了组件编辑与适应度变化之间的对应关系，迫使变异LLM从杂乱历史中推断先前编辑效果，导致程序搜索缓慢且不稳定。
AI.method: 引入组件感知反馈机制：将每个评估程序与其父程序比较，识别发生变化的组件，并将组件变化及对应指标差异记录到归因记忆；记忆以两种参考框架保存变化——局部相对父程序、全局相对种子程序，从而同时呈现变化的即时效果和自种子以来的累积进展。在LLM重排序这一多目标优化任务上验证。
AI.result: 在十二个BRIGHT数据集上，方法达到最强基线最终质量所需搜索预算的中位数为三分之一；留出nDCG@10高出7.2%；在成本感知目标下，找到的流水线平均更准确且每查询少用11%的token。
AI.conclusion: 组件感知反馈是提升自进化系统效率的有效方向。

title: StereoGaussians: Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting from Stereo Images
summary: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables reconstruction without per- scene optimisation, but practical stereo-camera applications require nearby-view extrapolation beyond the input views. Stereo depth anchors visible surfaces, yet rendering newly exposed regions also requires learned appearance and additional scene capacity. We introduce StereoGaussians, which predicts a metric 3DGS representation from a single calibrated stereo pair. It reuses intermediate repre- sentations from frozen pretrained stereo networks to predict Gaussian attributes, while calibrated disparity anchors the geometry. A second Gaussian layer and an expanded image canvas provide capacity for disoccluded and outside-field-of- view content. For training, we construct SceneSplat-Stereo from quality-filtered 3DGS teachers, pairing stereo inputs with nearby target views across 803 training scenes. Experiments on unseen real and photorealistic stereo benchmarks demon- strate improvements over strong view-synthesis baselines, while ablation studies support our main design choices.

AI.tldr: 提出 StereoGaussians，从单对校准立体图像前馈预测度量 3DGS 表示，实现近邻视角外推。
AI.motivation: 前馈 3DGS 无需逐场景优化即可重建，但实际立体相机应用需在输入视角之外进行近邻视角外推。立体深度只能锚定可见表面，渲染新暴露区域还需学习的外观与额外场景容量。
AI.method: 复用冻结预训练立体网络的中间表示来预测高斯属性，用校准视差锚定几何；引入第二高斯层与扩展图像画布以承载去遮挡和视场外内容；基于质量过滤的 3DGS 教师构建 SceneSplat-Stereo 数据集（803 个场景，配对立体输入与近邻目标视角）进行训练。
AI.result: 在未见过的真实与逼真立体基准上优于强视图合成基线，消融研究支持主要设计选择。
AI.conclusion: StereoGaussians 证明可从单对立体图像前馈预测度量 3DGS，并通过双层高斯与画布扩展有效处理新暴露区域，为立体相机近邻视角外推提供可行方案。

title: Autoregressive Frontier Expansion: Growing Trees with Graph Machine Learning
summary: Tree-like branching structures are common in nature, from botanical trees to neurons, blood vessels and respiratory trees. Their branching shape often reflects function, making structural modelling central to understanding how these systems work. Because acquiring real-world 3D data is often expensive or infeasible, realistic generative models are valuable for simulation and data augmentation. Existing morphology-specific models either constrain how topology is generated or rely on hand-tuned, mechanistic procedures. Generic 3D graph generators, by contrast, do not exploit or enforce the structure of trees. We propose Autoregressive Frontier Expansion, a generative framework that constructs trees through an iterative expansion process, simulating the biological growth of real trees. At each step, a flow-matching model parameterised by an SO(2)-equivariant GNN expands the frontier by predicting whether each active branch bifurcates or terminates. We evaluate our method on cortical neurons and botanical trees in unconditional, class-conditioned, and morphology-guided generation. Across both domains, the generated morphologies agree closely with the reference distributions and, in conditional experiments, with the specified targets.

AI.tldr: 提出Autoregressive Frontier Expansion生成框架，通过迭代扩展过程并利用SO(2)-等变GNN的流匹配模型预测分支分叉或终止，生成逼真的树状结构。
AI.motivation: 树状分支结构（如植物、神经元、血管、呼吸道）的分支形态常反映功能，结构建模对理解这些系统至关重要。由于真实3D数据获取昂贵或不可行，逼真的生成模型对模拟和数据增强很有价值。现有形态学专用模型要么约束拓扑生成方式，要么依赖手工调参的机制化流程；通用3D图生成器则未利用或强制树的结构。
AI.method: 提出Autoregressive Frontier Expansion，一个通过迭代扩展过程构建树的生成框架，模拟真实树木的生物生长。每一步用SO(2)-等变GNN参数化的流匹配模型扩展前沿，预测每条活跃分支是分叉还是终止。
AI.result: 在皮层神经元和植物树上，于无条件、类别条件和形态引导生成任务中评估。两个领域中生成的形态与参考分布高度接近，在条件实验中与指定目标也高度一致。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能够有效生成逼真的树状分支结构，兼顾拓扑与几何，为模拟和数据增强提供了有价值的生成模型。

title: ChartRevise: A Dataset and Evaluation Protocol for Exact Chart Editing via Code
summary: Chart editing requires cross-modal edit grounding, realizing a requested visual change in the code that draws it, with necessary related updates and without altering unrelated content. Existing benchmarks emphasize either code executability or chart quality, but their metrics do not clearly distinguish request completion from missed coupled updates and gratuitous changes. We introduce ChartRevise, a structured dataset and evaluation protocol for exact program-grounded chart editing. For dataset construction, we build on the grammar of graphics to systematically cover chart-editing operations, using source-program checks to verify their applicability across chart types and libraries. To improve edit exactness, our pipeline checks individual requirements and guides repair or exclusion when they are unmet. The resulting dataset contains 92,438 records covering 344 edit types across 20 chart types and three plotting libraries. For evaluation, our reference-free protocol separately measures atomic requirement completion, identifies gratuitous changes, and detects missed coupled updates. These checks are combined with successful execution and rendering to determine exact-edit success. Across five models and four external benchmarks, fine-tuning yields relative gains of 16\% in mean requirement recall and 22\% in mean exact-edit rate.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ChartRevise——一个面向精确程序级图表编辑的结构化数据集与评测协议，用语法图形学系统覆盖编辑操作，并强调区分"需求完成"与"遗漏联动更新、无谓修改"。数据集含 92,438 条记录、344 种编辑类型、20 种图表类型、3 个绘图库。
AI.motivation: 图表编辑需要跨模态的编辑定位：既要按请求修改绘图代码中的相应部分，又要完成必要的关联更新，同时不破坏无关内容。已有基准要么侧重代码可执行性、要么侧重图表质量，其指标难以清晰区分"请求是否完成""是否遗漏了耦合更新""是否做了多余改动"。
AI.method: 基于语法图形学（grammar of graphics）系统覆盖图表编辑操作，并用源程序检查验证其在不同图表类型与库上的适用性；为提升编辑精确性，流程逐条核查各需求，对不满足需求的情况进行修复或剔除。评测采用无参考（reference-free）协议，分别度量原子需求完成情况、识别多余修改、检测遗漏的耦合更新，并结合执行成功与渲染结果判定"精确编辑成功"。
AI.result: 构建出包含 92,438 条记录的数据集，覆盖 344 种编辑类型、20 种图表类型和 3 个绘图库。在 5 个模型与 4 个外部基准上，微调带来平均需求召回率相对提升 16%、平均精确编辑率相对提升 22%。
AI.conclusion: ChartRevise 通过结构化数据集与细粒度评测协议，将图表编辑中的需求完成、冗余修改、遗漏联动三类问题分开度量，弥补了现有基准在编辑精确性评价上的空白，并验证了其作为训练与评测资源对模型编辑能力的提升作用。

title: PixelUMM: Encoder-Free Unified Image and Video Understanding and Generation
summary: Unified Multimodal Models (UMMs) often rely on separate visual representations for understanding and generation, increasing visual context length and complicating integration with established vision-language pretraining pipelines. Recent advances in pixel-space modeling offer an encoder-free alternative, but extending this paradigm from images to videos is non-trivial: video understanding and generation adopt different temporal representations, leaving the design of a unified visual interface an open question. We present PixelUMM, an encoder-free model for unified image and video understanding and generation directly in pixel space. PixelUMM represents images as spatial patches and videos as spatiotemporal tubelets, connecting raw pixels to a shared multimodal backbone through single-layer linear projections. Its Mixture-of-Transformers architecture combines shared attention with task-specific parameters and extends clean-pixel prediction to video generation, jointly supporting autoregressive text prediction and pixel-space flow matching. Experiments show that PixelUMM achieves competitive performance across image and video understanding and generation tasks. We further conduct empirical studies of key design choices, including decoder design and spatial-temporal patch size, providing insights for future pixel-space unified multimodal models.

AI.tldr: PixelUMM 提出一种无编码器的统一多模态模型，直接在像素空间上统一图像与视频的理解和生成，通过共享骨干网络连接空间 patch 与时空 tubelet，并在多任务上取得竞争性表现。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态统一模型通常对理解和生成使用独立的视觉表示，增加了视觉上下文长度，并使与已有视觉-语言预训练流程的整合变得复杂。像素空间建模提供了无编码器的替代方案，但从图像扩展到视频面临挑战：视频理解与生成采用不同的时间表示，统一视觉接口的设计仍是未解问题。
AI.method: PixelUMM 将图像表示为空间 patch、视频表示为时空 tubelet，通过单层线性投影将原始像素连接到共享多模态骨干网络。其 Mixture-of-Transformers 架构结合共享注意力与任务特定参数，并将干净像素预测扩展到视频生成，同时支持自回归文本预测和像素空间流匹配。
AI.result: 实验表明，PixelUMM 在图像和视频的理解与生成任务上均取得竞争性表现。作者还对关键设计选择进行了实证研究，包括解码器设计和时空 patch 尺寸，为未来像素空间统一多模态模型提供见解。
AI.conclusion: PixelUMM 验证了无编码器、直接像素空间的统一图像-视频多模态建模的可行性，并通过设计选择分析为后续研究提供指导。

title: Does Text Steer Neural PDE Surrogates? A Controlled Diagnostic with OperatorCLIP
comment: 8 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables. Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Representation for the Physical Sciences
summary: Lower error from a text-conditioned neural surrogate does not, by itself, show that the model uses the meaning of the text. We examine this attribution problem with OperatorCLIP, comparing an unconditioned FNO, a constant-sentence FiLM control, and a fixed task description trained with contrastive alignment. Three-seed experiments cover Darcy2D, ShallowWater2D, and three-dimensional compressible Navier-Stokes (CNS3D). Constant conditioning has lower mean test error on both 2D tasks. Relative to this control, task text plus alignment has a similar mean on ShallowWater2D and CNS3D and a higher mean on Darcy2D; these descriptive comparisons have substantial seed uncertainty. The latter comparison changes both prompt content and loss, so it isolates neither effect. The text encoder is trained from scratch, and each conditioned model sees only one description during training. In this regime, pairwise InfoNCE cannot identify matched pairs and has minimum $\log B$. Prompt interventions show no reliable semantic ordering. This methodological caution demonstrates why pathway controls are needed; it neither establishes semantic competence of the encoder nor tests the effectiveness of text under varying physical context.

AI.tldr: 文本条件神经代理模型的更低误差本身并不能证明模型利用了文本语义；本文以OperatorCLIP为例，通过无条件FNO、恒定句子FiLM控制组和对比对齐训练的固定任务描述进行三组实验，发现条件化带来的优势有限且不确定，提示需要路径控制。
AI.motivation: 文本条件模型若测试误差更低，常被解读为模型理解了文本含义，但这种归因存在问题。作者希望检验：性能提升究竟来自文本语义，还是来自条件化机制本身或损失函数等混杂因素。
AI.method: 提出OperatorCLIP，对比三种设置：无条件FNO、恒定句子FiLM控制组（constant-sentence FiLM control）、以及使用固定任务描述并配合对比对齐训练的条件模型。每个条件模型训练时仅见一个描述，文本编码器从头训练。实验覆盖Darcy2D、ShallowWater2D和三维可压缩Navier-Stokes（CNS3D），每种设置用三个随机种子。通过提示干预（prompt interventions）检验语义排序，并用InfoNCE分析匹配能力。
AI.result: 恒定条件化在两个二维任务上的平均测试误差更低。相对于该控制组，任务文本加对齐在ShallowWater2D和CNS3D上均值相近，在Darcy2D上均值更高；这些描述性比较存在明显的种子不确定性。由于后者同时改变了提示内容和损失函数，无法分离单一效应。InfoNCE在每模型仅见一个描述的情况下无法识别匹配对，最小值仅为log B。提示干预未表现出可靠的语义排序。
AI.conclusion: 本研究是一项方法论警示，说明为何需要路径控制；它既不证明编码器具备语义能力，也未检验文本在不同物理情境下的有效性。因此，文本条件模型的低误差不能作为其使用文本语义的证据。

title: AgBench: Agentic AI Benchmarks for Personal AI Devices
summary: Agentic AI systems increasingly rely on cloud-hosted large language models for planning, tool use, and iterative execution, raising concerns about API cost and data exposure. Advances in personal AI devices enable agents to execute locally, but limited resources on device may affect task success and performance. Existing benchmarks are inadequate for systematically characterizing these trade-offs across devices, workloads, and deployment architectures. We present AgBench, a benchmark suite and open artifacts for reproducible evaluation of agentic AI on personal devices. Using AgBench, we evaluate local, hybrid, and cloud execution across agentic workloads, examining task success, latency, cloud API cost, and data exposure. Our results, drawn from over 162.07 million data points, show that personal AI devices can complete many agent tasks locally, but local-only execution generally has lower task success and longer completion times than cloud-only execution, especially as concurrency increases. Local-only execution eliminates cloud model API costs and sensitive-information exposure to cloud agents. Hybrid execution can improve task success, but its cloud cost and data exposure depend on how agents divide work and share information. No single architecture performs best across task success, goodput, cloud cost, and data exposure; deployment choices should reflect the intended workload and device capabilities. AgBench is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/AgBench-2777.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AgBench 基准套件，用于在个人设备上可复现地评估 Agentic AI 的本地、混合与云端执行架构，并系统刻画任务成功率、延迟、API 成本与数据暴露之间的权衡。
AI.motivation: Agentic AI 系统日益依赖云端大模型进行规划、工具调用与迭代执行，带来 API 成本与数据暴露问题；个人 AI 设备虽支持本地执行，但资源受限可能影响任务成功与性能。现有基准无法系统刻画不同设备、工作负载与部署架构间的权衡。
AI.method: 提出 AgBench 基准套件与开放工件；基于该基准评估本地、混合和云端三种执行架构在多种 agentic 工作负载下的表现，考察任务成功率、延迟、云 API 成本与数据暴露，共采集超过 1.6207 亿个数据点。
AI.result: 个人 AI 设备可在本地完成许多 agent 任务，但纯本地执行通常任务成功率更低、完成时间更长，且随并发增加而加剧；纯本地执行可消除云模型 API 成本与向云端 agent 的敏感信息暴露；混合执行可提升任务成功率，但其云成本与数据暴露取决于任务划分与信息共享方式。
AI.conclusion: 没有单一架构能在任务成功率、有效吞吐、云成本与数据暴露上全面最优，部署选择应结合目标工作负载与设备能力。AgBench 已开放获取。

title: Aperture: Training-Free Multiscale Concept Bottlenecks for Remote Sensing
summary: While earth observation models have advanced substantially, they still lack interpretability. While concept-bottleneck models provide interpretability and expert interaction, they are either too expensive to train for the remote sensing domain or perform poorly without annotation. We posit that in expert domains like remote sensing, such training-free models require both fine details in both image and concept space. In image space, we propose a multiscale concept bottleneck using greedy quadtree routing to locate small concepts. In concept space, we replace contrastive vision language models with pre-trained MLLMs and present a way to get reliable concept scores from them. We introduce APERTURE that blends concept scores at the global image and native concept-scale level to give state-ofthe-art training-free model performance. To test these models, introduce SiFC, a fine-grained concept-centric dataset across three countries, with human-reviewed class-level concept maps. On SiFC, APERTURE outperforms the best training-free baselines by more than 10 percentage points in macro F1-score, and notably also outperforms supervised concept bottleneck models. Targeted component-removal tests examine whether concept scores respond to changes in visual evidence, while temporal experiments show that descriptor updates improve recognition of technological changes without retraining.

AI.tldr: 提出无需训练的概念瓶颈模型 APERTURE，通过多尺度图像路由与预训练 MLLM 获取可靠概念分数，并发布细粒度数据集 SiFC，在宏观 F1 上比最优免训练基线高 10 个百分点以上。
AI.motivation: 地球观测模型缺乏可解释性；现有概念瓶颈模型在遥感领域要么训练成本过高，要么在无标注时性能差。作者认为，在遥感这类专家领域，免训练模型需要图像与概念两个空间都具备细粒度信息。
AI.method: 图像空间：提出多尺度概念瓶颈，用贪心四叉树路由定位小型概念。概念空间：用预训练 MLLM 替代对比式视觉语言模型，并提出从中获得可靠概念分数的方法。随后在全局图像与原生概念尺度上融合概念分数。为评测，构建 SiFC 数据集——跨三国的细粒度概念中心数据集，含人工审核的类别级概念图。
AI.result: 在 SiFC 上，APERTURE 的宏观 F1 比最好的免训练基线高出 10 个百分点以上，且优于有监督概念瓶颈模型。组件移除实验检验概念分数是否响应视觉证据变化；时序实验显示描述符更新可在不重训练的情况下提升对技术变化的识别。
AI.conclusion: APERTURE 证明了结合多尺度图像路由与 MLLM 概念打分的免训练概念瓶颈方案在遥感细粒度任务上可行且领先，并通过组件移除与时序实验验证了其可解释性与可更新性。

title: ShamAN-Q: Shampoo Augmented NanoQuant for Sub-1-bit LLM Weights
summary: We introduce ShamAN-Q, a sub-1-bit post-training quantization method that extends NanoQuant by replacing each its diagonal reconstruction geometry with a tractable dense curvature metric, using a general paradigm popularized by the Shampoo optimizer. For each linear weight, ShamAN-Q fits a Kronecker product to the empirical Fisher information matrix of a small calibration set by Kullback--Leibler minimization, forming a Mahalanobis reconstruction loss from the result. The continuous ADMM updates from NanoQuant become solutions to Sylvester equations, while its discrete projection and deployment format remain unchanged. Because the curvature is local to a given set of weights, ShamAN-Q re-measures the input curvature statistic for each layer immediately before layer factorization, periodically refreshing all statistics on the partially quantized model. ShamAN-Q also redistributes the uniform rank from NanoQuant across layers at the same total number of bits. On Qwen3-Base, ShamAN-Q lowers WikiText-2 perplexity at $\approx$1 bpw from 27.56 to 22.96 (0.6B), 19.21 to 16.72 (1.7B), and 14.29 to 13.80 (4B) while matching or improving zero-shot accuracy on the Eleuther LM Evaluation Harness. On 0.6B, ShamAN-Q at $\approx$0.8 bpw matches the published perplexity of NanoQuant at $\approx$1.0 bpw.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ShamAN-Q，一种 sub-1-bit 后训练量化方法，通过用稠密曲率度量替代 NanoQuant 的对角重构几何，在极低位宽下显著降低困惑度并保持零样本精度。
AI.motivation: NanoQuant 等 sub-1-bit 后训练量化方法使用对角重构几何，可能无法刻画权重重构的真实曲率结构，导致量化误差较大。作者希望借助 Shampoo 优化器中流行的 Kronecker 分解思想，引入更精确的稠密曲率度量来提升量化质量。
AI.method: ShamAN-Q 将 NanoQuant 的每个对角重构几何替换为可处理的稠密曲率度量。对每个线性权重，通过 KL 最小化将 Kronecker 积拟合到小型校准集的经验 Fisher 信息矩阵，形成 Mahalanobis 重构损失。连续 ADMM 更新转化为 Sylvester 方程求解，离散投影与部署格式保持不变。由于曲率是局部的，方法在每层分解前重新测量输入曲率统计，并在部分量化模型上周期性刷新统计，同时在同一总比特数下重新分配 NanoQuant 的统一秩。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3-Base 上，ShamAN-Q 在约 1 bpw 时将 WikiText-2 困惑度从 27.56 降至 22.96（0.6B）、从 19.21 降至 16.72（1.7B）、从 14.29 降至 13.80（4B），同时在 Eleuther LM Evaluation Harness 上匹配或提升零样本精度。在 0.6B 上，约 0.8 bpw 的 ShamAN-Q 达到 NanoQuant 在约 1.0 bpw 的已发布困惑度。
AI.conclusion: 用稠密 Kronecker 曲率替代对角几何能有效提升 sub-1-bit 后训练量化性能，ShamAN-Q 在极低位宽下实现更优困惑度与精度，并能在更低比特率下匹配先前方法。

title: EvoSteer: Online Self-Evolving Graph Orchestration via Reference-Anchored Credit Assignment
summary: In recent years, LLM-based multi-agent systems have been widely applied to orchestrate tool-using agents into executable communication graphs. However, existing self-evolving orchestration still faces key challenges, including post-hoc evolution that revises the team only after the trajectory ends, credit diffusion that gives every action the same terminal advantage under confounded baselines, and skill admission that is uncalibrated and never retired. To address these challenges, we propose EvoSteer, a new paradigm of Online Self-Evolving Graph Orchestration -- the orchestrator builds a running team and repairs its plausible but failing steps from execution features and a learned value estimate. To support this paradigm, we introduce Anchored Trajectory Balance (AnchorTB), a regression-style flow-matching loss that assigns each orchestration action a coefficient by balancing subtrajectories against a frozen reference. Built on the learned flow, we further propose Validated Skill Admission, in which a candidate skill is tried before promotion and promoted only if paired evidence passes a sequential test under a shared nominal testing budget. Moreover, AnchorTB combines measured task-level reference reward statistics with prefix-dependent corrections. Experimental results on twelve datasets show that EvoSteer significantly outperforms baselines across question answering, mathematical reasoning, code generation, and interactive decision making. Our code is available at https://github.com/beita6969/evosteer.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EvoSteer，一种在线自演化图编排新范式，通过锚定轨迹平衡（AnchorTB）与验证式技能准入机制，解决现有LLM多智能体编排中事后演化、信用扩散和技能准入不校准的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的多智能体系统在编排工具使用智能体时存在三大挑战：一是事后演化，仅在轨迹结束后才修正团队；二是信用扩散，在混杂基线作用下所有动作获得相同的终端优势；三是技能准入未校准且从不淘汰。这些问题限制了系统的自演化能力与编排质量。
AI.method: 提出EvoSteer范式，即在线自演化图编排，编排器基于执行特征和学习到的价值估计实时构建运行团队并修复看似合理但失败的步骤。引入Anchored Trajectory Balance（AnchorTB），一种回归式流匹配损失，通过将子轨迹与冻结参考进行平衡，为每个编排动作分配系数，并结合任务级参考奖励统计与前缀相关修正。此外提出Validated Skill Admission，候选技能需先试用，只有配对证据在共享名义测试预算下通过序贯检验才被提升，同时支持技能淘汰。
AI.result: 在十二个数据集上的实验结果表明，EvoSteer在问答、数学推理、代码生成和交互式决策等任务上显著优于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: EvoSteer通过在线自演化编排、AnchorTB流匹配损失和验证式技能准入，有效解决了事后演化、信用扩散和技能准入不校准的问题，在多种任务上取得显著性能提升。

title: After a Decade: Bringing Shadow Removal into the Real World with Agentic Training Data
summary: Shadow removal looks nearly solved on established benchmarks, yet remains brittle in the real world. Models have advanced; the paired training data they rely on have barely changed in nearly a decade. The reason is simple: obtaining a shadow-free target requires removing the occluder while keeping the scene, camera, and illumination otherwise unchanged, making diverse paired data difficult to capture. Meanwhile, large shadow detection datasets already contain diverse real-world images and masks, but no shadow-free targets. To turn this abundant but incomplete data into paired supervision, we propose an offline agentic workflow combining physics-motivated generation, failure detection, feedback-driven retry, candidate selection, and deterministic correction. Using this workflow, we construct AgenticShadow, a dataset of 17,138 image-mask-target triplets spanning general scenes, faces, and remote sensing. Our construction workflow reduces Color Distribution Difference by 50.5% over previous shadow removal work, while training existing shadow removal models on AgenticShadow reduces cross-domain LAB RMSE by 19.7-37.5%.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对真实场景阴影去除数据稀缺问题，提出离线智能体工作流，将现有阴影检测数据集转化为配对监督数据，构建了AgenticShadow数据集（17,138个三元组），显著降低了色差并提升跨域阴影去除性能。
AI.motivation: 阴影去除在既定基准上看似已接近解决，但在真实世界中仍表现脆弱。核心瓶颈在于配对训练数据近十年几乎未变：获取无阴影目标需移除遮挡物同时保持场景、相机和光照不变，导致多样化配对数据难以采集。而现有大规模阴影检测数据集虽含多样真实图像和掩码，却缺少无阴影目标。
AI.method: 提出离线智能体工作流，将大量但不完整的阴影检测数据转化为配对监督数据。该工作流结合物理驱动的生成、失败检测、反馈驱动的重试、候选选择以及确定性校正。据此构建AgenticShadow数据集，包含17,138个图像-掩码-目标三元组，覆盖通用场景、人脸和遥感。
AI.result: 构建工作流相比以往阴影去除工作将颜色分布差异（Color Distribution Difference）降低50.5%；在AgenticShadow上训练现有阴影去除模型，可将跨域LAB RMSE降低19.7%–37.5%。
AI.conclusion: 通过智能体工作流将已有阴影检测数据转化为配对监督数据，可有效缓解真实场景配对数据稀缺问题，提升阴影去除模型的跨域泛化能力。

title: MM-FinEval: A Multi-Task Multimodal Benchmark for Real-World Financial Forecasting
summary: Financial forecasting from earnings conference calls requires models to reason over complex corporate disclosures, market expectations, and subtle communication signals. However, existing financial benchmarks are often limited to unimodal inputs or single-task settings, making it difficult to evaluate whether multimodal large language models (LLMs) can support real-world financial analysis. In this paper, we introduce MM-FinEval, a novel benchmark designed to evaluate multimodal LLMs across multiple financial tasks. MM-FinEval spans a diverse timeline from 2019 to 2022. The entire proposed dataset contains 2,045 S\&P 500 conference earning calls as inputs and 12 financial task labels as outputs. Each input contains three modalities: a word-to-word text transcript of the earning call, the corresponding presentation slides used during the call, and the entire audio recording. To establish a rigorous evaluation framework, we analyze 19 baseline models across three distinct model categories: Image-Text, Audio-Text, and Any-to-Any configurations. We observe that small-size Any-to-Any models processing all three modalities achieve strong performance, even when compared against larger proprietary models restricted to two-modality inputs. This indicates that our tri-modal dataset design introduces useful, non-redundant information. These results validate that text, audio, and visual data serve as important, complementary signals that mimic the decision-making process of expert human analysts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MM-FinEval，一个面向财报电话会议的多模态、多任务金融评测基准，包含 2019-2022 年 2,045 个标普 500 财报电话会议，覆盖文本、幻灯片图像和音频三种模态与 12 类任务标签，并对 19 个基线模型进行系统评估。
AI.motivation: 现有金融基准多局限于单模态输入或单任务设定，难以评估多模态大语言模型能否胜任真实金融分析中复杂的公司披露、市场预期与沟通信号推理。因此需要一个多模态、多任务的金融评测基准。
AI.method: 构建 MM-FinEval 基准：数据覆盖 2019 至 2022 年，共 2,045 个标普 500 财报电话会议作为输入，12 个金融任务标签作为输出；每个输入包含三种模态——逐字的文字转录、会议中使用的演示幻灯片、完整音频录音。评估框架涵盖三类共 19 个基线模型：Image-Text、Audio-Text 与 Any-to-Any 配置。
AI.result: 小规模 Any-to-Any 模型在处理全部三种模态时表现强劲，甚至优于仅支持两模态输入的大型专有模型，说明三模态设计带来了有用且非冗余的信息。
AI.conclusion: 文本、音频与视觉数据是重要且互补的信号，能够模拟专家人类分析师在财报电话会议中的决策过程；MM-FinEval 为多模态 LLM 的金融分析能力提供了更贴近实际的评测手段。

title: Where Scientific Search Agents Fail: Decision-Checkpoint Auditing of Exposure and Inspection Attempts
summary: Final-answer accuracy does not reveal whether a scientific-search agent failed to encounter a target paper, attempt to inspect it, or return an accepted answer after inspection. We introduce decision checkpoints that record observations and tool actions without benchmark labels during inference, then join target identities and evaluator labels to assign outcome categories from recorded events. Across five conditions on 540 answerable AutoResearchBench Deep questions in a fixed, target-enriched environment, keyword search achieves 24.6\% accuracy, compared with 17.8\% for raw search. The keyword condition has fewer incorrect answers with neither target exposure nor inspection, but more incorrect answers after the target is exposed and left uninspected. Compared with keyword search, read-first has 27.4\% more recorded evidence-search calls. Target inspection attempts occur on 199 questions under read-first and 191 under keyword search; both conditions achieve 24.6\% accuracy. The checkpoint protocol makes these question-level differences explicit, distinguishing target exposure and inspection from aggregate accuracy and total tool use.

AI.tldr: 提出"决策检查点"协议，在推理时记录观测与工具动作，再联合目标身份与评测标签划分结果类别，以揭示科学搜索代理在聚合准确率背后"目标暴露"与"目标检查"的行为差异。
AI.motivation: 仅看最终答案准确率无法区分科学搜索代理是未能遇到目标论文、尝试检查却失败，还是检查后返回了合格答案，因此需要更细粒度的过程性诊断方法。
AI.method: 在推理阶段设置决策检查点，记录观测与工具动作但不使用基准标签；随后将目标身份与评测标签与记录事件关联，为每个问题分配结果类别。在固定且目标丰富的环境中，对 AutoResearchBench Deep 的 540 道可回答问题进行五种条件对比。
AI.result: 关键词搜索准确率 24.6%，原始搜索为 17.8%。关键词条件下"未暴露目标且未检查"的错误更少，但"目标已暴露却未检查"的错误更多。相比关键词搜索，read-first 多出 27.4% 的已记录证据搜索调用；目标检查尝试在 read-first 下出现于 199 题、关键词搜索下 191 题，两者准确率均为 24.6%。
AI.conclusion: 检查点协议使问题层面的差异显性化，可将目标暴露与检查行为同聚合准确率和总工具使用量区分开来。

title: Exo2EgoHOI: Hand-Object-Interaction Aware Exocentric-to-Egocentric Video Generation
summary: Egocentric videos of human manipulation provide valuable visual experience for embodied intelligence, yet collecting such data at scale is costly. Exocentric-to-egocentric video generation offers a scalable alternative by transforming abundant third-person manipulation videos into first-person observations. However, existing methods often struggle to faithfully preserve demonstrated hand-object interactions (HOI) across large viewpoint changes due to insufficient fine-grained interaction guidance and weak object-centric anchoring. We present Exo2EgoHOI, an HOI-aware video generative framework for interaction-preserving exocentric-to-egocentric translation. To preserve fine-grained HOI, we introduce a unified 4D HOI prior that combines scene geometry, articulated hand renderings, and dense hand-object relation fields, together with a dual-branch residual adapter for injecting structural and relational cues into the video generation backbone. To preserve object consistency, we introduce Decomposed Gated Cross-Attention, which separately encodes object and background references and adaptively integrates global semantic and local appearance features as object-centric anchors. Experiments on ARCTIC-HOI and Ego-Exo4D demonstrate substantial improvements in object consistency and HOI preservation while maintaining competitive visual fidelity. In particular, on ARCTIC-HOI, Exo2EgoHOI improves object mIoU by 32.3% and reduces MPJPE and PA-MPJPE by 34.7% and 50.0%, respectively, relative to the respective best baseline results. Project page: https://rcl-robotics.github.io/Exo2EgoHOI/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Exo2EgoHOI，一个以 HOI 感知为核心的第三人称到第一人称视频生成框架，通过 4D HOI 先验与物体中心锚定机制，在视角大幅变化下保持手物交互与物体一致性。
AI.motivation: 第一人称人手操作视频对具身智能有价值，但大规模采集成本高。用第三人称视频转为第一人称是可扩展替代方案，然而现有方法在大视角变化下难以忠实保留手物交互，原因在于细粒度交互引导不足、物体中心锚定薄弱。
AI.method: 提出统一 4D HOI 先验，结合场景几何、关节手渲染与稠密手物关系场；并设计双分支残差适配器，将结构与关系线索注入视频生成主干。为保持物体一致性，提出分解门控交叉注意力（Decomposed Gated Cross-Attention），分别编码物体与背景参考，并自适应融合全局语义与局部外观特征作为物体中心锚点。
AI.result: 在 ARCTIC-HOI 与 Ego-Exo4D 上，物体一致性与 HOI 保持显著提升，同时视觉保真度具竞争力。ARCTIC-HOI 上，相对各自最强基线，物体 mIoU 提升 32.3%，MPJPE 与 PA-MPJPE 分别降低 34.7% 和 50.0%。
AI.conclusion: Exo2EgoHOI 通过 HOI 感知的 4D 先验与物体中心锚定，有效解决跨视角手物交互保持难题，为低成本、可扩展获取第一人称操作视频提供了可行方案。

title: Revisiting scaling laws for reward optimization
summary: Scaling laws for optimization against reward models in AI alignment have pinned down how performance depends on optimization effort---measured by a KL-divergence budget relative to a reference policy. Beyond a certain budget, over-optimization (or reward hacking) can arise: because we optimize against a proxy reward model (distinct from true rewards), performance can plateau or degrade. Naturally, the proxy reward's accuracy depends on how much preference data (often in the form of pairwise comparisons) was used to train it. However, existing research does not cleanly identify how performance jointly scales with the amount of training data and the divergence budget. Our main contribution is to provide an empirically accurate and theoretically grounded scaling law in such context. Performance roughly scales as $Θ(\sqrt{\min\{\log(M),K\}})$, where $M$ is the number of comparisons in training data and $K$ is the policy's divergence budget. We develop an information-theoretic model to establish this upper bound and prove it is tightly achievable through a constructive procedure. Informed by this, we conduct extensive empirical evaluations using a real-world annotation setup, whereby a large 70B gold reward model generates feedback data and proxy reward models are trained from less capable models (0.6B to 4B). Our scaling law provides an excellent fit (R2 from 97\% to 99\%), outperforms alternative specifications, and remains robust across model sizes, noise, and optimization procedures (best-of-$N$ or policy tilting). Our evidence suggests that reward optimization is analogous to a surprisingly simple selection task: choosing from a sequence of IID Gaussian random variables using noisy preference feedback.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个关于在AI对齐中针对奖励模型优化时，性能如何随训练数据量和KL散度预算联合缩放的经验准确且理论有据的缩放定律：性能大致按Θ(√min{log(M),K})缩放，其中M为训练数据中的比较次数，K为策略散度预算。
AI.motivation: 现有关于AI对齐中针对奖励模型优化的缩放定律已确定了性能如何取决于优化努力（以相对于参考策略的KL散度预算衡量），但并未清晰识别性能如何同时随训练数据量和散度预算缩放。因此有必要建立二者联合的缩放规律。
AI.method: 作者开发了一个信息论模型来建立上界，并证明该上界可通过构造性过程紧致达成。基于此，使用真实世界标注设置进行了大量实证评估：由大型70B黄金奖励模型生成反馈数据，并从能力较弱的模型（0.6B至4B）训练代理奖励模型，采用best-of-N或policy tilting等优化程序并考察模型规模与噪声。
AI.result: 所提出的缩放定律拟合效果极佳（R²为97%至99%），优于替代设定，并在模型规模、噪声及优化程序（best-of-N或policy tilting）上保持稳健。性能大致按Θ(√min{log(M),K})缩放。
AI.conclusion: 证据表明奖励优化类似于一个异常简单的选择任务：使用带噪声的偏好反馈从一系列独立同分布高斯随机变量中进行选择。

title: Concept-Grounded Attention: A Controlled Evaluation of Graph-Injected Attention, Temporal Versioning, and Epistemic Status
summary: Knowledge-intensive language-model systems typically represent external knowledge as text chunks or static graphs, with limited support for concept evolution, point-in-time reasoning, and distinctions between validated and inferred knowledge. We introduce the Concept Lifecycle Model (CLM), which represents concepts as persistent, graph-grounded, temporally versioned entities with explicit provenance and epistemic status, and Concept-Grounded Attention (CGA), which injects concept-graph structure into transformer computation through graph-biased self-attention (Form A) and gated cross-attention over concept nodes (Form B). We evaluate the framework in controlled settings using disabled-mechanism baselines. On 200 MuSiQue and HotpotQA questions with retrieval fixed, concept-graph retrieval recovers explicit multi-hop paths but does not improve evidence recall. Form A appears to steer attention, with 2.76 times more attention on gold than distractor concepts, but the same ratio occurs when Form A is disabled; the learned bias is negligible and no answers change. An identity-preserving Form B improves F1 from 0.188 to 0.221, but control concepts yield 0.213, indicating that most of the gain reflects added capacity. On LongMemEval, explicit temporal representation improves answer accuracy by 13 to 25 points across all tested generators, up to 122B parameters, while simplified CLM version resolution performs similarly to dated serialization because concept identity is not established reliably. On a synthetic source-independence task, protocol-derived epistemic status reduces unsupported assertions from 28% to 0.1% in a fine-tuned small model and from 19-68% to 0-5% in 72-122B models. Overall, the results support making temporal validity and epistemic status explicit, while showing that graph-attention diagnostics are not informative without disabled-mechanism controls.

AI.tldr: 本文提出概念生命周期模型（CLM）与概念接地注意力（CGA），通过显式时间版本与认识论状态表示外部知识，并在多组基准上验证其有效性，同时强调图注意力机制需依赖禁用机制对照才能得到可靠结论。
AI.motivation: 现有知识密集型语言模型系统多以文本块或静态图表示外部知识，难以支持概念演化、时间点推理以及已验证知识与推断知识的区分，因此需要一种带有显式来源与认识论状态的知识表示框架。
AI.method: 提出CLM，将概念表示为持久化、图接地、带时间版本、具备显式来源与认识论状态的实体；提出CGA，通过图偏置自注意力（Form A）与概念节点上的门控交叉注意力（Form B）将概念图结构注入Transformer计算。评估采用禁用机制的对照基线，测试集包括MuSiQue、HotpotQA、LongMemEval及合成的来源独立性任务。
AI.result: 检索固定时，概念图检索能恢复显式多跳路径但不提升证据召回；Form A看似引导注意力（金标概念注意力为干扰概念的2.76倍），但禁用后比例相同，学习偏置可忽略且答案无变化；保身份的Form B将F1从0.188提至0.221，但对照概念为0.213，说明增益多来自容量增加；LongMemEval上显式时间表示使准确率提升13至25个点（模型至122B参数）；来源独立性任务中，协议衍生的认识论状态将无依据断言从28%降至0.1%（小模型微调）、从19-68%降至0-5%（72-122B模型）。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持将时间有效性与认识论状态显式化，同时表明若缺少禁用机制对照，图注意力诊断并不具信息量。

title: HIGS: Hierarchical Implicit Grids for Joint Geometric and Semantic Scene Understanding
summary: Neural implicit representations have had a significant impact on scene reconstruction by enabling robots to build continuous, differentiable, and high-fidelity 3D maps. Most existing works focus on geometric reconstruction and lack semantic information for high-level spatial understanding and task planning. Also, as the scale and complexity of the environment increase, neural representations face the challenge of maintaining computational efficiency in back-end optimization. To resolve these two challenges, we introduce a hierarchical neural field that leverages multiresolution submaps to achieve an efficient and scalable implicit representation, and a unified query and decoding mechanism to support both geometric and semantic features. More specifically, the learnable map features can be converted to the output with the query and decoding process for both training and inference. For large-scale representation, we decompose a scene into overlapping submaps and do hierarchical optimization within each local submap, thus enabling scalable computation. To further improve efficiency, we design feature encoders that predict initial hierarchical grid features to substantially reduce the time needed to optimize the submap features from scratch. To correct estimation drift among submaps, we align and fuse them entirely within the implicit feature space, leading to substantial acceleration by avoiding the need to decode the final output. Building upon this efficient hierarchical representation, we embed both geometric features and vision-language latent features into the map, and demonstrate it on both Signed Distance Field (SDF) construction and open-vocabulary object grounding. Our approach significantly improves computation and memory efficiency, maintains high estimation accuracy, and endows the robot with spatial awareness on large-scale real-world benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种层次化神经场表示方法，通过多分辨率子图实现高效可扩展的隐式建图，并统一查询与解码机制支持几何和语义特征，在SDF构建与开放词汇物体定位任务上兼顾精度与计算/内存效率。
AI.motivation: 现有神经隐式表示多聚焦几何重建，缺乏语义信息以支撑高层空间理解与任务规划；同时随环境规模与复杂度增加，后端优化面临计算效率难以维持的挑战。论文旨在同时解决这两大问题。
AI.method: 提出层次化神经场：将场景分解为重叠子图并在各局部子图内做层次优化以实现可扩展计算；设计特征编码器预测初始层次网格特征，减少从零优化子图特征的时间；在隐式特征空间内对齐融合子图以校正漂移，避免解码最终输出而大幅加速；通过统一的查询与解码机制，将可学习地图特征转换为几何与语义输出。
AI.result: 在大规模真实世界基准上，该方法显著提升计算与内存效率，保持高估计精度，并同时支持SDF构建和开放词汇物体定位，赋予机器人空间感知能力。
AI.conclusion: 层次化神经场结合多分辨率子图与统一查询解码机制，能有效实现兼具几何与语义、高效可扩展的隐式建图，适用于大规模机器人场景理解任务。

title: Does This Action Still Explain the Task? Reverse Scoring for Diffusion Language Model Agents
summary: Diffusion-based large language models (dLLMs) promise to break the sequential latency bottleneck of autoregressive agents through parallel decoding, but recent evaluations show this efficiency does not transfer to embodied agentic competence: dLLM-backed agents repeatedly fall into retry loops, re-issuing an action long after it has failed. We give a mechanistic account of this failure and a training-free remedy. We trace the retry loop to the adaptivity of masked decoding: the sampler commits the positions it is most confident about and defers the uncertain ones, and at a failure state the context already offers a confident fill for the deferred decision, i.e. the failed action itself, so the retry is committed without the failure feedback ever being confronted. We model the resulting distortion of the action distribution as a task-blind corruption: contextually salient actions (e.g., the action just taken) receive inflated probability by a factor that depends on the state and the action but not on the task. Under this model, we analyse an invariance proposition: the task-blind factor cancels exactly from the reverse conditional, i.e. the likelihood of the task given the state and a candidate action, which coincides with the task posterior of an idealized uncorrupted model. Masked dLLMs evaluate the reverse conditional natively, unlike autoregressive models, by masking the task tokens and denoising, at the cost of a few parallel passes per candidate. We instantiate the rule as Reflect Reverse and evaluate it on four multi-turn embodied benchmarks, where it improves task success and progression rates over forward-scoring baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示扩散式大语言模型（dLLM）智能体陷入重试循环的机制，并提出无需训练的补救方法 Reflect Reverse。
AI.motivation: dLLM 通过并行解码有望突破自回归智能体的顺序延迟瓶颈，但实验显示其效率优势无法转化为具身智能体能力：dLLM 驱动的智能体会反复陷入重试循环，在动作早已失败后仍不断重新发出同一动作。作者希望给出这一失败的机制性解释并提供补救方案。
AI.method: 将重试循环归因于掩码解码的自适应性：采样器优先确定高置信位置、推迟不确定位置，而在失败状态下上下文已为被推迟的决策提供了高置信填充（即失败动作本身），导致重试在未面对失败反馈时就被确定。作者将该动作分布扭曲建模为任务无关的污染：上下文显著的动作（如刚执行的动作）概率被放大，放大因子依赖状态与动作但不依赖任务。在此模型下，作者分析了一个不变性命题：任务无关因子在反向条件（给定状态和候选动作时任务的可能性）中恰好抵消，与理想无污染模型的任务后验一致。掩码 dLLM 天然可通过掩蔽任务 token 并去噪来评估反向条件（自回归模型则不能），每个候选代价为少量并行轮次。作者据此提出 Reflect Reverse 规则。
AI.result: 在四个多轮具身基准上评估，Reflect Reverse 相比前向评分基线提升了任务成功率和推进率。
AI.conclusion: dLLM 智能体的重试循环源于掩码解码的自信填充机制；通过评估反向条件可精确抵消任务无关的分布污染，Reflect Reverse 作为一种无需训练的补救方法经验性地改善了具身智能体表现。

title: GATE-ST: Gene-Aware Text-image Encoder for Spatial Transcriptomics
summary: Spatial transcriptomics enables spatially resolved gene expression analysis from slide-level images while preserving morphological features, providing valuable information for studying disease mechanisms and developing treatments. However, spatial gene expression profiling typically requires expensive and time-consuming tests. While existing image-based prediction optimizations mostly revolve around including positional embeddings and further image-based changes, text-based optimizations remain relatively unexplored. We present GATE-ST, which incorporates text-based inputs into image-based spatial gene expression predictions. With this approach, generated text descriptions of genes are utilized to better spatial transcriptomics prediction results. Gene summaries are put through a text encoder, generating embeddings that integrate with image embeddings through cross-attention layers to align with morphological features. We demonstrate the effectiveness of such text inputs by benchmarking performance against random gene embeddings and multiple other image-text fusion architectures, and show that GATE-ST outperforms these alternatives. Our results demonstrate the effectiveness of GATE-ST in pathology imaging, which may greatly reduce the time and cost of accurate spatial transcriptomic predictions, proving the potential of text-guided spatial gene expression prediction.

AI.tldr: 提出 GATE-ST，将基因文本描述引入图像驱动的空间基因表达预测，通过文本编码与图像嵌入的交叉注意力对齐形态特征，性能优于随机基因嵌入和其他图文融合架构。
AI.motivation: 空间转录组分析虽能保留形态信息，但检测昂贵耗时；现有图像预测优化多聚焦位置嵌入与图像端改进，基于文本的优化仍相对空白。
AI.method: 将基因的文本摘要经文本编码器生成嵌入，与图像嵌入通过交叉注意力层融合，以对齐形态学特征，用于空间基因表达预测。
AI.result: 与随机基因嵌入及多种图文融合架构进行基准对比，GATE-ST 均取得更优表现。
AI.conclusion: 文本引导的空间基因表达预测在病理成像中有效，有望大幅降低精确空间转录组预测的时间与成本。

title: Eulerian Motion Reconstruction for Water Scenery
summary: Reconstructing and animating water scenery from nature produces compelling and immersive visual experiences. Previous work examined this task from the perspective of 2D video textures, with the goal of creating a looping video. In our work, we tackle the problem from a 3D perspective, creating a looping 4D dynamic reconstruction which can be interactively rendered from novel viewpoints from a single non-looping 2D source video. We represent motion as a 3D static \textit{Eulerian} motion field that advects canonical Gaussian splats that are cyclically reborn at fixed time periods, supervised using rendering losses. To model non-periodic and stochastic dynamics present in real-world scenes, we add a non-periodic, time-varying residual term to capture deviations from the static Eulerian motion field. We show quantitatively and qualitatively that our framework enables photorealistic animation of water scenes better than prior art.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种从单段非循环2D视频重建可循环4D动态水体场景的方法，通过3D静态欧拉运动场驱动周期性重生的规范高斯splat，并加入非周期时变残差项，实现可从新视角交互渲染的逼真水体动画。
AI.motivation: 以往从自然中重建并动画化水体景观的工作多基于2D视频纹理，目标是生成可循环播放的视频，缺乏3D视角的自由度。本文希望从3D视角出发，用单段非循环2D源视频，构建可交互、可从新视角渲染的可循环4D动态重建，从而获得更具沉浸感的视觉体验。
AI.method: 将运动表示为3D静态欧拉运动场，该运动场对流传送规范高斯splat，这些splat在固定时间周期循环重生，并使用渲染损失进行监督。为刻画真实场景中的非周期与随机动态，额外加入一个非周期、时变的残差项以捕捉相对静态欧拉运动场的偏差。
AI.result: 定量与定性实验表明，该框架能够比已有方法更好地实现水体的照片级真实感人动画。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将水体场景重建从2D视频纹理推进到3D可循环4D重建，能够从单段非循环视频出发、从新视角交互渲染，兼顾周期性运动与随机动态，在真实感上优于先前方法。

title: ReLaG: A Scalable Framework Generalizing Random Splits to Data with Latent Relations
summary: Random splitting can yield non-independent train--test subsets when a dataset contains related samples, as is common in certain applications such as biochemical studies. This leads to overly optimistic generalization estimates. Here, we introduce ReLaG, a modality-agnostic framework that models sample relatedness through a hierarchical latent-variable process and infers groups of related samples using proximity graphs and community detection to produce independent train--test subsets. Across molecular and protein datasets, ReLaG matches existing relation-aware methods while scaling substantially better, enabling splits at previously impractical dataset sizes. We further introduce a label-free procedure that adapts the splitting resolution to production data, aligning evaluation with the intended deployment setting. ReLaG's inferred groups provide a cheap estimate of effective dataset size, enabling diversity-aware dataset scaling. ReLaG is open source and can be installed with pip install relag.

AI.tldr: ReLaG是一个模态无关的框架，通过层次潜变量过程建模样本相关性，利用近邻图和社区检测推断相关样本组，从而生成独立的训练-测试划分，避免随机划分导致的乐观泛化估计。
AI.motivation: 在生化等应用中，数据集常包含相关样本，随机划分会产生非独立的训练-测试子集，导致泛化估计过于乐观，需要一种能识别样本相关性并生成真正独立划分的方法。
AI.method: ReLaG将样本相关性建模为层次潜变量过程，并利用近邻图与社区检测推断相关样本组，进而生成独立的训练-测试子集。此外还提出无标签流程，可根据生产数据自适应调整划分分辨率。
AI.result: 在分子和蛋白质数据集上，ReLaG与现有的关系感知方法效果相当，但扩展性显著更好，可在以往不切实际的数据规模上进行划分；其推断的组还提供了有效数据集规模的廉价估计。
AI.conclusion: ReLaG是开源框架，可通过pip install relag安装，为生成独立训练-测试划分、对齐部署评估及多样性感知的数据扩展提供了实用工具。

title: Budget Boundary Effects in Test-Time Mathematical Reasoning
comment: Accepted as a poster at the 6th Workshop on Mathematical Reasoning and AI (MATH-AI), NeurIPS 2026. 11 pages, 3 figures, 8 tables. Includes additional post-acceptance accounting and selection diagnostics
summary: A cumulative token cap can fall inside a mathematical derivation, forcing a test-time controller to choose between stopping at the cap (strict) and allowing the current attempt to finish (advisory). We measure this boundary choice with paired offline replays of 19,200 public traces: 120 AIME, BrUMO and HMMT problems and two archive configurations of one model. Candidate order and a 16-attempt cap are fixed, and answer selection is blind to reference answers and correctness labels. Three findings emerge. First, at the 4k cap, most advisory accuracy gains replace abstention with a correct answer; strict stopping pays for an unfinished prefix that the completed-only selector cannot use. Second, comparisons along realized cost differ from same-cap comparisons: advisory 4k in low has higher accuracy than strict 8k at comparable mean completion cost, while in high its observed accuracy is 0.42 points below strict 32k using 59% of its mean tokens. These aggregate comparisons do not establish equal-compute superiority or accuracy equivalence. Third, increased candidate coverage does not guarantee higher answer accuracy: a log-probability selector loses accuracy while coverage rises, including after a source-grade consistency repair. Same-cap majority-accuracy differences shrink below 1.3 percentage points at 32k. Budget curves should jointly state the cap, realized cost, eligible candidates, stopping rule and selector information.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对19,200条公开轨迹的配对离线重放，考察累积token上限落入数学推导过程时"严格停止"与"建议性停止"的边界选择，并揭示精确率、实际成本与候选覆盖之间的非等价关系。
AI.motivation: 累积token上限可能恰好落在数学推导的中间，迫使测试时控制器在"到上限即停"（严格）与"允许当前尝试完成"（建议性）之间做选择。作者希望量化这一边界选择的影响，并厘清不同比较方式（同上限 vs 同实际成本）下预算曲线的解读问题。
AI.method: 对19,200条公开轨迹进行配对离线重放，涵盖120道AIME、BrUMO和HMMT题目及同一模型的两种归档配置；固定候选顺序与16次尝试上限，答案选择对参考答案和正确性标签保持盲选。对比严格与建议性停止规则，并沿实际成本进行跨上限比较。
AI.result: 第一，在4k上限下，建议性停止带来的精度提升大多是把弃答替换为正确答案，而严格停止会因未完成前缀而付出代价，仅完成选择器无法利用。第二，沿实际成本的比较与同上限比较不同：低配下建议性4k在相近平均完成成本下精度高于严格8k，高配下其观测精度比严格32k低0.42个百分点，仅用其59%的平均token。第三，候选覆盖增加并不保证精度提高：对数概率选择器在覆盖上升时精度反而下降，即使经过来源级一致性修复亦然。在32k时，同上限多数投票精度差异缩小至1.3个百分点以内。
AI.conclusion: 预算曲线应同时标明上限、实际成本、合格候选、停止规则和选择器信息；聚合比较不足以确立等算力优越性或精度等价性。

title: STEPS: Scene Text Editing with Preserved Style Using Diffusion and Contrastive Style Encoding
comment: 9 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. A version of this paper appeared in PAKDD 2026 (LNCS vol. 16618)
summary: We introduce Scene Text Editing with Preserved Style (STEPS), a novel diffusion model architecture for quality text replacement in images. Scene Text Editing (STE), also known as Visual Text Editing, consists of changing the textual content in an image while conserving the original style, e.g. font, colors, orientation, background, etc. STEPS advances the state of the art in STE through directed focus on improved style preservation. We introduce a style encoder for visual text that captures style independently of textual content, and a model architecture that combines the style encoder with multiple semantic conditions (target text characters encoding and rendered glyphs). STEPS achieves superior results to previous STE methods in style preservation, output readability, and subjective quality.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出STEPS，一种用于图像文本替换的扩散模型架构，通过独立于文本内容的风格编码器实现高质量场景文本编辑。
AI.motivation: 场景文本编辑（STE）需要在更改图像文本内容的同时保留原有风格（字体、颜色、方向、背景等），而现有方法在风格保持方面仍有不足。
AI.method: 提出STEPS扩散模型架构，包含一个独立于文本内容的视觉文本风格编码器，并将其与多种语义条件（目标文本字符编码与渲染字形）相结合。
AI.result: 在风格保持、输出可读性和主观质量方面，STEPS均优于先前的STE方法。
AI.conclusion: STEPS通过聚焦风格保持的架构设计，推动了场景文本编辑领域的技术进步。

title: When a Flatness Proxy Is Not a Function: Robustness Certificates and Training Interventions
summary: A valid curvature upper bound need not justify either a robustness certificate or an intervention on an intrinsic predictor property. We demonstrate this distinction for a last-layer relative-flatness proxy used in both settings. First, empirical-risk stationarity does not eliminate pointwise first-order loss terms: at a finite global empirical-risk minimum, the retained certificate expression underestimates a loss increase by over $210\times$. We derive a globally valid, gauge-invariant feature-space repair. Second, common-row softmax shifts preserve predictions and the exact contraction while making the proxy unbounded. Even standard reference-class choices double it on average relative to the centered representation. For a single fixed-feature example with at least three classes, scalar retuning generically cannot align the induced probability updates. Row centering gives the orbit-minimized bound and restores value and full-model gradient invariance under this symmetry. Across 45 paired one-step tests on algorithmic and image models, amplified shifts separate raw-regularized predictors while quotient-regularized predictors remain aligned. Long-horizon CIFAR-10 experiments show substantial, reversible suppression of generalization, while evidence for selective delay after memorization is less consistent. Together, these results show that validity as a curvature upper bound does not by itself justify either inversion into a robustness certificate or differentiation into an intrinsic training intervention.

AI.tldr: 本文区分了"曲率上界有效"与"可用于鲁棒性证书或内在训练干预"两种性质，并以末层相对平坦度代理为例加以论证。
AI.motivation: 文献中常把一个有效的曲率上界直接当作鲁棒性证书的合法性依据，或直接对其进行微分以构造内在正则化干预，但这一推断本身缺乏严格论证，需要检验此种"有效性"是否足以支撑上述两种用途。
AI.method: 作者针对末层相对平坦度代理构造反例与分析：一是考察有限全局经验风险极小点处保留的一阶损失项，给出有效且规范不变的特征空间修复；二是分析公共行softmax平移对预测与收缩性的保持，比较原始表示与中心化表示下的代理取值，并研究固定特征下多达三类以上时的概率更新对齐问题，同时进行45组配对单步测试与CIFAR-10长程实验。
AI.result: 经验风险平稳性不能消除逐点一阶损失项：在有限全局经验风险极小点处，保留的证书表达式低估损失增幅超过210倍；公共行softmax平移保持预测与精确收缩却使代理无界，标准参考类选择平均使其相对中心化表示翻倍；在至少三类的固定特征例子中，标量重调一般无法对齐诱导的概率更新。行中心化给出轨道最小化上界，并在此对称性下恢复取值与全模型梯度不变性。45组配对单步测试中，放大的平移将原始正则化预测器区分开，而商正则化预测器保持对齐；长程CIFAR-10实验显示对泛化的显著且可逆的抑制，但记忆后选择性延迟的证据较不一致。
AI.conclusion: 作为曲率上界的有效性本身既不能保证可反演为鲁棒性证书，也不能保证可微分为内在训练干预；两类应用需要各自独立的正当性依据。

title: Staying on Task: Testing the Foundations of Long-Horizon Agent Reliability
summary: Long-horizon agentic workflows require models to sustain repeated state-dependent actions all while the context grows, sub-task complexity changes, and new data arrives. Each situation represents an independent axis along which an agent may fail. An agent reconciling a long ledger, for example, must repeatedly read its state, update the correct record, and preserve alignment across thousands of outputs. A model may accept the entire ledger yet lose its place or stop applying the operation consistently as generation proceeds. We introduce Long-Transduction, a controlled diagnostic that tests a model's ability to stay on task during long generation while continuously reading, mutating, and outputting input-context dependent operations such as arithmetic, sorting, variable lookups, and table transformations. Long-Transduction evaluation independently varies local task complexity, input data formatting, and context length isolate failures along each axis. We evaluate seven open-weight models, finding a 62.8\% decrease when scaling context length from 4-128K, a 36.5\% decrease when varying input format, and a 39.9\% decrease by increasing local task complexity. Together, these failures represent critical liabilities in long-horizon agentic workflows.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Long-Transduction 诊断基准，用于测试模型在长生成过程中持续读取、变更并输出依赖上下文操作的能力，并在七个开源权重模型上揭示了随上下文长度、输入格式和局部任务复杂度变化而出现的显著性能下降。
AI.motivation: 长程智能体工作流要求模型在上下文增长、子任务复杂度变化和新数据到达的情况下，持续执行反复的状态依赖操作。每个情境都是智能体可能失败的独立轴。例如模型可能接受整个账本却在生成过程中失去位置或停止一致地执行操作，因此需要受控诊断来隔离这些失败。
AI.method: 引入 Long-Transduction，一个受控诊断方法，测试模型在长生成期间保持任务执行，同时持续读取、变更并输出依赖输入上下文的操作，如算术、排序、变量查找和表格变换。评估中独立变化局部任务复杂度、输入数据格式和上下文长度，以隔离各轴上的失败。
AI.result: 评估七个开源权重模型发现：上下文长度从 4K 扩展到 128K 时性能下降 62.8%；改变输入格式导致下降 36.5%；增加局部任务复杂度导致下降 39.9%。
AI.conclusion: 这些失败构成长程智能体工作流中的关键隐患，表明模型在长生成与状态依赖操作方面仍存在明显脆弱性。

title: Template-Search Domain Adaptation via Multi-Stage Feature Alignment for Cross-Modal Object Tracking
summary: Visual object tracking typically assumes that the initial template and subsequent search frames share the same sensing modality. In practice, sensor availability or operation may change over time, creating a substantial representation gap between template and search frames. Unlike conventional multi-modal tracking where paired modalities are simultaneously available, cross-modal tracking requires localization when template and search frames originate from different active modalities. Accordingly, we introduce TSDA-Track, a Template-Search Domain Adaptation framework to reduce modality discrepancy during training. We investigate two feature alignment strategies. Pre-AFA TSDA-Track applies adversarial alignment before transformer's template-search interaction to suppress modality-specific bias. Enc-CFA TSDA-Track applies contrastive alignment to encoder representations after interaction to strengthen target-level cross-modal correspondence. Both variants retain a shared inference pipeline without modality-specific branches. Experiments on LasHeR, and zero-shot evaluations on RGBT234 and GTOT under multiple cross-modal protocols demonstrate improvements over representative state-of-the-art trackers. For instance, under the modality-switch protocol on RGBT234, Pre-AFA TSDA-Track achieves an SR/PR of 43.2/56.0, compared with 36.8/50.0 for ToMP-101 baseline. In addition, a study on Anti-UAV-024 further verifies the applicability of TSDA-Track to aerial tracking. Our study highlights the effectiveness of feature alignment domain adaptation for cross-modal tracking.

AI.tldr: 提出 TSDA-Track 模板-搜索域适应框架，通过特征对齐缩小跨模态跟踪时的模态差异。
AI.motivation: 传统跟踪假设模板与搜索帧为同一模态，而实际中传感器可用性或工作状态会变化，导致模板与搜索帧间存在显著表示差距；跨模态跟踪需在不同模态来源下完成定位。
AI.method: TSDA-Track 框架采用两种特征对齐策略：Pre-AFA 在 Transformer 模板-搜索交互前进行对抗对齐以抑制模态特定偏差；Enc-CFA 在交互后对编码器表示进行对比对齐以增强目标级跨模态对应。两种变体共享统一推理流程，无需模态特定分支。
AI.result: 在 LasHeR 及 RGBT234、GTOT 的零样本多跨模态协议上优于代表性 SOTA；RGBT234 模态切换协议下 Pre-AFA 达到 SR/PR 43.2/56.0，基线 ToMP-101 为 36.8/50.0；Anti-UAV-024 研究验证了空中跟踪适用性。
AI.conclusion: 特征对齐域适应对跨模态跟踪有效。

title: Towards Universal Wasserstein Barycenters through Flow Matching
summary: Defining a weighted mean over probability measures under probability metrics is a central tool in probabilistic machine learning. Under the Wasserstein metric, these are called \emph{Wasserstein barycenters}. While most approaches compute barycenters for a fixed weight vector, approximating the whole family of barycenters over the simplex, which we call the \emph{Wasserstein simplex}, remains underexplored. We refer to this problem as \emph{Universal Barycenter Approximation}, and propose \texttt{BaryFM}, a flow matching model transporting the marginal measures into any barycenter in the Wasserstein simplex. Once trained, the network can draw samples from measures in the Wasserstein simplex through an ordinary differential equation. We validate our method on 4 downstream tasks: domain adaptation, generalization, Bayesian posterior aggregation and algorithmic fairness. \texttt{BaryFM} achieves the best average rank among 15 competing methods across 10 domain adaptation benchmarks, matching or surpassing non-universal solvers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 BaryFM，一种基于流匹配的通用重心近似模型，可将边缘测度输运到 Wasserstein 单纯形中的任意重心。
AI.motivation: Wasserstein 重心是概率机器学习中的核心工具，但现有方法多针对固定权重向量求解，对整个单纯形上重心族的近似研究不足。
AI.method: 将问题定义为通用重心近似，提出 BaryFM 流匹配模型，将边缘测度输运到 Wasserstein 单纯形中的任意重心；训练后可通过常微分方程从单纯形内测度采样。
AI.result: 在域适应、泛化、贝叶斯后验聚合和算法公平性四项任务上验证，BaryFM 在 10 个域适应基准上于 15 种竞争方法中取得最佳平均排名，匹配或超越非通用求解器。
AI.conclusion: BaryFM 为 Wasserstein 单纯形上的通用重心近似提供了有效方案，并在多任务中展现竞争力。

title: UniEvo-VL: An On-policy Self-Distillation Training Recipe for Multimodal Model Self-improvement
summary: Modern multimodal models bring generation and understanding into a single unified system, which enables them to provide and learn from their own feedback.
