Motivated by this unified capacity, we introduce UniEvo-VL, a self-evolving framework for multimodal models to learn from this constructive self-correction feedback during test-time compute. Instead of relying on a separate, often larger, teacher, we leverage their self-critiques as privileged information and ask a single multimodal model to act as both teacher and student with different contexts. The student only sees the vanilla question, while the teacher conditions on the privileged critique. Then training minimizes the per-state divergence between their denoising diffusion distributions over the student's own sampling trajectories. Experiments demonstrate that UniEvo-VL improves the image generation capabilities of multimodal models, while maintaining their sensitivity to additional reflection information. Specifically, we build on top of the open-source Qwen-image-2512 and observe a significant performance gain from 0.747 to 0.808 on GenEval and from 32.97 to 35.53 on GenEval2 Soft-TIFA. Moreover, attempts with more powerful external critics (e.g., GPT5.6-Luna) show that multimodal models with strong judge capabilities can anticipate a higher self-evolving ceiling. Last but not least, mixed text-rendering outcomes show that our self-improvements may not be uniform across different tasks. Our study aims to shed light on the current hot recursive self-improvement research line to enhance the user experience when using multimodal models without external supervision or guidance.

AI.tldr: UniEvo-VL：一种多模态模型自进化框架，利用自身批判作为特权信息，在测试时计算中通过师生同体不同上下文的扩散分布对齐训练，提升图像生成能力。
AI.motivation: 现代多模态模型将生成与理解统一于单一系统，具备提供并学习自身反馈的能力；现有自改进方法通常依赖独立且更大的教师模型，成本高且受外部监督限制。本文希望无需外部监督或指导，实现模型的递归自我改进。
AI.method: 让单一多模态模型同时充当教师与学生，学生仅见原始问题，教师额外以自身批判为特权信息；训练目标为在学生自身采样轨迹上，最小化二者去噪扩散分布之间的逐状态散度（per-state divergence）。
AI.result: 基于开源 Qwen-image-2512，GenEval 从 0.747 提升至 0.808，GenEval2 Soft-TIFA 从 32.97 提升至 35.53；使用更强外部批判（如 GPT5.6-Luna）显示强评判能力的模型具有更高自进化上限；混合文本渲染结果显示自改进并非在所有任务上均匀。
AI.conclusion: UniEvo-VL 能在无外部监督下提升多模态模型图像生成能力并保持对反思信息的敏感性，为递归自我改进研究提供启示，以增强用户使用多模态模型的体验，但改进效果存在任务差异。

title: Vision-Language-Action Autonomous Driving Agent with Language-based Memory
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) foundation models have recently emerged as one of the prevailing solutions for autonomous driving, as they can utilize knowledge acquired during vision-language pretraining for accurate and interpretable driving. However, VLAs can take only a limited number of frames as visual input due to the high token cost of an image, which is problematic for memory-dependent tasks such as determining the arrival order at all-way stops and long-horizon driving scene understanding. Existing solutions use latent vector memories accessed through cross-attention, which are neither interpretable nor portable. In this paper, we propose AD-Memo, a general-purpose VLA driving agent with language-based memory. The agent outputs memory as an extension of its Chain-of-Thought (CoT) to record surrounding objects critical to driving; this memory becomes part of the agent's future input. We curate memory-based datasets and train VLAs with a two-stage recipe: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and \textit{Da Capo}, a novel semi-closed-loop Reinforcement Learning (RL) algorithm which uses trajectory-level advantage for memory and step-level advantage for driving, leading to better credit assignment. Across scenarios such as all-way stops and general driving, AD-Memo improves driving quality, enables better question answering on driving scenes, and produces plug-and-play memory for other models.

AI.tldr: AD-Memo 提出一种带语言记忆的通用 VLA 驾驶智能体，将记忆作为思维链(CoT)的扩展输出并作为未来输入，配合两阶段训练 (SFT + Da Capo 半闭环 RL)，在全向停车与通用驾驶等场景中提升驾驶质量与场景问答能力，并生成可插拔记忆。
AI.motivation: VLA 基础模型因图像 token 成本高，只能输入有限帧，难以处理依赖记忆的任务（如全向停车到达顺序判断、长时域场景理解）。现有基于隐向量记忆 + 交叉注意力的方案既不可解释也不可移植。
AI.method: 提出 AD-Memo：以语言形式记忆，作为 CoT 的扩展记录对驾驶关键的周围物体，并作为智能体未来输入的一部分；构建基于记忆的数据集；两阶段训练：监督微调(SFT) + Da Capo——一种新颖的半闭环强化学习算法，对记忆使用轨迹级优势、对驾驶使用步级优势，实现更好的信用分配。
AI.result: 在全向停车和通用驾驶等场景中，AD-Memo 提升了驾驶质量，改善了驾驶场景问答表现，并产生可供其他模型即插即用(plug-and-play)的记忆。
AI.conclusion: 语言化记忆为 VLA 驾驶智能体提供可解释、可复用的记忆机制，结合分层优势的 RL 训练能有效提升记忆依赖任务与通用驾驶性能。

title: The Advantages of Fresh Sketching for Ridge Regression
summary: Over the past 25 years, sketching and sampling have become widely used tools for accelerating large-scale regression. In iterative randomized solvers, a basic design choice is whether to $\textit{reuse}$ the same sketch or draw $\textit{fresh}$ randomness at every step. For (under-constrained) iterative ridge regression with column sampling, whether fresh sketches offer provable advantages has remained open: $\textit{We show that they do.}$ Fresh sketching lets us analyze error only along the current residual solution, rather than uniformly over the entire Gram matrix. This directional view yields sharper convergence guarantees for leverage score and ridge leverage score sampling and, more importantly, leads to residual-aware sampling rules. By minimizing the variance of the relevant sketched matrix-vector product, we derive an oracle distribution and practical approximations to the oracle distribution, including a mixture sampling distribution with (somewhat weaker) convergence guarantees. Experiments on synthetic and real data, including ridge probes on Qwen2.5 representations, support our theory, showing substantially faster convergence.

AI.tldr: 本文研究迭代岭回归中列采样"复用草图"与"每步新鲜采样"的差异，证明新鲜草图具有可证优势，并据此提出残差感知采样规则与近似 oracle 分布，实验显示收敛显著加快。
AI.motivation: 过去25年，sketching与sampling广泛用于加速大规模回归。在迭代随机求解器中，一个基本设计选择是复用同一草图还是每步重新采样。对于（欠约束）迭代岭回归的列采样，新鲜草图是否有可证优势此前一直是开放问题。本文旨在回答这一问题。
AI.method: 作者证明新鲜草图确有优势：新鲜采样使误差只需沿当前残差解方向分析，而非在整个Gram矩阵上一致分析。这种"方向性视角"为leverage score与ridge leverage score采样带来更紧的收敛保证。通过最小化相关草图矩阵-向量乘积的方差，推导出oracle分布及其实际近似（包括具有（稍弱）收敛保证的混合采样分布）。
AI.result: 在合成数据与真实数据上的实验支持理论，包括在Qwen2.5表示上的ridge probes，显示收敛速度显著加快。
AI.conclusion: 新鲜草图相比复用草图在迭代岭回归列采样中具有可证优势，方向性分析视角与残差感知采样（近似oracle分布）是获得更快收敛的关键。

title: Code to Control: Synthesizing Parameterized Reactive Controllers
summary: Recent LLM-based approaches to control either invoke a language model to select actions or synthesize world models that require planning at every decision, introducing latency that can limit real-time use. We introduce Code to Control, an approach that synthesizes Python controllers which execute directly as policies. Code to Control separates program structure from parameters. An LLM synthesizes the controller structure, while derivative-free search fits its parameters for continuous control using feedback from the environment. Once learned, the resulting controllers require neither LLM inference nor planning at decision time, enabling real-time gameplay and, under our timing protocol, faster action selection than a PPO policy. Across a suite of Atari games, Flappy Bird, and MuJoCo tasks, Code to Control outperforms planning-based program synthesis methods, remains competitive with deep reinforcement learning while using fewer environment interactions, transfers across substantial changes in environment dynamics, and scales to complex locomotion tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出 Code to Control，用 LLM 合成 Python 控制器结构、再用无导数搜索拟合参数，使控制器在决策时无需 LLM 推理或规划，实现实时控制。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 LLM 的控制方法要么调用语言模型选择动作，要么合成需要每步规划的世界模型，决策时延高，难以满足实时控制需求。
AI.method: 将程序结构与参数分离：由 LLM 合成控制器结构，利用环境反馈通过无导数搜索拟合连续控制所需的参数，得到可直接作为策略执行的 Python 控制器。
AI.result: 在 Atari、Flappy Bird 和 MuJoCo 任务上，优于基于规划的程序合成方法，与深度强化学习相当且环境交互更少；可适应环境动态的显著变化，并可扩展到复杂运动任务；决策时无需 LLM 推理或规划，动作选择快于 PPO 策略。
AI.conclusion: 通过“结构由 LLM 生成、参数由搜索优化”的分离式设计，可在保持性能的同时消除决策时延，为实时控制提供可行方案。

title: ReGain: Restoring Subject Fidelity in Personalization on Synthetic Images
summary: Text-to-image diffusion models are personalized to a subject by DreamBooth fine-tuning on a handful of its images. Increasingly, these images come from a diffusion model rather than a camera. We show that fine-tuning on such synthetic images degrades subject fidelity, producing oversaturated color and excess high-frequency detail. To isolate the cause, we fine-tune two models from the same base model with the same DreamBooth recipe, one on real photos of a subject and one on synthetic images of that subject generated by the first. We trace the degradation to classifier-free guidance (CFG). For the model personalized on synthetic images, the angle between the conditional and unconditional noise predictions, and with it the norm of their difference, is much larger than for the model personalized on real photos. This inflation grows toward high frequencies and also appears at other prompts semantically close to the subject, such as its class noun, but not at unrelated ones. We propose ReGain, a training-free correction applied at sampling time that measures how much each frequency band of the guidance is inflated relative to the base model and scales that band down accordingly. ReGain needs no real photos. On Stable Diffusion v1.5, ReGain closes 51-64% of the subject-fidelity gap to the model personalized on real photos, as measured by DINO, DINOv2 and CLIP-I. It also improves subject fidelity on SDXL and SD 3.5 and preserves text alignment on all three backbones.

AI.tldr: 论文发现用合成图像做DreamBooth微调会因CFG放大高频噪声导致主体保真度下降，提出无需真实照片的采样期校正方法ReGain。
AI.motivation: 文本到图像扩散模型常通过DreamBooth在少量图像上个性化主体，但越来越多图像来自扩散模型而非相机。研究发现用合成图像微调会损害主体保真度，产生过饱和颜色和过多高频细节，需要定位原因并提出解决方案。
AI.method: 从同一基础模型用相同DreamBooth配方分别对真实照片和合成图像微调两个模型进行比较，追踪退化原因至classifier-free guidance (CFG)。发现在合成图像个性化模型中，条件与无条件噪声预测的夹角更大，导致其差值的范数更大，且该膨胀随高频增强并在语义相近提示下出现。提出ReGain，一种训练无关的采样期校正方法，测量每个频段引导相对基础模型的膨胀程度并相应缩放该频段，无需真实照片。
AI.result: 在Stable Diffusion v1.5上，ReGain已缩小51-64%的主体保真度差距（相对真实照片微调模型，以DINO、DINOv2和CLIP-I衡量）。在SDXL和SD 3.5上，ReGain也提升了主体保真度，并在三种骨干网络上保持了文本对齐。
AI.conclusion: ReGain有效缓解合成图像微调导致的CFG高频膨胀问题，无需真实照片即可提升主体保真度，适用于多种扩散模型骨干网络且不损害文本对齐。

title: FlexRouter: Learning Complementary Model Sets for Flexible LLM Routing
summary: Existing Large Language Model (LLM) routing methods score LLMs independently to select top-$k$ models. However, this ignores model correlations and enforces a rigid computational budget. Consequently, routers often select redundant models that share failure modes, limiting the overall probability of success. To address this, we propose FlexRouter, a routing framework that explicitly models model complementarity. FlexRouter optimizes for \textit{answer coverage}, maximizing the probability that at least one selected model yields a correct response. This objective aligns with practical inference pipelines where multiple candidate outputs are generated and a downstream verifier or user selects the final one. We formulate routing as a coverage-oriented subset selection problem and model the routing policy using Determinantal Point Processes (DPPs), which naturally capture both model competence and redundancy. To directly optimize coverage without requiring a ground-truth target subset, we introduce a training objective based on marginalizing over failure sets. During inference, we employ a greedy strategy based on marginal log-determinant gains, enabling the router to adaptively determine subset sizes without a predefined budget. Extensive experiments on the large-scale RouterEval benchmark demonstrate that our proposed FlexRouter achieves higher coverage with lower redundancy across both in-domain and out-of-domain tasks than strong baselines while maintaining flexible inference cost.

AI.tldr: FlexRouter 通过显式建模模型互补性并优化"答案覆盖"，提升 LLM 路由的成功率并降低冗余。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 路由方法独立地为各模型打分并选 top-k，忽略了模型之间的相关性，且强制固定计算预算，导致选出的模型往往共享失败模式、冗余度高，从而限制了整体成功概率。
AI.method: 将路由建模为面向覆盖的子集选择问题，用行列式点过程（DPP）刻画模型能力与冗余；提出基于对失败集边缘化的训练目标以直接优化覆盖，无需真值目标子集；推理时采用基于边缘对数行列式增益的贪心策略，自适应确定子集大小。
AI.result: 在 RouterEval 大规模基准上，FlexRouter 在域内与域外任务中均取得高于强基线的覆盖率和更低的冗余，同时保持灵活的推理成本。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模模型互补性并优化答案覆盖，是提升 LLM 路由效果的有效方向，可在无固定预算约束下自适应选择模型子集。

title: Learning to Route in Visual Space via Multi-Step Embedding Retrieval
summary: LLM agents rely on retrieval tools to access external knowledge, yet visual agentic search remains severely bottlenecked by standard single-step retrievers. In current pipelines, the agent must issue text queries for every intermediate step, struggling when visual clues are difficult to describe or when the retriever fails to surface necessary intermediate evidence within its top results. We hypothesize that offloading multi-step navigation across the entire embedding space directly to the retrieval tool resolves this performance bottleneck. To study this systematically, we introduce VHOP, a flexible data generation framework and benchmark with five core difficulty levels testing both visual matching and search planning. Using this framework, we develop VHOP-Router, an end-to-end training pipeline---combining supervised fine-tuning, online imitation learning, and reinforcement learning---that transforms a standard embedding model into an autoregressive multi-step retriever. Operating directly in the visual latent space, VHOP-Router retrieves linked image chains in a single tool call without requiring the agent to formulate intermediate text queries. Experiments show VHOP-Router boosts retrieval performance from under 5\% to 76.3\%. In agentic search, it improves task success rates by 52.7\% and reduces the average token length by 61\% from 1886 to 728, whereas upgrading the agent yields only a 3.7\% gain. Compared to a strong baseline where the agent retrieves the top 50 results per step, VHOP-Router maintains superior performance while reducing in-context images by $23\times$ and cutting the cumulative API payload by $35\times$. The models also generalize robustly to unseen difficulty levels and realistic test sets. Ultimately, VHOP and VHOP-Router provide an efficient and effective solution for visual agentic search that leaves native LLM capabilities entirely intact.

AI.tldr: 论文提出将多步导航直接卸载给检索工具，构建VHOP基准与VHOP-Router自回归多步检索器，显著提升视觉智能体搜索性能并大幅降低开销。
AI.motivation: 当前视觉智能体搜索受限于标准单步检索器：智能体需为每个中间步骤发出文本查询，当视觉线索难以描述或检索器无法在top结果中呈现中间证据时表现不佳。作者假设把整个嵌入空间上的多步导航直接卸载给检索工具可解决该瓶颈。
AI.method: 引入VHOP数据生成框架与基准，含五个核心难度级别，测试视觉匹配与搜索规划。基于此开发VHOP-Router，结合监督微调、在线模仿学习与强化学习的端到端训练流程，将标准嵌入模型转换为自回归多步检索器，直接在视觉潜空间中通过单次工具调用检索链接图像链，无需中间文本查询。
AI.result: 检索性能从不足5%提升至76.3%；智能体搜索任务成功率提升52.7%，平均token长度减少61%（从1886降至728），而升级智能体仅带来3.7%增益。相比每步检索top 50的强基线，性能更优且上下文图像减少23倍，累计API负载降低35倍。模型对未见难度级别和真实测试集具备稳健泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: VHOP与VHOP-Router为视觉智能体搜索提供了高效有效的解决方案，且完全保留原生LLM能力不受影响。

title: Unveiling the Value of Motion for Cinematic Camera Trajectories
summary: Cinematic camera motion is a fundamental storytelling tool, defined not only by where the camera is positioned in the scene, but also by how it moves in terms of direction and speed. Recent work on camera trajectory generation and alignment to text relies on pose-centric representations. While in principle a network could derive direction of movement and speed, we find that in practice this might not happen. In fact, in this paper we discover that decomposing the camera trajectory representation from the traditional per-frame poses to direction and speed has surprising benefits across multiple tasks, including trajectory-to-text alignment as well as text-to-trajectory generation. To accurately evaluate the former, we introduce a simple and reliable protocol that overcomes the limitations of prior evaluation baselines. For the latter, building on this representational insight, we propose a novel generative model for camera trajectories, CineGEN, that achieves superior performance across a variety of metrics. We also propose a novel dataset, CineScript, containing movie clips that are enriched with scene descriptions as well as higher-level metadata. This novel data allows us to test models' ability to capture high-level cinematographic information. We show that, despite its simplicity, representing camera trajectories through direction and speed not only helps numerically to achieve better alignment and generation, but also inherently encodes complex directorial intent.

AI.tldr: 论文发现将相机轨迹表示从逐帧位姿分解为方向与速度，能在轨迹-文本对齐与文本-轨迹生成任务上带来显著收益，并提出CineGEN模型与CineScript数据集。
AI.motivation: 电影相机运动是核心叙事工具，由相机在场景中的位置以及运动的方向与速度共同定义。现有相机轨迹生成与文本对齐工作依赖以位姿为中心的表示，理论上网络可以从位姿推导出运动方向与速度，但作者发现实践中并不一定如此，因此探索更优的轨迹表示方式。
AI.method: 将从传统逐帧位姿的相机轨迹表示分解为方向与速度表示；针对轨迹到文本的对齐任务，提出简单可靠的评测协议以克服先前评测基线的局限；针对文本到轨迹生成任务，基于该表示洞察提出生成模型CineGEN；同时构建CineScript数据集，包含带有场景描述与更高层元数据的电影片段。
AI.result: 方向与速度表示在轨迹-文本对齐和文本-轨迹生成任务上均取得数值上的提升；CineGEN在多项指标上取得更优性能；CineScript数据集可用于测试模型捕捉高层电影摄影信息的能力。
AI.conclusion: 尽管表示形式简单，用方向与速度表示相机轨迹不仅有助于实现更好的对齐与生成效果，还内在编码了复杂的导演意图。

title: NeurDuo-EEG: A Long-Sequence EEG Foundation Model with Persistent State and Explicit Memory
summary: Electroencephalography (EEG) is recorded continuously over hours, with relevant dynamics spanning timescales from milliseconds to hours. Most EEG foundation models nevertheless process fixed windows independently, limiting their ability to capture information encoded in long-timescale dynamics. State-space architectures enable persistent recurrent processing, but long-range information remains implicitly compressed in recurrent states. We present NeurDuo-EEG, a causal EEG foundation model with channel-resolved persistent memory. NeurDuo-EEG introduces multi-timescale memory management with learned consolidation and selective retrieval, enabling persistent modelling of continuous EEG with fixed-size state. It is pre-trained on 3,955 hours of EEG from 17 public datasets using multichannel autoregressive prediction of discrete spectral codes. Across three short-window and two long-sequence downstream tasks, NeurDuo-EEG achieves the best performance on four of five benchmarks, including all three short-window tasks and seizure detection, where AUC-PR improves from $0.285$ to $0.471$ over the strongest non-NeurDuo baseline. NeurDuo-EEG also remains competitive on sleep staging and supports efficient streaming inference, with nearly constant per-chunk latency as the available history grows to one hour. Notably, the Small variant achieves this with only 4.7M backbone parameters. These results demonstrate the value of persistent, multi-timescale modelling for both long-sequence and short-window EEG analysis. Our code is available at https://github.com/YifaNNW/NeurDuo-EEG.

AI.tldr: 提出因果EEG基础模型NeurDuo-EEG，通过通道级持续记忆实现多时间尺度长期建模。
AI.motivation: EEG连续记录数小时，相关动态跨越毫秒到小时多个时间尺度，但多数EEG基础模型独立处理固定窗口，难以捕获长时程信息；状态空间架构虽可循环处理，但长程信息被隐式压缩在循环状态中。
AI.method: NeurDuo-EEG采用通道级持久记忆、多时间尺度记忆管理（含学习式巩固与选择性检索），以固定大小状态持续建模连续EEG；在17个公开数据集共3,955小时EEG上，通过离散频谱码的多通道自回归预测进行预训练。
AI.result: 在3个短窗口和2个长序列下游任务中，5个基准里4个取得最佳性能，包括全部3个短窗口任务和癫痫检测（AUC-PR从0.285提升至0.471）；睡眠分期保持竞争力，并支持高效流式推理，历史增长至1小时时每块延迟近乎恒定；Small变体仅4.7M骨干参数。
AI.conclusion: 持续、多时间尺度建模对长序列与短窗口EEG分析均具有价值。

title: Self-Evolving Algorithm-Design Agents: Escaping In-Context Evolutionary Stagnation via Population-Curated Policy Optimization
summary: Large language models are increasingly participating in complex real-world tasks in the form of algorithm-design agents, designing and refining algorithms. Many successful algorithm-design agents adopt pure in-context evolutionary frameworks, but they may quickly plateau in domains that require specialized knowledge. Parametric adaptation offers a way to internalize specialized knowledge, but conventional training requires abundant domain-specific corpora while high-quality algorithms are scarce in complex algorithm-design scenarios. In this paper, we propose sample-efficient parametric self-evolution where agents can explore and learn from self-generated algorithms. First, we characterize in-context evolutionary stagnation and analytically propose the Improvement Chain proposition, showing how learning successive self-generated algorithms can locally increase the likelihood of neighboring algorithms. Motivated by this local-transfer perspective, we further propose Population-Curated Policy Optimization (PCPO) to utilize a global population and a hybrid policy update scheme for retaining and reusing high-quality, diverse self-generated algorithms, shifting the policy towards stronger algorithms. In the task of learning rate schedule design for global placement in electronic design automation, trained only on 4 chip cases, PCPO outperforms the state-of-the-art in-context evolutionary methods (e.g., OpenEvolve and ShinkaEvolve) on average across 16 chip cases. With an 8B-size base model, PCPO achieves competitive performance compared to frontier closed-source models such as GPT-5.5. PCPO also reduces inference-time token cost by internalizing grounded domain knowledge and prompt distillation. Moreover, PCPO achieves significant speedups on four GPU kernel designs, with an average of 8.27$\times$ speedup against the PyTorch Eager baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出样本高效参数自进化方法，让智能体从自生成算法中学习，提出PCPO，仅用4个芯片案例训练即在16个芯片案例上超越最先进方法。
AI.motivation: 纯上下文进化框架在需要专业知识的领域易陷入停滞，而传统参数训练需大量领域语料，但复杂算法设计场景中高质量算法稀缺，因此需要样本高效的参数自适应方法。
AI.method: 刻画上下文进化停滞现象，提出改进链（Improvement Chain）命题，说明学习连续自生成算法可局部提升邻近算法概率；据此提出人口精选策略优化（PCPO），利用全局种群与混合策略更新方案保留并复用高质量、多样的自生成算法。
AI.result: 在电子设计自动化全局布局的学习率调度任务中，仅用4个芯片案例训练，PCPO在16个芯片案例上平均超越OpenEvolve、ShinkaEvolve等最先进上下文进化方法；8B基础模型性能可与GPT-5.5等前沿闭源模型竞争；降低推理token成本；在四个GPU内核设计上平均获得8.27倍加速。
AI.conclusion: PCPO通过内化领域知识与提示蒸馏实现样本高效自进化，兼具强性能、低成本与广泛适用性，为算法设计智能体提供了有效路径。

title: EPIC: Epipolar-Consistent 360° Immersive Stereo Video Generation
summary:
Immersive displays can enable rich and diverse virtual experiences. Manually authoring every possible experience to realize this potential, however, is prohibitively expensive, difficult to scale, and impractical. Generative AI models could remove this bottleneck, but today's models are built for conventional displays and cannot generate the high-resolution, stereoscopic $360^\circ$ content required for immersive viewing. Further, temporal and stereo inconsistencies that may be tolerable on conventional displays can become highly disruptive when viewed through an immersive headset.
  Here, we address this gap with a zero-shot generative pipeline that extends existing video diffusion models into 4K stereoscopic $360^\circ$ videos. Inspired from binocular vision and depth perception, we develop an epipolar-aware $360^\circ$ image matching metric that captures the temporal and stereo geometric inconsistencies across views. We then use this metric as a preference signal for direct preference optimization with limited training data. Our work enables $360^\circ$ stereo video generation and provides a scalable path for bringing generative content to immersive displays, allowing diverse mixed reality experiences on demand.

AI.tldr: 提出一种零样本生成流程，将现有视频扩散模型扩展为4K立体360°视频，用于沉浸式显示内容生成。
AI.motivation: 沉浸式显示需要丰富多样的虚拟体验，但手动创作每种体验成本高昂、难以规模化且不现实。生成式AI有望消除这一瓶颈，但现有模型面向传统显示，无法生成沉浸式观看所需的高分辨率、立体360°内容；且传统显示上可容忍的时序与立体不一致，在头显中会变得高度干扰。
AI.method: 受双目视觉与深度感知启发，设计了一种极线感知的360°图像匹配度量，用于捕捉跨视角的时序与立体几何不一致；随后将该度量作为偏好信号，在有限训练数据下进行直接偏好优化（DPO），从而将现有视频扩散模型零样本扩展为4K立体360°视频生成。
AI.result: 实现了360°立体视频生成，能够生成高分辨率、立体的沉浸式内容，并缓解了时序与立体不一致问题。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为将生成式内容引入沉浸式显示提供了可扩展路径，支持按需生成多样化的混合现实体验。

title: Reinforcement Learning with Complex (valued) Memories
comment: 19 pages, 4 figures, 9 tables Accepted at the 19th European Workshop on Reinforcement Learning 2026
summary: Partially observable environments pose a fundamental challenge in deep reinforcement learning, requiring agents to compress temporal information from observations and maintain a memory to make effective decisions. While there exist many approaches ranging from gated recurrence to attention mechanisms and model-based RL, the search for effective representational techniques that can capture long-term dependencies remains an active area of research. In this work we revisit Unitary recurrent networks (uRNNs) [Arjovsky et al., 2016, Jing et al., 2017], that demonstrated superior gradient flow and associative recall, expressing the recurrence and the hidden state in a complex vector space. Their norm preserving unitary dynamics enable information propagation through long sequences. To this end, we propose three different versions of uRNNs as drop-in replacements for recurrent PPO architectures, and demonstrate that the simple recurrence and the added degree of freedom from the phase of the complex representations enable significant gains over baselines on several memory-improvable tasks, including continuous control. We further explore how to preserve the phase information of the complex hidden state for a phase-aware policy by drawing a parallel to how quantum states are measured. With our methods reaching up to 2-3 $\times$ the reward in environments like rocksample and Craftax compared to the baselines, this work points towards an exciting new direction of representations for RL and the problem of partial observability. Code is available at: https://github.com/Sathya98/qurl

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视酉循环网络（uRNNs），将其作为循环PPO架构的直接替代方案，用于解决深度强化学习中的部分可观测问题，并在多个记忆任务上取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 部分可观测环境是深度强化学习的核心挑战，智能体需要压缩时序信息并维持记忆。现有方法（门控循环、注意力机制、基于模型的RL）在捕捉长期依赖方面仍不理想，因此需要寻找更有效的表征技术。
AI.method: 提出三种uRNN版本，作为循环PPO架构的直接替代。uRNN在复向量空间中表达循环与隐状态，其保范的酉动力学可促进长序列中的信息传播。此外，借鉴量子态测量的思路，设计相位感知策略以保留复隐状态的相位信息。
AI.result: 在多个记忆可改进任务（含连续控制）上显著优于基线，在rocksample和Craftax等环境中奖励达到基线的2-3倍。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为强化学习表征和部分可观测问题开辟了新方向，表明简单的循环结构与复数相位带来的额外自由度可带来显著收益。代码已开源。

title: PathAnchor: Path-Structured Evidence for Scientific Agents
summary: Scientific agents can retrieve relevant passages yet still lose functional order, mix evidence across sources, or state conclusions that exceed the retrieved record. We introduce PathAnchor, a bounded scientific reasoning system built on path-structured evidence workspaces. Instead of treating passages or extracted concepts as independent units, the system retrieves source-linked Material-Sensor-Signal-System trajectories that preserve role, direction, and the evidence supporting each transition. A controller uses three read-only tools to search paper-specific trajectories, trace paths across candidate sources, and open exact evidence before producing a claim-cited answer and an explicit evidence boundary. On 120 single- and cross-paper flexible-sensor questions, PathAnchor scores 82.6% and leads six evaluated systems. Under a matched controller, corpus, and six-call budget, replacing unordered concept graphs with path-structured records raises source recall from 61.3% to 82.9%, increases answers whose claims all cite opened evidence from 69.2% to 90.0%, and reduces tool calls. These results show that evidence organization affects retrieval and citation completeness under fixed agent resources.

AI.tldr: PathAnchor 是一个基于路径结构证据工作空间的受限科学推理系统，通过检索保留角色、方向与证据的 Material-Sensor-Signal-System 轨迹，在 120 个柔性传感器问题上达到 82.6% 的得分并领先六个系统。
AI.motivation: 科学智能体即便能检索到相关段落，仍会丢失功能顺序、混合不同来源的证据，或给出超出检索记录的结论。作者希望解决证据组织方式对检索与引用完整性的影响问题。
AI.method: 系统不把段落或抽取概念视为独立单元，而是检索源链接的 Material-Sensor-Signal-System 轨迹，保留角色、方向以及每次转换的证据支撑。控制器使用三个只读工具：检索论文特定轨迹、跨候选来源追踪路径、在生成带引用的答案前打开精确证据，并给出显式的证据边界。
AI.result: 在 120 个单论文与跨论文柔性传感器问题上，PathAnchor 得分 82.6%，领先六个被评估系统。在匹配控制器、语料与六次调用预算下，用路径结构记录替代无序概念图，将来源召回率从 61.3% 提升至 82.9%，使所有主张均引用已打开证据的答案比例从 69.2% 提升至 90.0%，并减少工具调用次数。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，在智能体资源固定的条件下，证据组织方式会影响检索效果与引用完整性。

title: No Corners Cut: State-Grounded Transitions for Mid-Stream Prompt Switches in Video Generation
summary: Streaming video generators allow users to dynamically modulate video synthesis via mid-stream prompt switching. Existing streaming methods can respond to the updated instruction while still cutting corners, prematurely realizing goals or taking heuristic shortcuts that bypass necessary intermediate state changes needed for a plausible transition. In this study, we present SEGUE, a novel framework that makes this process explicit and trains the generator to execute these transitions faithfully. At each switch, a training-free planner parses the latest frame and prompts, writes a few segue prompts with roles and durations, and then hands control back to the user's prompt. Furthermore, to address the inherent difficulty of training causal models on short-lived temporal schedules without corrupting preparatory supervision, we introduce SPANDMD, which evaluates each active prompt using the full rollout as temporal context while retaining its DMD residual only within the prompt's assigned span. On OpenTrans-360, a benchmark of 1,800 switches that scores how the old state exits and the new one begins, SEGUE ranks first on all eight transition metrics and raises the overall score over the strongest baseline from 0.866 to 0.887. It also ranks first on four of six instruction-response metrics of StreamAV-Bench, while the planner transfers to frozen autoregressive generators without retraining.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SEGUE 框架，通过训练无关的衔接规划器与 SPANDMD 训练策略，让流式视频生成器在中途切换提示时能忠实完成过渡，在 OpenTrans-360 上八项过渡指标均第一。
AI.motivation: 现有流式视频生成方法在中途切换提示时容易走捷径，过早实现目标或绕过必要的中间状态变化，导致过渡不自然。
AI.method: SEGUE 在每次切换时由无需训练的规划器解析最新帧与提示，生成若干带角色和时长的衔接提示，再交还给用户提示；并引入 SPANDMD，用完整 rollout 作为时间上下文评估每个活跃提示，仅在该提示分配的时间跨度内保留其 DMD 残差，以解决短时时间调度下因果模型训练困难的问题。
AI.result: 在 OpenTrans-360（含 1,800 次切换）上，SEGUE 在全部八项过渡指标排名第一，总分由最强基线的 0.866 提升至 0.887；在 StreamAV-Bench 的六项指令响应指标中四项第一；该规划器无需重训练即可迁移到冻结的自回归生成器。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模过渡过程并忠实执行中间状态变化，可有效提升流式视频生成在提示切换下的过渡质量，且规划器具备良好的通用迁移性。

title: JARQ: Joint Alternating Refinement for Quantization
summary: Group-wise post-training quantizers for large language models round weights onto a grid that is not refit to the resulting integer codes. We show that this leaves accuracy on the table: the best grid depends on the codes, input correlations couple the errors of different groups, and useful code changes often involve many codes at once. We propose JARQ , a plug-in refinement that starts from any group-wise quantizer and alternates a joint least-squares fit of all group scales with bounded Babai proposals that move many codes of a group together on the current grid. The problem is a bilinear box-constrained mixed-integer least-squares problem; the solver is backpropagation-free, does not increase the layer-wise objective under exact scale solves, and keeps the host's bit width, groups, zero points, and inference cost. Across Llama-2, Llama-3, and Qwen models with RTN, GPTQ, OmniQuant, and AWQ hosts, JARQ lowers perplexity in 90 of 96 comparisons, cuts three-bit RTN perplexity by up to 36%, raises mean multiple-choice accuracy in 23 of 24 configurations, and improves QEP, QuaRot, and OJBKQ outputs, at under a minute per 7B block.

AI.tldr: JARQ是一种即插即用的分组量化精炼方法，通过联合最小二乘拟合组尺度与有界Babai提议交替优化，在不改变宿主量化器比特宽度、分组、零点及推理成本的前提下，显著降低大语言模型困惑度并提升准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有分组训练后量化器将权重舍入到网格后未再根据生成的整数码重新拟合网格，导致精度损失。作者指出三个问题：最优网格依赖于码本身，输入相关性使不同组的误差相互耦合，且有效的码改动往往涉及大量码同时变化。
AI.method: 提出JARQ，一种从任意分组量化器出发的插件式精炼方法。它交替进行两步：对所有组尺度进行联合最小二乘拟合，以及在当前网格上用有界Babai提议一次性移动一组的多个码。该问题被建模为双线性箱约束混合整数最小二乘问题，求解过程无需反向传播，在精确求解尺度时不增加层级目标值，并保持宿主的比特宽度、分组、零点和推理开销。
AI.result: 在Llama-2、Llama-3和Qwen模型上，以RTN、GPTQ、OmniQuant和AWQ为宿主，JARQ在96次比较中有90次降低困惑度，将三比特RTN困惑度最多降低36%，在24种配置中有23种提升平均多项选择准确率，并改善QEP、QuaRot和OJBKQ的输出，每个7B模块耗时不到一分钟。
AI.conclusion: JARQ通过联合尺度拟合与多码协同提议，有效弥补了分组训练后量化中网格未随码重新拟合的精度损失，是一种通用、低成本且不改变推理开销的量化精炼方案。

title: Action Conditioned Bisimulation For GUI Agent Memory
summary: An agent that remembers what it did on a web page must decide when two pages count as the same. Memories built on observation similarity merge pages that look alike but behave differently, and GUIs are full of such pages: two tabs of one widget or two rows of one menu answer the same click differently. We define the merge rule as an action-conditioned bisimulation over the empirical predictive state graph a frozen agent fills as it acts. Two states merge only when their shared actions lead to agreeing outcomes and successor blocks under an affordance label. Observation similarity never enters the rule, and nothing is trained. It replaces the merge rule of an existing outcome-value memory, so a closed-loop comparison isolates it. On MiniWoB++ it raises success rate over a memoryless agent, while a control taking identical exploratory detours, the prior successor-representation merge, and the same criterion without action conditioning change nothing.

AI.tldr: 提出以动作条件双模拟（action-conditioned bisimulation）作为网页GUI记忆中"页面合并"的规则，仅当共享动作导致一致结果时才合并状态，观测相似性不参与规则且无需训练；在MiniWoB++上提升了成功率。
AI.motivation: 基于观测相似性的记忆会把"看起来相似但行为不同"的网页（如同一组件的两个标签页、同一菜单的两行，点击结果不同）错误合并，导致记忆失真，因此需要一个不依赖观测相似性的合并规则。
AI.method: 把合并规则定义为在冻结智能体行动过程中填充的经验预测状态图（empirical predictive state graph）上的动作条件双模拟：只有当两个状态在共享动作下导向一致的结果，并在某可供性标签（affordance label）下导向一致的后续块时，二者才合并。观测相似性不进入规则，且不进行任何训练。该规则替换了已有结果-价值记忆（outcome-value memory）中的原合并规则，从而通过闭环对比实现隔离验证。
AI.result: 在MiniWoB++上，相比无记忆智能体成功率提升；而作为对照的"走相同探索绕路"的智能体、先前的后继表示合并方法、以及去掉动作条件的同一准则均无变化。
AI.conclusion: 动作条件双模拟是一种无需训练、可即插即用替换现有记忆合并规则的有效方案，其收益来自动作条件化本身，而非额外探索或既有后继表示方法。

title: SCALE: Synthetic Calibration via Agreement Labeling in Embedding Space
summary: Foundation models for computational pathology are usually evaluated using AUC and accuracy, while calibration is often left untested. This matters because a model can be accurate on average but still assign overly confident probabilities to cases that are difficult even for pathologists. We study calibration across eight pathology foundation models. Using pathologist agreement as a measure of diagnostic difficulty, we find that calibration error is consistently higher on low-agreement cases than on high-agreement cases. This pattern is not apparent from aggregate expected calibration error (ECE) alone. We then propose synthetic agreement calibration, a method for improving calibration without collecting multi-annotator labels. Given a trained linear probe, we select high-confidence embeddings as class anchors and interpolate between anchors from opposite classes. The interpolation weights encode a continuous notion of diagnostic ambiguity, which we use as a synthetic agreement signal to retrain the probe with agreement-aware label smoothing. On MHIST, which includes annotations from seven pathologists, synthetic agreement calibration recovers most of the calibration improvement obtained by label smoothing based on real pathologist agreement, while substantially reducing low-agreement ECE relative to the uncalibrated baseline. Discrimination metrics are preserved. On PatchCamelyon and BreakHis, public histopathology datasets without multi-annotator labels, the method improves calibration across the evaluated foundation models, whereas annotator-dependent approaches cannot be used without additional expert annotation.

AI.tldr: 病理基础模型的校准问题被忽视；该文发现低一致性(困难)病例校准误差更高，并提出"合成一致性校准"方法，无需多标注者标签即可改善校准。
AI.motivation: 计算病理学基础模型通常只用AUC和准确率评估，校准很少被检验。模型可能平均准确，却对连病理医生都觉得困难的病例给出过度自信的概率。以病理医生一致性衡量诊断难度，可揭示聚合ECE掩盖的低一致性病例校准更差的问题。
AI.method: 研究8个病理基础模型的校准表现。以病理医生一致性衡量诊断难度。提出合成一致性校准：给定训练好的线性探针，选择高置信度嵌入作为类锚点，在相反类别的锚点间插值；插值权重编码连续的诊断模糊性，作为合成一致性信号，配合一致性感知的标签平滑重新训练探针。
AI.result: 在含7位病理医生标注的MHIST上，合成一致性校准恢复了基于真实病理医生一致性的标签平滑所获得的大部分校准改善，同时显著降低低一致性ECE，且判别指标保持不变。在无多标注者标签的PatchCamelyon和BreakHis上，该方法在各评估基础模型上均改善校准，而依赖标注者的方法则无法使用。
AI.conclusion: 校准误差在低病理医生一致性（困难）病例上系统性更高，且无法从聚合ECE看出。合成一致性校准无需收集多标注者标签，即可在多个数据集和基础模型上有效改善校准，同时保持判别性能，弥补了依赖专家标注方法的局限。

title: Learning-Enabled Estimation: Tight Characterizations under Sample Selection Biases
summary:
When can we learn from biased samples? We study regression when outcomes are observed only after passing through selection filters that depend on both covariates and outcomes themselves, a ubiquitous challenge spanning clinical trials with patient dropout, labor markets with self-selection, and auctions with strategic entry. Ignoring such selection yields systematically biased conclusions with real-world consequences. This challenge has a long history in econometrics and statistics, starting with Heckman's seminal two-stage model and followed by numerous generalizations. While these works provide various sufficient conditions for identification, a complete characterization of when such regression is possible has remained elusive.
  In this work, we provide a characterization for when regression is possible in the presence of sample selection bias. Our results establish the minimal assumptions required on the functional forms of selection processes under which regression remains possible, which are particularly relevant in modern settings where selection mechanisms are increasingly complex and opaque. As a corollary of our characterization, we show that there are settings where the regression function can be identified even when the selection filter itself cannot. This observation already goes beyond the ``estimate selection filter, then debias regression'' paradigm that is followed by virtually all existing approaches. Under natural strengthenings of our identification conditions, we also establish finite-sample estimation guarantees with explicit convergence rates and provide oracle-efficient algorithms. This yields the first general-purpose estimation method for this broad class of selection problems. Finally, we explore the implications of our results for several well-studied econometric settings with complex selection mechanisms such as auctions with entry costs and labor markets.

AI.tldr: 本文刻画了在样本选择偏差下回归函数可识别的充要条件（最小函数形式假设），并给出有限样本估计保证与oracle高效算法，首次提供该类选择问题的通用估计方法。
AI.motivation: 样本选择偏差普遍存在于临床试验脱失、劳动力市场自选择和拍卖策略性进入等场景中，忽略选择会导致系统性偏差。尽管自Heckman两阶段模型以来已有大量研究给出各种充分识别条件，但"回归何时可能"的完整刻画始终缺失，尤其在当今选择机制日益复杂且不透明的背景下更显重要。
AI.method: 作者对选择过程（同时依赖协变量和结果）下回归函数的可识别性进行刻画，建立回归可行所需的选择机制函数形式的最小假设。作为推论，指出存在回归函数可识别但选择过滤器本身不可识别的情形。在加强识别条件下，建立带显式收敛率的有限样本估计保证，并给出oracle高效算法。
AI.result: 给出了样本选择偏差下回归可识别性的完整刻画；证明某些情形下回归函数可识别而选择过滤器不可识别，突破了"先估计选择过滤器再去偏回归"的范式；在自然加强条件下获得有限样本收敛率与oracle高效算法，形成该类选择问题的首个通用估计方法。
AI.conclusion: 本文为样本选择偏差下的回归提供了理论刻画与实用估计方法，并讨论了结果在带有进入成本的拍卖和劳动力市场等复杂选择机制计量场景中的意义。

title: Persona and Persuasive Framing in AI Voice Agents: A $2\times2$ Field Experiment with Children
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. Accepted at the 60th Hawaii International Conference on System Sciences (HICSS-60), 2027
summary: Conversational agents increasingly interact with children, yet evidence on how their design shapes children's susceptibility to persuasion comes almost entirely from the lab. We report a $2\times2$ randomized field experiment embedded in a public German Santa Claus telephone hotline. Children's calls were randomly routed to one of four LLM voice agents varying persona (Santa, high authority, vs. Helper, low authority) and framing (persuasive nudges toward prosocial wishes vs. neutral). Of 1,072 logged calls, 89 conversations (median age 6) met inclusion criteria. Persuasive framing raised the probability of a prosocial wish from 11.6% to 45.7%, robust to controls. Persona authority showed a near-zero effect: Santa did not outperform the Helper. Persona instead shaped engagement; children hung up on the Helper far more often within the first minute (65% vs. 39%). Where context already lends an agent legitimacy, how it speaks shapes children's compliance more than who it claims to be.

AI.tldr: 通过在德国公共圣诞老人电话热线中嵌入2×2随机田野实验，发现说服性框架使儿童许下亲社会愿望的概率从11.6%升至45.7%，而角色权威（圣诞老人vs.助手）几乎无影响，但角色影响参与度，儿童更易在1分钟内挂断助手电话。
AI.motivation: 关于对话智能体设计如何影响儿童易受说服程度的证据几乎全部来自实验室，缺乏真实场景下的田野证据；同时儿童与对话智能体的互动日益增多，亟需了解其设计对儿童说服敏感性的实际影响。
AI.method: 在德国公共圣诞老人电话热线中嵌入2×2随机田野实验，将儿童来电随机分配到四种LLM语音智能体之一，操纵两个因素：角色（圣诞老人=高权威 vs 助手=低权威）和框架（亲社会愿望的说服性引导 vs 中性）。共记录1072通来电，其中89通对话（中位年龄6岁）符合纳入标准。
AI.result: 说服性框架使儿童许下亲社会愿望的概率从11.6%提升至45.7%，且在控制变量下依然稳健；角色权威效应接近于零，圣诞老人并未优于助手；角色反而影响参与度，儿童在1分钟内挂断助手电话的比例远高于圣诞老人（65% vs 39%）。
AI.conclusion: 当语境本身已赋予智能体合法性时，其说话方式（框架）比其自称的身份（角色权威）更能影响儿童的顺从行为；智能体设计应重视话语框架的作用。

title: Hard-Region Supervision: #1 on the Waymo Open Dataset 2D Video Panoptic Segmentation Leaderboard
summary: We describe our winning entry to the Waymo Open Dataset 2D Video Panoptic Segmentation Challenge. The task asks for a semantic class at every pixel of every frame and, for countable objects, an identity that holds across 100 frames and across five overlapping cameras. We build on DVIS++, a cascade of a segmenter, a tracker, and a refiner, as our baseline. We propose hard region supervision (HRS) to improve the baseline. In particular, we use the baseline to define the hard region as where it makes mistakes, and design a loss and an auxiliary prediction head for this region. The auxiliary head is used only in training and removed at test time, so at inference the model trained with HRS has the same architecture as the baseline. In addition, we propose three test-time steps that further improve the results: a two-model ensemble, a merge of the segmenter's output into the final panoptic map, and cross-camera identity linking. On the challenge test set, our entry reaches 0.3547 wSTQ, 0.2071 wAQ, and 0.6075 mIoU, ranking first on all three metrics. It is 3.6 wSTQ points ahead of the second entry and 2.4 points ahead of our DVIS++ baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出硬区域监督HRS及三项测试时策略，在Waymo 2D视频全景分割挑战赛中获三项指标第一。
AI.motivation: Waymo开放数据集2D视频全景分割挑战要求为每帧每个像素赋予语义类别，并对可数物体在100帧、五个重叠相机间保持一致的实例身份。基线DVIS++仍有改进空间，需提升分割与跟踪精度。
AI.method: 以DVIS++（分割器、跟踪器、精化器的级联）为基线，提出硬区域监督（HRS）：用基线定义其出错的硬区域，为此设计损失函数与辅助预测头，辅助头仅用于训练并测试时移除，故推理架构与基线相同。另加三项测试时步骤：双模型集成、将分割器输出合并进最终全景图、跨相机身份链接。
AI.result: 在挑战测试集上取得0.3547 wSTQ、0.2071 wAQ、0.6075 mIoU，三项指标均排名第一，wSTQ比第二名高3.6分，比DVIS++基线高2.4分。
AI.conclusion: HRS在不改变推理架构的前提下提升基线性能，配合测试时集成与跨相机链接策略，使模型在视频全景分割挑战中全面领先。

title: Differentiable Structure Learning for Cyclic Linear Gaussian Models with Latent Confounders
summary: We study causal structure learning from observational data in linear Gaussian structural causal models in the presence of directed cycles and an unknown number of exogenous latent confounders, bounded by a given maximum. We derive the covariance of the observed variables and introduce marginal quasi-equivalence, which characterizes when different causal models share a full-dimensional subset of the observational distributions they can generate. We formulate structure learning as minimization of the Gaussian negative log-likelihood with a logarithmically scaled complexity penalty that counts directed edges and latent variables. For a fixed number of observed variables and a fixed upper bound on latent variables, we establish consistency of global score minimizers up to marginal quasi-equivalence under algebraic faithfulness, structural minimality, and model-overlap assumptions. We parameterize the inclusion of directed edges and candidate latent variables using Bernoulli gates, whose continuous probabilities are optimized jointly with the structural coefficients. Averaging the penalized negative log-likelihood over these gates yields an objective with a closed-form differentiable complexity penalty. We prove that this expected objective has the same global infimum as the corresponding discrete structure-learning objective. Experimental results show that our approach achieves lower recovery error than previous methods in several experimental settings.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在含向环和未知数量外生潜混淆因子的线性高斯结构因果模型中的因果结构学习，提出边际准等价概念，并基于对数缩放复杂度惩罚和Bernoulli门参数化方法实现结构学习，证明了全局最优解的相合性及目标函数全局下确界一致性，实验表明恢复误差低于已有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有因果结构学习方法通常假设无环或已知潜变量数量，难以处理实际中可能存在的向环以及数量未知（但有上界）的外生潜混淆因子。本文旨在填补这一空白，建立在此类更一般模型下可实现相合的结构学习框架。
AI.method: 首先推导观测变量的协方差，并引入边际准等价（marginal quasi-equivalence），刻画不同因果模型生成同一满维观测分布子集的条件。将结构学习表述为高斯负对数似然最小化问题，并采用对数缩放、计有向边和潜变量数量的复杂度惩罚。用Bernoulli门参数化有向边与候选潜变量的纳入，概率与结构系数联合优化；对门进行平均得到具闭式可微复杂度惩罚的目标函数。
AI.result: 在固定的观测变量数和潜变量上界下，证明了在代数忠实性、结构最小性和模型重叠假设下，全局得分最小者可达边际准等价意义下的相合性。进一步证明期望目标与对应离散结构学习目标具有相同的全局下确界。实验结果显示，在多种实验设置下，该方法比先前方法的恢复误差更低。
AI.conclusion: 本文为含向环和未知潜混淆因子的线性高斯因果结构学习提供了可相合的理论框架与可微优化方法，兼顾理论保证与实践效果，拓展了因果发现方法的适用范围。

title: Positive Ratings, Hidden Concerns: Employee Voice Disclosure in AI-Mediated Organizational Listening
comment: 10 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Accepted at the 60th Hawaii International Conference on System Sciences (HICSS-60), 2027
summary: Organizations started listening to employees through conversational AI agents alongside structured surveys. Little is known about what these channels change in what employees say when disclosure carries hierarchical risk. We report a field study inside a global management consulting firm whose process pairs a pre-survey with an adaptive AI voice interview on the same themes within one session. Across 44 first-session interviews (132 matched theme observations), 20-41% of sessions showed a favorable rating co-occurring with a substantive concern voiced later, depending on the favorability threshold. The Gioia analysis drew on 158 protective quotes from 65 eligible sessions. Disclosure rarely arrived unguarded: employees softened concerns, deflected accountability, and bounded how far they went, and this protective work tracked the perceived legitimacy of the listening structure. We develop a grounded model of bounded disclosure and derive four propositions for voice, channel and listening research. Silence, we argue, can persist inside expression.

AI.tldr: 在一家全球管理咨询公司开展田野研究，比较同一场次内"问卷预调查＋自适应AI语音访谈"的配对数据，发现员工普遍呈现"有界披露"：表面好感评级之后往往伴随实质顾虑，且这种保护性表达与所感知的倾听结构合法性相关。
AI.motivation: 组织越来越多地在结构化问卷之外，借助对话式AI代理倾听员工声音，但在披露存在层级风险的情境下，这类渠道究竟改变了员工"说什么"尚不清楚。已有研究缺乏对同一场次、同一主题下不同渠道表达差异的实证考察。
AI.method: 在全球管理咨询公司内开展田野研究：同一场次内先做预调查，再就相同主题进行自适应AI语音访谈。共44场首次访谈（132条配对主题观测），基于65场合格会话中的158条保护性引语进行Gioia编码分析。
AI.result: 按不同好感阈值，20%–41%的场次出现"正面评级"与"稍后提出的实质顾虑"并存的现象。披露很少毫无防备：员工弱化顾虑、转移责任、限定表达边界；这种保护性工作与员工对所感知倾听结构合法性的判断相一致。
AI.conclusion: 论文构建了"有界披露"的扎根理论模型，并就建言、渠道与倾听研究提出四个命题。核心论点：沉默可以在表达之中持续存在。

title: SpatialCORE: Confidence-Aware Grounded Spatial Reasoning in Large Vision--Language Models
summary: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have made remarkable progress across visual perception tasks, yet spatial reasoning remains a persistent weakness, especially for questions that require reasoning over visual space. Recent spatial-reasoning methods incorporate generated grounding, where models predict bounding boxes, masks, or other localization outputs for task-relevant objects as part of their reasoning trace. However, these approaches typically optimize final-answer correctness alone, allowing correct answers to be rewarded even when the model does not reason from confidently localized task-relevant objects. We introduce SpatialCORE (Spatially COnfident REasoning), a post-training framework that turns the model's own confidence in generated grounding into a learning signal for spatial reasoning. Its central idea is to reinforce grounding that is both accurate and confident, encouraging the model to reason from confidently localized task-relevant objects. SpatialCORE realizes this through a self-regulating spatial reward that weights each predicted bounding box's matching quality by its coordinate-token confidence. An answer gate further ties grounding optimization to final-answer correctness. SpatialCORE achieves state-of-the-art results among open-source and specialized spatial reasoning models across diverse benchmarks, and transfers effectively in zero-shot settings to unseen data distributions. The source code is available at https://github.com/rafiibnsultan/SpatialCORE.

AI.tldr: 提出 SpatialCORE 后训练框架，将模型在生成 grounding 中的置信度作为空间推理的学习信号，通过自调节空间奖励和答案门控强化"自信且准确"的定位，在多项基准上取得开源及专用空间推理模型中的最优结果。
AI.motivation: 大型视觉语言模型在视觉感知任务上进展显著，但空间推理仍是明显短板，尤其是需要基于视觉空间进行推理的问题。现有引入生成式 grounding（预测边界框、掩码等定位输出）的空间推理方法通常只优化最终答案正确性，导致即使模型并非基于可信定位的任务相关物体进行推理，也能因答对而获得奖励，从而无法保证推理过程真正依赖可靠定位。
AI.method: SpatialCORE 是一种后训练框架，把模型自身对生成 grounding 的置信度转化为空间推理的学习信号。核心是自调节空间奖励（self-regulating spatial reward），用坐标 token 的置信度对每个预测边界框的匹配质量进行加权，从而强化同时"准确且自信"的 grounding；并引入答案门控（answer gate），将 grounding 优化与最终答案正确性绑定。
AI.result: 在多种基准上，SpatialCORE 在开源模型与专用空间推理模型中取得最优（state-of-the-art）结果，并在零样本设置下有效迁移到未见过的数据分布。源代码已公开于 https://github.com/rafiibnsultan/SpatialCORE。
AI.conclusion: 利用模型对生成 grounding 的置信度作为学习信号，可有效提升视觉语言模型的空间推理能力，并具备良好的泛化迁移性。

title: Geometry-physics confounding impairs PDE learning across varying domains
summary: Learning partial differential equation (PDE) dynamics across varying domains is central to predictive modelling and data-driven discovery of governing equations. However, geometric variation alters both field representation and the governing differential operators, confounding geometric effects with intrinsic physical properties in the observed dynamics. This work identifies geometry-physics confounding as a unified failure mechanism for PDE learning across varying domains. In forward operator learning, this confounding increases the burden of inferring geometry-dependent operator changes from finite data, reducing data efficiency and generalisation. In equation discovery, omitting geometry-induced operators misspecifies the candidate library, leading to biased parameters, missed governing terms and spurious terms. We propose a de-confounding framework that makes the known geometry-to-operator transformation explicit. Geometry-induced coefficient fields improve prediction and data efficiency across five operator-learning benchmarks, while geometry-complete candidate libraries recover the generating equations and reduce held-out PDE residuals by more than two orders of magnitude in both evolving-domain systems. By separating known geometric action from intrinsic physics, the proposed framework supports more reliable and data-efficient PDE learning across scientific and engineering problems with varying geometries.

AI.tldr: 本文识别了"几何-物理混淆"问题，并提出显式建模几何到算子变换的去混淆框架。
AI.motivation: 在不同几何域上学习偏微分方程（PDE）动态对预测建模和数据驱动发现方程至关重要，但几何变化同时改变场表示和支配微分算子，将几何效应与内在物理性质混淆，导致学习困难。
AI.method: 提出去混淆框架，显式地利用已知的几何到算子变换，引入几何诱导的系数场，并构建"几何完整"的候选库。
AI.result: 在五个算子学习基准上，几何诱导系数场提升了预测精度与数据效率；几何完整候选库能恢复生成方程，并在两个动态域系统中将留出PDE残差降低超过两个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 通过将已知几何作用与内在物理分离，该框架支持在几何变化情形下更可靠、数据更高效的PDE学习。

title: GraphCert: Bootstrap Agentic Graph Reasoning with Certified Evidence Rubrics
summary: Graph agents extend large language models (LLMs) with the ability to actively explore and reason over knowledge graphs through multi-step interactions with graph tools. However, training capable graph agents typically requires large collections of question-answer pairs and reasoning trajectories, whose manual construction is costly and difficult to scale. Moreover, employing proprietary LLMs to generate such supervision further risks exposing sensitive graph data to external services. Therefore, we propose GraphCert to bootstrap agentic graph reasoning with certified evidence rubrics during post-training. Specifically, the Bootstrapped Graph Quizzer guided by generation controls produces graph-grounded QA pairs and marks supporting evidence, which undergo execution certification and semantic curation. The accepted evidence is then canonicalized into certified evidence rubrics that later reward Graph Solver evidence alignment alongside answer correctness during GRPO training. Experiments on five graph reasoning domains in GRBENCH demonstrate that GraphCert consistently outperforms substantially larger LLM agents and post-training method. Furthermore, our analysis demonstrates that the learned policy transfers robustly across heterogeneous graph domains, suggesting that GraphCert acquires reusable graph-reasoning capabilities rather than domain-specific patterns. These results establish executable self-certification as an effective approach to self-training compact graph reasoning agents. Our code will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出 GraphCert，通过“认证证据评分标准”在后训练阶段自举图智能体的推理能力，无需昂贵人工标注或暴露敏感图数据给专有 LLM，性能超越更大模型。
AI.motivation: 训练图智能体通常需要大量问答对和推理轨迹，人工构建成本高且难以扩展；同时使用专有 LLM 生成监督会带来敏感图数据外泄风险。因此需要一种低成本、保护隐私的自训练方法。
AI.method: GraphCert 在后训练中自举图推理：由受生成控制引导的 Bootstrapped Graph Quizzer 生成基于图的问答对并标注支持证据；证据经执行认证与语义筛选后，被规范化为“认证证据评分标准”，在 GRPO 训练中与答案正确性一起奖励 Graph Solver 的证据对齐。
AI.result: 在 GRBENCH 的五个图推理领域上，GraphCert 持续优于规模更大的 LLM 智能体和后训练方法；学到的策略可跨异构图领域稳健迁移，表明其获得的是可复用的图推理能力而非领域特定模式。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明“可执行自认证”是自训练紧凑图推理智能体的一种有效途径，且代码将公开。

title: Soft Spatial Reasoning
summary: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) commonly perform spatial reasoning through chain-of-thought (CoT), encoding intermediate reasoning as autoregressive sequences of discrete language tokens. Such hard thinking requires committing to a single token at each step, even when the correct spatial interpretation remains uncertain. This early commitment constitutes premature discretization: an incorrect token selection can propagate errors through subsequent reasoning. We propose Soft Spatial Reasoning, a post-training framework that introduces soft thinking for spatial tasks in LVLMs. At each intermediate reasoning step, the LVLM forms a continuous soft state by mixing token embeddings rather than selecting a single token, allowing multiple candidate continuations to influence the next step. The appropriate degree of softness, however, can vary across reasoning steps: retaining multiple candidates may preserve a useful spatial interpretation, but if those candidates imply conflicting spatial relations, mixing them may interfere with subsequent reasoning. At the core of Soft Spatial Reasoning is AdaptSoft, a controller that uses the current hidden state and predictive uncertainty to adapt the degree of softness at each reasoning step. To train AdaptSoft, we introduce a gradient-alignment learning objective that provides a step-specific learning signal for softness control without intermediate reasoning supervision. Across diverse spatial benchmarks, Soft Spatial Reasoning outperforms hard and fixed-soft CoT baselines using the same backbone, as well as a range of existing LVLMs. The source code is available at https://github.com/rafiibnsultan/Soft_Spatial_Reasoning

AI.tldr: 提出Soft Spatial Reasoning后训练框架，通过软思考缓解LVLM空间推理中的过早离散化问题，核心是AdaptSoft控制器自适应调节每步软化程度。
AI.motivation: LVLM通常用链式思维（CoT）做空间推理，将中间推理编码为离散语言token的自回归序列。这种硬思考要求每一步都选定单一token，即使正确的空间解释仍不确定。这种过早离散化会导致错误token在后续推理中传播误差。
AI.method: 在每个中间推理步骤，LVLM通过混合token嵌入形成连续软状态，而非选择单一token，使多个候选延续影响下一步。核心组件AdaptSoft利用当前隐藏状态和预测不确定性，自适应调整每步的软化程度。为训练AdaptSoft，引入梯度对齐学习目标，在无中间推理监督的情况下提供步特定的软化控制学习信号。
AI.result: 在多个空间基准上，Soft Spatial Reasoning优于相同骨干网络的硬CoT和固定软CoT基线，以及一系列现有LVLM。源代码已公开。
AI.conclusion: 通过自适应软思考替代过早离散化，能有效提升LVLM空间推理性能，且无需中间推理监督即可训练软化控制器。

title: Interpretable but Fragile? Robustness of Concept Bottlenecks under Geometric-Semantic Perturbations
summary: Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) are designed to provide interpretable intermediate representations, yet how such bottlenecks affect robustness remains unclear, with existing studies reporting mixed and sometimes contradictory findings. We argue that these discrepancies arise from conflating different robustness notions and perturbation regimes, rather than from fundamental disagreements about CBMs themselves. To disentangle these factors, we introduce a generator-based evaluation framework that enables controlled comparisons between standard classifiers and CBMs under two distinct perturbation types: continuous geometric perturbations in latent space and discrete semantic interventions in concept space. Within this framework, we evaluate robustness both empirically, via prediction and concept-level sensitivity metrics, and certifiably, using randomized smoothing in latent and concept spaces. Across experiments, we reconcile previously conflicting findings by clarifying when, and in what sense, concept bottlenecks do or do not improve robustness. By further analyzing robustness under varying task conditions, including class semantic similarity and concept vocabulary size, we show that interpretability does not inherently confer robustness. Instead, concept bottlenecks shift where and how sensitivity manifests, revealing a nuanced interpretability robustness trade off that depends critically on the perturbation regime and task structure. Together, our results show that interpretability and robustness are distinct objectives: interpretable intermediate representations do not uniformly improve robustness, but instead redistribute sensitivity across perturbation spaces and model families.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于生成器的评估框架，通过区分连续几何扰动与离散语义干预，并采用经验与可认证两种鲁棒性度量，澄清了概念瓶颈模型中"可解释性是否带来鲁棒性"的争议，指出可解释性与鲁棒性是不同目标。
AI.motivation: 现有关于概念瓶颈模型（CBM）鲁棒性的研究结论混杂甚至互相矛盾。作者认为这些矛盾并非源于对CBM本身的根本分歧，而是因为混淆了不同的鲁棒性概念与扰动机制，因此需要一套受控的评估框架来加以解耦。
AI.method: 提出基于生成器的评估框架，在两种扰动类型下对标准分类器与CBM进行受控比较：(1) 潜在空间中的连续几何扰动；(2) 概念空间中的离散语义干预。鲁棒性评估同时覆盖经验层面（预测与概念级敏感度指标）和可认证层面（潜在空间与概念空间中的随机平滑）。此外分析不同任务条件下的鲁棒性，包括类别语义相似度与概念词表规模。
AI.result: 通过统一框架调和了以往相互冲突的结论，明确了概念瓶颈在何时、以何种意义提升或不提升鲁棒性。结果显示，可解释性并不天然带来鲁棒性；概念瓶颈改变了敏感性的表现形式与位置。鲁棒性呈现依赖于扰动机制与任务结构的可解释性—鲁棒性权衡关系。
AI.conclusion: 可解释性与鲁棒性是两个相互独立的目标：可解释的中间表示不会一致地提升鲁棒性，而是将敏感性在不同扰动空间与模型族之间重新分配。

title: When Reasoning Goes Astray: Attention Dynamics of Uncontrolled Reasoning
summary: Large reasoning models (LRMs) improve performance on complex tasks through extended reasoning, yet the same process can degenerate into redundant verification and persistent generation loops. Such uncontrolled reasoning increases inference cost and creates risks of resource exhaustion and service degradation. However, existing mitigations largely truncate long outputs or react to surface repetition, and thus fail to distinguish normal thinking from uncontrolled reasoning or explain how benign reasoning degenerates into harmful behavior. In this paper, we operationalize LRM generation as four states and further introduce Reasoning-state Analysis via Dynamic Attention Responses (RADAR), which identifies the current reasoning state in real time and characterizes how effective reflection can develop into uncontrolled generation. Guided by RADAR's analysis, we further realign abnormal attention distributions toward patterns observed in normal requests and examine how this correction affects excessive reflection and persistent looping. Temporal analyses show that uncontrolled reasoning is characterized by attention distributions that deviate from normal generation, with abnormal trends becoming detectable before repetition begins. Correcting these deviations through Attention Realignment consistently reduces looping while largely preserving benign performance. Together, RADAR provide a mechanistic account of how reasoning becomes uncontrolled, offering actionable guidance for identifying critical failure stages and designing targeted runtime interventions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RADAR方法，将大推理模型的生成过程操作化为四种状态，通过动态注意力响应实时识别推理状态，并揭示良性反思如何演变为失控生成；基于此进行注意力重对齐，可减少循环同时保持正常性能。
AI.motivation: 大推理模型（LRMs）通过延长推理提升复杂任务表现，但该过程可能退化为冗余验证和持续生成循环，导致推理成本增加、资源耗尽与服务降级风险。现有缓解方法多仅截断长输出或对表面重复作出反应，无法区分正常思考与失控推理，也无法解释良性推理如何退化为有害行为。
AI.method: 将LRM生成操作化为四种状态；提出基于动态注意力响应的推理状态分析（RADAR），实时识别当前推理状态并刻画有效反思发展为失控生成的过程；在RADAR分析指导下，将异常注意力分布重对齐至正常请求中观察到的模式，并考察该修正对过度反思与持续循环的影响。
AI.result: 时序分析显示，失控推理的注意力分布偏离正常生成，且异常趋势在重复出现之前即可被检测到；通过注意力重对齐修正这些偏差，可一致地减少循环，同时基本保持良性性能。
AI.conclusion: RADAR为推理如何变得失控提供了机制性解释，为识别关键失败阶段和设计针对性运行时干预提供了可操作的指导。

title: Matisse: Evidence-Space Reasoning for Active 3D Reconstruction
comment: 20 pages, 7 figures, 7 tables. Project page: https://xihangyu630.github.io/matisse/
summary: How can a 3D reconstruction system acquire and retain useful information to understand the geometry of a scene from partial views under a limited computation budget? Existing active view acquisition methods typically estimate uncertainty over observed or instantiated geometry, limiting their ability to reason about unseen structure, while long-horizon reconstruction methods often retain redundant observations. We introduce Matisse, a training-free framework that unifies active reconstruction and keyframe selection by leveraging evidence provided by a pretrained generative 3D model. Matisse estimates Evidential Uncertainty from cross-attention evidence associated with 3D latent tokens and derives an Evidential Information Gain to guide both view acquisition and keyframe selection based on the expected reduction in posterior entropy. Matisse supports multi-object scenes through occlusion-aware, object-balanced aggregation and propagates uncertainty through intermediate latents to avoid full reconstruction during planning. Matisse reduces Chamfer distance by 12.7%, 3.8%, and 9.2% on GSO30, YCB-V, and Replica, respectively, relative to the best baseline on each dataset, and achieves a $1.50\times$ end-to-end speedup over the best active reconstruction baseline on GSO30 with the same reconstruction backend. In the GSO30 keyframe selection experiment for long-horizon reconstruction, Matisse achieves comparable Chamfer distance using 14% of the input views compared with Stream3D.

AI.tldr: Matisse：一个免训练框架，利用预训练生成式3D模型的证据不确定性，统一主动重建与关键帧选择。
AI.motivation: 现有主动视图获取方法仅估计已观测或已实例化几何的不确定性，难以推理未见结构；长时序重建方法则常保留冗余观测。如何在有限计算预算下高效获取并保留有用信息以理解场景几何，是核心问题。
AI.method: 基于预训练生成式3D模型，从3D潜在token的交叉注意力证据估计"证据不确定性"，并推导"证据信息增益"（基于后验熵期望减少），同时指导视图获取与关键帧选择；通过遮挡感知、物体均衡聚合支持多物体场景，并在中间潜在层传播不确定性以避免规划时的完整重建。
AI.result: 相比各数据集最佳基线，Chamfer距离在GSO30、YCB-V、Replica上分别降低12.7%、3.8%、9.2%；在GSO30上以相同重建后端取得1.50倍端到端加速。在GSO30长时序关键帧选择实验中，仅用14%输入视图即达到与Stream3D相当的Chamfer距离。
AI.conclusion: Matisse是免训练的，统一了主动重建与关键帧选择，借助生成式3D模型的证据实现更高效、更准确的部分视图3D重建。

title: Proper Scoring Rule-based Diffusion for Probabilistic Weather Forecasting
summary: Recent probabilistic weather forecasters train stochastic predictors with the continuous ranked probability score (CRPS) to generate each ensemble member in a single forward pass. These models learn the predictive distribution from the forecast context alone, which becomes difficult at longer forecast horizons where uncertainty is high. To learn the predictive distribution more effectively, we introduce auxiliary conditional denoising tasks that predict the same future state from the context and its corrupted version, which provides partial future information that can reduce prediction ambiguity. Building on distributional diffusion models, we learn the conditional distributions of these tasks with a single stochastic predictor by minimizing a proper scoring rule across noise levels. At inference, the predictor can still generate each ensemble member in a single forward pass at the fully corrupted endpoint. Standard CRPS training is recovered as the endpoint-only special case of our formulation, so our framework extends existing CRPS-based forecasters with only additional conditioning inputs. Controlled experiments show that the auxiliary tasks improve one-step forecasting across architectures, with larger gains at longer forecast horizons. The gains extend to high-dimensional global weather forecasting under both training from scratch and fine-tuning, along with improved calibration and potential benefits for generalization under distribution shift.

AI.tldr: 本文提出在基于CRPS的随机天气预报模型中引入辅助条件去噪任务，预测未来状态的同时也从污染版本预测未来状态，以单次前向传播生成集合成员，提升长预报时效的预测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有随机天气预报模型仅依赖预报上下文学习预测分布，在较长预报时效下不确定性高，难以有效学习预测分布，因此需要提供未来状态的额外信息来减少预测模糊性。
AI.method: 在分布扩散模型基础上，引入辅助条件去噪任务：从上下文及其污染版本预测同一未来状态，提供部分未来信息；用单个随机预测器在各噪声水平上最小化合适的评分规则（proper scoring rule）来学习这些条件分布。标准CRPS训练被视作仅在完全污染端点处的特例。
AI.result: 在受控实验中，辅助任务在不同架构上均改善单步预报，且预报时效越长增益越大；在高维全球天气预报中（从头训练和微调）均取得提升，同时改善校准，并在分布偏移下对泛化有潜在益处。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将现有基于CRPS的预报器扩展为仅需额外条件输入的形式，通过辅助去噪任务有效提升随机天气预报性能、校准与泛化能力。

title: Whose Voice Survives the Summary? A Voice-Retention Audit of LLM Employee Listening
comment: 10 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Accepted at the 60th Hawaii International Conference on System Sciences (HICSS 2027)
summary: Organizations increasingly route employee feedback to leaders through large language model (LLM) summaries, an unaudited layer that silences already-spoken voice. We introduce a Voice Retention / Representation Ratio metric for representational bias in summarization and apply it to a bilingual (English/German) corpus of 2,586 free-text responses from a global professional service company. First, employees supply criticism more reliably than praise (withholding praise is 82 times more common). Second, across 45 leader-summaries the pipeline filters by popularity, not sentiment: criticism survives, yet a concern voiced once is dropped 86% of the time, with short and German-only content lost on the same axis (theme retention 0.14 vs 0.74; German directional). Controlling for frequency, sentiment has no independent effect; the harm is prevalence-driven, which sentiment-only audits miss. A targeted prompt recovers only named themes. We contribute the metric, field evidence, and a disaggregated voice-retention card.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"声音保留/代表性比率"指标，用于检测LLM摘要中的代表性偏差，并在某全球专业服务公司2,586条英/德双语员工反馈语料上验证：摘要流程按"流行度"而非情感过滤，仅被提及一次的关切被丢弃的概率达86%。
AI.motivation: 组织越来越多地使用大语言模型（LLM）摘要向领导者转达员工反馈，这一未受审计的中间层会压制"本已被表达的声音"。作者希望揭示摘要环节中隐藏的代表性偏差，并弥补仅基于情感分析的审计方式所遗漏的问题。
AI.method: 作者提出"声音保留/代表性比率"（Voice Retention / Representation Ratio）指标，用于衡量摘要中的代表性偏差，并应用于某全球专业服务公司2,586条自由文本回答构成的双语（英语/德语）语料，覆盖45份面向领导者的摘要，考察情感、提及频率、长度和语言等因素对内容保留的影响；同时测试了针对性提示（targeted prompt）的补救效果。
AI.result: 第一，员工更倾向于提供批评而非赞扬（不提赞扬的频率是提赞扬的82倍）。第二，摘要流程按流行度而非情感过滤：批评性内容能够保留，但仅被提及一次的关切有86%的概率被丢弃；短文本和纯德语内容也在同一维度上丢失（主题保留率0.14对0.74，德语呈方向性差异）。在控制频率后，情感没有独立影响，危害由内容的普遍程度（流行度）驱动，这是仅做情感审计所无法发现的。针对性提示只能恢复被明确点名的主题。
AI.conclusion: 论文的贡献包括：提出声音保留/代表性比率指标、提供实地证据，以及一个可分解的"声音保留卡片"（disaggregated voice-retention card），用于审计和暴露LLM摘要流程中对少数、短文本及非英语内容的系统性压制。

title: Consensus-Aware Multi-Source Fusion for Reference-Guided Camouflaged Object Detection
comment: 20 pages, including 2 pages of appendix; 9 figures and 4 tables
summary: Reference-guided camouflaged object detection aims to segment a target whose visual appearance closely resembles its surroundings by exploiting auxiliary reference samples. The task remains difficult because reference samples contain inconsistent target cues, while generic visual representations are not inherently aligned with the target specified by the references. To handle these problems, we present a consensus-aware multi-source fusion framework. Reference-Conditioned Dual-Backbone Fusion (RCDF) couples trainable PVTv2 query features with frozen DINOv3 representations and uses reference-conditioned correlation to select foundation-model evidence before multi-scale fusion. The framework also aggregates multiple references through cross-reference consensus aggregation and injects reference information at semantic depths matched to the query features. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method. The results further show that reference consensus, target-conditioned foundation features, and hierarchical decoding provide complementary improvements under the evaluation protocol. The source code will be made publicly available upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出共识感知的多源融合框架用于参考引导的伪装目标检测，通过RCDF模块融合可训练PVTv2查询特征与冻结DINOv3表示，并进行跨参考共识聚合与语义深度注入。
AI.motivation: 参考引导的伪装目标检测因目标与背景高度相似而困难；参考样本包含不一致的目标线索，且通用视觉表示与参考所指定的目标并不天然对齐。
AI.method: 提出共识感知多源融合框架。核心模块RCDF将可训练的PVTv2查询特征与冻结的DINOv3表示耦合，利用参考条件化的相关性在融合前筛选基础模型证据，并进行多尺度融合；同时通过跨参考共识聚合整合多个参考，并将参考信息注入到与查询特征匹配的语义深度。
AI.result: 大量实验证明了方法的有效性；结果表明参考共识、目标条件化的基础模型特征与分层解码在评估协议下提供了互补的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 参考共识、目标条件化基础特征与分层解码三者互补，共同提升参考引导伪装目标检测性能，源代码将在接收后公开。

title: Alignment via Training Against Probes Without Losing Monitorability
summary: Models are usually aligned based on their observed outputs, using demonstrations, preference data, or reward signals. These objectives reward responses that look aligned. More capable models may learn to satisfy them without internalizing the intended behavior, for example by faking compliance during training. Such superficial compliance could be harder when the objective is defined on model internals rather than outputs. Therefore, we study probe-guided fine-tuning, using probes that detect undesired properties in model activations as a direct training signal. We evaluate linear and non-linear probes with different numbers of probes per layer across two alignment objectives: harmlessness and honesty. We find that training against probes that do not update during training is an easily exploitable objective, while continuously updated probes substantially reduce harmfulness and improve honesty while preserving utility. Probe-guided fine-tuning achieves better safety-utility trade-offs than DPO and inference-time steering, while being substantially more robust against jailbreak and abliteration attacks. Moreover, the concepts stay linearly encoded after fine-tuning, meaning oversight is not lost by our method. Training against probes thus offers a way to shape what models represent rather than only what they output, which may become increasingly important as models get better at making their outputs look aligned.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"探针引导微调"（probe-guided fine-tuning），用检测模型激活中不良属性的探针作为直接训练信号，在无害性和诚实性两个对齐目标上均优于DPO与推理时引导，安全-效用权衡更佳且对越狱和消融攻击更鲁棒。
AI.motivation: 现有对齐方法多基于模型的观测输出（演示、偏好数据、奖励信号），只奖励"看起来对齐"的回答。能力更强的模型可能学会在不内化目标行为的情况下满足这些目标（如在训练中假装服从），产生表面合规。作者认为，当目标定义在模型内部而非输出上时，这种表面合规会更难实现，因此探索以模型内部激活为训练信号的对齐方式。
AI.method: 研究探针引导微调：使用检测模型激活中不良属性的探针作为直接训练信号。评估了线性与非线性探针、每层不同探针数量，覆盖无害性与诚实性两个对齐目标。关键设计是对比训练中不更新的探针与持续更新的探针。
AI.result: 训练不更新的探针是一个容易被利用的目标；持续更新的探针能显著降低有害性、提升诚实性并保持效用。探针引导微调比DPO和推理时引导实现更好的安全-效用权衡，且对越狱和abliteration（消融）攻击更鲁棒。微调后相关概念仍保持线性编码，说明该方法不会丧失可监督性。
AI.conclusion: 针对探针训练提供了一条塑造模型"所表征内容"而非仅"所输出内容"的途径。随着模型越来越善于让输出看起来对齐，这种基于内部表示的对齐方法可能日益重要。

title: More Choices, Fewer Decisions: Ordinal-Scale Bias in JEV-like Direct-Decision Models
summary: Direct-decision models turn text into low-latency structured labels and scores, making them attractive for classification and automatic evaluation. Yet reliability requires more than accuracy: a model must also use the ordinal decision scale supplied by the user faithfully. We analyze JEV~1.13 and three open KEV models. Our investigation begins with ANLI, where JEV assigns 38.8\% of all predictions and 51.3\% of errors to Neutral despite 74.95\% accuracy, nearly balanced gold labels, and balanced candidate positions. Across 36 ordinal datasets, final decisions use only 67--76\% of the effective gold support, versus 87--102\% on four nominal tasks. Randomizing candidate order weakens but does not remove this compression. Holding items and source scores fixed while balancing gold support and positions, we refine scales from $K=2$ to $14$; utilization falls for every model and reaches 26--75\% at $K=14$, although candidate probabilities remain broad for most models. Targeted BA-LoRA post-training raises gold-relative utilization from roughly 47\% to 86\% on eight supervised scales at both KEV sizes, showing that the compression is learned and modifiable rather than an immutable architectural limit. We call this ordinal scale-utilization bias: decision-stage candidate-space compression distinct from accuracy, gold imbalance, fixed position, and candidate count alone. The code and data are available at https://github.com/Glax147/jev_ordinal_scale_bia

AI.tldr: 直接决策模型在序数评分上存在"序数刻度利用偏差"：决策阶段候选空间被压缩，利用率随刻度增大而下降，但可通过BA-LoRA后训练显著改善。
AI.motivation: 直接决策模型虽具备低延迟的结构化标签与打分能力，但可靠性不仅取决于准确率，还需忠实使用用户给定的序数决策刻度。论文旨在揭示并量化模型在决策阶段对序数刻度的利用不足问题。
AI.method: 分析JEV 1.13与三个开源KEV模型；从ANLI入手，考察预测与误差在Neutral类的聚集；在36个序数数据集与4个名义任务上比较有效金标支持利用率；随机化候选顺序；固定样本与源分数、平衡金标支持与位置，将刻度从K=2细化到K=14；并采用BA-LoRA针对性后训练。
AI.result: JEV在ANLI上准确率74.95\%、金标近似平衡，却将38.8\%预测和51.3\%错误分配给Neutral；36个序数数据集的最终决策仅用到67--76\%有效金标支持，而4个名义任务为87--102\%；随机化候选顺序仅削弱不消除压缩；K=14时利用率降至26--75\%；BA-LoRA后训练将八个监督刻度的金标相对利用率从约47\%提升至86\%（两种KEV规模均有效）。
AI.conclusion: 该压缩现象被命名为"序数刻度利用偏差"，是区别于准确率、金标不平衡、固定位置和候选数量的决策阶段候选空间压缩；其可被学习且可通过后训练修正，并非架构固有限制。

title: Here the World in Stereo: Learning Dynamic Spatial Correspondence for Immersive Joint Video-Audio Generation
summary: Recent joint video-audio generation models have achieved strong semantic correspondence and temporal synchronization. However, applications such as AR/VR and interactive gaming further require stereo audio to provide an immersive sense, which remains largely overlooked. Effective stereo audio requires the perceived sound location to evolve consistently with the motion of its corresponding visual source. We refer to this property as Dynamic Spatial Correspondence and propose StereoBind, a framework that binds visual source motion to stereo sound generation. StereoBind uses motion tracks to coordinate visual motion and stereo audio through three complementary mechanisms. Visual Motion Binding establishes source-aware audiovisual correspondence, the Spatial Track Encoder captures absolute source positions, and Residual Track RoPE models relative motion. For supervision and evaluation, we construct StereoWorld-29K, a large-scale stereo audio-video dataset with paired motion tracks, and StereoWorldBench for measuring audiovisual spatial consistency. Experiments show that StereoBind substantially improves spatial alignment in stereo audio generation over existing models while preserving overall audiovisual quality.

AI.tldr: 提出 StereoBind 框架，通过运动轨迹绑定视觉运动与立体声生成，实现动态空间对应，并构建数据集与基准。
AI.motivation: 现有联合视频-音频生成模型虽在语义对应与时间同步上表现良好，但 AR/VR、交互游戏等应用需要立体声以提供沉浸感，而这一需求被忽视。有效立体声要求感知声源位置随对应视觉源运动一致变化，即动态空间对应。
AI.method: StereoBind 使用运动轨迹协调视觉运动与立体声，包含三种机制：视觉运动绑定（建立源感知的音视频对应）、空间轨迹编码器（捕捉绝对声源位置）、残差轨迹 RoPE（建模相对运动）。同时构建 StereoWorld-29K 大规模立体声音视频数据集（含配对运动轨迹）与 StereoWorldBench 评估基准。
AI.result: 实验表明 StereoBind 在立体声生成的空间对齐上显著优于现有模型，同时保持整体音视频质量。
AI.conclusion: StereoBind 通过运动轨迹绑定机制有效提升了立体声音频生成的空间一致性，并配套数据集与基准推动该方向研究。

title: Uncertainty-Normalized Margins for Direct Preference Optimization
summary: Direct preference optimization (DPO) models binary preferences through a Bradley-Terry model with a common noise scale, without explicitly accounting for preference strength or prompt-dependent uncertainty from human feedback. We introduce uncertainty-normalized margin DPO (UNM-DPO), which combines strength-dependent margins with a learned prompt scale. Motivated by a heteroskedastic Bradley-Terry model, we develop two training objectives. Both compare the implicit rewards of preferred and rejected responses, derived from response log-probability ratios to a reference policy. Advantage-only (AO) divides this reward difference by the prompt scale before subtracting the margin; whole-residual (WR) subtracts the margin before dividing by the scale. For the WR comparison model, we establish a necessary and sufficient condition under which known margins make the prompt scale identifiable. We introduce a practical procedure for learning the scale. Building on WR, we introduce ULNM-DPO-WR, which normalizes each response's implicit reward by its length. We evaluate our methods against DPO and related baselines on HelpSteer2 and HelpSteer3, using the Skywork reward model as a judge. With Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, ULNM-DPO-WR achieves tie-adjusted win rates against matched DPO of 68.00% and 65.31% on evaluation panels, with higher mean rewards and shorter responses on average. On AlpacaEval with a GPT-4.1 judge and GPT-4-Turbo reference answers, the same 8B policy achieves a length-controlled win rate of 21.62%, compared with 16.39% for DPO and 15.30% for SimPO. These results demonstrate the potential of combining preference-strength margins, learned prompt scales, and length normalization for policy optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 UNM-DPO，将偏好强度边际与可学习的 prompt 尺度结合，并进一步提出长度归一化的 ULNM-DPO-WR，在多个评测上超越 DPO 与 SimPO。
AI.motivation: DPO 通过 Bradley-Terry 模型建模二元偏好，使用统一噪声尺度，未显式考虑偏好强度或来自人类反馈的 prompt 相关不确定性，因此无法刻画异方差偏好信号。
AI.method: 受异方差 Bradley-Terry 模型启发，提出 UNM-DPO，包含两种目标：Advantage-only（先用 prompt scale 除奖励差再减 margin）和 whole-residual（WR，先减 margin 再除 scale）。对 WR 给出已知 margin 下 prompt scale 可识别的充要条件，并提出实用学习流程；在 WR 上加入响应隐式奖励的长度归一化，得到 ULNM-DPO-WR。
AI.result: 在 HelpSteer2 与 HelpSteer3 上以 Skywork 奖励模型为评判，Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 的 ULNM-DPO-WR 相对匹配 DPO 的 tie-adjusted 胜率为 68.00% 与 65.31%，平均奖励更高且响应更短。在 AlpacaEval 上以 GPT-4.1 评判、GPT-4-Turbo 为参考答案，长度控制胜率为 21.62%，优于 DPO 的 16.39% 和 SimPO 的 15.30%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，将偏好强度边际、可学习 prompt 尺度与长度归一化结合，对策略优化具有良好效果。

title: Diversity Combining for Multi-Path LLM Reasoning
summary: Multi-path reasoning methods such as self-consistency (SC) sample $K$ reasoning paths and choose the most frequent answer. However, their gains quickly plateau as $K$ increases, and existing methods do not predict when this saturation will occur. We formalize multi-path LLM reasoning as a diversity combining problem from wireless communications: each path is a noisy channel observation, and the pairwise correlation of path correctness caps the design-effect effective sample size of the vote at a finite ceiling. Generalized least squares (GLS) analysis shows that, under exchangeability, the optimal symmetric linear combiner of latent embeddings is uniform, supporting majority vote as the natural default in standard SC while leaving room for weighting or pruning under heterogeneous prompt-template branches. Across 5 models and 12 benchmarks, prompt-template diversity reduces path correlation in $55$ of $57$ valid cells, with the strongest effect on open-ended QA. We derive an Adaptive-K rule that uses a four-path pilot to select $K^*$, retaining $96$--$103\%$ of MV@$K{=}32$ accuracy across Math, QA, and NLU.

AI.tldr: 本文将多路径LLM推理形式化为无线通信中的分集合并问题，提出路径相关性限制了投票的有效样本量上限，并据此推导出自适应K规则。
AI.motivation: 自一致性等多路径推理方法随K增大收益迅速饱和，而已有方法无法预测饱和何时发生，缺乏理论刻画。
AI.method: 将每条推理路径视为含噪信道观测，用成对相关性刻画正确性；通过广义最小二乘（GLS）分析潜嵌入的最优对称线性合并器；在5个模型、12个基准上测试提示模板多样性对路径相关性的影响，并推导基于四路径预实验选择K*的Adaptive-K规则。
AI.result: 在57个有效单元中有55个通过提示模板多样性降低了路径相关性，开放式QA效果最强；GLS表明交换性下最优对称线性合并器为均匀权重，支持多数投票作为默认；Adaptive-K在Math、QA、NLU上保留MV@K=32准确率的96%–103%。
AI.conclusion: 路径相关性是制约多路径推理扩展性的关键上限因素，多数投票在标准SC下是自然默认；通过引入模板多样性并用少量试点路径估计相关性，可自适应选择K以在低成本下逼近大K性能。

title: Agentic Relative Camera Pose Estimation via Learned Ranking and Verification
comment: 22 pages, including 10 pages for the main body
summary: A wide range of approaches have been developed for camera pose estimation, including correspondence-based methods, end-to-end pose regression, and recent 3D geometric foundation models. Our key observation is that no single estimator is optimal for diverse challenges, such as wide baselines, lack of texture, appearance changes, and occlusions. Further analysis reveals substantial performance variation across both benchmarks and individual image pairs, with different estimators exhibiting complementary strengths. We introduce PoseAgent, an agentic framework for relative camera pose estimation that dynamically orchestrates pose estimators through learnable ranking and verification. Given an image pair, a profiling agent first extracts appearance, semantic, and geometric features relevant to pose estimation, e.g., scene type. A learned ranking agent then predicts the relative competence of multiple pose estimators given the image-pair profile. The top-ranked estimator is executed, and its predicted pose is assessed by a learned verification agent that estimates the corresponding pose error. When verification fails, PoseAgent adaptively invokes lower-ranked estimators until a candidate is accepted or the execution budget is reached. For pose verification, our verification network predicts pose errors more accurately than prior models. For pose estimation, PoseAgent improves AUC@5 degree up to 4.2% over the strongest standalone estimator on each of ARKitScenes, MegaDepth, ScanNet++, and RealEstate10K. On ARKitScenes, PoseAgent also outperforms VLM-based agents, which include a VLM ranker with the same verifier and fallback policy. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of our learned ranking and verification.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PoseAgent，一个通过可学习排序与验证机制动态调度多个位姿估计器的智能体框架，在多个基准上取得一致的精度提升。
AI.motivation: 现有相机位姿估计方法（基于对应、端到端回归、3D 几何基础模型）各有优劣，没有单一估计器能在宽基线、弱纹理、外观变化、遮挡等多样挑战下都表现最优；且不同估计器在基准和单个图像对层面性能差异大、优势互补。
AI.method: PoseAgent 采用智能体式框架：先用 profiling agent 提取与位姿估计相关的外观、语义、几何特征（如场景类型）；再由可学习的 ranking agent 依据图像对画像预测多个估计器的相对能力并排序；执行最高排名估计器，并由可学习的 verification agent 估计其位姿误差；若验证失败，则自适应调用更低排名的估计器，直到候选被接受或达到执行预算。
AI.result: 验证网络在位姿误差预测上比先前模型更准确；在 ARKitScenes、MegaDepth、ScanNet++、RealEstate10K 上，PoseAgent 相比每个数据集上最强的单一估计器将 AUC@5° 最多提升 4.2%；在 ARKitScenes 上还优于包含相同验证器与回退策略的 VLM 排序器基线。
AI.conclusion: 结果证明了可学习排序与验证机制的有效性，说明动态编排互补的位姿估计器是应对多样挑战的可行方向。

title: Understanding Off- vs On-Policy Distillation: A Tale of Distinct Training Objectives
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) learns from teacher feedback on student-generated responses and has shown promise in reducing forgetting relative to supervised fine-tuning (SFT). However, its benefits and fragility remain incompletely understood. We study sequential distillation from multiple teachers, where the student minimizes its average divergence from the teachers.
