A fixed, dataset-agnostic normality prompt provides a window-independent semantic reference for aligning normal representations and estimating normality discrepancy. At inference, masking each temporal patch once yields timestamp-level reconstruction evidence, conditionally modulated by discrepancy from a separate unmasked view. Across four benchmarks, LEARN-TS achieves the highest mean performance in 13 of 16 dataset-metric comparisons. Controlled ablations examine observation conditioning, joint normality alignment and scoring, and reference content, showing dataset-dependent ranking benefits and modest average gains from semantic over random references.

AI.tldr: 提出 LEARN-TS，用冻结语言模型构建两种角色分离的语义表示，在无需时间配对外部文本的情况下增强多元时间序列异常检测的掩码重构。
AI.motivation: 多元时间序列异常检测中，重构误差难以可靠区分异常与良性偏差；语言语义可提供互补上下文，但现有多模态方法依赖难以稳定获取、且标准基准不提供的时间配对文本信息。
AI.method: 使用冻结语言模型构建两种角色分离的语义表示：一是窗口特定观测语义，编码时间与跨变量上下文但不含精确数值，用于引导通道共享的 patch 掩码重构；二是固定的、与数据集无关的正态性提示，作为窗口无关的语义参考，用于对齐正常表示并估计正态性偏差。推理时对每个时间 patch 各掩码一次以得到时间戳级重构证据，并由独立未掩码视图的偏差条件调制。
AI.result: 在四个基准上，LEARN-TS 在 16 项数据集-指标比较中的 13 项取得最高平均性能。控制消融考察了观测条件化、联合正态性对齐与打分以及参考内容，显示排序收益依赖数据集，语义参考相对随机参考带来适度平均提升。
AI.conclusion: 语言语义可作为多元时间序列异常检测的互补参考，通过角色分离的语义表示与正态性引导，在无需时间配对文本的条件下提升重构式检测效果，但收益幅度与数据集相关。

title: Targeted Retrieval, Compact Representations: How CoT Reasoning Improves Long-Context Counting
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have been rapidly improving in long-context tasks, powered by Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning. However, the internal mechanisms underlying this improvement remain unclear. We investigate these mechanisms through a needle-in-a-haystack (NIAH) counting task, where an LLM is asked to count the number of records dispersed in a long text. Across twelve model comparison groups, Thinking (or reasoning) improves counting accuracy over Non-thinking, with pronounced gains at larger counts. This motivates our mechanistic analysis, which identifies two contrasting mechanisms: (i) broad retrieval, where Non-thinking models broadly attend to multiple needles; (ii) targeted retrieval, where Thinking models use enumeration in CoT traces to successively retrieve needles. Targeted retrieval concentrates attention on individual needles and is accompanied by more compact internal representations. Moreover, causal intervention analysis suggests that Thinking models use the CoT trace to maintain and update an internal counter as needles are successively retrieved, even without explicit numbering. In small controlled experiments, both retrieval mechanisms and counter states emerge under standard autoregressive training. Together, our results connect long-context retrieval with representation geometry of counting, supporting a state-tracking account of CoT reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文通过"大海捞针计数"任务揭示了思维链(CoT)提升长上下文能力的内部机制：非思考模型采用广泛检索，思考模型采用定向检索并借助CoT轨迹维护内部计数器。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在长上下文任务上借助思维链(CoT)推理快速进步，但其内部机制尚不清楚。作者希望通过一个可控的计数任务来剖析Thinking与Non-thinking的差异所在。
AI.method: 设计了needle-in-a-haystack(NIAH)计数任务，要求模型统计长文本中分散记录的数量。构建十二个模型对比组，比较Thinking与Non-thinking的计数准确率；进而开展机制分析(注意力检索模式、内部表示几何、因果干预)以及小型自回归训练对照实验。
AI.result: Thinking普遍比Non-thinking更准确，且计数数量越大优势越明显。机制上识别出两种对比模式：Non-thinking为"广泛检索"，注意力分散在多个针上；Thinking为"定向检索"，通过CoT中的枚举逐一检索针，注意力集中于单个针且内部表示更紧凑。因果干预显示Thinking模型利用CoT轨迹维护并更新内部计数器(即便无显式编号)。对照实验中两种检索机制与计数器状态在标准自回归训练下即可涌现。
AI.conclusion: 长上下文检索与计数的表示几何之间存在联系，支持CoT推理的"状态追踪"解释：CoT轨迹充当外部存储，帮助模型维护内部计数状态。

title: On the Relaxation of Conditional Independence Assumption for Image Segmentation
summary: In semantic segmentation, a recent line of RankSEG methods directly optimizes Dice/IoU scores at inference time, improving alignment with evaluation metrics without modifying model training. Despite its theoretical and empirical success, RankSEG relies on the restrictive Conditional Independence Assumption (CIA), which ignores crucial label correlations and therefore degrades performance in ambiguous or low-contrast scenarios. However, accounting for full label dependence is computationally prohibitive, requiring $\mathcal{O}(d^3)$ time. To address this, we replace the CIA with a Spatially Localized Dependence (SLD) structure that captures local label correlations while keeping the dependence model tractable. We further overcome the remaining computational bottleneck via a Reciprocal Moment Approximation coupled with a novel fixed-point optimization strategy that eliminates exhaustive search. The proposed algorithm achieves a highly practical $\mathcal{O}(d \log d)$ complexity and consistently outperforms conventional argmax and CIA-based RankSEG across diverse segmentation benchmarks. Improvements are significant in low-contrast or small-object scenarios, where label dependence offers valuable signals complementary to image information for accurate segmentation. The code of experiments is available at https://github.com/ZixunWang/RankSEG-DEP.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RankSEG-DEP，用空间局部依赖（SLD）替代条件独立假设，结合倒数矩近似与不动点优化，将复杂度降至 O(d log d)，在语义分割中优于 argmax 与 CIA-based RankSEG，尤其提升低对比度与小目标场景表现。
AI.motivation: RankSEG 在推理时直接优化 Dice/IoU，无需改动训练，效果良好，但其依赖条件独立假设（CIA），忽略了关键标签相关性，在模糊或低对比度场景下性能下降；而完整建模标签依赖又需要 O(d^3) 时间，计算代价过高。
AI.method: 用空间局部依赖（SLD）结构替代 CIA，捕捉局部标签相关性同时保持依赖模型可处理；再通过倒数矩近似（Reciprocal Moment Approximation）结合新颖的不动点优化策略，消除穷举搜索，使算法达到 O(d log d) 的实际复杂度。
AI.result: 所提算法在多种分割基准上持续优于传统 argmax 与基于 CIA 的 RankSEG；在低对比度或小目标场景中提升显著，此时标签依赖提供了与图像信息互补的有效信号。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入空间局部标签依赖并以高效近似与不动点优化求解，可在可接受复杂度下改进 RankSEG 的分割表现，代码已开源。

title: Evaluating Persistent Calibration under Evolving Model Knowledge
summary: As AI systems move from static repositories to agents that are capable of continual adaptation and learning, maintaining their trustworthiness means equipping the models backing them with the ability to produce confidence estimates that dynamically reflect their changing skills and knowledge. We introduce the problem of persistent calibration, which requires a confidence estimator to faithfully reflect the knowledge contained in a model as that knowledge changes, without recurring supervision. We operationalize this by examining persistent calibration across checkpoints of open models, asking whether confidence estimators trained on earlier checkpoints can generalize to later ones. Specifically, we aim to shed light on whether confidence is dependent on knowledge, a question with implications for the reliability of confidence estimates. To measure this relationship, we define and evaluate calibration on knowledge contrast sets: subsets containing questions that one checkpoint answers correctly and another checkpoint answers incorrectly, reflecting a change in knowledge. We show that both inference-time and fine-tuning methods fall short on contrast-set calibration compared to oracle methods trained on future checkpoints, even for methods that are well-calibrated on the full dataset. We provide evidence for the hypothesis that persistent calibration is challenging because there is a vast space of possible confidence functions that are well-calibrated on a given checkpoint, out of which only some rely on meta-knowledge features that would generalize to other checkpoints. Towards improving contrast-set calibration, we show that multi-checkpoint training helps, suggesting an avenue for identifying confidence features that remain robust across changing knowledge.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"持久校准"问题：要求模型的置信度估计能在知识变化时动态反映其当前知识，且无需持续监督。通过在模型不同检查点上评估校准，尤其是知识对比集上的表现，发现现有推理时和微调方法均不如基于未来检查点的oracle方法，并提出多检查点训练可改善该问题。
AI.motivation: 随着AI系统从静态知识库转向能够持续适应和学习的智能体，维持其可信度需要模型具备随技能和知识变化而动态调整的置信度估计能力。作者希望探究置信度是否依赖于知识，这一问题对置信度估计的可靠性具有重要意义。
AI.method: 作者提出"持久校准"问题，通过考察开放模型不同检查点间的校准来操作化该问题，即测试在早期检查点上训练的置信度估计器能否泛化到后期检查点。为此定义了"知识对比集"：包含一个检查点答对而另一个检查点答错的子集，用以反映知识变化，并在此上评估校准。
AI.result: 实验表明，无论推理时方法还是微调方法，在对比集校准上均不如基于未来检查点的oracle方法，即使这些方法在完整数据集上校准良好。作者提出了一个假设：持久校准之所以困难，是因为在给定检查点上存在大量能良好校准的置信度函数空间，其中只有部分依赖于可泛化到其他检查点的元知识特征。此外，多检查点训练有助于改善对比集校准。
AI.conclusion: 持久校准在现有方法下仍具挑战性，根源在于良好校准的置信度函数空间庞大而泛化性有限；多检查点训练为识别在知识变化中保持稳健的置信度特征提供了可行方向。

title: Alleviating Hallucination in Reasoning Tasks with Training-Free Uncertainty-Guided Steering
summary: Recent work on hallucination detection in large language models has shown that, for a fixed pre-trained model and reasoning task, it is possible to estimate the model's confidence in the correctness of its outputs. Such uncertainty estimates have primarily been used to improve truthfulness by detecting or filtering confabulations. In this work, we ask whether these signals can instead be used more proactively to directly improve the accuracy of model-generated answers. We propose USteer, a simple, training-free steering mechanism that adjusts a model's layer-wise activations during inference using the gradient of a confidence measure with respect to the activations. This procedure nudges generation toward outputs with lower uncertainty at inference time, without modifying model parameters or requiring additional supervision. We show that this approach consistently reduces hallucination across a range of tasks, demonstrating that confidence signals can be leveraged not only for detection, but also for effective inference-time control of model behavior.

AI.tldr: 提出USteer，一种免训练的推理时激活引导机制，利用置信度对激活的梯度调整模型各层激活，主动降低生成内容的不确定性，从而减少幻觉。
AI.motivation: 现有幻觉检测工作虽能估计模型对输出正确性的置信度，但这些不确定性信号主要用于检测或过滤虚构内容，未被主动用于直接提升模型生成答案的准确性。
AI.method: USteer是一种简单、免训练的引导机制。在推理时，通过计算置信度度量相对于激活的梯度，对模型逐层激活进行调整，促使生成朝低不确定性方向偏移；无需修改模型参数，也不需要额外监督。
AI.result: 在多种任务上，该方法一致地降低了幻觉，表明置信度信号可有效用于推理时对模型行为的控制。
AI.conclusion: 置信度信号不仅能用于幻觉检测，还能被主动用于推理时的模型行为引导，从而直接提升生成答案的准确性。

title: Beyond Spatial-Domain Supervision: A Relation Constrained Space for Multi-Modal Image Fusion
summary: Multi-modal image fusion (MMIF) aims to form a single image by integrating shared information, preserving complementary cues, and coordinating cross-modal conflicts across modalities. However, due to the absence of ground-truth fused images, existing MMIF supervision commonly uses spatial-domain sources or gradient variants as surrogate ground truth, making the supervision mechanism inherently misaligned with the goal of MMIF and causing pixel-level compromise or modality bias. To address this, we propose a relation-constrained supervision paradigm that moves fusion supervision from the spatial domain to a learned relation space. Rather than relying solely on direct source approximation, we further leverage frozen pretrained representation models as information providers and design a learnable feature adapter to align heterogeneous DINO and CLIP features into a unified supervision space. The adapter infers three relation parameters, namely sharedness, dominance, and coordination radius, which define three losses corresponding to the MMIF's goal. To make this space reliable, we devise a self-supervised contrastive ranking objective tailored to the adapter and couple it with the fusion network through alternating optimization. Extensive experiments show that the proposed supervision space yields significant gains regardless of which mainstream backbone the fusion network adopts, offering a supervision paradigm better aligned with the goal of MMIF. Code: github.com/GMY628/RCS-Fusion.

AI.tldr: 本文提出关系约束监督范式（RCS-Fusion），将多模态图像融合的监督从空间域转移到可学习的关系空间，利用冻结的DINO与CLIP特征并通过可学习适配器推断共享性、主导性与协调半径三类关系参数，构建三种损失，并设计自监督对比排序目标与交替优化，在多种主流骨干网络上均取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 多模态图像融合（MMIF）缺乏真值融合图像，现有监督通常以空间域源图像或其梯度变体作为替代真值，这与MMIF的目标本质不符，容易导致像素级折中或模态偏置。因此需要一个与MMIF目标更一致的监督机制。
AI.method: 提出关系约束监督范式：不再仅依赖对源图像的直接逼近，而是利用冻结的预训练表示模型（DINO与CLIP）作为信息提供者，设计可学习特征适配器将异质特征对齐到统一监督空间。适配器推断三个关系参数——共享性（sharedness）、主导性（dominance）与协调半径（coordination radius），并据此定义三种损失，对应MMIF的融合目标。为使该空间可靠，设计了针对适配器的自监督对比排序目标，并与融合网络通过交替优化耦合。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，所提出的监督空间无论融合网络采用哪种主流骨干，都能带来显著性能提升，展现出与MMIF目标更好对齐的监督范式。代码开源：github.com/GMY628/RCS-Fusion。
AI.conclusion: 将融合监督从空间域迁移到学习到的关系空间，是一种与MMIF目标更好对齐的监督范式，可即插即用地提升多种主流融合骨干的性能。

title: Explicit Trajectory Diversity for RL-Based Post-Training of LLM Agents
summary: LLM agents often admit multiple high-quality solutions to the same task, differing in reasoning structure, tool-use pattern, or interaction trajectory. Yet existing notions of diversity in LLM post-training are mostly implicit, arising from general stochasticity and regularization mechanisms rather than explicitly targeting task-relevant behavioral variation. While such implicit diversity can be useful, it does not directly specify which forms of behavioral variation should be encouraged for a given task. In this work, we study explicit trajectory diversity in RL-based post-training for LLMs. Our key idea is to define diversity through user-specified, task-specific trajectory descriptors, which map each sampled trajectory to an interpretable behavioral representation, and then measure diversity as a set-level functional over the resulting descriptor matrix. Building on this formulation, we introduce Trajectory-guided Joint Policy Optimization(TJPO), a single-policy framework that optimizes explicit diversity over sampled trajectory groups, avoiding the need for population-based policy training, and instantiate it within group-based policy optimization through trajectory-level learning signals. This design makes the diversity objective both interpretable and controllable. Experiments on Sokoban and ALFWorld show that TJPO improves task-specific trajectory diversity while maintaining competitive task performance. Descriptor and trajectory analyses show that the learned variation follows the specified behavioral dimensions and includes distinct successful strategies. Extra experiment results suggest that explicitly shaping trajectory diversity can help LLM agents satisfy user requirements and remain effective when task conditions change.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"显式轨迹多样性"的RL后训练方法，通过用户指定的任务相关轨迹描述符定义多样性，并设计TJPO单策略框架实现可解释、可控的多样性优化，在Sokoban与ALFWorld上兼顾多样性与任务性能。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM后训练中的多样性多为隐式的，来自随机性与正则化机制，而非针对任务本身的行为差异。这种隐式多样性无法明确指定在特定任务中应鼓励哪些行为变化形式，因此需要显式、可指定、可解释的多样性定义与优化手段。
AI.method: 核心思想是用用户指定的、任务特定的轨迹描述符来定义多样性：将每条采样轨迹映射为可解释的行为表示，并在描述符矩阵上以集合级泛函度量多样性。基于此提出TJPO（Trajectory-guided Joint Policy Optimization），一个单策略框架，在采样的轨迹组上优化显式多样性，无需基于群体的策略训练，并通过轨迹级学习信号将其嵌入基于组的策略优化中。
AI.result: 在Sokoban和ALFWorld上的实验表明，TJPO在保持有竞争力任务性能的同时提升了任务特定的轨迹多样性。描述符与轨迹分析显示，学习到的行为变化沿指定的行为维度展开，并包含多种不同的成功策略。额外实验结果提示，显式塑造轨迹多样性有助于LLM智能体满足用户需求，并在任务条件变化时保持有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过用户指定的轨迹描述符显式定义并优化多样性，可使LLM后训练中的多样性目标兼具可解释性与可控性；TJPO以单策略、组级优化的方式实现了这一目标，且不牺牲任务表现，并有望提升智能体对用户需求与任务变化的适应能力。

title: When Order Matters: First-Speaker Bias and Mitigation through Personality in Sequential Multi-Agent Debate
summary: Multi-agent debate (MAD) is often used to improve large language model (LLM) reasoning, but sequential debate is rarely a neutral aggregator of agents' opinions. We show that sequential MAD suffers from a pronounced first-speaker bias: agents disproportionately shape the final answer when they speak first. As a result, placing a stronger model after weaker ones can substantially offset its reasoning advantage. We then focus on the disadvantaged strong-agent-last setting and ask whether personality prompting can mitigate this imbalance. Drawing on the Big Five model, we study agreeableness and extraversion as behavioral interventions applied to either the strong or weak side. We find that their effects are trait-specific. Influence consistently shifts in the direction of lower agreeableness, and assigning low agreeableness to the stronger agent helps restore its lost influence and improves final accuracy. Extraversion, by contrast, produces less systematic changes in influence and accuracy, with its clearest effect appearing in agents' verbosity. These findings show that effective MAD design depends not only on model capability, but also on how speaking order and induced interaction behavior shape the debate process.

AI.tldr: 顺序多智能体辩论（MAD）存在明显的"先发言者偏差"，首位发言的智能体对最终答案影响过大，导致强模型后发言时优势被削弱；通过大五人格中的低宜人性提示可部分恢复强模型的影响力并提升准确率，而外向性影响较不系统。
AI.motivation: 多智能体辩论常被用于提升大语言模型推理能力，但顺序辩论并非对智能体观点的中立聚合。作者希望揭示其固有的偏差机制，并探索在不改变模型能力前提下，通过行为干预（人格提示）来缓解强弱智能体间的影响力失衡。
AI.method: 首先分析顺序MAD中的先发言者偏差及其对强弱模型排序效应的影响；随后聚焦"强模型后发言"这一不利场景，基于大五人格模型，将宜人性（agreeableness）和外向性（extraversion）作为行为干预，分别施加于强或弱一方，考察其对影响力分配和最终准确率的影响。
AI.result: 影响力始终朝低宜人性方向转移；给强智能体赋予低宜人性有助于恢复其失去的影响力并提高最终准确率。外向性对影响力的改变较不系统，其最明显的作用体现在智能体的语言冗长度上。
AI.conclusion: 有效的MAD设计不仅取决于模型能力，还取决于发言顺序与所诱导的交互行为如何塑造辩论过程；人格提示可作为调节影响力分配的一种可行手段。

title: PARK: Accurate Block Retrieval for Sparse Attention in Video Diffusion Transformers
summary: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have become a dominant architecture for video generation, but their efficiency is limited by the quadratic complexity of full attention. Sparse attention reduces this cost by retrieving important blocks and computing attention only within them, but inaccurate retrieval can either degrade generation quality or yield unnecessary computation. We identify two retrieval mismatches in methods that retrieve blocks using the averaged representations of query and key blocks: (i) query-side aggregation mismatch, where averaging queries before Softmax fails to preserve their individual attention preferences, and (ii) key-side clustering metric mismatch, where standard Euclidean clustering in the original key space can group keys with dissimilar QK scores under the current query, so their average representation may not accurately represent how the current query scores individual keys. These mismatches can lead to inaccurate block retrieval. To address these mismatches, we propose PARK, a training-free sparse attention method for accurate block retrieval. PARK retains every original query, independently normalizes its attention over key blocks, and then averages these distributions within each query block. It also uses information from the current queries to transform keys before clustering, so that keys receiving similar QK scores are grouped together. A fused GPU kernel further reduces the overhead of block retrieval. Experiments on HunyuanVideo and Wan demonstrate that PARK improves block retrieval accuracy and preserves generation quality while accelerating inference, achieving the best quality-efficiency trade-off among the compared sparse attention methods.

AI.tldr: PARK是一种免训练稀疏注意力方法，通过修正查询端聚合和键端聚类的不匹配，实现精确的块检索，在视频生成中兼顾质量与效率。
AI.motivation: 扩散Transformer（DiTs）已成为视频生成的主流架构，但全注意力的二次复杂度限制了效率。稀疏注意力通过检索重要块并在其中计算注意力来降低成本，然而检索不准确会导致生成质量下降或产生不必要的计算。作者发现使用查询和键块的平均表示进行检索时存在两种不匹配问题。
AI.method: PARK是一种免训练的稀疏注意力方法。针对查询端聚合不匹配（Softmax前对查询取平均无法保留各自的注意力偏好）和键端聚类度量不匹配（原始键空间中的欧氏聚类可能将当前查询下QK分数不同的键分到一组），PARK保留每个原始查询，独立地对其在键块上的注意力进行归一化，然后在每个查询块内对这些分布取平均；同时利用当前查询信息在聚类前对键进行变换，使获得相似QK分数的键被分到一组。此外还设计了融合GPU内核以降低块检索开销。
AI.result: 在HunyuanVideo和Wan上的实验表明，PARK提升了块检索准确性，在加速推理的同时保持了生成质量，在所比较的稀疏注意力方法中实现了最佳的质量-效率权衡。
AI.conclusion: PARK通过修正查询端聚合和键端聚类两种检索不匹配，实现精确的块检索，是一种免训练的稀疏注意力方法，能够在视频生成中有效平衡质量与效率。

title: Blackboard Intelligence Can Surpass Autoregressive on Globally Constrained Problems
summary: Next-token prediction has driven remarkable progress in large language models, yet a growing body of evidence suggests that they can struggle on problems governed by complex global constraints. In this work, we focus on this regime and ask whether some of these limitations arise from the inference interface induced by next-token prediction itself. We study this question through blackboard intelligence: an inference-time perspective in which a model works on a fixed, revisable canvas and searches over candidate solution states rather than committing to a causal, left-to-right trajectory. We instantiate this idea with diffusion language models, whose any-order prediction interface naturally exposes predictions over partially filled solution states. Our key observation is that mean confidence, a simple model-internal quantity available from the standard masked diffusion objective, provides a useful proxy for global coherence and can guide inference-time search and revision. Empirically, across ZebraLogic, Nurse Rostering, and Job-Shop Scheduling, Blackboard consistently improves inference while holding the fine-tuned LLaDA-8B-Instruct checkpoint fixed and substantially outperforms same-scale autoregressive baselines, reaching 90.4% accuracy on ZebraLogic-Hard, 76.4% exact feasibility on Nurse Rostering, and 80.2% optimality on JSSP. Stronger autoregressive search and refinement also fail to close the gap on ZebraLogic-Hard, while Blackboard surpasses tested frontier LLMs there and on JSSP despite their substantially greater scale and strong test-time reasoning. We open-source our codebase at https://github.com/jwoosang1/blackboard-intelligence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"黑板智能"（Blackboard Intelligence）推理范式，利用扩散语言模型的任意顺序预测接口在可修订画布上搜索求解状态，以平均置信度引导推理时搜索与修正，在多个全局约束任务上超越同规模自回归基线及前沿大模型。
AI.motivation: 下一词预测虽推动大语言模型进步，但在受复杂全局约束支配的问题上表现不佳。作者探究这类局限是否部分源于下一词预测本身所诱导的推理接口（因果、从左到右的固定轨迹）。
AI.method: 提出"黑板智能"推理时视角：模型在固定、可修订的画布上工作，搜索候选解状态而非承诺因果左到右轨迹。用扩散语言模型实例化，其任意顺序预测接口天然暴露部分填充解状态上的预测；并利用掩码扩散目标可直接获取的模型内部量"平均置信度"作为全局连贯性的代理，指导推理时搜索与修正。
AI.result: 在 ZebraLogic、Nurse Rostering、Job-Shop Scheduling 上，保持 LLaDA-8B-Instruct 微调检查点不变，Blackboard 持续提升推理表现，大幅超越同规模自回归基线：ZebraLogic-Hard 达 90.4% 准确率，Nurse Rostering 达 76.4% 精确可行性，JSSP 达 80.2% 最优性。更强的自回归搜索与精化在 ZebraLogic-Hard 上仍无法弥合差距，而 Blackboard 在该任务和 JSSP 上超越了所测试的前沿大模型，尽管后者规模更大且测试时推理更强。
AI.conclusion: 下一词预测的推理接口本身是全局约束任务局限的来源之一；通过扩散语言模型的任意顺序预测与基于平均置信度的黑板式搜索修正，可在固定检查点下显著提升推理能力，并超越更大规模的前沿模型。代码已开源。

title: RealWorldShop: Benchmarking and Improving Conversational Shopping Agents in Real-World E-commerce
summary: Large language models are reshaping ecommerce from static recommenders into interactive shopping assistants, yet real-world shopping requires session-level decision support: users reveal and revise constraints, coordinate multiple goals, and expect product-grounded recommendations over a full conversation. Existing benchmarks are mostly outcome-oriented or execution-oriented, leaving this evolving decision process under-evaluated. We introduce REALWORLDSHOP, a benchmark built on 3.28M grounded products, structured shopping episodes, a profile-grounded and actioncontrolled user simulator, and role-play evaluation. Our analysis shows that current systems produce locally plausible responses but struggle with state tracking, constraint updating, and grounded convergence, especially under ambiguous intent, bundle, and multi-intent scenarios. We further propose REALSHOP_AGENT, an executable session-control framework with explicit state management, shopping-flow control, catalog-grounded retrieval, and runtime guards. Experiments show that REALSHOP_AGENT consistently outperforms strong baselines on REALWORLDSHOP.

AI.tldr: 本文提出REALWORLDSHOP基准和REALSHOP_AGENT框架，用于评估和改进大语言模型在真实购物会话中的会话级决策支持能力。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型正将电商从静态推荐器转变为交互式购物助手，但真实购物需要会话级决策支持：用户会逐步揭示和修改约束、协调多目标，并期望在整个对话中获得基于产品的推荐。现有基准多为结果导向或执行导向，未能充分评估这一动态决策过程。
AI.method: 构建REALWORLDSHOP基准，基于328万个真实商品、结构化购物回合、基于用户画像且动作可控的用户模拟器以及角色扮演评估。同时提出REALSHOP_AGENT——一个可执行的会话控制框架，包含显式状态管理、购物流程控制、基于目录的检索和运行时防护。
AI.result: 分析显示，当前系统能产生局部合理的回复，但在状态跟踪、约束更新和基于产品的收敛方面表现不佳，尤其在意图模糊、捆绑销售和多意图场景下更为明显。实验表明，REALSHOP_AGENT在REALWORLDSHOP上持续优于强基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 会话级决策支持是当前大语言模型购物助手的关键短板，REALWORLDSHOP和REALSHOP_AGENT为评估和提升该能力提供了有效的基准与框架。

title: Mitigating Object Hallucination in Large Vision-Language Models via False Discovery Controlled Visual Data Splitting
summary: Multiple object hallucination, where large vision-language models (LVLMs) generate objects not supported by the visual input, is a persistent challenge caused by visual uncertainty during decoding. Existing methods reduce hallucinations using contrastive signals, but they rely on heuristics and lack principled control of false positives at the image level. To address this, we propose False Discovery Rate-COntRol of HALlucination (CORAL), a training-free framework that models visual uncertainty using an uncertainty-aware visual data splitting strategy and leverages mirror statistics to quantify visual contrast during decoding. By computing mirror statistics from paired, symmetrically perturbed visual inputs, CORAL estimates spurious object predictions and sets a data-driven threshold to control the expected fraction of false discoveries per image, suppressing hallucinations while retaining high power for truly grounded objects. The framework is flexible, supports multiple LVLMs, and mitigates hallucinations without retraining or supervision. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks with several evaluation metrics demonstrate that CORAL consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, providing more reliable and robust hallucination control. Code is available at: https://changliu1993-cl.github.io/CORAL/

AI.tldr: 提出无需训练的CORAL框架，通过镜像统计量化视觉不确定性，在图像级别控制假发现率以抑制LVLM的物体幻觉。
AI.motivation: 大型视觉语言模型在解码时因视觉不确定性会产生物体幻觉，即生成视觉输入不支持的物体。现有基于对比信号的方法依赖启发式规则，缺乏在图像层面对假阳性的原则性控制。
AI.method: CORAL采用不确定性感知的视觉数据划分策略来建模视觉不确定性，利用镜像统计量在解码时量化视觉对比。通过对成对对称扰动的视觉输入计算镜像统计量，估计虚假物体预测，并设定数据驱动阈值，控制每张图像期望的假发现比例。
AI.result: 在多个基准和多种评估指标上的大量实验表明，CORAL持续优于现有最先进方法，提供更可靠、鲁棒的幻觉控制，同时保持对真实物体预测的高检验力。
AI.conclusion: CORAL是一个灵活、无需重训练或监督的框架，支持多种LVLM，能有效抑制幻觉，并在多个基准上取得领先性能。

title: Learning Chaos Without Seeing Chaos: Extrapolation of Global Dynamics in Autoregressive Transformers
summary: Autoregressive models are trained to predict a system's behavior one step at a time, and recursive generation allows the learned dynamics to unfold over long horizons. To what extent can such dynamics learned from local observations recover broader organization of an underlying system that was only partially observed during training? Here we study small autoregressive transformers trained from scratch on trajectories sampled from restricted parameter regimes of several non-linear dynamical systems, including logistic and sine maps, the Lorenz system, and the generalized Hopf system, with control parameters and state trajectories represented as sequences of continuous tokens. Under closed-loop evaluation at parameters far outside the training distribution, the models can recover self-similar period-doubling cascades, chaotic dynamics, and attractor structures with remarkable visual and numerical fidelity. For the logistic map, a transformer reproduces successive period doublings up to period 128, yielding a finite-order scaling ratio of 4.6687, matching the Feigenbaum constant to within $5\times10^{-4}$. We further investigate how these structures emerge over the course of training, and reveal with causal interventions how control-parameter information is processed through attention into state prediction and shapes the resulting closed-loop dynamics. These results suggest that a surprisingly narrow window into a system's local behavior may suffice for autoregressive transformers to generalize to its unseen global dynamical organization.

AI.tldr: 仅用局部参数区间的轨迹训练小型自回归Transformer，在闭环外推评估中即可恢复未见过的全局动力学结构（周期倍增、混沌、吸引子），并在logistic映射上以5×10⁻⁴精度复现Feigenbaum常数。
AI.motivation: 自回归模型逐步预测系统行为，递归生成可让学到的动力学在长时间尺度上展开。核心疑问是：仅从训练时部分观测到的局部观测中学习到的动力学，能在多大程度上恢复底层系统的更广泛组织（全局动力学结构）。
AI.method: 从头训练小型自回归Transformer，数据为若干非线性动力系统（logistic映射、sine映射、Lorenz系统、广义Hopf系统）在受限参数区间采样的轨迹；控制参数与状态轨迹均表示为连续token序列。在训练分布之外的参数上进行闭环评估，并考察这些结构在训练过程中的涌现，同时用因果干预揭示控制参数信息如何经注意力进入状态预测并塑造闭环动力学。
AI.result: 在远超出训练分布的参数下闭环评估时，模型能高保真地恢复自相似周期倍增级联、混沌动力学与吸引子结构（视觉与数值上均如此）。logistic映射上，Transformer复现了直到周期128的连续周期倍增，得到有限阶标度比4.6687，与Feigenbaum常数误差在5×10⁻⁴以内。
AI.conclusion: 系统局部行为的一个相当狭窄的观测窗口，可能就足以让自回归Transformer泛化到其未见的全局动力学组织；并揭示了控制参数信息经注意力被处理成状态预测、进而塑造闭环动力学的机制。

title: C-STRIDE: An Observation-Driven AI Digital Twin for Predicting Basin-Wide Flood Fields from Sparse Stream-Gauge Histories
summary: Emergency managers need to know where floodwater is, how deep it is, and how it will change over the coming hours across an entire river basin. During a flood, however, real-time measurements come from only a handful of stream gauges, and high-resolution hydrodynamic models are too costly to rerun each time new data arrive or to run as large ensembles. We present C-STRIDE, an observation-driven AI digital twin that turns short records from a few stream gauges, together with terrain and rainfall, into basin-wide maps of water depth and extends these predictions up to a day ahead. It is trained on simulations from a calibrated two-dimensional hydrodynamic model and needs no separate data-assimilation step. In the Des Plaines River basin near Chicago, six gauges inform predictions over 4.2 million 30-m grid cells. Terrain improves the predictions most, rainfall keeps errors from growing over longer horizons, and together they reduce errors by about 40% compared with gauge records alone. When future rainfall is known, errors remain near 15% one day ahead, compared with nearly 40% without rainfall. Given real instead of simulated gauge records, the model shifts its predictions toward the observed hydrographs at three of six gauges without retraining, and it runs about 150 times faster than the hydrodynamic model. These results show how sparse gauges, terrain, and rainfall can be combined into fast, continuously updated flood predictions, a step toward operational flood digital twins that still requires testing with real-time data and rainfall forecasts.

AI.tldr: 提出 C-STRIDE，一种观测驱动的 AI 洪水数字孪生，用少数水位站的短记录结合地形与降雨，生成全流域水深图并预测未来一天，速度比二维水动力模型快约150倍。
AI.motivation: 洪水应急管理需要掌握整个流域的水淹范围、水深及其未来数小时变化，但洪水中实时观测仅来自少数水位站，而高分辨率水动力模型重跑或做大集合模拟成本过高。
AI.method: C-STRIDE 由校准过的二维水动力模型模拟结果训练，无需单独的数据同化步骤；输入为少数水位站短序列、地形和降雨，直接输出流域尺度水深图并延伸至未来一天。在芝加哥附近 Des Plaines 河流域，6 个水位站支撑 420 万个 30 米网格单元的预测。
AI.result: 地形对预测提升最大，降雨可抑制长预见期误差增长，二者结合相比仅用站记录降低约40%误差；已知未来降雨时一天预见期误差约15%，无降雨时接近40%。使用真实而非模拟站记录时，模型无需重训练即可在6站中的3站向观测流量过程线靠拢，运行速度约为水动力模型的150倍。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏水位站、地形与降雨可组合成快速、持续更新的洪水预测，是迈向业务化洪水数字孪生的一步，但仍需用实时数据与降雨预报进一步检验。

title: MeshOctave generates meshes via cascading resolution transitions
summary: Generating compact, artist-style meshes with explicit topology typically relies on autoregressive models which incur prohibitive sequential per-token costs, or continuous flow models that depend on heuristic connectivity decoders. Next-scale generation paradigms offer a compelling alternative by enabling parallel intra-scale token prediction and coarse-to-fine refinement from global structure to local topology; yet, existing methods derive hierarchical scales via progressive mesh simplification and invert them sequentially. This eliminates intra-scale parallelism and scales generation steps linearly with face count. In this paper, we propose MeshOctave, which instead defines scale through dyadic spatial grid resolutions, framing coarsening as a deterministic collapse that merges vertices sharing a voxel cell and inherits connectivity. Its inverse operation, split-and-rewire, determines which octant sub-vertices are instantiated for each coarse face and resolves local connectivity using discrete structural tokens. These per-face operations require no serialization, each scale transition is modeled as an unordered set that adds one bit of coordinate precision, naturally supporting dynamic-length meshes and adaptive resolution refinement. We construct a scale-conditioned masked-uniform discrete diffusion model to learn split-and-rewire operation from resolution collapse hierarchies. MeshOctave outperforms strong baselines in geometric fidelity and topological validity by a non-trivial margin, while supporting adaptive resolution refinement and extending naturally to mesh subdivision tasks.

AI.tldr: MeshOctave 提出以二进空间网格分辨率定义尺度，将网格粗化视为确定性的体素合并，并用 split-and-rewire 逆操作实现并行、无序的逐面生成，配合尺度条件掩码均匀离散扩散模型，在几何保真度和拓扑有效性上显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: 现有生成紧凑、艺术家风格且具显式拓扑的网格方法存在不足：自回归模型逐 token 串行开销高昂，连续流模型依赖启发式连通性解码器。next-scale 范式虽有前景，但现有方法通过渐进式网格简化构造层级并在逆过程中串行还原，丧失了尺度内并行性，生成步数随面数线性增长。
AI.method: MeshOctave 用二进空间网格分辨率定义尺度，将粗化建模为确定性坍缩：合并共享同一体素单元的顶点并继承连通性。其逆操作 split-and-rewire 为每个粗面确定实例化哪些八分体子顶点，并用离散结构 token 解决局部连通性。这些逐面操作无需序列化，每次尺度转换建模为无序集合，每级增加一位坐标精度，从而天然支持变长网格和自适应分辨率细化。作者构建尺度条件掩码均匀离散扩散模型，从分辨率坍缩层级中学习 split-and-rewire 操作。
AI.result: MeshOctave 在几何保真度和拓扑有效性上以显著幅度超越强基线，并支持自适应分辨率细化和自然扩展到网格细分任务。
AI.conclusion: 通过将尺度定义为二进空间网格分辨率、把粗化与逆操作设计为可并行的逐面无序集合操作，MeshOctave 克服了序列化瓶颈，实现了高效、支持自适应分辨率的显式拓扑网格生成。

title: SparLeak: Privacy Leakage from Sparse Attention in LLM Inference on Shared GPUs
summary:
Sparse attention is widely used to accelerate long-context inference in modern large language models (LLMs), but its input-dependent execution behavior introduces previously unexplored privacy risks. We identify a new GPU micro-architectural side channel, termed Sparsity-Induced Memory Access (SIMA), which arises from secret-dependent key-value cache access patterns induced by sparse attention.
  Based on this observation, we present SparLeak, a phase-aware side-channel attack that extracts SIMA traces during LLM inference and enables two practical privacy extractions: query attribute inference from prefill-phase traces and autoregressive response reconstruction from decoding-phase traces. By reconstructing approximate token-level sparsity profiles from page-level observations and applying profiling-based learning, SparLeak accurately recovers sensitive information, including user-query attributes and private LLM response content. Extensive evaluation across three LLM architectures, three sparse attention mechanisms, and three privacy-sensitive datasets shows that SparLeak achieves average attack success rates of 90.9% for attribute inference and 87.3% for response reconstruction under real-world LLM serving settings, highlighting the significance to account for SIMA leakage when deploying sparse-attention-based LLM systems. We provide anonymized SIMA traces, trained attack models, evaluation scripts, and documentation as artifacts at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Janus_artifacts/.

AI.tldr: 本文发现稀疏注意力机制引入的新型GPU微架构侧信道SIMA，并提出SparLeak攻击，可从LLM推理中提取敏感信息。
AI.motivation: 稀疏注意力广泛用于加速长上下文LLM推理，但其依赖输入的执行行为引入了此前未被探索的隐私风险。
AI.method: 识别出Sparsity-Induced Memory Access（SIMA）侧信道，源于稀疏注意力导致的、与秘密相关的键值缓存访问模式；提出分阶段感知攻击SparLeak，在预填充阶段进行查询属性推断，在解码阶段进行自回归响应重建；从页级观测重构近似token级稀疏度剖面，并结合基于画像的学习。
AI.result: 在3种LLM架构、3种稀疏注意力机制、3个隐私敏感数据集上评估，属性推断平均攻击成功率90.9%，响应重建87.3%。
AI.conclusion: 在部署基于稀疏注意力的LLM系统时必须考虑SIMA泄漏问题，作者公开了匿名化SIMA轨迹、攻击模型、评估脚本等工件。

title: Search Shapes Conclusions: Auditing Evidence Selection Bias in Deep Research Agents
summary: Deep Research agents synthesize evidence into cited reports, yet a well-cited report can still reach a misleading conclusion. Citation correctness checks whether cited sources support individual claims. It does not show whether adaptive search exposed a representative view of all documents made available for evaluation, which we call the candidate pool. Early findings redirect later queries, document choices, and stopping, so the documents an agent reads form a selective sample. Existing evaluations rarely account for this selection. We formulate the problem as adaptive evidence sampling and introduce Causal Evidence Selection Correction (CESS). CESS predicts each candidate document's evidence direction and corrects the candidate-pool average using the logged probabilities of selecting each document and reaching each search round. Shrinkage stabilizes short searches, while intervals replace point estimates when some documents cannot be sampled. We also prove that estimating the average evidence direction of a common pool differs from measuring how a change in search policy alters the evidence read. The latter requires intervention. On questions from the MS2 systematic-review benchmark, CESS reduces mean absolute error against the candidate-pool average by $9.2\%$ and reduces the estimate's change under opposing document rankings by $39.4\%$ relative to averaging the evidence scores of documents read. Across trajectories from a public Open Deep Research agent, the corresponding reductions reach $60.1\%$ and $87.2\%$. A further 4,800 trajectories under paired interventions confirm that correcting a pool estimate and measuring a policy effect are different tasks. CESS therefore audits whether the evidence direction underlying a report reflects the documents available for evaluation, while a separate intervention analysis measures the effect of search decisions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"因果证据选择校正"（CESS），用于审计深度研究智能体所读证据方向是否代表候选池中全部可用文档，并区分"估计池平均证据方向"与"衡量搜索策略干预效应"两个不同任务。
AI.motivation: 现有引用正确性检查只能判断引用来源是否支持单条主张，无法反映智能体的自适应搜索是否采样到了候选池中具有代表性的证据。由于早期发现会改变后续查询、文档选择与停止条件，智能体实际阅读的文档构成选择性样本，而现有评估很少考虑这种选择偏差。
AI.method: 作者将问题形式化为自适应证据采样，提出CESS：预测每篇候选文档的证据方向，并利用记录的各文档被选概率与进入各搜索轮次的概率，对候选池平均进行校正；用收缩估计稳定短搜索，用区间估计替代无法采样文档的点估计。同时从理论上证明估计共同候选池的平均证据方向不同于测量搜索策略变化对阅读证据的影响，后者需要干预分析。
AI.result: 在MS2系统综述基准问题上，CESS相对"直接平均已读文档证据分数"将候选池平均的绝对误差降低9.2%，在相反文档排序下估计变化降低39.4%；在公开Open Deep Research智能体的轨迹上，两项降幅分别达60.1%和87.2%。额外4,800条配对干预轨迹验证了校正池估计与衡量策略效应是不同任务。
AI.conclusion: CESS可用于审计报告背后的证据方向是否反映评估所提供文档的整体情况，而搜索决策本身的效应则需通过独立的干预分析来衡量。

title: When Integral Meets Decomposition: A Signal-Level Self-Supervised Feature Decompose Paradigm for Multi-Modal Image Fusion
summary: Multimodal image fusion (MMIF) aims to integrate complementary information from different modalities into a high-quality fused image and support downstream tasks. Recently, feature decomposition has become an important paradigm by separating source images into common and modality-specific unique features. However, existing methods lack clear supervision because ground-truth (GT) decomposition feature maps are unavailable. They usually combine multiple image-level metrics as losses, which are inherently incomplete and may conflict since each pixel couples attributes such as texture, edge, and contour. To address this, we propose a 1D signal-level self-supervised feature decomposition paradigm. Our core insight is to reformulate feature decomposition from unclear 2D image-level supervision into an integral-driven 1D signal-level optimization problem. This objective-level reformulation uses the 1D signal form to compute the integral constraint. The decomposer is optimized by the integral area between common and original signals, enabling more stable optimization with a clear optimization objective. Our model follows a two-stage SSL framework. Stage I designs dual pretext tasks for integral-driven decomposition at the signal level and structure-preserving reconstruction at the image level. Stage II fuses unique features and combines them with common features to reconstruct the fused image. Experiments on representative MMIF tasks show state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance. Code: github.com/Wangjiayu0512/SIDFusion.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种1D信号级自监督特征分解范式（SIDFusion），将原本缺乏清晰监督的2D图像级特征分解重构为积分驱动的1D信号级优化问题，并在多模态图像融合任务上取得SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态图像融合中的特征分解方法缺乏明确监督，因为不存在真实的分解特征图（GT）。它们通常以多个图像级指标组合作为损失，这类损失本质上不完整，且由于每个像素耦合了纹理、边缘、轮廓等属性，指标之间可能相互冲突。
AI.method: 提出1D信号级自监督特征分解范式，将特征分解从模糊的2D图像级监督重新表述为积分驱动的1D信号级优化问题。利用1D信号形式计算积分约束，通过公共信号与原始信号之间的积分面积来优化分解器，实现更稳定且目标明确的优化。模型采用两阶段自监督框架：第一阶段设计双重预text任务，即在信号级进行积分驱动分解、在图像级进行结构保持重建；第二阶段融合特有特征并与公共特征结合以重建融合图像。
AI.result: 在具有代表性的多模态图像融合任务上实验表明取得了SOTA性能。代码已开源：github.com/Wangjiayu0512/SIDFusion。
AI.conclusion: 通过将特征分解的监督从图像级重构为1D信号级积分优化，实现了目标清晰、优化稳定的自监督分解，为多模态图像融合提供了有效的新范式。

title: ReSCENE: Server-Side Replay for Structural Mitigation of Catastrophic Forgetting in Federated Continual Learning
summary: Federated continual learning must integrate new tasks over time without losing earlier-task knowledge. Most existing methods attach an anti-forgetting mechanism to the client-trained, server-aggregated loop of federated learning, which holds back new learning to preserve earlier knowledge and burdens resource-constrained clients. We propose ReSCENE, which structurally mitigates catastrophic forgetting by having each client upload a small condensed surrogate of its local data while the server keeps the surrogates of past tasks and trains the global model on them together with the current task surrogates. For efficient server memory, we introduce temporal herding, which selects the more recent surrogates from the pool accumulated over a task into a compressed buffer. Our study provides a theoretical analysis showing that this buffer can represent the original task data more closely than full accumulation of all surrogates. Across CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and TinyImageNet, ReSCENE achieves the strongest accuracy over seven baselines, by up to $31.1$ points of average accuracy, while requiring as little as $0.11\times$ of the client computation and up to $179\times$ less upload than the model-update baselines. ReSCENE further demonstrates its effectiveness when scaled to larger client populations and larger models while remaining efficient, which makes it a practical method for federated continual learning.

AI.tldr: ReSCENE 通过让客户端上传本地数据的压缩代理（surrogate），由服务器保存历史任务代理并与当前任务代理共同训练全局模型，从结构上缓解联邦持续学习中的灾难性遗忘，同时降低客户端计算与通信开销。
AI.motivation: 现有联邦持续学习方法多将抗遗忘机制附加在"客户端训练—服务器聚合"的循环上，为保留旧知识而抑制新学习，并给资源受限的客户端带来沉重负担。
AI.method: 提出 ReSCENE：每个客户端上传本地数据的小型压缩代理，服务器保留过去任务的代理，并用其与当前任务代理一起训练全局模型；同时提出 temporal herding，从单个任务累积的代理池中选出较新的代理存入压缩缓冲区，以节省服务器内存。
AI.result: 理论分析表明，该压缩缓冲区比累积全部代理更能代表原始任务数据；在 CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100 和 TinyImageNet 上，ReSCENE 在七种基线中取得最高准确率，平均准确率最多高出 31.1 个百分点，客户端计算量低至 0.11×，上传量比模型更新类基线最多减少 179×；在更大客户端规模和更大模型下仍保持有效与高效。
AI.conclusion: ReSCENE 是一种实用且高效的联邦持续学习方法，在大规模客户端与模型场景下依然有效。

title: Multi-LLM Collaborative Alignment via Stackelberg Games
summary: A pool of language models can collaborate and improve collectively by learning from one another's responses. These interactions depend on the instructions used during training. Existing methods typically sample instructions uniformly, even though their usefulness may change as the models improve: an instruction on which models' responses once differed in quality may later be answered equally well, while a previously difficult instruction may begin to provide a useful learning signal. We propose Stackelberg Alignment, a game-theory-inspired leader-follower framework that turns instruction selection into an adaptive curriculum. An EXP3 bandit acts as the leader, allocating a fixed sampling budget across instructions and updating its sampling distribution using a reward that combines instruction difficulty and response discriminability. The language models act as followers: they respond to the selected instructions, evaluate one another's responses, and learn from the resulting preference signals through DPO or GRPO. The framework uses Elo-style reputation-weighted peer judgment and reputation-based opponent matching to support reliable and competitive model interactions. Experiments across three heterogeneous model pools and 12 benchmarks spanning scientific discovery, reasoning, code, instruction following, and knowledge show that Stackelberg Alignment achieves the highest macro-average across three diverse model pools, outperforming the strongest training-time baseline by up to 7.4% and the best static inference baseline by 12-25%. Analysis confirms that the adaptive leader concentrates duels on the most informative instructions, and ablations show that both reputation-weighted judgment and reputation-based matching improve the effectiveness of multi-LLM evolution.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Stackelberg Alignment 框架，将指令选择建模为领导者-跟随者博弈，用 EXP3 赌博机自适应地挑选最有信息量的指令，让多个语言模型通过相互评估与学习（DPO/GRPO）协同进化，在多个基准上显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: 多语言模型可以通过相互学习彼此的回复来协同提升，但这种交互高度依赖训练时使用的指令。现有方法通常对指令进行均匀采样，忽略了指令的有用性会随模型能力提升而变化：曾经能区分回复质量高低的指令，之后可能被同样好地回答；而曾经的难题也可能开始提供有效的学习信号。因此需要一个能随模型进步而动态调整的指令采样机制。
AI.method: 提出 Stackelberg Alignment，一种受博弈论启发的领导者-跟随者框架，把指令选择转化为自适应课程。领导者是一个 EXP3 赌博机，在固定采样预算下分配各指令的采样概率，并用结合"指令难度"和"回复可区分度"的奖励更新采样分布。语言模型作为跟随者：对选中的指令作出回复、相互评估回复，并通过 DPO 或 GRPO 从偏好信号中学习。框架还采用 Elo 式声誉加权的同伴评判和基于声誉的对手匹配，以保证交互可靠且有竞争性。
AI.result: 在三个异构模型池和 12 个基准（涵盖科学发现、推理、代码、指令遵循、知识）上的实验表明，Stackelberg Alignment 在三个模型池上取得最高宏平均成绩，比最强的训练时基线高出最多 7.4%，比最好的静态推理基线高出 12–25%。分析确认自适应领导者会把对决集中在最有信息量的指令上；消融实验显示声誉加权评判和基于声誉的匹配都能提升多 LLM 进化的效果。
AI.conclusion: 将指令选择建模为自适应博弈课程（EXP3 领导者 + 模型跟随者）能有效聚焦最有信息量的指令，配合声誉机制可显著提升多语言模型协同进化的效率与效果，为多 LLM 协同训练提供了一种新范式。

title: Frame Differential On-Policy Self-Distillation for Video Reasoning
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has substantially improved the reasoning ability of multimodal language models through verifiable rewards and increasingly fine-grainedvisual or temporal credit assignment. In video reasoning, however, current RL methods typically train with a fixed sparse frame budget: increasing the number of frames makes autoregressive rollouts expensive, while too few frames may miss temporally localized events and fine-grained visual details. We present \textbf{Frame Differential On-Policy Self-Distillation (FD-OPSD)}, which transfers the useful evidence of dense frame observations to a sparse frame policy during RL training. FD-OPSD compares the policy's token level preferences for the same sampled response under sparse and dense views, and distills the resulting frame differential signal without an external teacher or dense autoregressive rollout. The method preserves sparse-frame rollouts and leaves inference unchanged. Across Qwen2.5-VL-7B and Qwen3-VL-4B on six video reasoning benchmarks, FD-OPSD yields higher overall average performance than the strongest corresponding GRPO, T-GRPO, or Video-KTR baselines across the 16, 32, and 64 frame evaluation settings. These results show that dense visual evidence can be transferred selectively during training through token level self-distillation while retaining sparse frame rollouts and unchanged inference.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Frame Differential On-Policy Self-Distillation (FD-OPSD)，一种在强化学习训练中将密集帧观测的有用证据迁移到稀疏帧策略的方法。它通过比较同一采样响应在稀疏与密集视图下的 token 级偏好来蒸馏"帧差分信号"，无需外部教师模型或密集自回归 rollout，保持稀疏帧 rollout 与推理不变。在 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 和 Qwen3-VL-4B 上、六个视频推理基准测试中，FD-OPSD 在 16、32、64 帧评估设置下均优于 GRPO、T-GRPO、Video-KTR 等基线。
AI.motivation: 视频推理中的强化学习通常采用固定的稀疏帧预算：增加帧数会使自回归 rollout 代价高昂，而帧数过少又会遗漏时间上局部化的事件和细粒度视觉细节。因此需要一个既能利用密集帧的丰富证据、又不增加推理与 rollout 开销的方案。
AI.method: FD-OPSD 在 RL 训练过程中，对同一采样响应分别在稀疏视图与密集视图下计算策略的 token 级偏好，比较两者差异得到"帧差分信号"，并以此进行自蒸馏。该方法不依赖外部教师模型，也不进行密集自回归 rollout，仅使用稀疏帧 rollout，且推理阶段保持不变。
AI.result: 在 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 与 Qwen3-VL-4B 两个模型、六个视频推理基准上，FD-OPSD 在 16、32、64 帧评估设置下的总体平均性能均高于对应的最强 GRPO、T-GRPO 或 Video-KTR 基线。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，密集视觉证据可以在训练阶段通过 token 级自蒸馏被有选择地迁移到稀疏帧策略中，同时保留稀疏帧 rollout 与不变的推理流程。

title: scTrilemma: Balancing Identity, Invariance, and Fidelity in Single-Cell Representation Learning
summary: Single-cell RNA-seq representation learning is fundamentally label-free: cell identities, states, and contexts are not fixed training targets, so what constitutes signal or nuisance is analysis-dependent. A single representation must therefore preserve biological identity and state, remain robust to nuisance context, and retain the gene-level variation needed for expression analysis, three demands we call the representation trilemma. To tackle this problem, we introduce scTrilemma, a latent-bottleneck VAE that routes expression-derived variation to the embedding, the decoder, or the prior rather than forcing all of it through one embedding. It gates gene tokens by expression, routes the cell representation through the decoder, and conditions the prior on unlabeled pseudo-bulk context, under a single reconstruction objective and without target annotations or auxiliary representation losses. In release-based zero-shot evaluation on successive CZ CELLxGENE Census releases, scTrilemma leads all three demands at once and preserves biological-state, differential-expression, and pathway structure across multiple disease settings. Latent interventions further show that context can be removed at almost no cost to the other demands, leaving identity against fidelity as the remaining tension. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/yunhak0/scTrilemma.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 scTrilemma，一种潜在瓶颈 VAE，通过将表达变异分别路由到嵌入、解码器和先验，以单一重建目标同时满足单细胞表征的三大需求（保留生物身份与状态、抵抗冗余情境、保留基因级变异），在零样本评估中全面领先。
AI.motivation: 单细胞 RNA-seq 表征学习本质上是无标签的：细胞身份、状态和情境并非固定训练目标，因此何为信号、何为冗余取决于分析目的。单一表征需同时满足三个需求，即所谓"表征三难困境"：保留生物身份与状态、对冗余情境保持稳健、并保留用于表达分析的基因级变异。
AI.method: 提出 scTrilemma，一种潜在瓶颈 VAE：将表达衍生的变异路由至嵌入、解码器或先验，而非全部强制通过单一嵌入。其按表达对基因 token 进行门控，通过解码器路由细胞表征，并以无标签伪批量情境为条件化先验，在单一重建目标下运作，无需目标注释或辅助表征损失。
AI.result: 在基于 CZ CELLxGENE Census 连续发布的零样本评估中，scTrilemma 同时领先于全部三项需求，并在多种疾病情境下保留生物状态、差异表达和通路结构。潜在干预进一步显示，情境移除对其它需求的代价几乎可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 方法可近乎无损地去除情境信息，剩余的主要张力存在于身份与保真度之间。代码已公开于 https://github.com/yunhak0/scTrilemma。

title: Beyond Prediction: Steering VLM Agents with Retrospective World Modeling
summary: Equipping VLM agents with world modeling capabilities has shown strong potential for complex reasoning and long-horizon planning, while reducing the dependence of policy learning on costly real-world interactions. Existing methods mainly rely on prospective simulation to predict the consequences of candidate actions. However, this forward-only paradigm focuses on what will happen next and provides limited constraints for verifying whether an action is causally consistent with the observed state transition, which can lead to plausible-looking but physically incoherent behaviors. In this paper, we challenge the view of world modeling as only prospective prediction and introduce Retrospective World Modeling, a new agent learning paradigm that enables agents to reason backward by estimating the retrospective attribution distribution $P(\hat{a}{t}|s_t, s{t+1})$ for the action that most likely caused a given transition. Based on this capability, we formulate the Self-Consistency Reward (SCR), an intrinsic signal that measures the probabilistic consistency between the policy action and the retrospective explanation. Integrating SCR into reinforcement learning provides dense transition-level feedback and steers agents toward behaviors that are both task-effective and physically grounded. Extensive experiments across diverse agentic tasks show that our method substantially improves policy robustness and generalization over prospective-only world modeling baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出回顾性世界建模与自洽性奖励，通过反向推断动作归因，为强化学习提供密集反馈，提升智能体的鲁棒性与泛化。
AI.motivation: 现有方法主要依赖前瞻性模拟预测候选动作的后果，属于"仅向前"范式，只能回答"接下来会发生什么"，缺乏对动作与已观察状态转移是否因果一致的验证约束，容易产生看似合理但物理不一致的行为。因此作者挑战"世界建模仅等于前瞻预测"的观点，引入回顾性世界建模新范式。
AI.method: 提出回顾性世界建模范式，使智能体反向推理，估计导致给定状态转移的最可能动作的回顾性归因分布 P(â_t | s_t, s_{t+1})。基于该能力构建自洽性奖励（SCR），作为衡量策略动作与回顾性解释之间概率一致性的内在信号，并将其整合进强化学习，提供密集的转移级反馈。
AI.result: 在多种智能体任务上的大量实验表明，该方法相比仅前瞻的世界建模基线，显著提升了策略的鲁棒性和泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 回顾性世界建模与自洽性奖励为智能体学习提供了新的内在反馈机制，引导行为兼具任务有效性与物理合理性，是超越仅前瞻范式的重要方向。

title: Persistent Watermarking of Text-to-Image Models
summary: Text-to-image (T2I) generation is gaining increasing popularity with the general public, motivating the development of reliable mechanisms for copyrighting such models given their expensive training costs. An adversary may obtain and reuse a pretrained T2I model without authorization, and then serve a modified version through an API service. Such modifications may arise from ordinary downstream adaptation or deliberate attempts to erase ownership, including input-prompt preprocessing, model fine-tuning, and output post-processing. From the model owner's perspective, a key challenge is therefore to embed trigger data that remain persistent under such changes while preserving the model's normal image-generation capabilities. In this work, we propose a contrastive-style watermarking objective with a term that explicitly encourages the watermarked model to behave differently from the original model on trigger inputs. Experiments show substantially stronger trigger-data persistence than prior methods across a wide range of downstream modifications and deliberate attempts to weaken the watermark, resulting in higher detection rates, often approaching 100% TPR@FPR<$10^{-4}$.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种对比式水印目标，显式鼓励加水印模型在触发输入上与原始模型行为不同，从而在多种下游修改下保持触发数据持久性，检测率接近100% TPR@FPR<1e-4。
AI.motivation: 文本到图像（T2I）模型训练成本高昂，需要可靠的版权保护机制。攻击者可能未经授权获取并复用一个预训练T2I模型，经过普通下游适配或蓄意去除所有权（如输入提示预处理、模型微调、输出后处理）后通过API服务提供修改版。模型所有者的关键挑战是嵌入在这些变化下仍保持持久的触发数据，同时不损害模型正常的图像生成能力。
AI.method: 提出一种对比式水印目标，包含一个显式项，鼓励加水印模型在触发输入上的行为与原始模型不同。
AI.result: 实验表明，在广泛的下游修改和蓄意削弱水印的尝试下，触发数据持久性显著强于先前方法，检测率更高，通常接近100% TPR@FPR<1e-4。
AI.conclusion: 对比式水印目标能有效提升T2I模型水印在多种修改下的持久性和检测率，为T2I模型版权保护提供了更可靠的机制。

title: Scoring Higher, Answering Worse: Mitigating Reward Hacking in Rubric-Based RL via Protocol-Level Rubrics
summary: Rubric-based reinforcement learning (Rubric-RL) trains language models where no verifier exists. A judge checks each criterion of a rubric, and the verdicts are aggregated into a reward, most often by a weighted sum. We show that this additive aggregation is the weak point. Under a sum, criteria compensate for one another: a policy that misses the one decision that matters can buy the points back with advice nobody asked for. On clinical consultation, such a policy scores higher and answers worse. Rubric coverage rises while appropriateness on held-out physician criteria falls below the untrained model. The medical criteria are not to blame. Grouped so that they must hold together, the same criteria, unchanged to the word, recover a third of the loss; shorter answers recover almost none. We therefore propose Protocol-level Rubrics (ProRubric), which keeps what the criteria ask for and changes how they are aggregated. It groups a checklist into a few protocol-level dimensions. A dimension counts only when all of its criteria hold and its failure clause does not fire. The grouping is done once, offline, and leaves the optimizer unchanged. ProRubric raises appropriateness by 10.8 points without losing coverage and has the best seven-benchmark average at both scales. Reward validity is set not only by what a rubric verifies, but by how it aggregates. Code is available at https://github.com/Estrellajer/ProRubric

AI.tldr: 论文指出基于评分标准的强化学习（Rubric-RL）中，加权求和式奖励聚合是可补偿的弱点：模型可通过无关内容的堆砌补偿关键缺失。作者提出 ProRubric，将清单按协议级维度分组并要求维度内条件全部满足，离线完成分组且不改变优化器，从而提升适当性而不损失覆盖率。
AI.motivation: 在缺乏验证器的任务中，Rubric-RL 依赖评判者对每条标准逐项判定，并以加权求和聚合为奖励。作者认为这种加性聚合是关键薄弱点：各项标准可以互相补偿，导致策略出现"丢失关键决策却用多余建议回购分数"的错位——在临床问诊上表现为评分更高但答案质量更差，评分覆盖率上升却在留出的医师标准上适当性低于未训练模型。
AI.method: 作者首先诊断问题：将同一套医学标准按"必须同时成立"的方式分组（措辞不变），可挽回约三分之一的损失，而缩短回答几乎无帮助，说明问题在聚合方式而非标准本身。据此提出 Protocol-level Rubrics（ProRubric）：把检查清单归并为少量协议级维度，只有当某维度下所有标准同时成立、且其失败条款未被触发时该维度才计分。分组一次性离线完成，优化器保持不变。
AI.result: ProRubric 在临床问诊场景中将适当性提升 10.8 分，同时不损失覆盖率；在两个模型规模下均取得七个基准的最佳平均成绩。对照实验显示，仅按"必须同时成立"分组即可恢复约三分之一损失，缩短回答收益很小。
AI.conclusion: 奖励的有效性不仅由评分标准验证什么决定，还由其如何聚合决定。避免可补偿的加性聚合、采用协议级维度的合取式聚合，可在不改变优化器与标准内容的前提下显著改善策略质量。

title: Reserve-Aware Contrast Certificates for Conservative Bandits with Uncertain Baselines
summary: Conservative bandits must improve an incumbent policy without exhausting a prescribed performance budget. When the incumbent is uncertain, separately bounding candidate and baseline rewards can charge twice for shared estimation error. We develop Reserve-C4B around the baseline-relative contrast itself. A shared confidence set yields an exact expression for this avoidable penalty and a tighter admissibility test at every fixed history. A reserve ledger separates statistical evidence from permitted performance deficit; a prefix-refresh extension recertifies accumulated decisions under the current confidence set without discarding previously certified credit. For linear rewards, self-normalized confidence sets provide simultaneous validity over time and adaptively generated candidates, and the resulting policy satisfies a conditional-mean performance constraint with high probability. Reproducible experiments isolate certificate coupling, prefix refresh, and historical information, showing large reductions in baseline fallback while exposing the limitations of frozen certificates.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Reserve-C4B，通过直接围绕基线的相对对比构造共享置信集，避免了分别对候选与基线奖励设界时对共享估计误差的重复惩罚，并借助储备账本与前缀刷新机制，在保证条件均值性能约束的前提下显著减少回退到基线的频率，但冻结证书仍存在局限。
AI.motivation: 保守老虎机需要在不超过预设性能预算的前提下改进现有策略。当现有基线本身不确定时，分别对候选奖励和基线奖励设置置信界，会因共享的估计误差而被重复计入，导致不必要的保守性；因此需要一种直接针对"基线相对对比"进行建模的方法来消除这种可避免的惩罚。
AI.method: 论文提出 Reserve-C4B：围绕基线相对对比构建共享置信集，给出该可避免惩罚的精确表达，并在每个固定历史下提供更紧的可采纳性检验；设计储备账本，将统计证据与允许的性能赤字分离；提出前缀刷新扩展，在不丢弃已认证信用的前提下，用当前置信集重新认证历史决策；对线性奖励，使用自归一化置信集，使其在时间维度与自适应生成的候选上同时有效。
AI.result: 在理论层面，所得策略以高概率满足条件均值性能约束。可复现实验分别隔离了证书耦合、前缀刷新与历史信息的作用，结果显示基线回退大幅减少，同时暴露出冻结证书的局限性。
AI.conclusion: 通过直接对基线相对对比建模并引入储备账本与前缀刷新机制，Reserve-C4B 有效缓解了共享估计误差导致的过度保守，在满足性能约束的同时减少基线回退；不过，证书一旦冻结便难以适应新信息，这提示未来需要更灵活的认证更新机制。

title: TED:Text-Axis Evidence Decomposition for Prompted Anomaly Localization
comment: 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
summary: CLIP is a powerful vision-language model, but it was not designed for fine-grained defect localization; CLIP-based anomaly detectors therefore adapt it with prompts or lightweight modules to increase defect sensitivity. We show that stronger sensitivity does not necessarily make local evidence reliable: under domain shift, adapted CLIP-AD models often assign high anomaly scores to both true defects and visually complex normal regions. The issue is not simply missing defect information, but a local scoring rule that decodes defect and hard-normal evidence, having the same anomaly evidence. We propose TED (Text-Axis Evidence Decomposition), a post-hoc scoring method that asks whether each ambiguous response is better supported by source defect patches or by source normal patches mistaken as anomalous. TED compares these supports under the host's normal-versus-anomaly text response, leaves the backbone and prompts unchanged, and requires no target-domain training. It works as a train-free score for raw VLM backbones or as a source-calibrated residual correction for adapted CLIP-AD hosts. Across frozen VLM backbones, TED substantially improves pixel-level localization over raw prompt similarity; across adapted hosts, it improves most pixel-level settings over P-AUROC, P-PRO, and P-AP. Gains are largest under stronger hard-FP competition, with mean localization gain increasing from +5.0 in low-competition regimes to about +10.9 in mid/high-competition regimes. These results suggest that recoverable defect evidence can already exist in pretrained multimodal representations, but reliable localization requires decoding it against hard-normal competitors. Code will be released at TED GitHub repository.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TED（Text-Axis Evidence Decomposition），一种无需训练的后处理评分方法，通过判断模糊响应更支持源域缺陷块还是被误判为异常的源域正常块，提升CLIP类异常检测器在域偏移下的细粒度缺陷定位可靠性。
AI.motivation: CLIP虽强大，但并非为细粒度缺陷定位设计；现有CLIP异常检测方法通过提示或轻量模块增强缺陷敏感性。然而作者发现，更强的敏感性并不等于可靠的局部证据：在域偏移下，适配后的CLIP-AD模型会对真实缺陷和视觉复杂的正常区域都给出高异常分数。问题不在于缺少缺陷信息，而在于局部评分规则将缺陷证据与"困难正常"证据解码为相同的异常证据。
AI.method: 提出TED（Text-Axis Evidence Decomposition）后处理评分方法。它询问每个模糊响应是否更受源域缺陷块支持，还是更受被误判为异常的源域正常块支持；在宿主模型的正常-异常文本响应下比较这两种支持度。方法保持主干与提示不变，无需目标域训练，既可作为原始VLM主干的免训练分数，也可作为适配CLIP-AD主机的源校准残差修正。
AI.result: 在冻结的VLM主干上，TED显著提升像素级定位效果，优于原始提示相似度；在适配主机上，在P-AUROC、P-PRO和P-AP指标上改善了大多数像素级设置。在更强的困难假阳性竞争下增益最大，平均定位增益从低竞争场景的+5.0提升到中/高竞争场景的约+10.9。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，预训练多模态表示中可能已存在可恢复的缺陷证据，但实现可靠定位需要针对"困难正常"竞争者进行解码。代码将发布于TED的GitHub仓库。

title: Visualizing Distribution Coverage in Generative Diffusion Models
summary: Diffusion distillation is widely adopted to accelerate sampling, and the resulting few-step models are broadly believed to match or even surpass their multi-step teachers in generation. However, standard evaluations such as GenEval2 typically draw only one sample per prompt, so improved scores may fail to reveal losses in distribution coverage. We therefore revisit whether distilled models truly match their teachers beyond single-draw performance using \textbf{pass@$\mathbf{k}$}, which measures the probability that at least one of $k$ independent samples satisfies a quality criterion. At $k{=}1$, pass@$k$ reduces to standard single-draw evaluation. As $k$ grows, the curve reveals whether additional draws find genuinely different successes or merely revisit the same modes, directly exposing how broadly a model covers the space of valid outputs. We first show that classifier-free guidance (CFG), whose quality--coverage tradeoff is well established, is the clearest case: higher guidance improves pass@$1$, but its advantage shrinks and reverses at larger $k$. Applying pass@$k$ to few-step distilled models, we find the same tradeoff splits along training objectives: distribution-matching objectives concentrate the student's output distribution, boosting early-hit rates while eroding large-budget coverage, whereas consistency and trajectory-based objectives better preserve the teacher's coverage even at large $k$. We further show that this tradeoff extends to few-step causal video generation. Our findings reveal a previously overlooked cost of diffusion distillation: across both image and video generation, the choice of training objective fundamentally determines whether a few-step model inherits its teacher's distribution coverage or trades it away for single-draw quality.

AI.tldr: 论文提出用 pass@k 重新评估扩散蒸馏模型，发现少步模型在多次采样下的覆盖率可能不如其多步教师模型，且训练目标类型决定这一权衡。
AI.motivation: 标准评估（如 GenEval）通常每个提示只采样一次，可能掩盖蒸馏模型在分布覆盖上的损失，因此需要更全面的指标来判断少步模型是否真正匹配其教师。
AI.method: 采用 pass@k（k 次独立采样中至少一次满足质量标准的概率）作为评估指标；k=1 时退化为单采样评估，k 增大可揭示模型对有效输出空间的覆盖广度。先用 CFG 验证质量-覆盖权衡，再将该指标应用于少步蒸馏模型和少步因果视频生成。
AI.result: CFG 提高 pass@1 但在大 k 时优势缩小甚至反转；蒸馏模型的权衡随训练目标分裂：分布匹配目标集中于输出分布、提升早期命中率但削弱大预算覆盖，而一致性目标和轨迹目标在大 k 下更能保持教师覆盖；该权衡同样存在于视频生成。
AI.conclusion: 扩散蒸馏存在此前被忽视的代价：在图像和视频生成中，训练目标的选择决定了少步模型是继承教师的分布覆盖，还是以覆盖换取单采样质量。

title: MASCRDM: Multi-Agent System for Compliance Risk Detection and Mitigation in Training Process of Large Language Models
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have been applied in various fields. However, ensuring compliance and safety of LLMs, such as avoiding discrimination and bias, still remains a challenge. Current efforts mainly focus on detecting and filtering inputs and outputs of the trained models, rather than studying the intrinsic architecture of the models in real-time. To tackle this challenge, we analyze the LLMs training process and discover two critical issues: 1) Most of the existing methods are predominantly static in their approach to detection and filtering, achieving only localized optimizations without systematically enhancing the compliance of LLMs. 2) Another issue with existing approaches is the lack of real-time risk detection and mitigation across the full training process, which leads to limited flexibility. Motivated by these, we propose MASCRDM (Multi-Agent System for Compliance Risk Detection and Mitigation) during the LLM training process. Firstly, we develop a set of compliance rules based on existing Artificial Intelligence (AI) laws and a compliance-specific LLM with the instruction of compliance law experts. Then, we deconstruct LLMs into several components and identify key nodes based on the compliance knowledge graph. During LLMs training, we implement our multiple agents in the whole process, giving compliance risk alerts and suggestions for LLM developers. Experiments on discrimination and bias benchmark demonstrate that our multi-agent system can effectively improve the compliance while maintaining reasonable semantic performance. The results indicate that our method provides an executable path for mitigating compliance risk from within the LLMs systematically.

AI.tldr: 提出MASCRDM多智能体系统，在LLM训练全过程进行合规风险检测与缓解，兼顾合规性与语义性能。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM合规安全研究多聚焦于对已训练模型的输入输出进行检测与过滤，缺乏对模型内在结构的实时研究。作者分析训练过程发现两个问题：1）现有方法多为静态检测过滤，仅做局部优化，无法系统性提升合规性；2）缺乏贯穿整个训练过程的实时风险检测与缓解，灵活性有限。
AI.method: 提出MASCRDM（用于合规风险检测与缓解的多智能体系统），应用于LLM训练过程。首先基于现有AI法律制定合规规则集，并在合规法律专家指导下构建合规专用LLM；然后将LLM解构为多个组件，并基于合规知识图谱识别关键节点；训练过程中部署多个智能体贯穿全流程，为开发者提供合规风险预警与建议。
AI.result: 在歧视与偏见基准上的实验表明，该多智能体系统能有效提升合规性，同时保持合理的语义性能。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为从LLM内部系统性地缓解合规风险提供了可执行路径。

title: BadAction: Backdoor Attacks on Interactive Video Generation via Action-Guided Triggers
comment: 12 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables. Project page: https://wsad55.github.io/badaction01/
summary: Interactive video generation (IVG) models have achieved remarkable progress in producing controllable visual content guided by user-defined actions, yet their security vulnerabilities remain largely unexplored. In this paper, we present the first systematic study of backdoor attacks against the interactivity of IVG models. Based on this attack surface, we propose BadAction, which leverages action-guided triggers to achieve the attack. Specifically, BadAction implants predefined motion patterns into the action sequences of backdoor samples and associates them with a static target video. Once triggered, the backdoored model generates frozen future frames that no longer respond to subsequent user actions, while preserving normal behavior on benign action sequences. In addition, we explore a stealthier attack in which multimodal triggers jointly poison action, text, and image inputs. Experiments show that BadAction achieves average attack success rates of 91.0% with action-only triggers and 80.4% with multimodal triggers. Moreover, extensive defense evaluations show that BadAction successfully bypasses existing backdoor detection methods, revealing a critical security gap in the interactive video generation pipeline. Project page: https://wsad55.github.io/badaction01/.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统研究交互式视频生成（IVG）模型的后门攻击，提出 BadAction 方法，通过动作引导触发器植入后门，使模型在被触发后输出冻结帧、不再响应用户动作。
AI.motivation: IVG 模型在可控视觉内容生成方面进展显著，但其安全漏洞（尤其是交互性方面的后门风险）尚未被探索，存在关键安全空白。
AI.method: 提出 BadAction：在动作序列中植入预定义运动模式作为触发器，并将其与静态目标视频关联；触发后模型生成不再响应后续用户动作的冻结未来帧，同时在良性动作序列上保持正常行为。此外探索了联合污染动作、文本、图像输入的多模态触发器隐蔽攻击。
AI.result: 仅动作触发器平均攻击成功率达 91.0%，多模态触发器达 80.4%；大量防御评估表明 BadAction 可成功绕过现有后门检测方法。
AI.conclusion: BadAction 揭示了交互式视频生成流程中关键的安全缺口，表明现有防御手段难以检测此类攻击。

title: Mitigating the Length-Scaling Tax with Online Distillation
summary: Length scaling during reinforcement-learning (RL) post-training is often viewed as a sign of improved reasoning ability, especially on difficult problems, but may also make responses to already-solved problems unnecessarily verbose. We quantify this side effect as the length-scaling tax (LST): excess response length on already-solved queries without a commensurate accuracy gain. To mitigate LST, we propose Length Self-Distillation (LSD), which routes solved prompts to on-policy distillation and retains the original RL objective for unsolved prompts. LSD uses an exponential moving average of the online policy as its teacher, requiring no external model. We find that LSD achieves comparable or better performance than RL across multiple variants, while substantially curbing response-length growth on easy queries. LSD reduces LST from 19.0% to -3.7% on single-turn reasoning and from 31.4% to 13.7% on multi-turn agentic tasks, demonstrating that LSD effectively preserves concise response patterns on easy queries while supporting efficient exploration on difficult queries during RL post-training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"长度缩放税"(LST)概念，用于量化RL后训练中对已解决简单问题的冗余输出，并提出Length Self-Distillation (LSD)方法在保持推理性能的同时抑制该副作用。
AI.motivation: RL后训练中的长度缩放通常被视为推理能力提升的标志，尤其是难题上，但也会让已解决问题变得不必要地冗长。作者希望量化这一副作用并加以缓解。
AI.method: 作者定义LST为已解决问题上无相应准确率收益的额外响应长度。为缓解LST，提出LSD：对已解决的prompt采用on-policy蒸馏，对未解决的prompt保留原始RL目标；教师模型使用在线策略的指数移动平均(EMA)，无需外部模型。
AI.result: LSD在多个变体上达到与RL相当或更好的性能，同时显著抑制简单查询的响应长度增长。单轮推理中LST从19.0%降至-3.7%，多轮智能体任务中从31.4%降至13.7%。
AI.conclusion: LSD在RL后训练中有效保留简单查询的简洁响应模式，同时支持困难查询的高效探索。

title: BELIEFRAG: Making Adaptive RAG State-Aware under Evolving Evidence
summary: Adaptive RAG uses signals such as confidence, relevance, support, and retrieval quality to decide when to search or correct evidence. In multi-step retrieval, however, these local signals must be combined into a persistent view of what the current evidence supports, what remains missing, and which action should follow. Existing methods often use such signals as separate triggers, making it difficult to preserve a coherent evidence state across a trajectory; we call this problem evidence-state fragmentation. We introduce BELIEFRAG, a closed-loop controller that updates an explicit state over sufficiency, reliability, conflict, uncertainty, evidence gaps, and acquisition cost, then chooses among retrieval, query rewriting, verification, answering, stopping, and abstention. Across six QA benchmarks with gpt-oss-120b, BELIEFRAG reaches mean token F1 0.572 with 3.89k tokens per question, outperforming fixed iterative retrieval (0.555 F1) while using 39% fewer tokens. The same quality-cost pattern transfers to Qwen3-32B, where BELIEFRAG reaches 0.552 F1 versus 0.523 for iterative retrieval while using 35% fewer tokens. Analysis shows that the main gains come from corrective re-retrieval rather than pruning alone, while several belief dimensions are redundant and calibrated answerability plays the strongest operational role. Calibration improves threshold stability across related evidence sources, although source shift can still invalidate the same decision signal.

AI.tldr: BELIEFRAG 是一个闭环控制器，用显式信念状态（充分性、可靠性、冲突、不确定性、证据缺口、获取成本）统一决策检索/改写/验证/作答/停止/弃权，在六个 QA 基准上以更少 token 取得更高 F1。
AI.motivation: 多步检索中，置信度、相关性、支持度、检索质量等局部信号常被当作独立触发器使用，难以在整条轨迹上维持连贯的证据状态，作者将这一问题称为"证据状态碎片化"（evidence-state fragmentation）。
AI.method: 提出 BELIEFRAG：一个闭环控制器，维护显式状态，涵盖充分性、可靠性、冲突、不确定性、证据缺口与获取成本；基于该状态在检索、查询改写、验证、作答、停止、弃权六类动作间进行选择。
AI.result: 在六个 QA 基准、gpt-oss-120b 上，平均 token F1 达 0.572、每题 3.89k token，优于固定迭代检索（0.555 F1）且 token 减少 39%；在 Qwen3-32B 上同样迁移，0.552 F1 对 0.523，token 减少 35%。增益主要来自纠正性重检索而非单纯剪枝，若干信念维度冗余，校准后的可答性作用最强；校准提升相关证据源间的阈值稳定性，但源漂移仍可能使同一决策信号失效。
AI.conclusion: 统一的显式信念状态能有效缓解证据状态碎片化，在质量—成本权衡上优于固定迭代检索，且跨模型可迁移；但信念维度存在冗余、源漂移下决策信号仍可能失效。

title: TSMD: Temporal-Stream Modality Dropout for Robust Video Highlight Detection
summary: Existing multimodal video highlight detectors typically assume that visual, audio, and textual streams are continuously available. In practice, however, inputs may suffer from localized frame missingness or complete-stream outage. We formulate this robustness challenge along two dimensions: temporal missingness, where frames are missing independently in each modality, and stream-level missingness, where one modality is unavailable throughout a video. Moreover, we find that the mean squared error (MSE) loss is misaligned with both the evaluation metrics and the peak-driven nature of highlights. Therefore, we propose Temporal-Stream Modality Dropout (TSMD), which combines structured missingness simulation with a joint objective comprising pointwise MSE, per-video Pearson correlation, and peak-oriented RankNet loss terms. TSMD has three variants: temporal, stream-level, and mixed dropout. On the MoSu and Mr. HiSum datasets, TSMD-Temporal improves mAP@15 by 7.06 and 3.41 points over TripleSumm under 50% independent temporal removal, whereas TSMD-Stream performs the best under complete-stream removal. TSMD-Mix retains most of these complementary benefits and ranks the best or the second-best across the evaluated temporal and stream-level conditions.

AI.tldr: 提出TSMD方法提升多模态视频高光检测在时序与整模态缺失下的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有方法假设视觉、音频、文本流始终可用，但实际存在局部帧缺失或整流中断；且MSE损失与评测指标及高光的峰值特性不一致。
AI.method: TSMD结合结构化缺失模拟与联合目标（逐点MSE、每视频Pearson相关、面向峰值的RankNet损失），含Temporal、Stream、Mixed三种变体。
AI.result: 在MoSu与Mr. HiSum上，50%独立时序移除下TSMD-Temporal较TripleSumm的mAP@15提升7.06和3.41分；TSMD-Stream在整流移除下最优；TSMD-Mix保持互补优势，位居最优或次优。
AI.conclusion: TSMD有效应对时序与整模态缺失，兼具鲁棒性与性能优势。

title: Optimal Design for Active Preference Learning with Biased LLM Judges
summary: Learning from human preferences is central to large language model (LLM) alignment, but human preference annotation is costly. Active preference learning reduces this cost by selecting informative comparisons, and LLM judges can provide additional scalable feedback. However, the preferences of the judges may deviate from those of the target human population. Even after calibration on trusted reference data, active acquisition can shift the comparison distribution and expose residual judge bias. We therefore incorporate judge deviations into the acquisition design rather than relying on a separate calibration stage. Under joint estimation, comparisons that appear highly informative about the reward may also reflect judge bias and therefore provide less information about human preferences. To address this issue, we propose Nuisance-Adjusted Optimal Design (NAOD), a comparison-selection strategy that prioritizes policy-relevant target information after nuisance adjustment and uses the Frank-Wolfe algorithm for optimization. Theoretically, we establish a sharp conditional local asymptotic minimax lower bound on policy risk and construct an estimator that attains it. We further characterize the finite-sample cost of learning the nuisance representation and show that representation error can reverse an oracle design advantage. Finally, we validate these predictions experimentally and evaluate NAOD on Chatbot Arena data across 17 judges, 15 budget configurations, and 15 random cluster-level splits. NAOD reduces the mean regret of proxy policy by 29.1% relative to a matched target-information design, outperforms existing methods, and improves human-preference prediction on held-out data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NAOD方法，在主动偏好学习中同时考虑人类偏好与LLM评审偏差，避免单独校准阶段，实验证明可显著降低代理策略遗憾并提升人类偏好预测。
AI.motivation: 人类偏好标注成本高昂，主动偏好学习可降低成本，且LLM评审能提供可扩展反馈。但评审偏好可能与目标人群存在偏差，即使在校准后，主动采集会改变比较分布并暴露残余评审偏差，因此需将评审偏差纳入采集设计。
AI.method: 提出Nuisance-Adjusted Optimal Design（NAOD），一种比较选择策略：在干扰项调整后优先获取与策略相关的目标信息，并采用Frank-Wolfe算法进行优化。
AI.result: 理论上建立了策略风险的紧致条件局部渐近极小极大下界，并构造达到该下界的估计量；刻画了学习干扰表示的有限样本代价，并表明表示误差可能反转oracle设计的优势。在Chatbot Arena数据上，跨17个评审、15种预算配置和15次随机簇级划分进行验证，NAOD相对匹配的目标信息设计将代理策略平均遗憾降低29.1%，优于现有方法，并提升留出数据上的人类偏好预测。
AI.conclusion: 将评审偏差纳入主动采集设计（而非独立校准）对降低策略风险至关重要，NAOD在理论与实验上均表现出有效性。

title: Schema: Discovering Unknown Environments via Agentic Program Induction
summary: Learning to complete tasks in unfamiliar environments with unknown rules remains a key challenge for LLM agents. Current LLM agents often record their discoveries in prose, which may not provide a compact, explicit account of how the environment works. Inspired by how scientists organize observations into testable, predictive theories, we introduce Schema, an agent harness that organizes learning and action through interactive program induction. The LLM agent decides what to investigate and how to act, expressing its evolving understanding of the environment as executable programs. The harness consists of a persistent program workspace and a small set of interfaces for checking these programs against the interaction history, planning within them, and executing plans under step-by-step verification. Schema raises ARC-AGI-3 RHAE from 58.7% to 99.2% with the same base model, solves 100% of the public DiG-bench games, and reaches the median performance of the top-50 human players on MazeBench. Extensive analysis shows the effectiveness of Schema in unknown mechanism discovery, and ablations confirm the contribution of each component.

AI.tldr: 提出 Schema 智能体框架，通过交互式程序归纳将环境理解表示为可执行程序，大幅提升 LLM 智能体在未知规则环境中的任务完成能力。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体在规则未知的陌生环境中完成任务仍是核心挑战；现有智能体多以自然语言散文记录发现，难以形成紧凑、显式的环境运作模型。
AI.method: 受科学家将观察组织为可检验预测理论的启发，提出 Schema 框架：智能体决定探索内容与行动方式，将不断演进的环境理解表达为可执行程序；框架包含持久化程序工作区，以及少量接口，用于将程序与交互历史对照检验、在程序内进行规划，并在逐步验证下执行计划。
AI.result: 在同一基础模型下，将 ARC-AGI-3 RHAE 从 58.7% 提升至 99.2%；100% 解决公开 DiG-bench 游戏；在 MazeBench 上达到前 50 名人类玩家的中位表现。分析显示其在未知机制发现上的有效性，消融实验验证了各组件的贡献。
AI.conclusion: 以可执行程序承载环境理解、并结合检验、规划与逐步验证的交互式程序归纳，是提升 LLM 智能体在未知规则环境中表现的有效途径。

title: Agentic Tool-Augmented Reasoning for Explainable Image Forgery Detection
summary: Conventional image forgery detection methods produce binary scores or pixel-level masks without interpretable evidence, while recent multimodal large language model (MLLM)-based approaches generate post-hoc explanations of predetermined classification results rather than reasoning from evidence. Inspired by the forensic workflow of human judicial experts, we propose Agentic Tool-Augmented Reasoning (ATAR), a framework integrating 22 specialized forensic tools across seven complementary domains to autonomously detect, localize, and explain image forgeries through multi-turn reasoning. A Dual-Stream Forensic Reasoning paradigm combines a high-level semantic anomaly path, which magnifies suspicious regions for fine-grained inspection, with a low-level forgery artifact path, which invokes forensic tools to extract objective evidence. We further introduce Forensics Curriculum Learning: during General Experience SFT, an automated teacher-student mentoring pipeline synthesizes multi-turn tool-usage reasoning trajectories; during Forensic Scene RL, a Tool Prior Curriculum guides early tool exploration and progressively transfers control to the agent, while a Structured Evidence Reward provides fine-grained process-level supervision. Experiments across IMDL, Deepfake detection, DMDL, and AIGC detection show that ATAR achieves 78.5% average image-level F1 on six zero-shot IMDL benchmarks, surpassing the strongest MLLM baseline by 11.8 percentage points, and remains competitive with specialized detectors on other tasks while producing substantially more faithful and grounded explanations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ATAR 框架，通过整合 22 个取证工具和双流取证推理范式，实现图像伪造的自主检测、定位与可解释推理，并结合课程学习提升性能。
AI.motivation: 传统图像伪造检测方法仅输出二元分数或像素级掩码，缺乏可解释证据；而现有多模态大模型方法只是对预定分类结果做事后解释，而非基于证据进行推理。
AI.method: 提出 Agentic Tool-Augmented Reasoning（ATAR），集成跨七个领域的 22 个专用取证工具，通过多轮推理完成检测、定位与解释；采用双流取证推理范式（高层语义异常路径与低层伪造痕迹路径）；并设计取证课程学习，包括自动师生指导合成多轮工具使用推理轨迹，以及工具先验课程和结构化证据奖励进行强化学习。
AI.result: 在 IMDL、Deepfake 检测、DMDL 和 AIGC 检测任务上，ATAR 在六个零样本 IMDL 基准上取得 78.5% 的平均图像级 F1，超过最强 MLLM 基线 11.8 个百分点，同时在其他任务上与专用检测器保持竞争力，并生成更忠实、有依据的解释。
AI.conclusion: ATAR 通过工具增强推理与课程学习，有效提升图像伪造检测的自主性、准确性和可解释性，验证了基于证据推理解释路线的有效性。

title: GeoNest: Learning to Select Failure-Aware Neighborhoods for the Irregular Knapsack Problem in a Circular Container
summary: The two-dimensional irregular knapsack problem in a fixed circular container is an important combinatorial optimization problem for maximizing material utilization in manufacturing. Conventional geometric packing solvers can produce tightly packed layouts, yet they often partition the residual space into isolated small pockets that cannot fit valuable unplaced polygons. To overcome this late-stage packing bottleneck, we propose a failure-aware large neighborhood search framework named GeoNest, driven by a graph policy trained via reinforcement learning. Specifically, we first construct neighborhoods by pairing failed target polygons with residual pockets. We then use explanatory poses to identify the placed polygons that block candidate insertions. These diagnosed blocking relations define bounded, fixed-item repair subproblems for the underlying geometric solver. Finally, the graph policy selects the most promising subproblem for execution. For evaluation, we introduce CircleNest-Bench, a benchmark comprising 2,391 load-controlled instances from four contour sources, including a held-out industrial CAD source. Experimental results demonstrate that, under the same total time budget, GeoNest improves mean utilization over a state-of-the-art standalone packing solver by about 0.9% on average across the three main test sets and by about 0.6% on the held-out industrial set.

AI.tldr: 提出GeoNest框架，用强化学习训练的图策略驱动失败感知大邻域搜索，解决固定圆形二维不规则背包问题中的后期装填瓶颈，并发布CircleNest-Bench基准。
AI.motivation: 常规几何装填求解器虽能生成紧凑布局，但常把剩余空间分割成孤立小空洞，无法容纳有价值的未放置多边形，造成后期装填瓶颈，材料利用率受限。
AI.method: 先通过配对失败目标多边形与剩余空洞构造邻域；再用解释性位姿识别阻挡候选插入的已放置多边形；这些阻塞关系定义有界、固定物品的修复子问题；最后由强化学习训练的图策略选择最有潜力的子问题交由底层几何求解器执行。
AI.result: 在相同总时间预算下，GeoNest在三个主要测试集上平均利用率提升约0.9%，在留出的工业CAD集上提升约0.6%，均优于最先进的独立装填求解器。同时提出含2,391个负载控制实例、来自四类轮廓源的CircleNest-Bench基准。
AI.conclusion: GeoNest通过失败感知的大邻域搜索与学习型图策略有效突破几何装填的后期瓶颈，提升材料利用率，并配套基准推动该问题研究。

title: RefCon: Iterative Refinement and Contrastive Memory Extraction for Context-Evolving Agent
summary: Long-horizon agent interactions generate useful but noisy experience, and retraining models to absorb it is expensive. Context-evolving agents therefore need memory extraction methods that improve with more test-time compute without relying on gold labels. We propose RefCon, which combines sequential self-refinement with parallel self-contrast to extract higher-quality memories without gold labels.
