Evaluated on AppWorld and BFCL-V3 across multiple context-evolving agent frameworks, RefCon delivers strong and consistent gains, including relative improvements of 21.6% on ACE and 16.6% on ReMe over no-scaling baselines, while a diversity-focused variant (DivCon) achieves a 35.5% gain on ReasoningBank. RefCon consistently outperforms existing baselines without ground-truth labels, and generalizes across model scales and to software engineering tasks, where it surpasses even ground-truth baselines. We further analyze the accuracy-token trade-off and scaling behavior, showing RefCon maintains favorable efficiency and continues to improve as more trajectories are used, unlike diversity-only scaling which saturates earlier.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RefCon，一种无需金标准标签的记忆提取方法，结合序列式自精炼与并行式自对比，在多个智能体框架和任务上取得显著增益。
AI.motivation: 长时程智能体交互会产生有用但含噪的经验，而重新训练模型来吸收这些经验成本高昂。上下文演化型智能体因此需要能在测试时增加计算量即可提升、且不依赖金标准标签的记忆提取方法。
AI.method: RefCon 将序列式自精炼（sequential self-refinement）与并行式自对比（parallel self-contrast）相结合，在无金标准标签条件下提取更高质量的记忆；另提出聚焦多样性的变体 DivCon。
AI.result: 在 AppWorld 与 BFCL-V3 上，跨多个上下文演化型智能体框架评测，RefCon 取得稳定增益：相对无扩展基线，ACE 提升 21.6%，ReMe 提升 16.6%，DivCon 在 ReasoningBank 上提升 35.5%。RefCon 持续优于无真值标签的现有基线，并跨模型规模泛化，在软件工程任务上甚至超越真值基线。
AI.conclusion: RefCon 在准确率-令牌权衡与扩展行为上保持良好效率，且随使用轨迹增多持续提升，而仅依赖多样性的扩展会更早饱和。

title: MRI Super-Resolution with RCDM/WaveMix and Task-Aware Segmentation
summary: Super-resolution and quality enhancement of 1.5\,T brain MRI are normally validated with image-fidelity metrics, although their purpose is to improve downstream analysis. We study whether enhancement improves tissue segmentation, and for which segmenters. We propose an unpaired, physics-guided training pipeline for a lightweight ($\le$2.5\,M parameter) recurrent convolutional enhancer: a six-module stochastic 1.5\,T degradation operator, a residual adversarial network that adds scanner-specific texture without moving anatomy, and a cycle-consistent objective with an anti-identity penalty that rules out the copy solution. We then train U-Net, Swin-UNet and wavelet token-mixing segmenters \citep{jeevan2023wavemix} from scratch on either raw or enhanced 1.5\,T images of the same subjects, using identical labels and subject-level splits, for three enhancer variants and two datasets. On ABIDE (41 held-out subjects, FreeSurfer labels) enhancement significantly improves the wavelet segmenter (mean Dice $+0.014$, Wilcoxon $p=3.5\times10^{-5}$; CSF $+0.018$, grey matter $+0.013$), significantly degrades the U-Net ($-0.008$, $p=5.1\times10^{-4}$) and leaves Swin-UNet unchanged. On IXI, whose labels come from FSL-FAST, enhancement lowers Dice for all nine pairings, almost entirely through CSF; we trace this to spatially implausible CSF voxels in the labels that penalise smoother predictions. Enhancement of low-field MRI should therefore be validated per downstream model and against reliable labels.

AI.tldr: 本文研究1.5T脑MRI增强是否真正改善下游组织分割，发现增强效果因分割模型与标注来源而异，并非普遍有效。
AI.motivation: 超分辨与质量增强通常用图像保真度指标评估，但其真正目的是改善下游分析任务，因此需要验证增强对组织分割的实际影响，并明确对哪些分割器有益。
AI.method: 提出无配对、物理引导的训练流程，训练轻量（≤2.5M参数）循环卷积增强器：包含六模块随机1.5T退化算子、保持解剖结构不变的残差对抗网络（添加扫描仪特定纹理）以及带反恒等惩罚的循环一致性目标。随后用相同标签和受试者级划分，从头训练U-Net、Swin-UNet和小波token混合分割器，分别在原始或增强的1.5T图像上，覆盖三种增强器变体和两个数据集。
AI.result: 在ABIDE（41名留出受试者，FreeSurfer标签）上，增强显著提升小波分割器（Dice均值+0.014，p=3.5e-5；CSF +0.018，灰质+0.013），显著降低U-Net（-0.008，p=5.1e-4），对Swin-UNet无影响。在IXI（FSL-FAST标签）上，增强使全部九种配对Dice下降，几乎全由CSF导致，归因于标签中空间不合理的CSF体素会惩罚更平滑的预测。
AI.conclusion: 低场MRI增强应按下游模型逐一验证，并依赖可靠标签进行评估。

title: On Parameters of Nonlinear Scalar Dynamics from Video: Invariants, Calibration, and Identifiability
summary: Physical parameter estimation from video aims to recover the parameters of a known family of governing dynamical equations from pixel observations. Existing identifiability theory for this setting has focused on linear time-invariant (LTI) second-order systems, leaving open what can be identified for nonlinear scalar dynamics. We develop an identifiability theory for nonlinear scalar second-order ODEs, organized by how their velocity dependence interacts with changes of the learned state coordinate. Under a shared non-collapsed state map and explicit same-state velocity-coverage conditions, we show that parameter identifiability depends on the ODE family: some parameters are uniquely identifiable, while in other families only invariant parameter combinations are identifiable or external physical calibration is required. For laws that are at most linear in velocity, compatibility forces affine coordinate alignment, yielding explicit parameter relations, invariants, and calibration conditions. This affine conclusion extends to broader finite velocity-feature families when coordinate curvature can be separated from the declared velocity dependence. For families admitting a squared-velocity term, nonlinear coordinate ambiguity can remain; a law-derived normalization instead enables affine comparison between canonical laws. Experiments on synthetic systems and real pendulum and free-fall videos support the predicted parameter relations, coverage effects, and calibration requirements.

AI.tldr: 本文针对从视频中估计物理参数的问题，建立了非线性标量二阶ODE的可辨识性理论，按速度依赖性与学习状态坐标变化的关系进行分类，并通过合成与真实视频实验验证了参数关系、覆盖效应与校准需求。
AI.motivation: 从视频恢复支配动力学方程的参数是重要问题，但现有可辨识性理论仅关注线性时不变（LTI）二阶系统，对非线性标量动力学的可辨识性尚不清楚。
AI.method: 在共享非塌缩状态映射与显式同状态速度覆盖条件下，建立非线性标量二阶ODE的可辨识性理论；分析速度依赖性与坐标变化如何相互作用。对速度至多线性的规律，证明兼容性强制仿射坐标对齐，给出显式参数关系、不变量与校准条件；将该仿射结论扩展到更广的有限速度特征族（当坐标曲率可与声明的速度依赖分离时）；对含速度平方项的族，分析非线性坐标歧义并引入规律导出归一化以实现典型规律间的仿射比较。
AI.result: 理论表明参数可辨识性依赖ODE族：部分参数唯一可辨识，另一些族仅可辨识不变参数组合或需外部物理校准。合成系统及真实单摆与自由落体视频实验支持了预测的参数关系、覆盖效应与校准需求。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将视频物理参数可辨识性从LTI二阶系统推广到非线性标量二阶ODE，刻画了可达的辨识界限与所需校准条件，并得到实验验证。

title: MADBench: Benchmarking the Security of Multi-Agent Debate
summary:
Multi-agent debate (MAD) can improve large language model (LLM) reasoning by allowing multiple agents to exchange and critique their answers to the same task. However, the interactions that enable agents to correct mistakes can also spread adversarial errors and steer the agents toward an incorrect answer. Although some efforts have been made to examine particular attack types on MAD, systematic evaluation of MAD under diverse attacks remains limited. A central question is whether debate mitigates adversarial influence or amplifies it.
  In this paper, we present MADBench, a benchmark for evaluating the security of MAD. We organize attacks into a layered taxonomy following the MAD workflow, incorporating both established attacks and new strategies tailored to debate. We evaluate six attack families over 356 source tasks and 3,958 test cases, examining their effects on the final answer and the propagation of adversarial influence. Our results show that, under attacks, MAD does not necessarily improve LLM reasoning. Compared with a single-agent baseline, MAD can mitigate attacks on answer accuracy in question-answering tasks while amplifying unauthorized reads or writes in both question-answering and workspace tasks. Moreover, even when three out of five agents collude, the attack changes the final answer from correct to wrong on only 28.30\% of tasks answered correctly without attack, while only 3.26\% of initially correct honest agents switch to wrong answers during debate.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MADBench基准，系统评估多智能体辩论（MAD）在多种攻击下的安全性，发现辩论并不必然提升推理，且会放大工作区任务中的未授权读写风险。
AI.motivation: MAD能通过多智能体交换与批判答案提升大模型推理，但这种交互也可能传播对抗性错误并诱导错误答案。目前对MAD的特定攻击研究零散，缺乏在多样攻击下的系统评估，核心问题是辩论究竟是缓解还是放大对抗影响。
AI.method: 构建MADBench基准：按MAD工作流建立分层攻击分类法，整合已有攻击与为辩论设计的新策略；在6类攻击家族、356个源任务、3958个测试用例上评估攻击对最终答案及对抗影响传播的作用。
AI.result: 攻击下MAD并不必然提升推理：相比单智能体基线，MAD在问答任务中可缓解对答案准确率的攻击，但在问答与工作区任务中会放大未授权读/写。即使五分之三智能体合谋，仅28.30%原本答对任务被改为错误，且辩论中仅3.26%最初正确的诚实智能体转为错误。
AI.conclusion: MAD的安全性取决于任务与攻击类型：它可减轻部分准确率攻击，却会放大工作区权限类风险；即便多数合谋，辩论对答案的鲁棒性仍有一定保护作用。

title: UGOD: Uncertainty-Guided Opacity and Dropout for Sparse-View 3D Gaussian Splatting
comment: 31 pages, 5 figures, 10 tables. Supplementary material included at the end of the manuscript
summary: Sparse-view 3D Gaussian Splatting is prone to overfitting because limited observations leave many Gaussian primitives weakly constrained, yet their contributions are still accumulated through alpha blending. Without uncertainty estimation, the renderer cannot distinguish unreliable primitives from well-constrained ones, allowing their erroneous contributions to corrupt novel-view synthesis. We introduce UGOD, an uncertainty-guided framework that estimates a view-dependent uncertainty score for each Gaussian and uses it to regulate its rendering contribution. A lightweight uncertainty head conditioned on Gaussian attributes and viewing direction predicts this score, which then drives a differentiable opacity-modulation mechanism that attenuates high-uncertainty primitives before compositing. During training, a detached soft-dropout branch applies an uncertainty-controlled continuous keep mask to discourage the model from relying on poorly constrained Gaussians and thereby reduce overfitting. Crucially, detaching the uncertainty score prevents gradients from this stochastic regulariser from biasing or collapsing the uncertainty prediction. Experiments on Mip-NeRF~360 and LLFF show that UGOD improves sparse-view novel-view synthesis while producing more compact Gaussian representations than the compared methods. These results demonstrate that Gaussian uncertainty provides an effective rendering-time control for sparse-view reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出UGOD，一个不确定性引导的稀疏视角3D高斯泼溅框架，为每个高斯基元估计视角相关不确定性并调制其渲染贡献，从而缓解过拟合并提升新视角合成质量。
AI.motivation: 稀疏视角下观测有限，许多高斯基元约束不足，但仍在alpha混合中累积贡献。渲染器缺乏不确定性估计，无法区分不可靠与约束良好的基元，导致错误贡献破坏新视角合成。
AI.method: 引入轻量不确定性头，以高斯属性和视角方向为条件预测视角相关不确定性分数；该分数驱动可微不透明度调制机制，在合成前衰减高不确定性基元；训练时使用分离的软dropout分支施加不确定性控制的连续keep掩码以抑制过拟合，且分离不确定性分数防止随机正则化梯度偏置或坍缩不确定性预测。
AI.result: 在Mip-NeRF 360和LLFF数据集上，UGOD改善了稀疏视角新视角合成效果，同时生成比对比方法更紧凑的高斯表示。
AI.conclusion: 高斯不确定性可为稀疏视角重建提供有效的渲染时控制手段。

title: Does Learning Protein Folding Generalize to Broader Reasoning?
summary: Large language models rely heavily on human text, which often conveys surface answers rather than the spatial and structural logic behind them. Protein folding is a natural testbed, because one solved structure yields thousands of exactly checkable spatial and topological statements. We ask: can learning to fold proteins teach general models reusable reasoning capabilities? To answer this, we build FoldingCorpus, a protein-derived question-answer dataset, and Fold2Reason, a recipe that post-trains on it through two complementary signals: discrete structural answers predicted via the model's native language head, and continuous 3D geometry decoded from the same shared representations. On FoldBench, Fold2Reason achieves structure prediction scores 2.7 to 3.5 times those of Qwen3.5-9B. Beyond protein structure prediction, it improves performance on all 10 benchmarks spanning spatial, graph, scientific, and general reasoning, raising macro-average accuracy from 45.09% to 48.33% (+3.23 pp), with positive gains on all 10 benchmarks, while matched controls built from random, synthetic, and shuffled structure yield substantially smaller or negative gains. Our work shows that non-linguistic, structure-dense scientific data can systematically improve broad reasoning in language models, making a solved scientific problem a practical source of post-training supervision.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 FoldingCorpus 数据集与 Fold2Reason 后训练配方，用蛋白质折叠的结构与几何监督信号训练语言模型，发现这种非语言、结构密集的科学数据能系统性地提升模型的通用推理能力。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型高度依赖人类文本，而人类文本往往只传达表层答案，缺乏背后的空间与结构逻辑。作者希望探究：学习折叠蛋白质这类结构密集的任务，是否能教会通用模型可迁移的推理能力。
AI.method: 作者构建了由蛋白质衍生的问答数据集 FoldingCorpus，并提出 Fold2Reason 后训练配方，通过两种互补信号进行训练：一是通过模型原生语言头预测离散结构答案，二是从共享表示中解码连续三维几何信息。
AI.result: 在 FoldBench 上，Fold2Reason 的结构预测分数是 Qwen3.5-9B 的 2.7 至 3.5 倍。此外，它在涵盖空间、图、科学与通用推理的 10 个基准上全部取得提升，宏平均准确率从 45.09% 升至 48.33%（+3.23 个百分点）；而由随机、合成和打乱结构构建的对照实验提升明显更小甚至为负。
AI.conclusion: 非语言、结构密集的科学数据可以系统性地改善语言模型的广泛推理能力，表明一个已被解决的科学问题可以作为后训练监督的实用来源。

title: Do Self-Evolving Skills Generalize to Held-Out Tasks?
summary: AI agents can externalize what they learn from past tasks into reusable \emph{skills}, such as procedures, checklists, code, or other executable artifacts, that can be retrieved and reused when solving new tasks. Self-evolving skill methods keep rewriting these skills after each round of practice on training tasks, and the skill is then used on new tasks of the same kind. We ask a question: does the improvement a skill shows on its training tasks carry over to new test tasks? We test five self-evolving methods and a one-shot skill on six benchmarks, with the same model, the same agent, and the same train/test split for every method. Of the 21 skills that improve on their training tasks, 5 keep all of that improvement on the test tasks, 13 keep part of it, and 3 keep none of it. No existing method is best everywhere. When we read the skills, the ones that carry over badly often fix details that should depend on the task, such as column names and output files, or turn a fix for one failure into a rule for every task. An LLM judge that reads the skill content can often see this: it ranks finished skills the same way the test results do in 86\% of pairs. But it predicts the effect of a single edit poorly, so edits still have to be tested by running them. Based on these findings, we describe Generalizable Skill Optimization (GSO), which keeps only a guide for writing skills and writes a new skill for each task; it scores highest on all six benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"技能泛化"问题：自进化技能方法在训练任务上的提升能否迁移到新测试任务？实验显示仅少数技能完全迁移，据此提出GSO方法，在六个基准上均最优。
AI.motivation: AI智能体可将过往任务经验外化为可复用技能（流程、清单、代码等），并在新任务中检索复用。自进化技能方法在每轮训练任务练习后不断重写技能，但作者质疑：技能在训练任务上的改进是否能真正迁移到同类新测试任务上？现有方法缺乏对泛化性的系统检验。
AI.method: 在相同模型、相同智能体、相同训练/测试划分条件下，测试五种自进化方法和一种一次性（one-shot）技能，覆盖六个基准。并对技能内容进行阅读分析，同时评估LLM评判者对技能排序及单次编辑效果的预测能力。基于发现提出Generalizable Skill Optimization（GSO）：只保留"如何编写技能"的指南，并为每个任务新写一份技能。
AI.result: 在21个于训练任务上有提升的技能中，5个在测试任务上完全保持提升，13个部分保持，3个完全没有保持。没有任何单一现有方法在所有场景下最优。泛化差的技能常固化应依赖任务的细节（如列名、输出文件名），或将单次失败的修复泛化为对所有任务的规则。LLM评判者阅读技能内容后，其排序与测试结果在86%的配对中一致，但对单次编辑效果的预测较差。
AI.conclusion: 技能在训练任务上的改进并不必然迁移到新任务，泛化性因方法而异，且无普适最优方法。编辑仍需实际运行测试验证。由于LLM评判者可较好评估成品技能但难以预测单次编辑，作者提出GSO，通过维护通用写作指南并为每个任务定制新技能，在全部六个基准上取得最高分。

title: DeCoPrune: Efficient KV-Cache Pruning for Autoregressive Video Diffusion via Denoising Consistency
summary: Autoregressive video diffusion supports streaming generation and interactive control, but its KV cache grows with the generated history. Existing compression strategies discard history using fixed windows or select tokens through local attention and similarity signals, without directly measuring whether a chunk contributes information beyond the retained context. We introduce DeCoPrune, a training-free method that treats cache compression as a denoising-consistency problem. We find that tokens with larger discrepancies between intermediate clean predictions and final denoised values tend to carry visual evidence less predictable from the retained context. DeCoPrune uses this model-intrinsic signal to retain high-discrepancy tokens in the long-term cache while pruning low-discrepancy tokens. To evaluate information retention, we introduce CMBench, comprising 58 approximately one-minute generated or real-world context episodes and 116 Reappear or Revisit continuation tasks requiring recall of earlier events or objects. Experiments with LingBot World v2 show that DeCoPrune achieves a DINO score of 0.6701 on a 0-1 scale, with an 85.43% reduction in cumulative historical KV token counts and a 4.14-fold continuation-generation speedup over FullKV. Its head-specialized variant reaches 0.6783 at an 86.19% pruning ratio, approaching FullKV's 0.6803 score and exceeding the evaluated compression baselines at similar budgets. These results indicate that denoising consistency can support long-range information retention while reducing autoregressive inference cost. Our project homepage is https://decoprune.github.io. The code is available at https://github.com/DeCoPrune/CMBench, and the benchmark at https://huggingface.co/datasets/Aoraku/CMBench.

AI.tldr: DeCoPrune：一种免训练的自回归视频扩散KV缓存压缩方法，将缓存压缩视为去噪一致性（denoising-consistency）问题，通过中间干净预测与最终去噪值之间的差异来筛选保留token。
AI.motivation: 自回归视频扩散支持流式生成与交互控制，但其KV缓存随生成历史不断增长；现有压缩策略采用固定窗口丢弃历史，或依赖局部注意力与相似度信号选择token，无法直接衡量某个chunk对保留上下文之外的信息贡献。
AI.method: 提出DeCoPrune，一种免训练方法，将缓存压缩建模为去噪一致性问题。基于观察：中间干净预测与最终去噪值差异较大的token，往往承载难以从保留上下文预测的视觉证据。据此，保留长时缓存中高差异token，剪除低差异token。同时提出CMBench基准，含58段约一分钟的生成/真实场景episode与116个Reappear/Revisit延续任务，用于评测信息保留能力。
AI.result: 在LingBot World v2实验中，DeCoPrune在0-1尺度上取得DINO分数0.6701，累计历史KV token数减少85.43%，延续生成较FullKV加速4.14倍。其头特化变体在86.19%剪枝率下达到0.6783，接近FullKV的0.6803，并在相近预算下超过所评测的压缩基线。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明去噪一致性可支持长程信息保留，同时降低自回归推理成本。

title: Right Answers, Costly Models: The Efficiency Gap in LLM-based Optimization Modeling
summary: Optimization modeling formulates real-world decision problems as mathematical programs that solvers can use to find optimal decisions. Large language models (LLMs) can automate this process, but the resulting correct formulations can require substantial time and memory to construct and solve, limiting practical scalability. Therefore, we systematically investigate whether LLMs can identify problem structure from natural-language descriptions and apply suitable optimization modeling techniques to generate mathematical models and solver code that solve the problems correctly and efficiently. To this end, we first curate OptTips, a knowledge base of 50 expert modeling techniques in eight families. Using this knowledge, we develop OptDachshund, a multi-agent framework that transforms problems from existing optimization benchmarks into new tasks for evaluating LLMs' use of modeling techniques. It constructs conventional and expert mathematical models with solver code for the same task and data, providing baselines for correctness and computational cost. The resulting EfficientOpt benchmark contains 561 expert-reviewed tasks with paired reference implementations. Evaluation of 11 representative LLMs reveals an efficiency gap on correctly solved tasks with comparable measurements: for every LLM, most generated programs take longer to solve than their expert counterparts. Within the comparable reference-size subset, 57\% of programs with correct objective values and fewer variables and linear constraints have longer recorded solver times. Case studies show that different modeling techniques can achieve the same optimal value at similar recorded cost. Faster solving may not reduce execution time if the code takes longer to prepare data and build the model. LLM optimization modeling should therefore be evaluated for both correctness and computational efficiency.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统研究LLM能否从自然语言描述中识别问题结构并应用优化建模技巧，构建OptTips知识库、OptDachshund多智能体框架和EfficientOpt基准，发现LLM生成的模型虽能正确求解但普遍比专家实现更慢，呼吁同时评估正确性与计算效率。
AI.motivation: LLM可自动完成优化建模，但生成的正确模型在构建和求解时往往耗时耗内存，限制了实际可扩展性。作者希望系统检验LLM是否能识别问题结构并应用合适的建模技巧，以生成既正确又高效的模型与求解代码。
AI.method: 首先整理OptTips——包含8大类50种专家建模技巧的知识库；基于此开发OptDachshund多智能体框架，将现有优化基准问题转化为评估LLM使用建模技巧的新任务，为同一任务和数据构建常规模型与专家模型及求解代码作为正确性和计算成本基线；由此形成EfficientOpt基准，含561个经专家评审的任务及成对参考实现。
AI.result: 在正确求解且测量口径可比的任务上，11个代表性LLM均存在效率差距，多数生成程序求解时间超过专家对照；在可比参考规模子集中，57%目标值正确且变量与线性约束更少的程序反而记录了更长的求解时间。案例研究显示不同建模技巧可达到相同最优值且记录成本相近；若代码准备数据和构建模型耗时更长，更快求解未必缩短整体执行时间。
AI.conclusion: LLM优化建模应同时从正确性和计算效率两方面进行评估，仅关注正确性会掩盖实际效率差距。

title: Rep2Skill: Representation-Guided Skill Self-Evolution for LLM Agents
summary: Textual skills enable large language model (LLM) based agents to accumulate reusable procedural knowledge without updating model parameters. Yet existing skill evolution remains largely confined to the text space: an optimizer must diagnose success and failure patterns, and revise skills solely from long execution trajectories and sparse task outcomes. This text-only paradigm leaves the agent's internal representations, which contain rich records of its evolving execution state, outside the skill optimization loop. We ask whether an agent can improve its external textual skills by reflecting on its own internal representations. We introduce Rep2Skill, a representation-guided framework for self-evolution on agent skills. Specifically, upon the collected agent rollouts, Rep2Skill models their internal model representation trajectories to localize turns that deviate from successful execution dynamics, and it further interprets these signals alongside the execution contexts as actionable textual feedback for targeted skill revision. Experiments on two agent environments with two open-source LLMs show that Rep2Skill consistently outperforms text-only approaches in the self-evolution setting, where the same LLM serves as both executor and optimizer without a stronger external model. This establishes a promising direction moving agent self-improvement beyond text-only reflection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Rep2Skill，一种基于表示引导的智能体技能自进化框架，通过分析模型内部表示轨迹来定位偏离成功执行模式的轮次，并转化为可操作的文本反馈以修订技能，实验证明其优于纯文本方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的智能体技能进化局限于文本空间，优化器只能从长执行轨迹和稀疏任务结果中诊断成败并修订技能，导致包含丰富执行状态记录的内部表示被排除在技能优化循环之外。作者希望探究智能体能否通过反思自身内部表示来改进外部文本技能。
AI.method: Rep2Skill在采集到的智能体轨迹上，对其内部模型表示轨迹进行建模，以定位偏离成功执行动态的轮次；随后结合执行上下文解释这些信号，转化为可操作的文本反馈，用于有针对性地修订技能。
AI.result: 在两个智能体环境和两种开源LLM上的实验表明，在不依赖更强外部模型、同一LLM同时充当执行者和优化器的自进化设置下，Rep2Skill始终优于纯文本方法。
AI.conclusion: 该工作确立了将智能体自我改进推向超越纯文本反思的有前景方向，即利用内部表示引导技能自进化。

title: CamAgent: An LLM-Agent Framework for Multi-Species Camera-Trap Workflows
summary: Camera traps accumulated vast, multidimensional data for wildlife monitoring, yet translating raw media archives into meaningful ecological insights remains highly fragmented. Current research workflows require laboriously stitching together disparate analysis tools and scripts, creating steep programming hurdles and complicating end-to-end spatiotemporal analyses. To overcome this fragmentation, we present CamAgent, an autonomous Large Language Model (LLM) agent framework that integrates camera-trap analytical workflows into a unified intelligent ecosystem. CamAgent interprets natural-language ecological intent, schedules computational routing, and executes specialized tools spanning computer-vision perception (e.g., SpeciesNet), CamtrapDP-compatible data management, detection-corrected occupancy modeling, temporal activity analysis, and species co-occurrence networks. The framework automates multi-stage analytical pipelines while maintaining essential data-quality controls and analytical conventions. Consequently, CamAgent significantly reduces manual programming overhead for conservationists, establishing a transparent, scalable, and fully integrated paradigm for camera-trap ecology. Our project is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/artifact72c6f4.

AI.tldr: CamAgent 是一个基于大语言模型的自主智能体框架，将碎片化的红外相机数据分析工具整合为统一的智能生态分析系统。
AI.motivation: 红外相机积累了大量多维野生动物监测数据，但将原始媒体档案转化为生态学洞见的过程高度碎片化。现有工作流需要费力拼接各类分析工具和脚本，编程门槛高，端到端时空分析复杂。
AI.method: 提出 CamAgent 框架，能够解析自然语言的生态学意图、调度计算路由，并调用专门工具，涵盖计算机视觉感知（如 SpeciesNet）、兼容 CamtrapDP 的数据管理、经探测校正的占据模型、时间活动分析和物种共现网络；自动化多阶段分析流程，同时保留数据质量控制和分析规范。
AI.result: 显著降低了保护工作者的手工编程负担，建立了透明、可扩展且完全集成的红外相机生态学分析范式。
AI.conclusion: CamAgent 通过 LLM 智能体实现红外相机生态分析的一体化与自动化，为相关领域提供了可扩展的集成化解决方案，项目已开源。

title: VERA: Verifiable Feasibility Representations with Counterfactual Credit for Constrained Multi-Agent Control
summary: Constrained multi-agent control requires more than predicting rewarding actions: an action can cease to be executable as contact windows, shared capacity, and deadlines change. We introduce VERA, a centralized-training, decentralized-execution framework that separates feasibility estimation from credit assignment. Each actor predicts a five-dimensional verifiable feasibility representation (VFR). After an action is proposed, exact action-conditioned margins available only during training supervise that representation, while a counterfactual group-relative advantage (CGRA) ranks candidate representation-action pairs. Execution uses one actor pass and no privileged state. In a dynamic space-air-ground integrated network (SAGIN), VERA obtains 55.33% +/- 3.60% success with 0.45% +/- 0.81% coverage violation, within 1.33 percentage points of a privileged-mask reference. With rewards matched over ten paired seeds, VERA improves success over the strongest baseline by 8.74 percentage points (p=0.023) and reduces violation by 52.19 percentage points (p=5.7e-8). A ten-seed 4-by-2 factorial attributes a 14.16-16.48 percentage-point gain to CGRA across handcrafted, learned, random, and latent representations; evaluation on seven unseen topologies preserves a 24.33-30.02 percentage-point advantage over multi-agent proximal policy optimization. From 10 to 40 users, success remains 50.1-53.8%, and VFR adds only 0.026 ms to a central processing unit (CPU) actor step. Cross-domain tests further identify the governing condition: counterfactual credit succeeds when candidate scores respect shared constraints and fails under incompatible reward geometries. These results establish action-conditioned feasibility as an auditable training interface and counterfactual credit as a geometry-dependent optimization mechanism.

AI.tldr: VERA 是一个集中训练、分散执行的框架，将可行性估计与信用分配分离，通过可验证可行性表示（VFR）与反事实组相对优势（CGRA）提升受限多智能体控制性能。
AI.motivation: 受限多智能体控制中，动作可能因接触窗口、共享容量和截止时间变化而失效，仅预测有回报的动作不足，需要显式处理可行性问题。
AI.method: VERA 令每个 actor 预测五维可验证可行性表示（VFR），训练时用精确的动作条件边际监督该表示，并用反事实组相对优势（CGRA）对候选表示-动作对排序；执行时仅需一次 actor 前向，不使用特权状态。
AI.result: 在动态 SAGIN 中，VERA 成功率 55.33%±3.60%，覆盖违规 0.45%±0.81%，距特权掩码参考仅 1.33 个百分点；配对种子下成功率比最强基线高 8.74 个百分点（p=0.023），违规降低 52.19 个百分点（p=5.7e-8）。十种子因子实验表明 CGRA 贡献 14.16–16.48 个百分点增益；七个未见拓扑上相对 MAPPO 保持 24.33–30.02 个百分点优势；10 到 40 用户下成功率保持 50.1–53.8%，VFR 仅增加 0.026 ms CPU 开销。
AI.conclusion: 结果确立动作条件可行性作为可审计的训练接口，反事实信用作为依赖几何结构的优化机制；反事实信用在候选分数尊重共享约束时成功，在奖励几何不兼容时失败。

title: Beyond the Remembered World: Predictive 4D Belief for Persistent Navigation in Evolving Worlds
summary: Persistent spatial memory enables embodied agents to navigate familiar environments across repeated visits. However, targets may move while unobserved, including during navigation, making remembered locations unreliable by the time an agent arrives. Despite advances in memory retrieval and state prediction, accounting for continued hidden world evolution and revising beliefs under limited visibility remain challenging. We study Evolving-World Navigation, where agents infer target locations from intermittent observations, predict their states at inspection time, and revise beliefs using visual evidence. We propose EvolvingNav, which constructs a time-indexed belief from timestamped 3D object histories through a structured persistence-relocation model. The belief distinguishes persistence at the last observed location from relocation to alternative locations and retains probability mass outside the known candidate set. An event-driven filter propagates the current belief as time elapses, forecasts target occupancy at candidate inspection times, and incorporates new RGB-D evidence. Negative observations downweight location hypotheses according to calibrated, visibility-conditioned detection probabilities, while evidence tracking prevents repeated use of the same observations. A frozen, zero-shot vision-language controller uses the updated belief to choose actions and replan. We further introduce EvoWorld-Bench, a benchmark grounded in human activity traces, comprising 54 scenes and 803,680 tasks with controlled changes before and during navigation. In simulation and real-robot experiments, EvolvingNav improves navigation success and search efficiency over the evaluated baselines. Paired experiments show the clearest gains under learnable temporal patterns, while ablations demonstrate the value of preserving uncertainty and incorporating visibility-aware evidence.

AI.tldr: 提出EvolvingNav，用时间索引信念建模动态世界中的目标位置，并结合事件驱动滤波与零样本视觉语言控制器，提升导航成功率与搜索效率。
AI.motivation: 持久空间记忆能帮助具身智能体重复导航熟悉环境，但目标可能在未被观测时移动（含导航过程中移动），导致到达时记忆位置不可靠；现有记忆检索与状态预测方法难以应对世界持续隐式演化与低可见度下的信念修正。
AI.method: 研究“演化世界导航”任务：智能体从间歇观测推断目标位置，预测检查时刻目标状态，并用视觉证据修正信念。提出EvolvingNav，基于带时间戳的3D物体历史，通过结构化“持续-迁移”模型构建时间索引信念，区分目标停留在上次观测位置与迁移到其他位置，并保留已知候选集之外的概率质量。采用事件驱动滤波器随时间传播信念、预测候选检查时刻的目标占据情况并融合新RGB-D证据；负观测按标定的可见度条件检测概率降低位置假设权重，证据跟踪防止同一观测重复使用。使用冻结的零样本视觉语言控制器基于更新信念选择动作并重规划。同时构建EvoWorld-Bench基准，含54个场景、803,680个任务。
AI.result: 在仿真与真机实验中，EvolvingNav在导航成功率和搜索效率上优于所评估基线；配对实验显示在可学习时间模式下增益最明显；消融验证了保留不确定性及引入可见度感知证据的价值。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模目标持续与迁移、保留不确定性与可见度条件证据修正，可有效应对导航中目标隐藏演化问题，并提升真实环境导航性能。

title: Beyond Local Linearity: Scale-Resolved Geometry of Learned Image Encoders
comment: Extended abstract, NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Symmetry and Geometry in Neural Representations (NeurReps). 14 pages, 5 figures
summary: Understanding how learned representations respond to finite input changes is important for characterizing their sensitivity, invariances, and robustness. Yet existing geometric analyses are predominantly local and describe only infinitesimal perturbations. We introduce a scale-resolved statistic that compares an encoder's measured feature displacement with its local linear prediction as the perturbation magnitude increases. Across diverse image encoders, we discover a characteristic plateau-rise-peak-decay profile, which we call the bump. The bump is absent at initialization, emerges early during standard training, and does not form under randomized labels or random-noise inputs. Its shape also varies with the training distribution and robustness objective. These results establish departures from local geometry as a signature of how encoder representations are shaped by learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种尺度分辨的统计量，比较编码器特征位移与其局部线性预测随扰动幅度增大的偏差，发现在多种图像编码器中存在特征性的"bump"曲线轮廓。
AI.motivation: 现有的几何分析多为局部性，仅能描述无穷小扰动，无法刻画有限输入变化下学习表示的敏感性与不变性。
AI.method: 引入尺度分辨统计量，在扰动幅度递增过程中，将编码器实测特征位移与其局部线性预测进行比较。
AI.result: 在多种图像编码器中观察到"平台-上升-峰值-衰减"的bump轮廓；该现象在初始化时不存在，标准训练早期出现，随机标签或随机噪声输入下不形成，且其形状随训练分布和鲁棒性目标变化。
AI.conclusion: 偏离局部几何可作为编码器表示受学习塑造的一种特征标志。

title: Learning Continuous Neural Representation of Stochastic Hybrid Systems
summary: A stochastic hybrid system (SHS) is governed by a stochastic differential equation (SDE) describing the continuous dynamics and a Markov reset kernel triggered on the guard surface. Its probability evolution can be described by a hybrid Fokker-Planck (HFP) equation with a partial differential term corresponding to the SDE and an integral term arising from the reset kernel. This work shows that such an SHS can be approximated by an SDE in a higher-dimensional latent space where the sample paths are continuous. The key to this result is to encode different branches of the reset kernel using auxiliary variables, transforming the resets into deterministic ones that enable topological gluing. By the embedding theorem, the glued manifold can then be embedded into a higher-dimensional Euclidean space. We show that the probability evolution on the embedded image no longer requires explicit reset terms in the HFP equation. Building on this theorem, we design a loss that matches the evolving state distributions, enabling a single latent SDE to recover the probability evolution of the SHS without mode labeling, trajectory segmentation, or event-based simulations.

AI.tldr: 本文将随机混合系统(SHS)近似为一个更高维潜空间中的随机微分方程(SDE)，通过辅助变量编码重置分支并实现拓扑粘合，使概率演化无需显式重置项，并据此设计分布匹配损失来学习潜SDE。
AI.motivation: SHS由连续SDE动态与守卫面上的Markov重置核共同支配，其概率演化由含偏微分项与积分项的混合Fokker-Planck(HFP)方程描述，重置项带来的不连续性使建模与学习较为困难，作者希望用更简洁的连续SDE框架来刻画其概率演化。
AI.method: 用辅助变量编码重置核的不同分支，将随机重置转化为确定性重置，从而进行拓扑粘合；再依据嵌入定理把粘合流形嵌入到更高维欧氏空间，证明嵌入像上的概率演化不再需要HFP方程中的显式重置项。基于该定理设计一个匹配演化状态分布的损失函数，以单一潜SDE恢复SHS的概率演化，无需模式标注、轨迹分段或事件驱动仿真。
AI.result: 证明了SHS可由高维潜空间中样本路径连续的SDE近似，且在嵌入像上的概率演化无需显式重置项；所设计的分布匹配损失使单个潜SDE能够恢复SHS的概率演化。
AI.conclusion: SHS的概率演化可等价地用高维潜空间中的连续SDE刻画，这一理论为无模式标注、无轨迹分段、无事件仿真的SHS概率演化学习提供了新途径。

title: Reinforcing Multimodal Reasoning via Token-Level Perception-Grounded Advantage Estimation
summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has improved the reasoning capabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), yet existing frameworks rely on coarse, sequence-level reward signals that lack the fine-grained supervision over the visually-grounded steps within a multimodal reasoning chain. We investigate this gap through the lens of two token-level metrics: visual dependency (i.e. how much a token's prediction relies on the input image features) and predictive entropy. Our empirical analysis reveals two key findings: (1) correct reasoning chains exhibit a markedly sharper entropy reduction as visual grounding intensifies, compared to incorrect ones; (2) pivotal tokens, those whose misprediction triggers reasoning collapse, are statistical outliers in the joint distribution of visual dependency and predictive entropy derived from correct chains. Motivated by these findings, we propose token-level perception-grounded advantage estimation (TPAE), which estimates token-level advantages by measuring each token's statistical consistency with the vision-entropy patterns of correct rollouts. TPAE leverages this granular score to modulate the sequence-level advantage, producing a fine-grained supervision signal that can be integrated into various RLVR frameworks. Extensive experiments on seven benchmarks show that TPAE consistently outperforms leading strong baselines, yielding more stable and efficient optimization for multimodal reasoning. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/Zhihan72/TPAE.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出token级感知锚定优势估计（TPAE），通过视觉依赖度与预测熵的联合分布为多模态推理提供细粒度奖励信号。
AI.motivation: 现有基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）用于多模态大模型时，只提供序列级粗粒度奖励，缺乏对多模态推理链中视觉锚定步骤的细粒度监督，导致优化信号不够精准。
AI.method: 作者从token级视觉依赖度与预测熵两个指标入手进行实证分析，发现正确推理链在视觉锚定增强时熵下降更显著，且关键token在正确链的联合分布中是统计离群点。据此提出TPAE，通过衡量每个token与正确rollout的视觉-熵模式统计一致性来估计token级优势，并用该粒度分数调制序列级优势，可嵌入多种RLVR框架。
AI.result: 在七个基准测试上，TPAE持续优于现有强基线，实现更稳定高效的多模态推理优化。
AI.conclusion: 利用视觉依赖度与预测熵的token级统计规律可为多模态推理提供细粒度奖励信号，TPAE是一种通用且有效的RLVR增强方法。

title: GRC-Pose: Generation-Reconstruction Correspondence for Prior-Free 6D Object Pose Tracking
summary: Prior-free 6D object pose tracking seeks to recover the trajectory of an unseen object from a single RGB video without object-specific CAD models, posed reference images, or pose annotations. Geometric foundation models provide complementary object-centric and scene-centric cues, yet SAM3D CAD is indexed by an arbitrary object-local surface parameterization, whereas reconstructed evidence is expressed in a sequence-specific world frame with partial surface coverage. To exploit this complementarity, we formulate tracking as generation-reconstruction correspondence and introduce GRC-Pose, a correspondence-based framework that combines learned correspondence prediction with robust pose estimation. Concretely, GeoCorr-Matcher estimates weighted object-scene correspondences and per-match uncertainty for each pose candidate. FGH-Solver integrates these matches through multiple robust geometric estimators and sequence-level posterior inference, while a posterior-gated memory retains only inlier-supported observations through occlusion and viewpoint change. Extensive evaluation shows that with SAM3D CAD, GRC-Pose achieves state-of-the-art Average Recall and motion retention on HOT3D, improving the latter by 58% over prior art. On classical benchmarks including YCBInEOAT and LINEMOD, it remains highly competitive.

AI.tldr: GRC-Pose 将无先验6D物体位姿跟踪建模为“生成-重建对应”问题，结合学习式对应预测与鲁棒位姿估计，在 HOT3D 上取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 无先验6D位姿跟踪需在无CAD模型、无参考位姿图、无位姿标注条件下从单目RGB视频恢复未见物体轨迹。几何基础模型虽提供物体中心与场景中心的互补线索，但 SAM3D CAD 基于任意物体局部表面参数化，而重建证据位于序列特定的世界坐标系且表面覆盖不完整，二者难以直接对齐。
AI.method: 提出基于对应的框架 GRC-Pose，将跟踪表述为生成-重建对应问题。其中 GeoCorr-Matcher 估计加权物体-场景对应及每个匹配的不确定性；FGH-Solver 通过多个鲁棒几何估计器与序列级后验推断融合匹配；后验门控记忆机制在遮挡与视角变化下仅保留有内点支持的观测。
AI.result: 结合 SAM3D CAD 时，GRC-Pose 在 HOT3D 上取得最优平均召回率与运动保持率，后者较此前方法提升58%；在 YCBInEOAT 与 LINEMOD 等经典基准上仍具高度竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模生成-重建对应并融合鲁棒几何估计与序列级后验推断，可有效利用几何基础模型的互补线索，实现无先验6D物体位姿跟踪的先进性能。

title: Unmerge: Efficient Machine Unlearning via Task Arithmetic
summary: Approximate machine unlearning seeks to remove the influence of a forget set from a trained model without full retraining. Existing gradient-based methods require data-dependent hyperparameter search, struggle when forget and retain knowledge are entangled, and offer little insight into where unlearning actually happens inside the network. We recast unlearning through the lens of task arithmetic: if finetuning produces a merged task vector $τ_m$ that combines learning on forget and retain sets, unlearning is the inverse operation that subtracts a learned forget component $τ_F$ to recover the retain task vector $τ_R$. The forget signal is concentrated: at every layer, forget activations lie in a subspace spanned by a handful of dominant directions, so we factorize $τ_F$ in a low-rank forget basis, which is faithful up to a small tail-eigenvalue residual and limits how far the correction can perturb retain. We then optimize three intuitive goals (match the merged vector inside the forget span, suppress leakage into the retain span, and bound the correction size) that provably bound forget leakage and retain damage in activation space. The resulting algorithm, Unmerge, is fast and powerful: on class-level unlearning with ResNet-50 on CIFAR-100 and Tiny ImageNet, it improves Tug-of-War by up to ~24% over a baseline of comparable runtime and by up to ~18% over stronger baselines that run ~5x slower, keeps membership-inference exposure at the level of retraining, and shrinks the feature-distribution gap to the retrained model, where relabeling methods leave forget features cleanly separable. Further studies show that Unmerge also applies to ViT-S/16 and scales to Llama-3.2-3B. The per-layer basis geometry that drives the algorithm also serves as a layerwise diagnostic for when and where unlearning becomes structurally hard.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出Unmerge，通过任务算术视角将机器遗忘重构为减去低秩遗忘任务向量的逆操作，实现快速、有效的近似遗忘，并可在多层网络上定位遗忘发生的层级。
AI.motivation: 现有基于梯度的近似机器遗忘方法需要依赖数据相关的超参数搜索，当遗忘集与保留集知识高度纠缠时效果不佳，且无法解释网络内部究竟在何处发生遗忘。
AI.method: 将遗忘问题建模为任务算术的逆操作：微调产生合并任务向量τ_m，遗忘即减去学到的遗忘成分τ_F以恢复保留任务向量τ_R。发现遗忘激活集中于少数主导方向构成的低秩子空间，据此对τ_F做低秩分解，并优化三个目标：在遗忘子空间内匹配合并向量、抑制向保留子空间的泄漏、约束修正幅度，从而在激活空间中对遗忘泄漏与保留损伤给出可证明的界。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-100和Tiny ImageNet上以ResNet-50进行类级遗忘，Tug-of-War指标较同运行时基线提升约24%，较运行约5倍慢的更强基线提升约18%；成员推断暴露与重训练相当，特征分布与重训练模型的差距缩小。方法还可用于ViT-S/16并扩展至Llama-3.2-3B。
AI.conclusion: Unmerge快速有效，能在接近重训练的安全水平下完成遗忘，并适用于多种架构与规模。其逐层基几何不仅驱动算法，还可作为诊断工具，用于判断遗忘何时何地变得结构上困难。

title: Learning Process Rewards via Reasoning State Propagation
summary: Process reward models (PRMs) have demonstrated notable effectiveness in test-time scaling and reinforcement learning by providing fine-grained signals for evaluating intermediate reasoning states, but their training relies heavily on costly process annotations. A natural way to alleviate this dependence is to complement limited process supervision with scalable outcome supervision. However, existing PRMs often model reasoning prefixes independently, providing no explicit mechanism for effectively using final outcome to guide the learning of intermediate reasoning states. We introduce Reasoning State Propagation (RSP), which represents each reasoning prefix with a binary validity state and models transitions between successive states across the reasoning trajectory. Specifically, RSP predicts a break probability that a valid state becomes invalid and a repair probability that an invalid state returns to valid. By propagating these transitions, RSP connects intermediate states to the final state, allowing process annotations to supervise intermediate states while outcome labels supervise the final state and can provide learning signals to preceding steps. Across reasoning search, response selection, and reinforcement learning, RSP consistently outperforms representative PRM baselines, with average improvements over Qwen2.5-Math-PRM of 5.6% in beam search and 2.1% in reinforcement learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出推理状态传播（RSP），将推理前缀表示为二元有效性状态并建模状态转移，用过程标注监督中间状态、用结果标签监督最终状态，从而把结果信号传播到前面的步骤。
AI.motivation: 过程奖励模型（PRM）能提供细粒度信号，但训练依赖昂贵的过程标注；用可扩展的结果监督补充过程监督时，现有PRM独立建模推理前缀，缺乏用最终结果指导中间推理状态学习的显式机制。
AI.method: RSP为每个推理前缀赋予二元有效性状态，并建模相邻状态之间的转移：预测有效状态变为无效的"断裂概率"和无效状态恢复为有效的"修复概率"。通过传播这些转移，RSP将中间状态与最终状态连接起来，使过程标注监督中间状态、结果标签监督最终状态，并为前面的步骤提供学习信号。
AI.result: 在推理搜索、响应选择和强化学习任务中，RSP均稳定优于代表性PRM基线；相比Qwen2.5-Math-PRM，beam search平均提升5.6%，强化学习平均提升2.1%。
AI.conclusion: RSP通过状态转移传播机制有效地将结果监督与过程监督结合，缓解了对昂贵过程标注的依赖，并在多种推理任务上验证了其有效性。

title: Is Better Teacher Supervision Enough? Unlocking Student-side Learning in Multimodal On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) improves reasoning by providing token-level supervision from a teacher on a student's own trajectories. Existing methods primarily focus on enhancing this teacher-side guidance (e.g., by enriching teacher inputs and refining teacher feedback), yet we find that limited student perception is another critical bottleneck in multimodal OPD. By providing oracle visual facts, the performance of OPD-trained students can still be substantially improved for both weak and strong teachers. To address this bottleneck, we propose S-OPD, a simple multimodal on-policy distillation framework that explicitly strengthens student perceptual learning through two objectives. Specifically, Teacher-calibrated Policy Contrast separates student policies under original and masked images with teacher-based token-level gating, strengthening the student's reliance on visual evidence during reasoning. Policy Agreement aligns student policies under original and noise-perturbed images, further improving perceptual robustness to visual noise. Notably, our method can be seamlessly plugged into existing OPD frameworks, requiring no additional data annotations, model parameters or inference operations. Extensive experiments on eight benchmarks across student scales and distillation paradigms demonstrate consistent performance improvements, with gains of up to 4.25 points on LogicVista. When combined with existing teacher-side supervision methods, our method can yield further gains. Code is available at https://github.com/Sirilaw/S-OPD.

AI.tldr: 提出S-OPD框架，通过强化学生感知学习解决多模态on-policy蒸馏中的感知瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态OPD方法主要聚焦于增强教师端指导（如丰富教师输入、优化教师反馈），但作者发现学生感知能力有限是另一个关键瓶颈：即使提供oracle视觉事实，弱教师和强教师训练的学生的性能都能大幅提升。
AI.method: 提出S-OPD，通过两个目标强化学生感知学习：1）Teacher-calibrated Policy Contrast，利用教师端token级门控，对比原始图像与掩码图像下的学生策略，增强学生对视觉证据的依赖；2）Policy Agreement，对齐原始图像与噪声扰动图像下的学生策略，提升感知鲁棒性。该方法可无缝接入现有OPD框架，无需额外数据标注、模型参数或推理操作。
AI.result: 在八个基准、不同学生规模和蒸馏范式上取得一致性能提升，LogicVista上最高提升4.25分；与现有教师端监督方法结合可带来进一步增强。
AI.conclusion: 学生感知是限制多模态OPD的关键瓶颈，S-OPD通过强化学生感知学习有效提升性能，且易于集成，具有良好的通用性和可扩展性。

title: K2P: Label-Free Knowledge to Prompt Distillation
summary: Knowledge distillation can transfer reasoning from stronger teachers to frozen students through reusable prompts, but avoiding weight updates does not eliminate supervision. Without ground-truth answers, teacher solutions are unverified, and agreement with the teacher can reward shared mistakes. We introduce Knowledge-to-Prompt (K2P) for label-free knowledge distillation to prompts. K2P synthesizes reusable instructions from teacher solutions, refines them using paired teacher and student responses, and guides search and selection with answer agreement. It retains candidates that adaptive search may undervalue and selects on reserved questions. Deployment uses only the frozen student and selected prompt. Our theory separates generation and selection gaps and gives conditions under which agreement-guided construction yields accuracy guarantees despite imperfect teacher references. Across reasoning tasks and students, K2P outperforms label-free alternatives overall and remains competitive with supervised prompt optimization. Ablations and archive diagnostics assess the contributions of teacher solutions and refinement, while revealing the limits of agreement-guided selection.

AI.tldr: K2P提出了一种无标签的知识蒸馏到提示的方法，通过从教师解答合成可复用指令、用师生配对响应精炼，并以答案一致性指导搜索与选择，无需真实答案即可将教师的推理能力迁移给冻结的学生模型。
AI.motivation: 知识蒸馏可借助可复用提示将强教师的推理能力迁移给冻结的学生，但避免权重更新并不能消除监督需求。在没有真实答案的情况下，教师解答本身未经核验，且与教师的一致性可能会奖励共同的错误，因此需要一个无标签、能缓解一致性选择风险的蒸馏方案。
AI.method: K2P从教师解答中合成可复用指令，利用配对的教师与学生响应进行精炼，并以答案一致性引导搜索与选择。方法保留自适应搜索可能低估的候选，并在保留问题上进行选择；部署时仅使用冻结学生和已选提示。理论上区分了生成鸿沟与选择鸿沟，并给出在教师参考不完美情况下，一致性引导构造仍能提供准确率保证的条件。
AI.result: 在多种推理任务和学生模型上，K2P整体优于无标签替代方案，并与有监督的提示优化保持竞争力。消融实验与档案诊断评估了教师解答与精炼的贡献，同时揭示了基于一致性选择的局限性。
AI.conclusion: K2P表明在无真实标签条件下，通过一致性引导的提示构造与选择可以有效实现教师到学生的推理蒸馏，并在理论上给出准确率保证的条件；但一致性引导的选择仍存在局限，需要进一步改进。

title: Fyan: A Human--AI Harness with Semantic Auditing for Document-Level Formalization
summary: We present FYAN, a human--AI harness for document-level mathematical formalization. Rather than treating theorems in isolation, FYAN coordinates an end-to-end workflow spanning specification, proof planning, logical review, Lean proof construction, knowledge curation, and validation, with support for independent supervision and human guidance. A central component is evidence-grounded semantic auditing, which assesses whether formal statements faithfully preserve their informal specifications. A language model constructs structured evidence over local correspondences, omissions, scope, and logical relations, while a deterministic validator checks this evidence and produces reproducible judgments. When a substantive but admissible deviation is accepted, FYAN requires an explicit proof-transfer obligation connecting the formal statement back to a source-facing interpretation. With the same model (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash) in every stage, FYAN proves 86 of 143 FormalTCS theorems under a strict Lean check, against 69 for a general agent harness, and raises the natural-language proof score from 0.501 to 0.851. On ConsistencyCheck, its semantic audit catches more inconsistent statements than a direct LLM judge, both on labels verified against the source (recall 0.777 vs. 0.636) and on the original labels (0.873 vs. 0.820), and localizes each mismatch it reports to a specific hypothesis, conclusion, or scope. FYAN also built ODENumLib, a 9,355-line Lean library for the numerical analysis of ordinary differential equation.

AI.tldr: FYAN是一个面向文档级数学形式化的人机协同框架，通过端到端工作流与语义审计，在Lean验证下显著提升定理证明与语义一致性检测效果。
AI.motivation: 传统方法将定理孤立处理，缺乏对文档级整体流程的协调，且形式化陈述可能偏离原始非形式化规范，需要可复现的语义审计与人工监督机制。
AI.method: FYAN协调规范、证明规划、逻辑审查、Lean证明构建、知识整理与验证等端到端工作流，支持独立监督与人工指导；核心为证据驱动的语义审计，由语言模型构建关于局部对应、遗漏、范围与逻辑关系的结构化证据，确定性验证器检查并生成可复现判断；当存在可接受偏差时需显式证明迁移义务。
AI.result: 在统一使用DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash的情况下，FYAN在严格Lean检查下证明143个FormalTCS定理中的86个（基线69个），自然语言证明得分从0.501提升至0.851；在ConsistencyCheck上语义审计较直接LLM判断更能发现不一致陈述（召回率0.777 vs 0.636，原标签0.873 vs 0.820），并能定位到具体假设、结论或范围；还构建了9,355行的ODENumLib库。
AI.conclusion: FYAN通过人机协同与证据驱动的语义审计，有效提升了文档级数学形式化的证明成功率与语义一致性检测能力，并产出了可用的Lean数学库。

title: How to Reduce Localization Ambiguity? Geometry-Semantic Constrained BEV Representation Learning for Satellite-Ground Localization
summary: Satellite-ground localization estimates the planar position and yaw orientation of a ground camera within a geo-referenced satellite image. Most recent methods map ground and satellite features into a shared bird's-eye-view (BEV) space and establish spatial correspondences. However, insufficient depth constraints can assign one ground feature to different distances along a viewing direction, creating geometric ambiguity in BEV feature placement. Similar appearances at different locations can also create descriptor matching ambiguity, while existing descriptor learning lacks explicit semantic supervision to distinguish them. We propose GeoSem-BEV, a geometry-semantic constrained BEV representation learning method. Radial depth supervision constrains distance assignment, and vertical height supervision constrains height aggregation. Shared explicit semantic supervision promotes consistent semantic predictions across views and helps distinguish locations with similar semantics. These constraints improve feature placement and descriptor discriminability, enhancing state-of-the-art BEV localization models. On VIGOR with unknown orientation, GeoSem-BEV reduces mean orientation error by 37.2% and 38.1% in the cross-area and same-area settings, respectively. The corresponding errors are reduced by 10.8% and 15.6% on DReSS-D. On KITTI-CVL, it reduces same-area mean orientation error by 26.8% under 10 degree orientation noise.

AI.tldr: 提出GeoSem-BEV，通过几何与语义约束学习BEV表示，提升星地定位精度。
AI.motivation: 现有BEV星地定位方法存在两类歧义：深度约束不足导致同一地面特征被映射到视线方向上不同距离，造成几何歧义；不同位置的相似外观造成描述子匹配歧义，且现有描述子学习缺乏显式语义监督。
AI.method: GeoSem-BEV采用几何-语义约束的BEV表示学习：径向深度监督约束距离分配，垂直高度监督约束高度聚合；共享显式语义监督促进跨视图语义预测一致，帮助区分相似语义位置，从而改善特征放置与描述子判别力。
AI.result: 在VIGOR未知朝向设置下，跨区域和同区域平均朝向误差分别降低37.2%和38.1%；在DReSS-D上分别降低10.8%和15.6%；在KITTI-CVL上，10度朝向噪声下同区域平均朝向误差降低26.8%。
AI.conclusion: 几何与语义约束可有效提升BEV星地定位模型的性能，增强特征放置准确性与描述子判别能力。

title: Certified Approximation for Interpretable Representer Landmarks
summary: Representer explanations rank the training landmarks that most influence a self-supervised representation. At scale, this ranking rests on up to four stacked approximations of the empirical neural tangent kernel (eNTK). These are random output heads, a parameter sketch, landmark sampling and a coefficient fit. Existing analyses bound each approximation separately, but none certifies the top-$K$ set against their combined error. We introduce CAIRN (Certified Approximation for Interpretable Representer laNdmarks), a framework that carries this error through to the ranking. We derive the exact variance of the sketched multi-head eNTK, which matches measurement within $4\%$ where Johnson-Lindenstrauss bounds err by up to $2.5\times$. This yields a high-probability top-$K$ certificate for a fixed coefficient fit, alongside exact residual-trace certificates for discarded spectral mass. An exact product-variance identity separates kernel error from fit variability and identifies when a larger kernel budget can still sharpen a ranking. Stochastic Lanczos Quadrature (SLQ) estimates the effective dimension within $0.72\%$ and guides the landmark budget without dense eigendecomposition. We show that residual mass does not control class coverage, and residual-greedy selection cuts the worst coverage excess of $k$-means++ from $8.5\times$ to $1.55\times$ ($4\times$ on the sketched eNTK). Cross-view initializers outperform principal-component initialization in five (AUI) to all six (CSI) settings. Against the KREPES Gauss-Newton solver, CAIRN converges $2.5$ to $11.3\times$ faster, trails by at most $0.31$ points and gains up to $3.14$ points on MNIST. Together, these results make the reliability of representer explanations measurable and show where approximation budgets are best spent.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CAIRN框架，将多重近似误差传递到自监督表示的可解释代表性地标top-K排序中，实现误差可认证与预算优化。
AI.motivation: 大规模代表性地标解释依赖对经验神经切核（eNTK）的多层近似（随机输出头、参数草图化、地标采样、系数拟合）。已有分析各自独立界定单项近似误差，却无一能将组合误差认证到top-K集合，导致解释可靠性无法度量。
AI.method: 推导草图化多头eNTK的精确方差；据此给出固定系数拟合下的高概率top-K证书与丢弃谱质量的精确残差迹证书；用精确乘积方差恒等式分离核误差与拟合波动；用随机Lanczos求积（SLQ）估计有效维数并指导地标预算；提出残差贪心选择与跨视图初始化策略。
AI.result: 方差推导与实测吻合在4%以内（JL界误差可达2.5倍）；SLQ有效维数估计误差0.72%；残差贪心将k-means++最差覆盖超额从8.5倍降至1.55倍（草图eNTK上4倍）；跨视图初始化在AUI五个、CSI全部六个设置中优于主成分初始化；相比KREPES高斯-牛顿求解器收敛快2.5–11.3倍，精度最多落后0.31分、在MNIST上最多提升3.14分。
AI.conclusion: CAIRN使代表者解释的可靠性变得可度量，并揭示近似预算应如何最优分配。

title: Effective Does Not Mean Useful: Conditional Functional Substitutability for Redundancy and Scaling in Transformers
summary: Modern neural networks scale predictably, yet the mechanisms behind these regularities remain unclear. Neural redundancy is typically characterized by component importance or representational similarity, both indirect proxies. We view redundancy as an input-conditioned, dynamic relation: intermediate computational states are functionally redundant when they induce similar downstream responses. We introduce Conditional Functional Substitutability (CFS) to directly characterize such functional substitution. CFS exposes functional relations and reduction potential missed by conventional importance- and similarity-based measures. Across modalities and Transformer families, CFS reveals systematic functional reorganization with scale. Controlled scaling further shows that performance gains need not track growth in substitutability, while fixed-capacity models with more independent functional structure perform better, providing a functional account of diminishing returns. Predicted CFS further enables dynamic computation with a better performance--computation trade-off than importance-based component selection, suggesting new directions for redundancy-aware computation and more efficient model scaling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出条件功能可替代性（CFS），从功能角度刻画神经网络冗余，揭示了规模变化下的功能重组规律，并为动态计算提供了新思路。
AI.motivation: 现代神经网络规模可预测地扩展，但其背后机制尚不清晰。现有对神经冗余的刻画多依赖组件重要性或表征相似性，二者均为间接代理，无法直接反映冗余的功能本质，因此需要一种更直接的功能性度量。
AI.method: 将冗余视为一种输入条件化的动态关系：当中间计算状态诱发相似的下游响应时，即视为功能冗余。据此提出条件功能可替代性（CFS），直接刻画这种功能替代关系；并在多种模态与Transformer家族上验证，同时开展受控缩放实验，并将预测的CFS用于动态计算中的组件选择。
AI.result: CFS能揭示传统重要性和相似性度量所遗漏的功能关系与压缩潜力；跨模态与Transformer家族呈现随规模变化的功能重组；受控缩放显示性能提升并不必然伴随可替代性增长，而固定容量模型若具有更独立的功能结构则表现更好；基于CFS预测的动态计算在性能—计算权衡上优于基于重要性的组件选择。
AI.conclusion: 冗余应被理解为输入条件化的功能替代关系，CFS提供了对规模收益递减的功能性解释，并为冗余感知计算与更高效的模型扩展指明新方向。

title: GeoGAT: Bidirectional Temporal Sampling Meets Hierarchical Graph Attention for Global Video Geo-localization
summary: Global video geo-localization aims to infer the geographic location of a video worldwide, evaluating performance across four geographic hierarchies: city, state/province, country, and continent. Existing methods typically employ one-way uniform sampling to process video frames and train independent classifiers for each hierarchy, which leads to the loss of key geographic cues and prediction conflicts between hierarchies, especially for complex multi-shot edited videos. To address these limitations, we propose GeoGAT, which integrates bidirectional temporal sampling with graph attention networks (GATs). Specifically, GeoGAT extracts forward and offset-reversed frame sequences to construct complementary spatiotemporal features. These fused features are then fed into a predefined geographical hierarchy graph, where GATs perform structure-aware message passing, while a dual-constraint mechanism prunes predictions to eliminate cross-hierarchy conflicts. We construct GeoGAT10k, comprising 9,720 multi-shot edited videos from 166 cities worldwide, specifically to benchmark generalization ability on complex video structures. Experimental results on CityGuessr68k and GeoGAT10k demonstrate that GeoGAT eliminates hierarchical conflicts entirely and achieves state-of-the-art performance across all four geographic hierarchies. On CityGuessr68k, GeoGAT outperforms the strongest baseline, evaluated under both classification and retrieval protocols, by 2.6 percentage points at the city level. On the more challenging GeoGAT10k with multi-shot edited videos, the accuracy improvement exceeds 24 percentage points, validating strong generalization to complex real-world scenarios.

AI.tldr: 提出GeoGAT，结合双向时序采样与图注意力网络，实现全球视频地理定位，消除层级冲突并取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有全球视频地理定位方法采用单向均匀采样处理视频帧，并为每个地理层级训练独立分类器，导致关键地理线索丢失，且各层级之间存在预测冲突，在复杂多镜头剪辑视频中尤为严重。
AI.method: GeoGAT融合双向时序采样与图注意力网络（GAT）。它提取前向与偏移反转的帧序列以构建互补的时空特征，将融合特征送入预定义的地理层级图，由GAT进行结构感知的消息传递，并通过双约束机制修剪预测以消除跨层级冲突。此外构建了GeoGAT10k数据集，包含来自全球166个城市的9,720段多镜头剪辑视频。
AI.result: 在CityGuessr68k和GeoGAT10k上，GeoGAT完全消除了层级冲突，并在四个地理层级上均达到最先进性能。在CityGuessr68k上，城市层级在分类与检索两种协议下均超过最强基线2.6个百分点；在更具挑战性的GeoGAT10k上，准确率提升超过24个百分点。
AI.conclusion: GeoGAT通过双向采样与图注意力网络的结合，有效解决了线索丢失与层级冲突问题，展现出对复杂真实场景的良好泛化能力。

title: Amortized Data Borrowing with Exchangeability-Aware Neural Posterior Estimation
comment: 27 pages. Accepted at the 11th Machine Learning for Healthcare Conference (MLHC 2026)
summary: Augmenting small concurrent studies with external or historical cohorts is attractive in drug development, where enrollment is slow, follow-up is expensive, and closely related trial or real-world data are often already available. Bayesian dynamic borrowing (BDB) provides a principled framework for adaptively controlling the influence of external data, but classical implementations often depend on hand-specified priors and MCMC-based inference, which can be computationally expensive and not generalizable. In this work, we study amortized neural posterior estimation (NPE) as a flexible alternative. A single network is pretrained on simulated current/external dataset pairs spanning covariate shift, outcome drift, and joint non-exchangeability, and then returns an approximate posterior for a scalar current-study target in a single forward pass. Through simulation studies, we find that NPE is most useful under outcome drift and joint mismatch: in the harder outcome-drift regimes, it gives up to about five-fold lower absolute bias than the best classical baseline and keeps Type I error close to nominal. After pretraining, posterior summaries are obtained in about 8 ms per dataset, roughly $10^3\times$ faster than MCMC-based borrowing baselines in our timing experiment. We further analyze Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI) data and show that, when mild cognitive impairment outcomes differ across cohorts, the NPE formulation recovers the later-cohort risk level in this example without claiming greater precision. Code is available at https://github.com/ChinHungScott/NPE-for-Bayesian-Dynamic-Borrowing-MLHC-.

AI.tldr: 本文研究摊销神经后验估计（NPE）作为贝叶斯动态借用的灵活替代方案，在模拟与ADNI数据中显示其在结果漂移情形下偏差更低、计算速度约快10³倍。
AI.motivation: 药物开发中入组慢、随访昂贵，利用外部或历史队列可提升小样本并发研究效率；贝叶斯动态借用能自适应控制外部数据影响，但经典实现依赖人工指定先验与MCMC推断，计算昂贵且泛化性差。
AI.method: 将摊销神经后验估计用于贝叶斯动态借用：在覆盖协变量偏移、结果漂移和联合非可交换性的模拟当前/外部数据集对上进行单网络预训练，随后单次前向传播即返回当前研究标量目标的近似后验。
AI.result: 模拟显示NPE在结果漂移与联合失配下最有用，较难的结果漂移情形中绝对偏差最多降低约五倍，第一类错误接近名义水平；预训练后每个数据集后验汇总约8毫秒，比MCMC基线快约10³倍；ADNI分析中，当轻度认知障碍结局在不同队列间存在差异时，NPE能恢复后入组队列的风险水平且不虚增精度。
AI.conclusion: 摊销NPE为贝叶斯动态借用提供了一种灵活、快速且无需逐次MCMC的替代方案，尤其适用于结果漂移与联合非可交换场景，但并非在所有设定下都优于经典方法。

title: ANI: Adaptive Numerical Injection for Unifying Semantic and Arithmetic Representations in Numerical Reasoning
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026. 16 pages, 7 figures. Code available at https://github.com/Jinsung-Jeon/ANI_EMNLP
summary: Precise numerical reasoning with Large Language Models (LLMs) is essential for expanding their applicability to complex real-world tasks. However, text-based tokenization often fragments numbers, significantly hindering precise arithmetic reasoning. Meanwhile, numerical embeddings, despite arithmetic precision, rely on context-agnostic substitution that disregards the semantic role of numbers as identifiers. To combine the complementary strengths, we propose \textbf{ANI (Adaptive Numerical Injection)}, a hybrid framework that governs the selective injection of numerical features based on the semantic context. By employing a context-aware gating mechanism, we selectively inject numerical embeddings (specifically FoNE) into the latent space, explicitly preserving nominal identifiers while enhancing quantitative operands. Through extensive evaluations across various LLMs, we demonstrate that ANI enhances MATH performance by 9.5 points over the official reference model, while maintaining robust performance on general linguistic benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 论文提出ANI框架，通过上下文感知门控机制选择性注入数值嵌入，融合文本分词与数值嵌入的优势，提升LLM数值推理能力。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在复杂真实任务中需要精确的数值推理能力。然而基于文本的分词会碎片化数字，阻碍精确算术推理；而数值嵌入虽具算术精度，却依赖与上下文无关的替换，忽视了数字作为标识符的语义角色。二者各有优劣，需要结合其互补优势。
AI.method: 提出ANI（Adaptive Numerical Injection）混合框架，基于语义上下文控制数值特征的选择性注入。采用上下文感知的门控机制，将数值嵌入（具体为FoNE）选择性注入潜在空间，在保留名义标识符的同时增强定量操作数。
AI.result: 在多种LLM上进行广泛评估，ANI在MATH任务上比官方参考模型提升9.5分，同时在通用语言基准上保持稳健表现。
AI.conclusion: ANI通过上下文感知的选择性数值注入，有效结合文本分词与数值嵌入的互补优势，在提升数值推理能力的同时不损害通用语言能力。

title: Perceptual Color Difference Modeling Using Machine Learning and Human Similarity Judgments
comment: This manuscript has been submitted to IEEE Access for consideration
summary: Accurate assessment of color differences is essential for applications ranging from digital design to quality control. While existing color difference metrics, such as CIEDE2000, aim to approximate human perception, they may still exhibit inconsistencies with perceptual judgments. In this study, we investigate a data-driven approach to color-difference estimation based directly on human evaluations. We collect similarity judgments for 2,000 systematically generated color pairs, each rated by seven observers using a four-point ordinal scale. These judgments are then used to train regression models using different color representations, including RGB channel differences, HSI differences, and COLIBRI fuzzy linguistic categories. Experiments with five regression algorithms show that the choice of color model has a greater influence on prediction performance than the choice of regression algorithm. Using COLIBRI features alone, linear regression achieves an R2 of 0.595, outperforming RGB and HSI representations, which achieve R2 values of 0.479 and 0.493, respectively. The best performance is obtained by LightGBM using the combined representation, reaching an R2 of 0.703. The results indicate that human perceptual color differences are better captured when numerical color coordinates are complemented by graded perceptual categories, highlighting the potential of data-driven models for perceptually aligned color-difference estimation.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过收集人类相似性判断数据，训练回归模型来估计颜色差异，发现颜色表示方式的选用比回归算法选择更关键，COLIBRI模糊语言类别配合LightGBM组合表示效果最佳。
AI.motivation: 现有颜色差异度量（如CIEDE2000）虽试图逼近人类感知，但仍可能与感知判断不一致，因此需要一种直接基于人类评价的数据驱动方法来估计颜色差异。
AI.method: 收集2,000对系统生成颜色对的相似性判断，每对由7位观察者用四点有序量表评分；使用RGB通道差异、HSI差异和COLIBRI模糊语言类别等不同颜色表示，配合五种回归算法训练回归模型。
AI.result: 颜色模型的选择对预测性能影响大于回归算法选择。仅用COLIBRI特征时线性回归R²为0.595，优于RGB（0.479）和HSI（0.493）；LightGBM使用组合表示取得最佳效果，R²达0.703。
AI.conclusion: 当数值颜色坐标辅以分级感知类别时，能更好地捕捉人类感知的颜色差异，凸显了数据驱动模型在感知对齐颜色差异估计方面的潜力。

title: DAMPER: Return-Prioritized Gradient Control for Smooth Policies
summary: Actor-critic methods achieve strong performance in continuous control, but their policies can produce highly oscillatory actions. A common remedy is to add auxiliary smoothness losses. However, their contribution can be negligible when their gradients are small relative to the native actor gradient. Moreover, existing methods often combine multiple auxiliary losses, complicating loss balancing without necessarily improving the return-smoothness trade-off. We introduce DAMPER (Direction-Aware Magnitude-Controlled Projection with Explicit Return Priority), which combines the native actor gradient with a temporal-consistency gradient through conflict-conditioned projection and adaptive magnitude control. It removes the auxiliary component opposing the actor gradient and scales the retained temporal direction relative to the actor gradient norm, preserving positive alignment with the native actor gradient. Experiments with TD3 and SAC on six continuous-control tasks show reduced action oscillation relative to the native agents in all 12 task-backbone pairs and the best oscillation score among the compared methods in eight, with task-dependent return trade-offs.

AI.tldr: DAMPER通过冲突条件投影与自适应幅度控制，将时序一致性梯度与原生actor梯度结合，在保持回报的前提下减少动作振荡。
AI.motivation: Actor-critic方法在连续控制中表现优异，但策略会产生高度振荡的动作。常用的辅助平滑损失在梯度相对原生actor梯度较小时贡献甚微，且现有方法常组合多个辅助损失，导致损失平衡复杂，未必能改善回报-平滑性的权衡。
AI.method: 提出DAMPER（Direction-Aware Magnitude-Controlled Projection with Explicit Return Priority），将原生actor梯度与时序一致性梯度通过冲突条件投影和自适应幅度控制相结合：移除与actor梯度相冲突的辅助分量，并按actor梯度范数缩放保留的时序方向，从而保持与原生actor梯度的正向对齐。
AI.result: 在TD3和SAC上于六个连续控制任务进行实验，相比原生智能体，在全部12个任务-骨干组合中均减少了动作振荡，并在八个组合中取得所比较方法中最优的振荡分数，同时回报存在任务相关的权衡。
AI.conclusion: DAMPER能有效缓解动作振荡，同时通过显式回报优先机制在回报与平滑性之间实现可控权衡。

title: MiniRep: Robust Reputation-Based Aggregation for Multi-Agent Debate
summary:
Autonomous agents powered by large language models (LLMs) are rapidly evolving into an open agentic ecosystem. To support trustworthy collaboration, industry initiatives increasingly assess agent reputation from past behavior and provide performance leaderboards. However, reputation derived from past performance may not reliably predict an agent's behavior on new tasks, particularly when malicious agents can adapt their behavior and influence other agents during collaboration.
  We study reputation in multi-agent debate (MAD), where multiple agents answer the same query, debate to improve their answers, and aggregate them into a final output. We present MiniRep, a reputation-based aggregation system for MAD under malicious agents. To ground our threat model in established research, we construct an attack taxonomy drawing on reputation-system attacks and software-testing mutation operators, covering strategic exploitation of reputation and subtle corruption of agent proposals. Guided by this taxonomy, MiniRep evaluates agents based on both their behavior on the current task and their reputation over time, while preventing groups of agents with highly similar responses from dominating the final decision. We assess MiniRep across diverse tasks, LLM-agent compositions, corruption placements, and attack types drawn from our taxonomy. Our experimental results show that, MiniRep outperforms both conventional MAD aggregation and conventional reputation-based approaches on MATH no matter being attacked or not. Also, under a heterogeneous 10-agent setting on MATH, MiniRep outperforms all baselines in all 28 attack conditions.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究带有恶意智能体的多智能体辩论（MAD）场景下的声誉机制，提出基于声誉的聚合系统 MiniRep，用于抵御恶意智能体的策略性声誉利用与提案污染攻击，并在 MATH 等任务上验证其优于传统 MAD 聚合与传统声誉方法。
AI.motivation: 基于大语言模型的自主智能体正形成开放智能体生态，业界通过评估历史行为生成声誉与排行榜以支持可信协作。但仅凭过往表现得出的声誉未必能可靠预测智能体在新任务上的行为，尤其当恶意智能体能够自适应调整行为并影响其他智能体时，现有声誉机制存在被利用的风险。
AI.method: 论文聚焦多智能体辩论（MAD）中的声誉问题：多个智能体回答同一查询、通过辩论改进答案并聚合为最终输出。作者提出 MiniRep，一种在存在恶意智能体时用于 MAD 的基于声誉的聚合系统。为确立威胁模型，作者结合声誉系统攻击与软件测试变异算子构建攻击分类法，涵盖对声誉的策略性利用与对智能体提案的细微污染。在此分类法指导下，MiniRep 同时依据智能体在当前任务中的行为与长期声誉进行评估，并防止响应高度相似的智能体群体主导最终决策。
AI.result: 作者在多样化任务、不同 LLM 智能体组合、不同污染位置以及分类法中的多种攻击类型下评估 MiniRep。实验表明，在 MATH 任务上，无论是否受到攻击，MiniRep 均优于传统 MAD 聚合方法与传统基于声誉的方法。此外，在 MATH 的异构 10 智能体设置下，MiniRep 在全部 28 种攻击条件下均优于所有基线。
AI.conclusion: MiniRep 通过融合当前任务行为与历史声誉，并抑制高相似响应群体的支配作用，有效提升了 MAD 在恶意智能体环境下的鲁棒性与聚合质量，为可信多智能体协作中的声誉机制提供了更可靠的方案。

title: Unlearning Deceptive Behaviors in LLMs with Contrastive Forget Sets
summary: Large language models often know the truth and say otherwise: a model that answers correctly when asked neutrally will affirm a user's mistaken belief, or misstate a fact its system prompt wants hidden, once the context rewards it. Such deception is a behavior conditioned on context, not knowledge, yet machine unlearning, the natural tool for removing a behavior from the weights, is built to forget facts that a deceptive model still needs. We propose to unlearn when a model deceives rather than what it knows, with a contrastive forget unit built from the model's own realized deceptions: the same question under a deception-triggering and a neutral context, admitted only where belief holds and behavior flips. Standard objectives on this unit face a dilemma. Suppression objectives such as NPO leave much of the deception in place. Target-based objectives, which distill the model's neutral behavior into the pressured context, remove it but induce context blindness: a target generated without the context teaches the model to stop reading it, eroding benign system-prompt instructions, secret-keeping and the reasoning a monitor inspects, a failure invisible to deception rates and capability benchmarks. We introduce PACT, which trains toward pressure-aware counterfactual targets (the model's own honest response, with a trace that registers the pressure and resists it) while retaining the benign uses of the triggering context. On two 32B reasoning models, PACT reduces held-out deception from over 50% to under 3% while system-prompt adherence, secret-keeping and the reasoning trace stay at the base model's level. On a tug-of-war score of removal against retention, PACT reaches 0.94 and 0.86, against at most 0.77 and 0.60 for any baseline. Like removed knowledge, removed deception is shallow under relearning, and terms that simulate the attacker hold it only at a cost in context use.

AI.tldr: 提出 PACT 方法，将"机器遗忘"从遗忘事实转向遗忘"欺骗行为"，通过压力感知的反事实目标降低模型在诱导语境下的欺骗率，同时保留良性语境使用能力。
AI.motivation: 大模型常在知道真相的情况下因语境奖励而欺骗：中性提问时回答正确，一旦语境诱导就会附和用户错误信念或隐瞒事实。这种欺骗是语境条件化的行为而非知识缺失，而传统机器遗忘针对的是事实记忆，无法直接去除行为。同时，现有方法面临两难：抑制类目标（如 NPO）去不干净；目标蒸馏类方法虽能去除欺骗，却导致"语境盲"，即模型不再读取语境，损害良性系统指令遵循、保密与推理监控。
AI.method: 构建对比式遗忘单元：取自模型自身实际发生的欺骗，即同一问题在"诱导语境"与"中性语境"下的成对样本，仅保留"模型确有正确信念但行为发生翻转"的样本。在此单元上提出 PACT，训练模型朝向"压力感知的反事实目标"——即模型自身的诚实回答，并附上能登记压力并加以抵抗的推理痕迹，同时保留触发语境的良性用途。
AI.result: 在两个 32B 推理模型上，PACT 将留出欺骗率从 50% 以上降至 3% 以下，且系统提示遵循、保密能力与推理痕迹均维持在基座模型水平。在"去除 vs 保留"的拔河评分中，PACT 达 0.94 与 0.86，而所有基线最高仅为 0.77 与 0.60。此外，与移除的知识类似，被移除的欺骗在重新学习下具有浅层性；模拟攻击者的项虽可保持欺骗去除，但需以牺牲语境使用为代价。
AI.conclusion: 去除欺骗应针对"行为发生的条件"而非"事实知识"，PACT 通过压力感知的反事实目标实现了高去除率与良性能力保留的兼顾，但被移除的欺骗仍是浅层的，面对再学习与对抗性模拟存在局限。

title: WorkGenesis: Building the Worlds That Teach Agents to Work
summary: The ability of Large Language Model (LLM) agents to complete daily and professional work is receiving increasing attention. Training such agents requires realistic work scenarios. Expert-authored occupational work is costly and slow to produce, while unconstrained synthesis often yields tasks with weak factual grounding or internally inconsistent requirements. To bridge this gap, we introduce WorkGenesis, a framework that constructs executable occupational work from real-world artifacts through two core technical innovations: (1) Evidence-Based Work Construction, which grounds each unit of work in real-world evidence by retrieving public files guided by O*NET occupational knowledge and synthesizing the surrounding context, companion materials, work request, and itemwise rubric around them; and (2) Execution-Guided Consistency Verification, which renders a reference deliverable inside the constructed work, attributes every unsatisfied rubric item to the agent, the task, or the rubric, and uses task and rubric defects as feedback to iteratively repair the work until it passes the audit. Experimental results demonstrate that Fx-Work-35B, trained with simple supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on only 20K units of work synthesized by WorkGenesis, achieves the highest scores among all comparable-scale baselines on the five reported metrics across GDPvalAA-v2, APEX-Agents-AA, and JobBench (31.00 versus 24.79 average score), and even surpasses frontier models such as the 1.6T DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Preview. These results show that WorkGenesis provides scalable training data for working agents.

AI.tldr: WorkGenesis 通过真实世界证据构建可执行职业工作数据，并用执行引导的一致性验证迭代修复任务，合成的 20K 数据经 SFT 训练后使 Fx-Work-35B 在多个职业工作基准上取得同规模最优成绩。
AI.motivation: 训练能完成日常与专业工作的 LLM 智能体需要真实工作场景数据，但专家撰写成本高、速度慢，而无约束合成又常导致事实基础薄弱或要求内部矛盾，因此亟需兼顾真实性、可执行性与一致性的数据构建方法。
AI.method: 提出 WorkGenesis 框架，包含两项核心创新：(1) 基于证据的工作构建，借助 O*NET 职业知识检索公开文件，围绕其合成上下文、配套材料、工作请求与逐项评分标准，使每个工作单元扎根于真实证据；(2) 执行引导的一致性验证，在构建的工作中渲染参考交付物，将每个未满足的评分项归因于智能体、任务或评分标准，并以任务与评分标准缺陷为反馈迭代修复，直至通过审计。
AI.result: 仅用 WorkGenesis 合成的 20K 工作单元进行简单 SFT 训练，Fx-Work-35B 在 GDPvalAA-v2、APEX-Agents-AA 与 JobBench 上五项报告指标均取得同规模基线中最高分（平均 31.00 对 24.79），甚至超越 1.6T 的 DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Preview 等前沿模型。
AI.conclusion: WorkGenesis 能够为工作型智能体提供可扩展的高质量训练数据，证明以真实证据为基础、辅以执行一致性验证的数据合成路径，可显著提升智能体的职业工作能力。

title: Feature-Aware Token Attack for Compression-Triggered Stealthy Failures in Large Vision-Language Models
comment: 29 pages including references and appendices, 10 figures. Submitted to ICLR 2027
summary: Visual-token compression improves the efficiency of large vision-language models, but can expose failures that full-token evaluation misses. We study adversarial images that preserve full-token correctness yet induce errors after compression, even when both inference paths succeed on the clean image. Creating such failures is challenging because perturbing token importance can also damage the visual content needed for full-token inference. We propose Feature-Aware Token Attack (FATA), which couples attention suppression with cosine-based feature preservation on a fixed set of salient clean-image tokens. In the primary LLaVA-1.5-7B setting, FATA uses only vision-encoder gradients, without access to the deployed compressor, token budget, or downstream task. Across four visually dependent task subsets and four compressors under a controlled reconstruction protocol, FATA achieves SR = 96.3% full-token accuracy retention and CBR = 22.1% conditional blinding, compared with 89.8% and 15.7% for CAA. Ablations support the role of both objectives in balancing compressed-path failure against full-token preservation. FATA also has the lowest measured detection rate among four attacks across three evaluated detectors at a 5% false-positive rate. These findings motivate assessing adversarial robustness jointly across full-token and compressed inference.

AI.tldr: 论文研究视觉token压缩导致的安全漏洞：提出FATA攻击，在保持全token推理正确的同时，使压缩后推理出错，并具有较低的可检测性。
AI.motivation: 视觉token压缩能提升大型视觉语言模型效率，但可能暴露全token评估无法发现的失败模式。存在一类对抗图像：全token推理正确，却因压缩而诱导错误。构造这类失败很困难，因为扰动token重要性也可能破坏全token推理所需的视觉内容。
AI.method: 提出Feature-Aware Token Attack（FATA），在固定的显著干净图像token集合上，将注意力抑制与基于余弦的特征保持相结合。在LLaVA-1.5-7B主设定中，FATA仅使用视觉编码器梯度，不需要接入部署的压缩器、token预算或下游任务信息。
AI.result: 在四个视觉依赖任务子集和四个压缩器、受控重建协议下，FATA达到SR=96.3%的全token准确率保持，CBR=22.1%的条件性致盲，优于CAA的89.8%和15.7%。消融证明两个目标共同作用于平衡压缩路径失败与全token保持。在三个检测器、5%假阳性率下，FATA在四种攻击中检测率最低。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果说明，对抗鲁棒性评估应同时覆盖全token推理与压缩推理两条路径。

title: Generalized Residual Closure: General Learning Dynamics for Stability-Plasticity Compatibility
summary: Learning must acquire new capabilities while preserving both prior responsibilities and the capacity to learn again. We introduce Generalized Residual Closure (GRC), a framework for learning as recursive closure of future-relevant discrepancies: closing a residual establishes the conditions for subsequent prediction, interaction, and learning. Under a complete representation-relation description at a fixed learner-world boundary, persistent internal learning has two primitive modes: Transformation within a representation and revision of the Representation itself. We establish a local tangent decomposition under regularity assumptions and a criterion for when representation revision is necessary. In an affine model, we derive a necessary-and-sufficient condition for stability-plasticity compatibility and the unique solution of a constrained quadratic update problem, which preserves registered old responsibilities while reducing residuals with an effective safe response. We prove that reconstructive semantic protection weakly enlarges the safe-response operator relative to preserving an exact historical realization. Dynamic sufficiency and future-closure viability extend representation adequacy from current prediction to lawful future updating and continued learning. Growth Learning expands the lawful closure domain or lowers optimal closure cost without regression of the registered capability-cost frontier; a conditional commit rule maintains this order. Restricted-sector recoveries and a conditional representation theorem connect the framework to optimization, machine learning, and control. Together, these results organize adaptation, representation revision, and reusable capability within a common account of continued learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"广义残差闭合"(GRC)框架，将学习理解为对未来相关差异的递归闭合，统一刻画适应、表示修改与可复用能力。
AI.motivation: 学习需要在获得新能力的同时保留既有职责以及再次学习的能力，即稳定性与可塑性的兼容问题；现有工作缺乏一个统一的、以残差闭合为核心的持续学习理论描述。
AI.method: 在固定学习者—世界边界与完整表示—关系描述下，将持续内部学习划分为表示内的变换与表示本身的修改两种基本模式；在正则性假设下给出局部切分解及表示修改必要性的判据。在仿射模型下，推导稳定性—可塑性兼容的充要条件，并求解约束二次更新问题的唯一解；证明重构式语义保护相对精确历史实现的保持可弱扩张安全响应算子。进一步引入动态充分性与未来闭合可行性，并用条件提交规则维持能力—成本前沿。
AI.result: 得到两类学习模式的刻画、表示修改必要性的判据、稳定性—可塑性兼容的充要条件与唯一更新解；证明重构式语义保护可扩张安全响应算子；通过受限扇区恢复与条件表示定理，将框架与优化、机器学习和控制建立联系。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将适应、表示修改与可复用能力纳入持续学习的统一解释中，为稳定性—可塑性权衡与生长式学习提供了理论基础。

title: Understanding as No-Arbitrage: Bounded Dutch Books as a Definition and Training Objective for Language Models
summary: Does a language model merely predict tokens, or does it understand what it says? We make this question measurable by defining "understanding" through the lens of no-arbitrage. A model understands a vocabulary to a certain degree if a computationally bounded trader cannot extract guaranteed profit by betting against the model's probabilities on logically related claims (a "Dutch book"). We establish three theoretical results: first, because full logical coherence is computationally intractable, understanding is inherently graded, not absolute. Second, we prove that the exact optimum of standard next-token prediction is inherently incoherent across different question formats; the flaw lies in the training objective, not the architecture. Third, we show that uncertainty accumulates predictably along reasoning chains, making unjustified overconfidence an arbitrage opportunity in itself. To address this, we introduce Arbitr, a training framework where an adversarial trader penalizes the model for logical inconsistencies, paired with a calibration anchor to prevent uninformative collapse. Across five pre-registered experiments on Qwen2.5 and Phi-3.5 models, we demonstrate that standard models are highly exploitable across different phrasings. Arbitr reduces this exploitability by orders of magnitude without sacrificing task accuracy, and the effect successfully transfers to unseen logical patterns and new model families. Crucially, we uncover a scaling illusion: at 7B parameters, near-zero measured incoherence often coincides with extreme, unjustified confidence. We conclude that while Arbitr enforces rigorous logical consistency, coherence is a necessary condition for knowledge, but not a sufficient one

AI.tldr: 该论文通过"无套利"视角定义语言模型的"理解"，提出理论证明标准下一词预测目标本身导致逻辑不一致，并设计了Arbitr训练框架，利用对抗交易者惩罚逻辑不一致性，在多个模型上大幅降低可被套利程度而不损失准确率。
AI.motivation: 论文试图回答一个核心问题：语言模型只是预测token，还是真正"理解"其内容。作者希望将"理解"这一模糊概念变成可测量的指标，于是借用金融学中的无套利思想来定义理解程度——如果计算受限的交易者无法通过对逻辑相关命题下注来从模型概率中获取保证利润（即无法构造"荷兰赌局"），则模型在一定程度上"理解"了该词表。
AI.method: 作者从理论上证明三点：完全逻辑一致性在计算上不可行，因此理解是分级的而非绝对的；标准下一词预测目标的最优解在不同提问格式下本质不一致，缺陷在训练目标而非架构；不确定性会沿推理链可预测地累积，使不合理的过度自信本身成为套利机会。据此提出Arbitr训练框架，引入对抗"交易者"惩罚模型的逻辑不一致性，并配合校准锚点防止模型塌缩为无信息输出。在Qwen2.5和Phi-3.5上进行了五个预注册实验。
AI.result: 标准模型在不同措辞下极具可被套利性；Arbitr将这种可套利性降低了数个数量级，同时不牺牲任务准确率，且效果能迁移到未见过的逻辑模式和新的模型家族。此外发现一种"规模错觉"：在7B参数规模下，近乎为零的测量不一致性往往伴随极端且不合理的自信。
AI.conclusion: Arbitr能够强制实现严格的逻辑一致性，但一致性只是知识的必要条件，而非充分条件——即模型逻辑自洽并不代表它真正拥有知识。

title: Asking the World: Generalist Physical Reasoning through Agentic World Modeling and Probing
summary: Physical reasoning from video requires inferring latent physical properties and dynamics beyond direct observation. Direct VLM inference remains unreliable on complex physical tasks without explicit modeling and validation, while predefined tool pipelines rely on task- and domain-specific priors that limit generalization across materials, dynamics, and reasoning tasks. We introduce Asking the World (ATW), a generalist agent that constructs and interrogates task-relevant executable worlds through two adaptive stages: World Modeling calibrates a world from video, while World Probing queries, simulates, and intervenes on it to obtain question-relevant evidence. Rather than prescribing the operations in either stage, ATW determines how to model and probe according to the scene and question. We develop PolyWorld Engine, a lightweight and highly programmable Warp-based multiphysics simulator for constructing and probing worlds with rigid bodies, soft bodies, cloth, ropes, fluids, and their coupled interactions. CEM-based system identification recovers task-relevant dynamics during World Modeling. The resulting world becomes an active workspace for question-directed physical experiments rather than a predetermined downstream tool. We evaluate ATW on CLEVRER, ContPhy, and three real-world scenarios. Using Gemini-3-Flash as its base VLM, ATW achieves 80.82% overall per-question accuracy on CLEVRER, improving direct Gemini-3-Flash by 46.50 points, GPT-5.5 by 13.58 points, and PhysMind by 8.27 points. On ContPhy, it reaches 70.56% overall accuracy, surpassing Gemini-3-Flash by 28.10 points and GPT-5.5 by 3.53 points. Across the three real-world scenarios, ATW achieves 71.67% accuracy, 28.33 points above GPT-5.5.
