But this benefit depends on targeting: a deployable hedge derived from the model's own belief entropy inherits that signal's weakness and can do more harm than good. Externalized uncertainty helps a human partner only when it is accurately targeted.

AI.tldr: 在人机协作拼图任务中，研究"指代不确定性"的识别、表达与利用：单独引出的信念分布比动作概率校准更好，模型能随指令模糊度上升而感知不确定性却很少外化，且只有精准针对性地说出不确定性才能真正帮助人类伙伴减少错误接受。
AI.motivation: 人机协作需要双方通过交互建立共同指代，但当描述模糊、候选对象相似或双方所见不同时，这种指代关系十分脆弱。作者希望研究协作任务中的"指代不确定性"，即描述究竟指向哪个候选对象的不确定性，并检验AI能否识别、表达这种不确定性，以及人类伙伴能否识别并据此行动。
AI.method: 采用人机协作拼图任务：人类Helper指示AI Worker放置拼块，Worker需识别并传达其不确定性。对比单独引出的候选拼块信念分布与原始动作token概率的校准（ECE）与判别性（AUROC）。在三个前沿视觉语言模型（GPT-4.1、GPT-5、GPT-5.5）上，考察不确定性随指令模糊度和上下文中竞争指代物的变化。另开展N=210的受控人类实验，比较默认消息、精确描述与针对性模糊限定语对错误接受率的影响，并测试基于模型自身信念熵的可部署模糊限定语。
AI.result: 单独引出的信念分布校准更好（ECE 0.15）、判别性更强（AUROC 0.65），优于严重过度自信的原始动作token概率（平均置信度0.97，ECE 0.44）。三个模型引出的不确定性随指令模糊度可预测上升，但不随上下文中竞争指代物上升，即便后者增加错误。模型很少外化不确定性，仅在3.5%–16.7%的回合中请求澄清。人类实验中，仅看到Worker默认消息的被试接受78%的错误放置，且无法区分对错（AUC 0.50）；精确描述、尤其是针对性强的模糊限定语可将错误接受率降至36%，同时大体保持正确放置的接受率，弥补了如看不到Worker动作等共享意识缺失。但该收益依赖针对性：基于模型自身信念熵推导的可部署模糊限定语继承了该信号的弱点，可能弊大于利。
AI.conclusion: 外化的不确定性只有在被精准针对性表达时才能真正帮助人类伙伴；模型内部虽有可校准的不确定性信号，但既不充分外化，也难以自动转化为有效的对外沟通，因此如何精准地定位并表达不确定性是关键挑战。

title: MegaAvatar: Controllable Talking Avatar Generation
summary: This report presents \textbf{MegaAvatar}, a controllable talking avatar generation framework built on top of the Wan2.2-TI2V-5B model. Compared with previous talking-avatar methods that mainly rely on audio or reference-image conditioning, we introduce additional SMPL-X-derived 3D guidance, enabling global control over body pose and head motion. Specifically, we render the driving SMPL-X sequence into dense mesh frames and encode them with a lightweight 3D convolutional encoder, whose outputs are injected into the latent tokens to provide overall motion control. Furthermore, we extend Wan2.2-TI2V-5B with additional audio and face cross-attention modules to enable fine-grained expression control and preserve the input identity, respectively. In addition, we implement an audio-to-SMPL-X model to predict an SMPL-X sequence conditioned on the reference image and input audio, allowing MegaAvatar to support audio-driven inference without user-provided SMPL-X frames. Experiments show that MegaAvatar achieves high-quality talking avatar generation with controllable body and head motion, speech-synchronized facial expressions, and consistent identity preservation. MegaAvatar also supports inference with flexible resolutions and video lengths. Codes, dataset, models will be avaliable in https://github.com/Jeoyal/MegaAvatar

AI.tldr: MegaAvatar：基于Wan2.2-TI2V-5B的可控说话数字人框架，引入SMPL-X 3D引导实现身体与头部运动控制，并支持音频驱动推理。
AI.motivation: 以往说话数字人方法主要依赖音频或参考图像条件，缺乏对整体身体姿态与头部运动的全局控制能力。
AI.method: 在Wan2.2-TI2V-5B基础上，将驱动SMPL-X序列渲染为稠密网格帧，用轻量3D卷积编码器编码后注入潜变量token实现全局运动控制；扩展音频与面部交叉注意力模块分别实现细粒度表情控制与身份保持；并训练音频到SMPL-X的预测模型，实现无需用户提供SMPL-X帧的音频驱动推理。
AI.result: 实验表明MegaAvatar可生成高质量说话数字人，具备可控身体与头部运动、语音同步面部表情和一致的身份保持，并支持灵活分辨率与视频长度推理。
AI.conclusion: MegaAvatar通过引入SMPL-X 3D引导与音频/面部注意力模块，实现了可控、同步且身份一致的说话数字人生成，代码、数据集与模型将开源。

title: Synchronous Multi-view Neural Diffusion
summary: Multi-view learning seeks to learn more comprehensive representations by exploiting the complementarity and consistency across diverse modalities or views. However, existing multi-view fusion strategies treat intra- and inter-view fusion as independent stages, without simultaneously considering the evolution within views and the dependency across views. Such an asynchronous fusion paradigm inevitably constrains cross-view interactions due to conflicting view-specific structural inductive biases. As a result, information flow is prone to distortion and compression along intermediate pathways, confining the model to learn within a restricted solution space. To address this, we propose Synchronous Multi-view Neural Diffusion (SynMDiff), which conceptualizes the multi-view feature space as a unified dynamical system driven by a diffusion process. By modeling the diffusion flow across arbitrary dyadic feature interactions in a joint space, SynMDiff enables the concurrent and adaptive intra- and inter-view information fusion. While a direct implementation of this synchronized mechanism incurs prohibitive computational costs, we further introduce an energy-based topological sampling strategy and an Ego-Net style centralized training architecture, ensuring both efficiency and scalability during learning and inference. Due to its conceptual elegance and computational efficacy, evaluations on real-world datasets demonstrate that SynMDiff outperforms the baselines by a large margin.

AI.tldr: 本文提出同步多视图神经扩散（SynMDiff），将多视图特征空间建模为由扩散过程驱动的统一动力系统，实现视图内与视图间信息的同步自适应融合，并通过能量拓扑采样和Ego-Net集中式训练架构保证效率与可扩展性，在真实数据集上大幅超越基线。
AI.motivation: 现有多视图融合策略将视图内融合与视图间融合视为相互独立的阶段，未能同时考虑视图内部的演化与视图之间的依赖关系。这种异步融合范式因视图特有的结构归纳偏置相互冲突而限制跨视图交互，导致信息流在中间路径上易发生失真与压缩，使模型只能在受限的解空间中学习。
AI.method: 提出同步多视图神经扩散（SynMDiff），将多视图特征空间视为由扩散过程驱动的统一动力系统；通过在被联合空间中建模任意二元特征交互之间的扩散流，实现视图内与视图间信息的同时、自适应融合。针对直接实现该同步机制计算开销过大的问题，引入基于能量的拓扑采样策略与Ego-Net风格的集中式训练架构，以保证学习与推理的效率及可扩展性。
AI.result: 在真实世界数据集上的评测表明，SynMDiff 大幅优于各基线方法。
AI.conclusion: SynMDiff 通过同步扩散机制在概念上优雅且计算高效，有效突破了异步融合范式带来的解空间限制，验证了同步多视图融合在多视图学习中的优越性。

title: Growing an Agent/Prover Interface: Evolutionary Tool Design for Cost-Efficient Theorem Proving in Rocq and Lean
summary: Recent achievements in AI-assisted mathematics require intensive interaction of agents with proof assistants to generate machine-checked proof certificates. Agents interact with proof assistants such as Rocq or Lean through an interface that controls what the agent receives from the prover and the cost of these interactions. Today, these interfaces are adapted from tools designed for humans and not optimized for agents. We propose an evolutionary method where a frontier model incrementally proposes new features and only keeps the ones that improve the overall performance of smaller models. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our method by growing, on a curated set of mathematical problems, \rme, a new MCP server for the Rocq prover. On the held-out \texttt{test} split of miniF2F-Rocq, an agent equipped with \rme outperforms both the baseline that only exposes the Rocq compiler and an established MCP server, across four models from two families, in success rate, cost per solve, and time per solve. Although evolved for Rocq, the resulting server transfers to Lean, improving cost and time per solve on a subset of PutnamBench. We release \rme and its port to Lean.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种进化式方法，让前沿模型逐步提出新功能，仅保留能提升小模型整体性能的功能，从而为Rocq证明助手自动进化出一个名为rme的MCP服务器，并验证其在数学证明任务中的效果。
AI.motivation: 当前AI辅助数学依赖代理与证明助手（如Rocq、Lean）的密集交互，而现有交互接口是从面向人类的工具改造而来，并非为代理优化。这限制了代理从证明器获取信息的效率和交互成本，因此需要专门为代理设计和优化交互接口。
AI.method: 提出进化式方法：由前沿模型增量式地提出新功能，只保留那些能提升较小模型整体性能的功能。在一个精选的数学问题集合上，用该方法"生长"出面向Rocq证明器的新型MCP服务器rme。
AI.result: 在miniF2F-Rocq的留出test划分上，配备rme的代理在成功率、每次求解成本和每次求解时间三个指标上均优于仅暴露Rocq编译器的基线以及一个已有MCP服务器，且该结论在来自两个模型家族的四个模型上均成立。此外，尽管rme是为Rocq进化而来，它还能迁移到Lean，在PutnamBench子集上改善了成本和求解时间。
AI.conclusion: 针对代理优化的证明助手接口可以显著提升AI数学证明的效率与成功率，且跨证明器具有可迁移性。作者发布了rme及其Lean移植版本。

title: BMASH: Ball-Motion-Aware Soccer Header Spotting
summary: Recent advances in computer vision have made broadcast sports videos increasingly useful for event analysis, performance assessment, and player-safety applications. In soccer, however, header spotting remains a challenging problem due to the subtle and short-lived nature of header events. This paper focuses on soccer header spotting: identifying moments in broadcast videos where the ball contacts a player's head. We first adapt and evaluate Video Swin as a strong action-recognition baseline for this task, and then introduce BMASH, a ball-motion-aware fusion framework that integrates detector-derived ball features. BMASH combines Video Swin action representations with ball-presence and motion features from frame-level soccer-ball detection, integrating player-action context with ball dynamics to distinguish headers from visually similar events. We evaluate BMASH using game-level splits with separate test matches and rotating validation folds, considering both centered-window classification and continuous full-video spotting. Results show that Video Swin provides a strong baseline for header spotting, while BMASH improves clip-level AP and ROC-AUC over the corresponding Video Swin baseline. In continuous full-video spotting, BMASH achieves a comparable event-level F1-performance with a different precision--recall trade-off.

AI.tldr: 本文研究足球广播视频中的头球定位问题，提出BMASH框架，将Video Swin动作识别特征与足球检测得到的球存在与运动特征融合，在片段级与连续全视频定位上取得改进。
AI.motivation: 足球头球事件细微且短暂，仅依靠通用动作识别难以与视觉相似动作区分，需要引入球体运动信息。头球定位对赛事分析、表现评估和球员安全应用有价值。
AI.method: 先以Video Swin作为动作识别基线；再提出BMASH（球运动感知融合框架），将Video Swin的动作表征与帧级足球检测得到的球存在特征和运动特征结合，融合球员动作上下文与球的动态信息。评估采用比赛级划分（独立测试比赛与轮换验证折），涵盖居中窗口分类和连续全视频定位两种设定。
AI.result: Video Swin构成强基线；BMASH在片段级AP和ROC-AUC上优于对应Video Swin基线；在连续全视频定位中，BMASH取得与基线相当的事件级F1，但精确率—召回率权衡不同。
AI.conclusion: 引入球运动感知特征可有效提升头球定位性能，BMASH在片段级分类上明确优于纯动作识别基线，而在连续定位中提供不同权衡选择。

title: A Rank Graduation metric for Algorithmic fairness
summary:
Fairness assessment in algorithmic decisions that affect individuals, such as credit scoring, often relies on parity measures calculated at the aggregate group level. Such measures may not reveal which individuals experience unfairness or which explanatory factors contribute to it. In this paper, we propose a rank-based framework that evaluates fairness through the distribution of model prediction errors, thereby linking fairness assessment with predictive accuracy and explainability. The framework combines Rank Graduation Fairness (RGF), its integrated measure AURGF, a centered Cramer--von Mises permutation test, and a feature removal procedure for fairness explainability.
  We evaluate the methodology using logistic regression, random forest, gradient boosting, and a multilayer perceptron. The simulation study shows that protected-group imbalance can reverse descriptive fairness comparisons, whereas the proposed inferential procedure correctly distinguishes fair from unfair mechanisms. Its application to HMDA mortgage data produces model rankings that differ from those obtained with classical fairness criteria. Tree-based models, rather than logistic regression, provide the strongest combination of predictive accuracy and rank-based fairness, while the fairness null hypothesis is rejected for all four models. The persistence of disparity across statistical, bagging, boosting, and neural network specifications, together with the feature removal results, indicates that the observed unfairness is not specific to a single algorithm or predictor, but is associated with group differences embedded in the characteristics of the lending data. These findings support a broader approach to trustworthy artificial intelligence that combines predictive accuracy, fairness measurement, statistical inference, and explainability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于秩的公平性评估框架，将预测误差分布与准确性、可解释性相联结，通过RGF、AURGF、CvM置换检验与特征剔除程序，检验算法决策中的群体公平性。
AI.motivation: 现有公平性评估多依赖群体层面的均等性指标，无法揭示哪些个体遭遇不公平、哪些解释因素导致不公平，因此需要一种能联结公平性、预测准确性与可解释性的评估方法。
AI.method: 提出基于秩的公平性框架，结合Rank Graduation Fairness（RGF）、整体测度AURGF、中心化Cramer–von Mises置换检验，以及用于公平性解释的特征剔除程序；在逻辑回归、随机森林、梯度提升与多层感知机上评估，并开展模拟研究与HMDA抵押贷款数据应用。
AI.result: 模拟研究表明受保护群体失衡可能逆转描述性公平比较，而所提推断程序能正确区分公平与不公平机制；HMDA数据上的模型排序与经典公平标准不同，树模型在准确性与秩公平性上表现最佳，四个模型的公平性零假设均被拒绝，特征剔除结果说明不公平并非源于单一算法或预测变量。
AI.conclusion: 不公平性与贷款数据中固有的群体特征差异相关，而非特定算法所致；研究支持将预测准确性、公平性测量、统计推断与可解释性结合的可信人工智能路径。

title: RankEvolve: A Reliable Multi-Agent Auto-Research Harness for Evolving Ranking Models
comment: 29 pages, 5 figures, 13 tables, 1 algorithm; includes appendices
summary: Auto-research agents, LLM systems that propose, implement, train, and evaluate model changes across iterations, promise to automate applied ML's experimental loop. Over long horizons, execution accuracy is a binding constraint: a change can silently leak held-out data, omit normalization, disconnect a gradient, or leave a train/eval flag unwired, invalidating expensive runs and compounding error across iterations. We present RankEvolve, an auto-research framework for evolving generative ranking models. An Executable Operating Protocol (EOP) declares phases, gates, branches, and loops, and the runtime enforces the compiled state machine. A meta-meta-harness composes complete black-box coding-agent products, including Claude Code and Codex, as execution-graph nodes that review and repair one another's work. In a budget-matched evaluation, heterogeneous composition raises all-oracle execution accuracy from the best single-product baseline of 45.8 percent to 62.5 percent (paired +16.7 points, 95 percent CI [6.6, 26.7]) while achieving a 10.4 percent silent critical-defect rate. An implemented knowledge layer carries findings, including negative results, across iterations. In a twelve-iteration deployment on the open-source HSTU recommender, RankEvolve reported NDCG@10 of 0.2192 on MovieLens-20M LARGE (+4.48 percent over the published anchor) and 0.1948 on BASE (+2.80 percent). ExecML-HSTU, seeded by incidents from that deployment, provides the oracle benchmark for the execution-accuracy evaluation. A pre-specified LitGPT transfer split replicates the heterogeneous-composition effect beyond recommendation (+12.5 points, 95 percent CI [3.0, 22.0]), and a paired ablation isolates per-step from full-protocol instruction injection. These results characterize when runtime-controlled composition of coding-agent products improves execution accuracy.

AI.tldr: RankEvolve 是一个自动化科研框架，通过可执行操作协议和黑箱编码智能体的异构组合，将长周期ML实验的执行准确率从45.8%提升到62.5%，并在HSTU推荐模型上取得NDCG@10提升。
AI.motivation: 长周期的自动科研智能体面临"执行准确率"这一关键瓶颈：代码变更可能悄悄泄漏留出数据、遗漏归一化、断开梯度或未接通训练/评估开关，导致昂贵实验失效并使误差在多轮迭代中不断累积。因此需要一种能严格控制执行流程、减少静默缺陷的框架。
AI.method: 提出RankEvolve框架：1）可执行操作协议（EOP）声明阶段、门控、分支与循环，运行时强制执行编译后的状态机；2）元-元-框架（meta-meta-harness）将完整黑箱编码智能体产品（如Claude Code、Codex）组合为执行图节点，使其互相审查与修复；3）实现知识层，跨迭代传递发现（含负面结果）。
AI.result: 在预算匹配评估中，异构组合将全Oracle执行准确率从最佳单产品基线45.8%提升至62.5%（配对+16.7点，95%CI [6.6,26.7]），静默严重缺陷率为10.4%。12轮部署在开源HSTU推荐器上，MovieLens-20M LARGE的NDCG@10达0.2192（较已发表锚点+4.48%），BASE为0.1948（+2.80%）。ExecML-HSTU提供Oracle基准。预设定的LitGPT迁移实验复现了异构组合效应（+12.5点，95%CI [3.0,22.0]），配对消融分离了分步与全协议指令注入的作用。
AI.conclusion: 运行时控制的编码智能体异构组合能有效提升执行准确率，并刻画了其适用范围。该框架通过协议化控制与多产品互审机制，缓解长周期自动科研中的静默执行错误问题，并具备跨领域迁移能力。

title: Rethinking Generative Image Compression at Extremely Low Bitrates
summary: Generative image compression produces visually plausible reconstructions at low bitrates, yet their behavior as the rate approaches zero remains largely unexplored. When pushed below normal operating rates, representative codecs undergo semantic collapse: rather than gracefully losing source-specific detail, they produce malformed or unrecognizable content. Our analysis identifies two factors. As the bitrate decreases, reconstruction losses increasingly conflict with semantic objectives on gradients and visual results, while pixel-space and reconstruction-oriented VAE diffusion models become less efficient on semantic preservation. Guided by these findings, we introduce RAE-CoD, a compression-oriented diffusion (CoD) built in a representation autoencoder (RAE) space with direct alignment between compressed and source representations, preserving recognizable, naturally structured content for a $256\times256$ image with as few as 16 bits. We evaluate this framework using five vision foundation models (VFM) and a blinded vision-language model protocol. On MSCOCO-30K, RAE-CoD stands out from all evaluation. At 0.001-0.008 bpp, it reduces relative VFM feature MSE and Fréchet Distance ratio by at least 25.7% and 69.1% over the best competitors. Meanwhile, semantic recognizability and quality of the reconstructions remain nearly constant while source consistency falls smoothly, replacing abrupt semantic collapse with a graceful transition toward unconditional generation. Code will be released at https://github.com/LuizScarlet/RAE-CoD.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究极低比特率下生成式图像压缩的"语义崩塌"现象，并提出RAE-CoD框架，在表示自编码器空间中进行扩散压缩，实现平滑降质。
AI.motivation: 生成式图像压缩在低比特率下可产生视觉合理的重建，但当比特率趋近于零时的行为尚未被充分探索。代表性编解码器在被推到低于正常工作码率时会发生"语义崩塌"，产生畸形或不可识别的内容，而非优雅地丢失源特定细节。
AI.method: 分析语义崩塌的两个成因：一是比特率下降时，重建损失与语义目标在梯度和视觉结果上日益冲突；二是像素空间及面向重建的VAE扩散模型在语义保持上效率降低。据此提出RAE-CoD——一种在表示自编码器（RAE）空间中构建的面向压缩的扩散模型（CoD），在压缩表示与源表示之间进行直接对齐。
AI.result: 使用五个视觉基础模型（VFM）和盲测视觉语言模型协议评估。在MSCOCO-30K上，RAE-CoD在0.001-0.008 bpp区间内，相对VFM特征MSE和Fréchet距离比率分别比最佳竞争者至少降低25.7%和69.1%。仅用16比特即可保持256×256图像的可识别、自然结构化内容。
AI.conclusion: RAE-CoD使重建的语义可识别性和质量几乎保持不变，同时源一致性平滑下降，将突发的语义崩塌替换为向无条件生成的优雅过渡。代码将在GitHub发布。

title: Switching Linear Attention
summary: Designing expressive sequence layers with efficient inference remains a central challenge in modern machine learning. Standard softmax attention achieves excellent sequence modeling performance through rich nonlinear token interactions, but it requires a key-value cache that grows linearly with sequence length, limiting its scalability. Linear attention enables efficient recurrent computation with a constant memory footprint, yet its reduced expressivity often yields inferior modeling performance. We introduce Switching Linear Attention (SwiLA), a novel sequence layer that bridges this gap by enhancing representational capacity while retaining the fixed-size recurrent state of linear attention. We derive the SwiLA recurrence from the test-time regression framework, casting the state update rule as online expectation-maximization in a mixture of linear regressions model. At test time, each output dimension dynamically selects among multiple linear attention components based on the input. Across associative recall, in-context language learning, and language modeling benchmarks, SwiLA shows strong performance and narrows the gap to softmax attention, even surpassing it in several settings.

AI.tldr: SwiLA通过引入动态切换机制，在保留线性注意力固定大小循环状态的同时增强了表达能力，缩小了与softmax注意力的性能差距。
AI.motivation: 标准softmax注意力性能强但需随序列长度线性增长的键值缓存，限制可扩展性；而线性注意力虽具有常数内存的循环计算优势，但表达能力受限导致性能不足。论文旨在弥合两者之间的差距。
AI.method: 提出Switching Linear Attention（SwiLA），从测试时回归框架推导其循环形式，将状态更新规则设计为混合线性回归模型中的在线期望最大化（EM）。在测试时，每个输出维度根据输入动态地在多个线性注意力组件之间进行选择。
AI.result: 在联想回忆、上下文语言学习和语言建模等基准测试中，SwiLA表现强劲，缩小了与softmax注意力的差距，并在多个场景中实现了超越。
AI.conclusion: SwiLA成功兼顾线性注意力的固定大小循环状态与更高的表达能力，是一种有前景的高效序列层设计。

title: Divide and Collapse: MAPF-Collapse via Exact Decomposition into Independent Sub-Instances
summary: In this work we study the problem of MAPFC, a post-optimization step for Multi-Agent Path Finding (MAPF) plans where we are given a feasible plan produced by a modern MAPF solver and are tasked with removing avoidable moves while preserving feasibility. This NP-hard problem naturally arises when using learning-based state-of-the-art (SOTA) solvers which construct plans that contain redundant moves that can be removed. Recently, Tang et al. presented Judgelight, which uses Integer Linear Programming (ILP) to solve MAPFC. Importantly, the ILP is constructed over all agents jointly, so its cost is governed by the full instance rather than by the small coupled residue that actually requires joint reasoning. Our key insight, motivating this work, is that MAPFC instances naturally decompose into independent sub-problems, most of which involve a single agent and can be solved without any inter-agent reasoning. To this end, we first identify which agents need to coordinate their motion and partition the instance into sub-problems accordingly. For the cases where no coordination is required, we introduce an extremely lightweight solver that is $\approx\!1{,}900\times$ faster than Judgelight. For cases where coordination is required, Judgelight can be used but we introduce an alternative CBS-like solver which is more efficient on easier problems. The resulting framework is exact, uses no commercial ILP solver, and matches Judgelight's quality while running substantially faster on the coordination-light majority of instances; on the coordination-heavy instances we propose a regime-aware hybrid planner that falls back to Judgelight. Over all benchmarks tested, this planner achieves a median $10.5\times$ per-instance speedup over Judgelight.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究MAPFC（MAPF路径后优化）问题，提出将实例分解为独立子问题，用轻量求解器处理单智能体情形，用类CBS求解器或回退到Judgelight处理需协调情形，实现精确、无需商业ILP求解器且中位数10.5倍加速的框架。
AI.motivation: 现代基于学习的SOTA MAPF求解器生成的路径常含可移除的冗余移动，MAPFC即去除这些冗余移动同时保持可行性的后优化步骤。现有方法Judgelight用ILP在全体智能体上联合建模，成本由整个实例规模决定，而非实际需要联合推理的小规模耦合部分，导致效率低下。
AI.method: 核心洞察是MAPFC实例可自然分解为独立子问题，多数仅涉及单智能体。方法首先识别哪些智能体需要协调运动，据此将实例划分为子问题；无需协调的情形用极轻量求解器；需协调的情形可用Judgelight，作者提出更高效的类CBS求解器处理较易问题；对协调密集实例采用regime-aware混合规划器回退到Judgelight。
AI.result: 无需协调情形下轻量求解器比Judgelight快约1900倍；整体框架为精确方法，不使用商业ILP求解器，在多数协调稀疏实例上质量与Judgelight相当且显著更快；协调密集实例回退Judgelight。全部基准测试上中位数达每实例10.5倍加速。
AI.conclusion: 通过利用MAPFC的可分解结构并对不同协调程度采用不同求解策略，实现了高效且精确的MAPFC求解框架，大幅超越现有ILP方法。

title: TexTailor: Texture-Preserving Video Virtual Try-On via Adaptive Garment Conditioning
summary: Video virtual try-on has attracted increasing attention due to its broad potential in digital fashion and intelligent e-commerce. However, existing methods primarily focus on low-resolution settings and still face substantial challenges when extended to high-resolution scenarios. These limitations can be attributed to two main factors: (1) the insufficient utilization of rich garment reference information, and (2) the lack of explicit positional modeling between garment and video representations during cross-modal interaction, which weakens fine-grained local correspondence. To address these issues, we propose TexTailor, a high-fidelity video virtual try-on framework built upon a pretrained video Diffusion Transformer. Specifically, we introduce a timestep-adaptive modulation mechanism to dynamically adjust garment visual representations throughout denoising. We further develop a frame-aligned positional encoding strategy to strengthen garment-to-video correspondence, together with a multi-source injection design that reduces interference among heterogeneous conditions. Extensive experiments on multiple video virtual try-on benchmarks, including the high-resolution Eevee dataset, demonstrate that TexTailor achieves competitive performance in garment detail preservation, temporal consistency, and overall video quality.

AI.tldr: 提出TexTailor，基于预训练视频扩散Transformer的高保真视频虚拟试穿框架，提升高分辨率场景下的细节保持与一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有视频虚拟试穿方法多聚焦低分辨率场景，扩展至高分辨率时面临两大挑战：一是服装参考信息利用不充分，二是跨模态交互中缺乏服装与视频表征间显式的位置建模，削弱了细粒度局部对应关系。
AI.method: TexTailor构建于预训练视频扩散Transformer之上，包含三个关键设计：时间步自适应调制机制，在去噪过程中动态调整服装视觉表征；帧对齐位置编码策略，增强服装到视频的对应关系；多源注入设计，减少异构条件间的干扰。
AI.result: 在多个视频虚拟试穿基准（包括高分辨率Eevee数据集）上的大量实验表明，TexTailor在服装细节保持、时序一致性和整体视频质量方面均取得有竞争力的性能。
AI.conclusion: TexTailor通过自适应调制、帧对齐位置编码与多源注入，有效解决了高分辨率视频虚拟试穿中的参考信息利用与跨模态对应问题，实现了高保真试穿效果。

title: Cycle-Aware Autoencoder with Cross-SignalConsistency for Railway Door Anomaly Detection
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures. Accepted and presented at the 29th Euromicro Conference on Digital System Design (DSD 2026)
summary: Passenger access doors are safety-critical subsystems in railway vehicles, yet detecting abnormal door behavior in real operation is challenging because faults are rare, diverse, and often unlabeled. This paper addresses railway door condition monitoring as a cycle-level unsupervised anomaly detection problem, where each complete opening-dwell-closing cycle is treated as a single monitoring unit. We propose the Temporal Cycle-Aware Attention Autoencoder with Cross-Signal Consistency (TCAA-CS), trained exclusively on nominal cycles. It combines a dual-stream encoder that processes continuous physical measurements (position, current, voltage) and binary logical states (door-closed, door-locked) through separate 1D-CNN branches, an LSTM encoder with temporal attention pooling, and a triple hybrid anomaly score fusing reconstruction error, latent-space deviation, and phase-aware cross-signal consistency. The consistency term helps identify cases where individual signals appear plausible but their inter-signal relationships become physically or logically inconsistent. On real industrial data from a passenger train in commercial service, TCAA-CS achieves 93.8% recall, 97.3% precision, and a 0.5% false-alarm rate, outperforming representative unsupervised baselines. System-level evaluation on an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Xavier supports the feasibility of real-time onboard deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文将铁路车门状态监测建模为"开门-停留-关门"完整循环级别的无监督异常检测问题，提出时序循环感知注意力自编码器（TCAA-CS），仅用正常循环训练，在真实列车数据上达到93.8%召回率、97.3%精确率和0.5%误报率。
AI.motivation: 车门是轨道车辆的安全关键子系统，但实际运行中的异常检测十分困难：故障罕见、形态多样且大多缺乏标注数据，传统监督方法难以适用。
AI.method: 提出TCAA-CS模型，仅使用正常循环训练。采用双流编码器，分别通过独立的一维CNN分支处理连续物理量（位置、电流、电压）与二值逻辑状态（门关闭、门锁闭）；结合带时序注意力池化的LSTM编码器；并设计融合重构误差、隐空间偏差与相位感知跨信号一致性的三合一混合异常评分。一致性项用于识别单个信号看似合理但信号间物理或逻辑关系异常的工况。
AI.result: 在某商业运营客运列车的真实工业数据上，TCAA-CS取得93.8%召回率、97.3%精确率和0.5%误报率，优于代表性的无监督基线方法。在NVIDIA Jetson AGX Xavier上的系统级评估验证了实时车载部署的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 将车门监测定义为循环级无监督异常检测，并引入跨信号一致性约束，可有效提升异常检出性能，且满足车载实时部署需求。

title: A2Z GameSpec-Bench: How Faithfully Can Coding Agents Generate Games from Game Design Specifications?
summary: Delegating complete application development to coding agents requires preserving the intended design rather than simply producing plausible outputs through naive prompting. Game development provides a demanding testbed, as long-form Game Design Documents (GDDs) describe requirements that must work together across game logic, visual rendering, and player interactions. However, existing game-development benchmarks typically use compact specifications and provide limited support for evaluating interdependent requirements across these aspects in long-form GDDs. We introduce A2Z GameSpec-Bench, a benchmark of 100 long-form GDDs for evaluating end-to-end game development by agents. We measure faithfulness by checking whether the game satisfies the GDD requirements and preserves the relationships among them. Each GDD is turned into a dependency-aware contract that contains rules, constraints, and prerequisite relations. Following game-development practices, we combine source-code inspection with agent-generated test policies for scenario-based replay and adaptive playtesting. The contract remains fixed across agents and revision rounds, while judgments and evidence linked to the same requirements support consistent comparison and failure detection. Our evaluations show that current agents struggle to jointly satisfy interdependent requirements across code implementation and actual play. Requirement-specific feedback improves GDD Fidelity by 10.9% relative to self-revision after two rounds. A2Z GameSpec-Bench assesses end-to-end specification-following ability beyond implementation judgments and provides targeted feedback to support more faithful game development. Code and datasets are available at https://a2z-gamespec-bench.github.io.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 A2Z GameSpec-Bench，一个包含100份长篇游戏设计文档（GDD）的基准，用于评估编码智能体端到端游戏开发中对复杂依赖需求的忠实度。
AI.motivation: 将完整应用开发交给编码智能体，需要忠实遵循设计意图而非仅靠提示生成看似合理的输出。游戏开发是严格的测试场景，长篇GDD中的需求需在游戏逻辑、视觉渲染和玩家交互间协同工作。然而现有游戏开发基准多用紧凑规格，缺乏对长篇GDD中跨方面相互依赖需求的评估支持。
AI.method: 将每份GDD转化为依赖感知契约，包含规则、约束和前置关系。结合源码检查与智能体生成的测试策略，进行场景回放和自适应游戏测试。契约在智能体和修订轮次间保持固定，判断与证据关联同一需求，支持一致比较与失败检测。
AI.result: 当前智能体难以在代码实现与实际游玩中同时满足相互依赖的需求。相比自我修订，需求特定的反馈使GDD忠实度在两轮后提升10.9%。
AI.conclusion: A2Z GameSpec-Bench 评估超越实现判断的端到端规格遵循能力，并提供针对性反馈以支持更忠实的游戏开发。代码和数据集已公开。

title: Rethinking Multi-Image Re-Representation in Multi-Image Understanding
summary: Multi-image understanding requires MLLMs not only to recognise the content of individual images, but also to organise visual evidence distributed across them. We study this problem through multi-image re-representation, viewing prompted Chain-of-Thought reasoning and agentic visual tool use as different ways of re-organising visual evidence during reasoning. We introduce Mosaic, a general-purpose multi-image visual harness that enables an MLLM to actively construct visual intermediates with ten composable image operations. We compare five re-representation settings on existing multi-image benchmarks and on MosaicBench, a new grounding-focused benchmark for fine-grained multi-image understanding. Our experiments show that the relative benefits of textual and visual re-representation are strongly task-dependent. Visual re-representation is particularly effective for tasks requiring precise visual evidence, including hypothesis testing, precision comparison, and orientation-sensitive reasoning, while tasks dominated by higher-level semantic content show smaller or less consistent gains. Building on this finding, we train MosaicAgent-8B to use Mosaic with reinforcement learning using only accuracy and format rewards. Without demonstration trajectories or rewards for specific tool-use, the agent learns to compose visual operations over multiple steps and exhibits diverse problem-solving patterns unpromptedly. Code and data will be released at https://github.com/gengyuanmax/Mosaic.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究多图理解中视觉证据的组织问题，提出多图视觉工具框架Mosaic，通过十种可组合图像操作让MLLM主动构建视觉中间表示，并训练出MosaicAgent-8B，发现文本与视觉重表示的收益强烈依赖任务类型。
AI.motivation: 多图理解不仅要求MLLM识别单张图像内容，还需组织跨图像分布的视觉证据。作者将提示式思维链推理与智能体式视觉工具使用视为推理过程中重新组织视觉证据的不同方式，借此研究多图重表示问题。
AI.method: 提出Mosaic通用多图视觉工具框架，支持MLLM用十种可组合图像操作主动构建视觉中间表示；在现有多图基准与新建的MosaicBench（聚焦细粒度多图理解的grounding基准）上对比五种重表示设置；并用强化学习仅以准确率和格式奖励训练MosaicAgent-8B使用Mosaic。
AI.result: 实验表明文本与视觉重表示的相对收益强烈依赖任务：视觉重表示对需要精确视觉证据的任务（假设检验、精度比较、方向敏感推理）尤其有效，而高层语义主导的任务收益较小或不稳定。MosaicAgent-8B在无示范轨迹、无特定工具使用奖励下学会多步组合视觉操作，并自发涌现多样化解题模式。
AI.conclusion: 视觉重表示与文本重表示各有适用场景，应根据任务类型选择；通过强化学习可让智能体自主掌握多步视觉操作组合能力，为多图理解提供通用视觉工具框架。代码与数据将开源。

title: Hard-Gate Candidacy in a Deployed Validator Suite
comment: 7 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables. NeurIPS 2026 Workshop: Can We Trust the Judge? (JUDGe)
summary: Before a validator can be promoted to a hard gate on a deployment pipeline, it has to be shown that its firing separates outputs that reach users in working order from those that do not. We run that screen on 13 validators in a deployed generative agent, against 550 runtime and 350 static builds labelled by downstream outcome, and report each check's marginal separation $J=\mathrm{TPR}-\mathrm{FPR}$ with Newcombe intervals and Fisher exact tests. Two checks survive correction for multiple comparisons, two more are nominal only, and the remaining nine are not distinguishable from zero, three of them because they never fired on any sampled build. Execution itself is not random with respect to the property being gated, and this replicates: across four runs covering 1,867 builds and ten distinct runtime checks, probes were skipped on 144 of 895 broken builds and 1 of 972 acceptable builds (per-run rates 15.6% to 16.6% against at most 0.3%), every skip carrying the same unsafe-to-probe reason. Because a skipped check is recorded as a pass, this imposes a ceiling that no check quality can lift: a check that needs a live artifact cannot operationally detect more than about 84% of broken builds in this harness. For the one check with construct-specific labels, a detector built for blank output fires on 0 of 90 human-labelled blank builds (95% upper bound on sensitivity 3.3%), and the global frame statistic it approximates separates the classes only weakly (AUC 0.59), so the gap is not a threshold that needs tuning. The same gap appears one layer up: on a census of tens of thousands of judge-scored builds, 32.5% of rejections carry no recorded issue at all. We argue that evaluation records must distinguish a check that ran and passed from one that did not run, must carry the evidence for a rejection, and that an inventory of checks is not evidence about a gate.

AI.tldr: 对部署中的生成式智能体开展13项验证器筛查：仅2项通过多重比较校正，且"跳过即通过"的记录方式使需要活跃产物的检查对破损构建的检出上限约84%，评估记录应区分"运行且通过"与"未运行"。
AI.motivation: 验证器在成为部署流水线的硬性门控之前，需证明其触发能区分到达用户的可用输出与不可用输出。作者希望检验已部署智能体中的验证器是否真的具备这种分离能力，并考察评估记录方式本身对门控效果的限制。
AI.method: 在部署的生成式智能体上对13个验证器进行筛查，覆盖550个运行时构建与350个静态构建，均以下游结果标注。对每项检查报告边际分离度 J=TPR−FPR，并给出Newcombe区间与Fisher精确检验，同时进行多重比较校正。此外开展四次运行、覆盖1,867个构建和10项运行时检查，统计探针被跳过的比例与原因；并对一个带有构造特定标签的检查做人工标注验证（90个空白构建）及全局帧统计的AUC评估；最后对数万个判分构建进行普查，统计无记录问题的拒绝比例。
AI.result: 13项检查中仅2项在校正后仍具分离度，2项名义显著，9项与零不可区分（其中3项从未在任何抽样构建上触发）。执行过程对被测属性并非随机：4次运行中共有895个破损构建中的144个、972个可用构建中的1个被跳过探针，跳过率15.6%–16.6% 对比至多0.3%，且全部因同一"不安全探测"原因。由于跳过被记为通过，需要活跃产物的检查在操作上最多只能检出约84%的破损构建。带有构造特定标签的检查对90个人工标注空白构建的检出为0（灵敏度95%上界3.3%），其近似的全局帧统计仅弱分离（AUC 0.59）。向上一个层级，数万个判分构建中32.5%的拒绝未附任何已记录问题。
AI.conclusion: 检查清单的存在并不构成关于门控有效性的证据。评估记录必须区分"检查运行并通过"与"检查未运行"，必须为拒绝结论附带证据，并应建立可核查的检查清单，否则门控效果存在无法通过提升检查质量来突破的上限。

title: AVERT-VLN: Abstention-aware Visual Error Recovery and Training for Vision-and-Language Navigation
summary: Deploying vision-and-language navigation (VLN) agents in unseen environments remains challenging because unfamiliar layouts and visual conditions can cause execution to go off track. Rather than relying on continuous human supervision, a practical strategy is to selectively request corrective guidance, recover the ongoing task, and reuse corrective interactions to improve subsequent navigation. We propose Abstention-aware Visual Error Recovery and Training for Vision-and-Language Navigation (AVERT-VLN), a closed-loop framework that uses a plug-in vision-language Monitor for online human-assisted recovery and offline preference learning. The Monitor operates separately from navigation decision generation and assesses instruction-execution consistency from the instruction, visual history, and current observation. To train the Monitor for deviation recognition, we construct LOSTNAV DATASET with 20K counterfactual risk trajectories and rule-based deviation labels. The Monitor is first fine-tuned on 40K normal trajectories to assess instruction progress and then jointly fine-tuned on normal and risk trajectories to recognize semantic deviations. At runtime, Asynchronous Sidecar Monitoring evaluates execution alongside the navigation model. When the controller accepts a LOST verdict, it suspends autonomous execution and requests human guidance for recovery. For offline policy improvement, Trajectory-Anchored Preference Learning converts deviation-associated failures into decision-level preference pairs under shared decision contexts, restricting supervision to the decisions targeted for correction. Under human-assisted evaluation, the full AVERT-VLN system achieves success rates of 76.2% and 66.3% on the val-unseen splits of R2R-CE and RxR-CE, respectively. The same monitoring and human-assisted recovery interface also improves success rates across the three evaluated navigation architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AVERT-VLN框架，通过插件式视觉语言Monitor在线检测执行偏差并请求人工纠正，再用轨迹锚定偏好学习离线改进导航策略，在R2R-CE与RxR-CE上取得76.2%与66.3%成功率。
AI.motivation: 在未见环境中部署视觉语言导航（VLN）智能体时，陌生布局与视觉条件易导致执行偏离轨道；依赖持续人工监督不现实，因此需要选择性请求纠正指导并能复用这些纠正交互来改进后续导航。
AI.method: 提出闭环框架AVERT-VLN：1）插件式视觉语言Monitor，独立于导航决策生成，基于指令、视觉历史与当前观测评估指令-执行一致性；2）构建LOSTNAV DATASET，含2万条反事实风险轨迹与基于规则的偏差标签；Monitor先在4万条正常轨迹上微调评估指令进度，再在正常与风险轨迹上联合微调识别语义偏差；3）运行时采用异步边车监控（Asynchronous Sidecar Monitoring）；4）控制器接受LOST判定时暂停自主执行并请求人工指导恢复；5）离线采用轨迹锚定偏好学习（Trajectory-Anchored Preference Learning），在共享决策上下文下把偏差相关失败转为决策级偏好对，仅对目标纠正决策施加监督。
AI.result: 在人工辅助评估下，完整AVERT-VLN系统在R2R-CE和RxR-CE的val-unseen划分上成功率分别达76.2%和66.3%；相同的监控与人工辅助恢复接口在三种被测导航架构上均提升了成功率。
AI.conclusion: 通过选择性地请求人工纠正并复用纠正交互进行离线偏好学习，AVERT-VLN实现了有效的VLN错误恢复与策略改进，且监控与恢复接口具有良好的跨架构通用性。

title: COBICount: Separating Object and Background Responses for Remote Sensing Object Counting Without Training on Target Data
summary: Remote sensing object counting estimates how many buildings, vehicles, or ships appear in overhead images. Most supervised counters predict a density map, whose sum gives the object count, and assume similar categories, sizes, and backgrounds. Applying them across regions, sensors, or categories often requires target data or further training, which may be costly or unavailable. We study source-only counting. Training for the counting task and model selection use one group of images that shares an object category and similar imaging conditions, with one point marking each object. Target images and information remain unavailable until the model is fixed. This reduces data preparation but makes transfer harder. A model trained on one source may place high density values, called responses, on real objects and repeated background structures. Road edges, parking grids, roof boundaries, and water boundaries may then be counted as objects, creating candidate origin ambiguity. COBICount separates response generation, acceptance, and background suppression. Candidate Evidence (CE) generates possible responses. Candidate Acceptance (CA) keeps compact responses centered on objects. Bias Isolation (BI) reduces responses associated with repeated background structures. Their outputs form the final density map. Trained on RSOC Building and evaluated directly on DOTA Large Vehicle, Small Vehicle, and Ship, COBICount achieves the lowest mean absolute error (MAE) averaged over the target domains among the compared methods, 174.132. It uses 5.07 million parameters and 17.41 billion floating point operations for a 512x512 input. COBICount improves transfer without target data or training for each target. The code will be available at: https://github.com/yixuxi22/COBICount.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究遥感目标计数的"仅源域"设定，提出COBICount方法，通过分离响应生成、接受与背景抑制来缓解跨域迁移中的候选源歧义，在多个目标域上取得最低平均MAE 174.132。
AI.motivation: 大多数有监督计数方法依赖密度图预测，并假设类别、尺寸和背景相似；跨区域、传感器或类别应用时往往需要目标域数据或额外训练，成本高甚至不可得。因此论文研究仅源域计数，即训练和模型选择只用一组共享类别与相似成像条件的源图像，目标数据在模型固定前不可用。该设定虽降低数据准备成本，却使迁移更难：源域模型可能在真实目标及重复背景结构（如道路边缘、停车网格、屋顶边界、水体边界）上产生高密度响应，导致候选源歧义。
AI.method: COBICount将响应生成、接受与背景抑制分离，包含三个模块：Candidate Evidence (CE) 生成可能的响应；Candidate Acceptance (CA) 保留以目标为中心且紧凑的响应；Bias Isolation (BI) 减少与重复背景结构相关的响应。三者输出组合形成最终密度图。
AI.result: 在RSOC Building上训练，并直接在DOTA Large Vehicle、Small Vehicle和Ship上评估，COBICount在目标域平均MAE上取得所比较方法中最低值174.132；模型使用5.07M参数，对512x512输入的计算量为17.41 GFLOPs。
AI.conclusion: COBICount无需目标域数据或针对每个目标的训练即可提升迁移性能。代码将发布于 https://github.com/yixuxi22/COBICount。

title: Structure-aware Reinforcement Learning for Protein Directed Evolution
summary: Protein optimization remains a longstanding goal in life sciences. Existing machine learning-assisted directed evolution (MLDE) methods primarily rely on sequence-only features, overlooking the critical spatial constraints and co-evolutionary interactions encoded in protein structures. However, directly integrating structural information remains challenging due to the scarcity of reliable mutant structures. To address these issues, we propose StructEvo, a novel structure-aware reinforcement learning framework for protein directed evolution. StructEvo employs a delta-structure fusion encoder to approximate mutant structure features via feature differences, enabling dynamic incorporation of spatial knowledge. The vast mutation space is then decomposed into manageable subspaces through a structure-aligned hierarchical action network, while a geometric constraint further stabilizes delta feature learning. Our approach outperforms prior state-of-the-art methods by 9.2% and 16.3% on two challenging optimization benchmarks, and further identifies an experimentally validated epistasis pattern in GFP, highlighting the importance of structural guidance for effective protein directed evolution.

AI.tldr: 提出StructEvo，一种结构感知的强化学习框架，用于蛋白质定向进化，通过delta结构融合编码器、结构对齐分层动作网络与几何约束，克服突变体结构稀缺问题，在两项基准上分别超越SOTA 9.2%和16.3%，并在GFP中发现实验验证的上位性模式。
AI.motivation: 蛋白质优化是生命科学的长期目标。现有机器学习辅助定向进化(MLDE)方法主要依赖纯序列特征，忽视了蛋白质结构中关键的 spatial constraints 与共进化相互作用。然而直接引入结构信息存在困难，因为可靠突变体结构数据稀缺。因此需要一种能够在结构数据稀缺条件下动态整合空间知识的方法。
AI.method: StructEvo采用三项核心技术：(1) delta-structure fusion encoder，通过特征差异近似突变体结构特征，实现空间知识的动态引入；(2) structure-aligned hierarchical action network，将庞大的突变空间分解为可管理的子空间；(3) geometric constraint，进一步稳定delta特征学习。整体为结构感知的强化学习框架。
AI.result: 在两个具有挑战性的优化基准上，分别超越此前最先进方法9.2%和16.3%；并在GFP中识别出一个经实验验证的上位性(epistasis)模式。
AI.conclusion: 结构引导对有效的蛋白质定向进化具有重要性；StructEvo证明了在突变体结构稀缺情况下整合结构信息的可行性与优越性。

title: Why Do Conventional World Models Fail to Learn Cellular Automata?
comment: 35 pages, 18 figures. Code and reproduction materials: https://github.com/guoshaoyang-pku/momentum-induction
summary: Although conventional world models - auto-regressive or diffusion models based on transformers or convolutional networks - may learn surface statistics of world dynamics, can they learn the exact world dynamics from its observed history? Leveraging cellular automata as a simple testbed, we find the answer to be no in many cases. Conventional architectures predict most pixels correctly yet rarely complete a rollout: a CNN predicts 96.3% of cells but completes 18.9% of rollouts; a joint diffusion model completes none. We trace the gap to three failure modes of these world models - namely, they fail to exactly capture spatial locality, temporal locality or temporal stability. Simple changes repair each: (1) for spatial locality, two-dimensional rotary positions lift a transformer from 39.1% to 100% on the Game of Life; (2) for temporal locality, handing each token its cell's previous-frame neighbourhood lifts the same transformer from 25.8% to 99.9% on unseen rules; (3) for temporal stability, causal freezing lifts the same diffusion weights from 42.2% to 99.9%. None of the three changes touches the architectural backbone; each only modifies the information flow within it. We also compare joint and ordered sampling on billiards and, in an exploratory study, on a simulated Burgers equation.

AI.tldr: 该论文质疑传统世界模型（自回归或扩散模型）能否从观测历史中学习精确的世界动力学，并借用元胞自动机作为测试平台，发现它们通常无法完成完整推演。作者将失败归因于空间局部性、时间局部性和时间稳定性三个缺陷，并通过仅改变信息流、不动架构骨干的简单修改逐一修复，显著提升完成率。
AI.motivation: 传统世界模型（基于 Transformer 或卷积网络的自回归/扩散模型）可能只学到世界动力学的表面统计量，却难以从观测历史中学到精确动力学。论文希望借助元胞自动机这一简单测试平台，验证这些模型是否能精确学习世界动力学，并揭示其失败原因。
AI.method: 采用元胞自动机作为测试平台，评估 CNN、联合扩散模型等传统世界模型的推演表现；将失败归因于空间局部性、时间局部性和时间稳定性三个失败模式，并分别提出对应修复：用二维旋转位置编码改善空间局部性；将每个 token 所在单元的前一帧邻域信息提供给它以改善时间局部性；用因果冻结（causal freezing）改善时间稳定性。这些修改不改变架构骨干，只调整内部信息流。还在台球任务和模拟 Burgers 方程上比较联合采样与有序采样。
AI.result: CNN 能正确预测 96.3% 的单元，但仅完成 18.9% 的推演；联合扩散模型完成率为零。二维旋转位置编码使 Transformer 在生命游戏上的完整推演率从 39.1% 提升到 100%；提供前一帧邻域信息使同一 Transformer 在未见规则上从 25.8% 提升到 99.9%；因果冻结使同一扩散权重从 42.2% 提升到 99.9%。
AI.conclusion: 传统世界模型普遍无法精确学习世界动力学，但仅通过修改内部信息流（不改变架构骨干）即可针对性修复空间局部性、时间局部性和时间稳定性问题，从而大幅提升完整推演能力。论文还比较了台球及模拟 Burgers 方程上的联合采样与有序采样。

title: EgoTools: Towards Tool-Centric Reasoning in Real-World Egocentric Videos
summary: Real-world embodied tasks, from everyday activities to professional procedures, require agents to act under physical constraints while tracking evolving object and task states. Tool use sits at the heart of such tasks, as many everyday and professional activities are tool-mediated. Understanding them requires reasoning about affordances, hand-tool-object geometry, procedural progress, and causal effects on target objects. Yet despite strong performance on perception-oriented video tasks such as captioning and general video QA, current multimodal video models remain limited in this form of tool-centric embodied reasoning. Progress in this direction has been limited by the lack of real-world egocentric data and diagnostic benchmarks. To address this gap, we introduce EgoTools, the first comprehensive suite for egocentric tool-use understanding. It consists of two complementary components: EgoTools-Data, a large-scale corpus of 100 hours of tool-centric egocentric recordings with synchronized audio, dense captions, reasoning-heavy narrations, and supplementary 3D information; and EgoTools-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark of 1,000 QA pairs across four tracks that cover tool-use understanding from perception and geometry to procedure and causal reasoning. Experimental results show that current models still struggle to ground tool use in visual evidence: Gemini-3.1-Pro achieves 66.9% overall accuracy but only 51.7% on Perception & Grounding. Beyond evaluation, we validate EgoTools-Data as a training resource. On the full 1,000-question benchmark, full supervised fine-tuning improves Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct from 50.0% to 60.9%, under strict source-video separation. Together, these results establish EgoTools as a unified resource for both training and diagnostic evaluation of real-world egocentric tool-use understanding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EgoTools，首个面向第一人称视角工具使用理解的综合套件，包含大规模数据语料EgoTools-Data与诊断基准EgoTools-Bench，旨在推动视频模型在工具中心具身推理方面的能力。
AI.motivation: 现实世界的具身任务（从日常活动到专业流程）要求智能体在物理约束下行动，并跟踪不断演变的物体与任务状态。工具使用是这类任务的核心，需要推理可供性、手-工具-物体几何关系、程序进展以及对目标物体的因果影响。然而，当前多模态视频模型虽在感知类视频任务（如描述、通用视频问答）上表现优异，但在工具中心的具身推理方面仍受限。该方向进展缓慢主要受限于缺乏真实世界第一人称视角数据与诊断基准。
AI.method: 作者提出EgoTools，由两部分互补组成：(1) EgoTools-Data，一个大规模语料库，包含100小时工具中心的第一人称录制，配有同步音频、密集描述、推理型叙述及补充3D信息；(2) EgoTools-Bench，一个诊断基准，包含1000个问答对，覆盖四个赛道，从感知与几何到程序与因果推理，全面考察工具使用理解。此外，作者还将EgoTools-Data作为训练资源进行验证，在严格源视频分离条件下进行全监督微调。
AI.result: 实验显示当前模型难以将工具使用建立在视觉证据之上：Gemini-3.1-Pro整体准确率为66.9%，但在感知与定位（Perception & Grounding）上仅51.7%。作为训练资源，在完整1000题基准上，全监督微调将Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct从50.0%提升至60.9%，且遵循严格的源视频分离。
AI.conclusion: EgoTools作为一个统一资源，同时支持真实世界第一人称工具使用理解的训练与诊断评估，揭示了现有模型的关键短板并验证了数据在训练上的有效性。

title: The Missing Coefficients: Bayesian Pairwise Merging for Model Personalization
summary: How can we personalize a shared expert library from a user's pairwise choices? Prior work can realize different reward trade-offs by merging reward-specialized experts, given a vector of trade-off weights. In practice, users can more naturally choose between outputs than specify numerical weights. The challenge is therefore to turn these choices into the coefficients required for merging, while accounting for ambiguity when feedback is limited. Our key idea is to treat the unknown reward weights as latent variables: infer a posterior over them from pairwise choices and reward-score differences, and use its mean directly as the merge coefficients. We instantiate this idea as Bayesian Pairwise Merging (BPM), whose posterior also characterizes which reward trade-offs remain plausible given the feedback. We evaluate BPM on radiology summarization, image captioning, and story generation, spanning text-to-text and image-to-text generation. With 100 feedback per simulated persona, BPM achieves macro decided win rates of 91.7%, 77.1%, and 64.3% against uniform merge. For six pairs of simulated personas, each prefers the model fitted to its own feedback, a pattern also observed in a human proof-of-concept. In simulations under BPM's model and prior, its nominal 90% intervals for temperature-scaled reward weights achieve task-averaged marginal coverage of 88.9% and 89.2% with only 10 and 25 comparisons, respectively. BPM thus enables personalization from pairwise feedback without per-user policy training, while characterizing the coefficient ambiguity left by limited feedback.

AI.tldr: 提出贝叶斯成对合并（BPM），将未知奖励权重视为潜变量，从成对选择中推断其后验，并直接用后验均值作为专家合并系数，实现无需逐用户策略训练的个性化。
AI.motivation: 现有工作通过合并奖励专家、给定权衡权重向量来实现不同奖励权衡，但实践中用户更自然地是在输出之间做选择，而非指定数值权重。因此需要将成对选择转化为合并所需的系数，并在反馈有限时处理其歧义性。
AI.method: 将未知奖励权重作为潜变量，从成对选择与奖励分数差中推断后验分布，取后验均值直接作为合并系数，实例化为 Bayesian Pairwise Merging（BPM）；其后验同时刻画在给定反馈下哪些奖励权衡仍然合理。
AI.result: 在放射学摘要、图像描述和故事生成（覆盖文本到文本与图像到文本）上评估。每个模拟人格 100 条反馈下，BPM 相对均匀合并的宏观已决胜率为 91.7%、77.1%、64.3%。六对模拟人格中各自偏好按自身反馈拟合的模型，人类概念验证中亦观察到该模式。在 BPM 模型与先验下模拟，温度缩放奖励权重的名义 90% 区间在仅 10 和 25 次比较时任务平均边际覆盖率分别为 88.9% 和 89.2%。
AI.conclusion: BPM 能从成对反馈实现个性化，无需逐用户策略训练，同时刻画了有限反馈带来的系数歧义。

title: ChronoGraph: Functional 4D Scene Graphs with Vision-Language Models for Interaction Understanding and Grounded Planning
summary: Embodied agents must determine where to act, anticipate the resulting scene changes, and interpret observed outcomes to guide subsequent actions. This requires connecting 4D interaction understanding, which explains how past actions changed the scene, with spatially grounded planning, which determines how and where to act toward a goal and anticipates the resulting scene changes. We introduce ChronoGraph, a functional 4D scene graph that links actions on affordance parts to semantic and geometric state changes. By representing observed and anticipated transitions in the same form, it provides a shared basis for understanding and planning. We construct ChronoGraphBench through an automatic data engine that converts human-interaction videos and simulated robot trajectories into graph-annotated questions for training and evaluating Vision-Language Models (VLMs) on both tasks. Using these annotations, we train ChronoGraphVLM by adapting pretrained VLMs in two stages. Graph-as-Chain-of-Thought supervised fine-tuning teaches the models to reconstruct observed transitions and predict future ones as graph traces before answering. Subsequent joint 4D graph reinforcement learning directly rewards graph properties and answer correctness. Experiments across model scales show improvements over the corresponding pretrained baselines and zero-shot transfer to VLM4D. Real-world demonstrations further show that graph-based planning and affordance grounding support mobile manipulation through existing robot skills without additional fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ChronoGraph，一种功能性 4D 场景图，将动作与语义、几何状态变化关联，统一表示观察到的和预期的状态转移，从而为 4D 交互理解与空间规划提供共享基础。作者构建了 ChronoGraphBench 数据集，并通过两阶段训练得到 ChronoGraphVLM。
AI.motivation: 具身智能体需要决定在哪里行动、预测由此带来的场景变化，并解读观察到的结果以指导后续行动。这要求将解释过去动作如何改变场景的 4D 交互理解，与决定如何、在哪里行动并预期场景变化的空间规划联系起来。然而现有方法缺乏一个统一框架来同时支撑理解与规划。
AI.method: 提出 ChronoGraph 功能性 4D 场景图，将作用于可供性部件的动作与语义及几何状态变化相链接，用同一形式表示已观察和预期的转移。通过自动数据引擎将人类交互视频和仿真机器人轨迹转化为带图标注的问题，构建 ChronoGraphBench。基于该标注，分两阶段训练 ChronoGraphVLM：第一阶段用"图即思维链"的监督微调，令模型在回答前以图轨迹形式重建已观察转移并预测未来转移；第二阶段进行联合 4D 图强化学习，直接奖励图属性和答案正确性。
AI.result: 跨不同模型规模的实验表明，ChronoGraphVLM 相比对应的预训练基线均有提升，并能零样本迁移到 VLM4D。真实世界演示显示，基于图的规划与可供性定位可借助现有机器人技能支持移动操作，无需额外微调。
AI.conclusion: ChronoGraph 通过统一的 4D 场景图表示，将 4D 交互理解与空间规划联系起来，配合专用数据集与两阶段训练策略，有效提升了 VLM 在具身任务上的理解与规划能力，并具备零样本迁移和真实机器人部署的潜力。

title: InfoAgent: Traceable Generation and Repair of Evidence-Grounded Infographics
summary: Reliable infographic generation requires facts, symbols, and visual relations to remain consistent through rendering and revision. Correcting one element also requires tracking its supporting evidence and the dependencies affected by the change. We present \textbf{InfoAgent}, a training-free framework for \emph{evidence-bound visual-symbolic program synthesis}. Its Infographic Visual Description (IVD) records factual payloads, evidence provenance, execution routes, and verification obligations in a typed dependency graph. Retrieved design priors guide compilation, and layered execution combines raster synthesis with editable symbolic and binding objects while retaining their traces. Dependency-aware repair localizes corrections, rechecks affected dependencies, and requires protected obligations to remain satisfied under the declared checkers. Unresolved obligations remain explicit. On IGenBench, InfoAgent achieves 93.0 Q-ACC and 59.0 I-ACC. We also introduce InfoGraphicBench-Evidence, where complete-checklist pass rates on 200 test requests increase from 21.5\% for Same-IVD Prompt to 23.5\% for the initial layered output and 28.5\% after repair, using the same evidence and initial IVD. On 120 audited repair cases, localized repair edits 12.4\% of the canvas on average, compared with 67.3\% for global regeneration.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练框架InfoAgent，通过证据绑定的可视化-符号程序合成实现可靠信息图生成与依赖感知修复。
AI.motivation: 信息图生成需保证事实、符号与视觉关系在渲染和修改过程中保持一致；修正单个元素还需追踪其支撑证据与受影响的依赖关系，现有方法难以满足这一需求。
AI.method: 以信息图视觉描述（IVD）在类型化依赖图中记录事实载荷、证据溯源、执行路径与验证义务；检索设计先验指导编译；分层执行结合栅格合成与可编辑的符号及绑定对象并保留其痕迹；依赖感知修复定位修改、重检受影响依赖，并要求受保护义务在声明检查器下保持满足。
AI.result: 在IGenBench上达到93.0 Q-ACC和59.0 I-ACC；在InfoGraphicBench-Evidence的200个测试请求上，完整清单通过率由Same-IVD Prompt的21.5%提升至分层初始输出的23.5%，修复后达28.5%；120个审计修复案例中，局部修复平均仅编辑12.4%的画布，而全局重生成达67.3%。
AI.conclusion: 证据绑定与依赖感知修复能在保持证据和初始IVD一致的前提下显著提升清单通过率，并使修复更为局部高效，未解决的义务被显式保留。

title: Argus: A Real-EKS Study of When Predicting Spot Interruptions Beats Simple Checkpointing
summary: Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2) Spot is 60% to 90% cheaper than On-Demand but can be reclaimed on just a 2-minute notice; for expensive multi-node training this loss can be severe, with one reclaim costing hours of synchronous progress. We build Argus, a Kubernetes operator, and ask empirically, on a CIFAR-10 testbed, when predicting interruptions beats simple checkpointing. Argus on real EKS survives a real Spot drain with a graceful SIGTERM checkpoint, resuming from epoch 8 and losing only the in-progress epoch. Alongside, we further find that in an 80-trial benchmark, the reactive-on-notice degrades toward no protection once interruption outpaces the fixed 2-minute notice, and predictive wasted compute is driven to zero, but with an oversized fixed lead it over-migrates so severely that at the fastest rate only one of five runs completes, while periodic is a strong ML-free baseline. A lead-time sweep turns the lead prediction into a guideline where a small lead suffices for zero waste, but excess lead is wasteful. The predictor built is advisory (a proxy label); real interruption labels and large-model-scale validation are future work.

AI.tldr: Argus 是一个 Kubernetes 算子，在 CIFAR-10 测试平台上比较预测式中断与简单检查点策略；在真实 EKS 上可经受一次 Spot 回收，仅损失进行中的 epoch，并给出预测提前量设置的指导。
AI.motivation: EC2 Spot 价格比 On-Demand 便宜 60%–90%，但仅有 2 分钟回收通知；对昂贵多节点训练，一次回收可损失数小时同步进度。因此需要实证判断何时"预测中断"优于"简单检查点"。
AI.method: 构建 Kubernetes 算子 Argus，在 CIFAR-10 测试平台上开展 80 次试验基准，比较被动通知响应、预测式迁移、周期性检查点等策略，并进行提前量（lead-time）扫描。
AI.result: Argus 在真实 EKS 上经受真实 Spot drain，通过 SIGTERM 优雅检查点从 epoch 8 恢复，仅损失进行中的 epoch。基准发现：当中断快于固定 2 分钟通知时，被动式退化至无保护；预测式浪费算力可降为零，但提前量过大时过度迁移严重，最快速率下五次运行仅一次完成；周期性检查点是无需 ML 的强基线。
AI.conclusion: 提前量扫描将提前预测转化为一条指导原则：较小提前量即可实现零浪费，过量提前量则造成浪费。所构建的预测器为建议性（代理标签），真实中断标签与大模型规模验证为未来工作。

title: Values as Style: Disentangling Values from Semantics with One-Way Mixing for Low-Damage LLM Steering
summary: Value steering should change an LLM's normative priorities while preserving the scenario, facts, and task constraints underlying its answer. Conventional activation edits often change both. We introduce an editable semantic-value interface on frozen residual states, with a one-way semantic-to-value pathway that grounds value recognition in context. Stop-gradient blocks feedback through this pathway; swap consistency, topic de-confounding, and decorrelation encourage selective codes. At inference, editing the value code produces a residual delta while holding the semantic code fixed. On two instruction-tuned backbones, this interface improves semantic preservation and reduces benign refusals at comparable value alignment. A matched mixing-by-gating ablation separates representation learning from selective edit activation, and dimension-matched probes establish improved code selectivity. Against validation-selected prompting on LLaMA-3.1-8B, the method achieves comparable alignment (0.750 vs. 0.748), higher BERTScore (0.938 vs. 0.923), and fewer contradictions (5.1% vs. 7.6%). Human ratings and cross-taxonomy controls provide complementary evidence for low-damage value steering.

AI.tldr: 提出一种可编辑的语义-价值接口，在冻结残差状态上实现低损伤的价值操控。
AI.motivation: 价值操控应改变LLM的规范性优先级，同时保留其回答所依赖的场景、事实和任务约束，但传统激活编辑往往同时改变了二者。
AI.method: 在冻结残差状态上构建可编辑的语义-价值界面，采用单向语义到价值通路将价值识别置于上下文中；使用停止梯度阻断反馈，并借助交换一致性、主题去混杂与去相关来促进选择性编码；推理时固定语义编码、编辑价值编码生成残差增量。
AI.result: 在两个指令微调基座上，该方法在价值对齐相当的情况下提升语义保持并减少良性拒答；匹配的门控混合消融分离了表示学习与选择性编辑激活，维度匹配探针证明编码选择性提升。对比验证集选择的提示方法（LLaMA-3.1-8B），对齐度相当（0.750 vs. 0.748），BERTScore更高（0.938 vs. 0.923），矛盾更少（5.1% vs. 7.6%）。
AI.conclusion: 人工评分与跨分类体系对照进一步支持该方法实现了低损伤的价值操控。

title: PCB-MC: Missing Component Analysis in Printed Circuit Boards
summary: Detecting missing components on printed circuit boards (PCBs) differs fundamentally from conventional object detection, as the model must localize components that are not present. We introduce PCB-MC, a curated dataset for missing component detection with footprint level annotations built on top of the RF100 dataset. The dataset contains 197 distinct board types, each corresponding to a unique PCB design, with multiple augmented samples per type. We also provide benchmark results on PCB-MC by evaluating a diverse set of supervised and unsupervised methods. To ensure fair evaluation, we propose board type aware cross validation splits that prevent layout leakage between training and test sets. Supervised models showcase high false negative rates on unseen board designs, and unsupervised anomaly detection methods fail entirely due to the lack of spatial alignment with a board specific reference. These results confirm that missing component detection on diverse PCB layouts remains an open challenge. We release PCB-MC and all training protocols to support reproducible research on structural absence detection in industrial inspection.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 PCB-MC 数据集，专门用于印刷电路板（PCB）缺失元件检测，并提供基准评测方法，揭示该任务仍是开放挑战。
AI.motivation: PCB 缺失元件检测与传统目标检测本质不同：模型需要定位“不存在”的元件，而非仅仅识别已存在的目标。现有数据集和方法对此任务支持不足，缺乏专门的数据与评测协议。
AI.method: 构建 PCB-MC 数据集，基于 RF100 数据集，采用封装级（footprint level）标注，包含 197 种不同板型（每种对应唯一 PCB 设计），并配有多种增强样本。提出“板型感知”（board type aware）的交叉验证划分，防止训练集与测试集之间发生布局泄漏。评测了多种有监督与无监督方法。
AI.result: 有监督模型在未见过的板型上表现出很高的假阴性率；无监督异常检测方法因缺乏与板型特定参考的空间对齐而完全失效。
AI.conclusion: 在多样化 PCB 布局上的缺失元件检测仍是开放挑战。作者发布 PCB-MC 数据集及全部训练协议，以支持工业检测中“结构性缺失检测”的可复现研究。

title: SparseEngine: Sparse-First Inference Engine
summary: Long-context LLM agents accumulate interaction histories that strain KV-cache memory and attention computation. Although sparse attention reduces these costs, heterogeneous cache representations and workflows hinder integration with existing inference engines, while prior sparse-serving abstractions support only specific layouts or workflows. We present SparseEngine, a ground-up, sparse-first inference engine whose shared lifecycle contract lets each method control its KV representation and computation while coordinating state transitions with common serving infrastructure. SparseEngine supports 15 methods across four categories and enables cross-request state management through Chain Cache, which resumes KV-eviction methods from retained history, and controllable Prefix-Cache Pruning, which removes KV from selected history regions while preserving logical-prefix matching. While maintaining method quality, SparseEngine delivers over 10x higher throughput with KV eviction, over 2.5x faster decoding at matched concurrency than vLLM, and over 2x end-to-end speedup on agent benchmarks. The code is available at https://github.com/CURRENTF/SparseEngine.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SparseEngine，一个面向稀疏注意力的底层推理引擎，通过共享生命周期契约支持15种稀疏方法并实现跨请求状态管理，显著提升吞吐与解码速度。
AI.motivation: 长上下文LLM智能体的交互历史会加重KV缓存内存和注意力计算负担。稀疏注意力虽能降低成本，但异构的缓存表示与工作流阻碍其与现有推理引擎集成，且已有稀疏服务抽象仅支持特定布局或工作流。
AI.method: 提出 SparseEngine，采用从零构建的"稀疏优先"推理引擎，其共享生命周期契约让每种方法可控制自身KV表示与计算，同时与通用服务基础设施协调状态转换。引擎支持四大类共15种方法，并通过 Chain Cache 实现跨请求状态管理（使KV驱逐方法可从保留历史中恢复），以及可控的 Prefix-Cache Pruning（在保持逻辑前缀匹配的同时移除选定历史区域的KV）。
AI.result: 在保持方法质量的前提下，SparseEngine 在KV驱逐下实现超过10倍吞吐提升，在相同并发下解码速度较 vLLM 快2.5倍以上，在智能体基准上端到端加速超过2倍。
AI.conclusion: SparseEngine 作为一种稀疏优先的统一推理引擎，有效解决了异构稀疏方法集成与跨请求状态管理难题，在保持质量的同时大幅提升吞吐与速度。代码已开源。

title: A helps B while B hurts A: directed transfer in instruction-tuning mixture
summary: Adapting a language model to a specialized corpus means choosing which instruction-tuning tasks to train on under a fixed budget, and testing one choice costs a fine-tuning run. Common heuristics add more source tasks or pick sources similar to the target. The first assumes transfer is never negative; the second, that it is symmetric. We show that both assumptions fail: task $A$ can help task $B$ while $B$ hurts $A$, so helpfulness is a signed property of ordered source--target pairs. We introduce the transfer map, a signed estimate of how much each source helps or hurts each held-out target. We fit the map in hundreds of fine-tuning runs on Qwen3 and Mistral models from 0.6B to 32B parameters, with all sources drawn from one corpus and no training examples from the target. The map predicts a held-out target's accuracy on unseen mixtures: recorded before those runs, its predictions have less than half the error of a mixture-agnostic baseline. The map is specific to its target and corpus but transfers across model scale: a mixture selected in advance at one size beats training on all source tasks at every other size we tested. Transfer is thus a property of the data. The map selects the tasks that help and drops the one that interferes: accuracy on the reasoning targets (causal explanation, multi-hop questions and methodological critique) rises by up to 14 percentage points over training on all source tasks.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"迁移地图"（transfer map），一种对有序源-目标任务对帮助/损害程度的带符号估计，通过数百次微调实验拟合，能预测未见任务混合的准确率并指导任务选择，使推理类目标准确率最高提升14个百分点。
AI.motivation: 在固定预算下将语言模型适配到专门语料时，需要选择训练哪些指令微调任务，而每次尝试都要花费一次微调。常见启发式假设迁移永不为负（多加源任务）或迁移是对称的（选相似源任务），论文指出这两个假设均不成立：任务A能帮助B，而B却损害A，即帮助性是有序源-目标对的带符号属性。
AI.method: 引入迁移地图，即每个源任务对每个留出目标帮助或损害的带符号估计。在Qwen3和Mistral模型（0.6B到32B参数）上进行数百次微调运行来拟合该地图，所有源任务取自同一语料，且不使用目标任务的训练样本。地图在未见混合上的预测于运行前记录，与忽略混合的基线相比误差减半。
AI.result: 迁移地图对留出目标在未见混合上的预测误差不到混合无关基线的一半。该地图对目标和语料特定，但能跨模型规模迁移：在一个规模上预先选定的混合，在其他所有测试规模上都优于训练全部源任务。推理类目标（因果解释、多跳问题和方法论批判）的准确率相比训练全部源任务最高提升14个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 迁移是数据的属性。迁移地图能选出有帮助的任务并剔除造成干扰的任务，在保证跨模型规模可迁移性的同时显著提升目标任务的准确率，为固定预算下的指令微调任务选择提供了有效方法。

title: Towards Trustworthy AI for Glioma Diagnosis: A Task-Aware Evaluation of Uncertainty Quantification
comment: Accepted for publication at the Journal of Machine Learning for Biomedical Imaging (MELBA) https://melba-journal.org/2026:033
summary: Uncertainty Quantification (UQ) is a key requirement for trustworthy AI in high-stakes medical image analysis. In this work, we evaluate UQ in a multi-task Deep Learning framework for MRI-based glioma diagnosis that performs tumor segmentation and predicts IDH mutation status, 1p/19q co-deletion status, and tumor grade. Monte Carlo Dropout (MCD) is used for a detailed task-aware analysis of predictive, aleatoric, and epistemic uncertainty. We assess MC sample convergence, calibration, error detection, selective prediction, associations with segmentation performance, and the effect of voxel-wise uncertainty aggregation on case-level reliability. We also compare MCD with Deep Ensembles (DE) and Monte Carlo Deep Ensembles (MCDE), examine interactions between segmentation quality and classification, and evaluate a composite trust score integrating segmentation and classification uncertainty. Across tasks, uncertainty estimates supported meaningful error detection, while calibration depended on the dropout rate, with moderate rates yielding the most reliable probabilities. Uncertainty decomposition provided task-dependent interpretability but did not consistently improve error detection over predictive uncertainty alone. DE and MCDE showed comparable operational utility, with no method consistently dominating across tasks and metrics. The composite trust score did not consistently outperform classification uncertainty for selective prediction. Overall, our results provide a task-aware evaluation strategy and practical guidance for the development of trustworthy AI for glioma diagnosis.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了多任务深度学习框架在MRI胶质瘤诊断中的不确定性量化，采用蒙特卡洛Dropout、深度集成等方法，从校准、误差检测、选择性预测等角度进行任务感知分析。
AI.motivation: 在高风险医学图像分析中，不确定性量化（UQ）是可信AI的关键要求。本文旨在为基于MRI的胶质瘤诊断多任务框架提供任务感知的UQ评估策略与实践指导。
AI.method: 构建多任务框架，同时执行肿瘤分割并预测IDH突变、1p/19q共缺失及肿瘤分级。使用蒙特卡洛Dropout（MCD）进行预测、偶然与认知不确定性的分解分析，评估MC样本收敛、校准、误差检测、选择性预测及分割性能关联；并对比深度集成（DE）与蒙特卡洛深度集成（MCDE），考察分割质量与分类的交互，以及融合两类不确定性的复合信任评分。
AI.result: 各任务中不确定性估计均支持有意义的误差检测；校准依赖dropout率，中等比率给出最可靠的概率。不确定性分解提供了任务相关的可解释性，但未稳定优于仅用预测不确定性。DE与MCDE操作效用相当，无方法在各任务和指标上全面占优。复合信任评分在选择性预测中未稳定超过分类不确定性。
AI.conclusion: 研究提供了任务感知的UQ评估策略，并为胶质瘤诊断可信AI的开发提供了实践指导：需按任务选择合适方法与dropout率，并谨慎对待不确定性分解与复合评分的增益。

title: HO-FL: Hybrid-Order Federated Learning for Heterogeneous Edge Devices
summary: Federated learning (FL) on memory-constrained edge devices faces a dilemma: first-order (FO) optimization (i.e., backpropagation) demands substantial memory, whereas zeroth-order (ZO) optimization suffers from severe convergence slowdown. To resolve this dilemma, we introduce HO-FL, a hybrid-order FL framework that trains a model's bottom segment with ZO optimization and its top segment with FO optimization. Each device can flexibly select its order boundary according to its memory budget while participating in the training of the same global model. Moreover, our convergence analysis reveals a new, fundamental trade-off: clients with larger FO-trained segments can provide more accurate updates, but favoring them can underrepresent other clients' data. We connect this trade-off to the bias and variance of actual multi-step local updates, yielding a sampling optimization problem and a practical dimension-aware approximation with direct model averaging. Experiments on language tasks examine task performance, client memory, and sampling under data heterogeneity. The results show that hybrid-order local training can retain much of the full-FO performance with substantially lower client memory requirements. Our code is available at https://github.com/HKU-WILL-Lab/HO-FL.

AI.tldr: HO-FL是一种混合阶联邦学习框架，模型底层用零阶优化、顶层用一阶优化，设备按内存预算灵活选择分界，在显著降低内存的同时保留接近全一阶的性能。
AI.motivation: 内存受限的边缘设备在联邦学习中面临两难：一阶优化（反向传播）内存开销大，而零阶优化收敛速度严重变慢。需要一种能兼顾内存与收敛性能的方案。
AI.method: 提出HO-FL混合阶框架：模型底部用零阶优化、顶部用一阶优化，各设备按内存预算自行选择阶数分界并共同训练同一全局模型。收敛分析揭示新权衡（一阶段更大的客户端更新更准确，但偏向它们会使其他客户端数据代表不足），并将该权衡与多步本地更新的偏差和方差联系，转化为采样优化问题，给出实用的维度感知近似结合直接模型平均。
AI.result: 在语言任务上考察任务性能、客户端内存与数据异构下的采样。结果表明混合阶本地训练能以大幅降低的客户端内存保留大部分全一阶性能。
AI.conclusion: HO-FL通过混合阶本地训练有效缓解了内存与收敛的两难问题，并提出了新的收敛权衡及采样优化方法，兼顾性能与内存效率。

title: ArchitectureIQ: On the Measure of Training Intuition
comment: 29 pages, 10 figures. Code and reproduction materials: https://github.com/renrua52/ArchitectureIQ
summary: Top researchers have good intuition, but do language models have as good intuition about model training as top AI researchers? To measure model intuition of LLMs and humans, we introduce the ArchitectureIQ benchmark. Each question presents a synthetic dataset and several training recipes, and the test-taker is asked to predict the recipe yielding the best test metric. Overall, we find that LLMs' model intuition is good but has four limitations: (1) The intuition is imperfect, or even sub-human in some cases. Frontier models achieve around 76% accuracy (random choice 33%) vs best human researcher (66.0%), yet remain far from perfect. For architecture-only questions, best human achieves 65% while GPT-6 Astra only has 38%. (2) The intuition is empirical, not structured, supported by the fact that more CoT compute does not lead to substantial improvement. Unlike math, we still lack a "Science of AI" language that enables structured reasoning on AI. (3) The intuition is not maximally condensed, and can be further compressed into a knoledge base. Our constructed knowledge base with only 20 items yields large gains for weak models: GPT-4o equipped with the accumulated knowledge almost matches the performance of Claude Opus 5. (4) The intuition is insensitive to dataset properties, but the best model should in general depend on data properties. This suggests that data is the real "dark matter" in AI -- LLMs (so do human researchers) understand too little about data, even less than model architectures.

AI.tldr: 提出 ArchitectureIQ 基准，通过"给定合成数据集与多种训练配方，预测哪个配方能得到最佳测试指标"来测量 LLM 与人类研究者的模型训练直觉，发现 LLM 直觉可用但存在四大局限。
AI.motivation: 顶尖研究者拥有良好的"模型直觉"，但语言模型是否也具备同等水平的训练直觉尚不清楚，缺乏对这一能力的系统评测手段。
AI.method: 构建 ArchitectureIQ 基准：每题提供合成数据集与若干训练配方，要求受测者预测能获得最佳测试指标的配方；对 LLM 与人类研究者进行对比评测，并开展 CoT 计算量、知识库注入、数据属性敏感性等分析。随机基线为 33%。
AI.result: 前沿模型准确率约 76%，优于最佳人类研究者（66.0%），但远非完美；架构类问题上最佳人类 65%，而 GPT-6 Astra 仅 38%。增加 CoT 计算量未带来显著提升；仅含 20 条目的知识库即可让 GPT-4o 接近 Claude Opus 5 的水平；模型直觉对数据集属性不敏感。
AI.conclusion: LLM 的模型直觉"好但有四大局限"：非完美甚至局部低于人类、经验性而非结构化、未被最大程度压缩成知识库、对数据属性不敏感。作者据此认为数据是 AI 中的真正"暗物质"，LLM 与人类研究者对数据的理解都远少于对模型架构的理解，仍缺少支撑结构化推理的"AI 科学"语言。

title: CAST: Causal Advantage-Structured Training with Spatially Grounded Compositional Rewards for Diffusion Models
summary: Online reinforcement learning has been extended to flow matching for diffusion model (DM) image generation. However, this paradigm faces three limitations: (1) Window selection. Existing methods manually set the stochastic differential equation (SDE) sampling window, i.e., the denoising steps where exploration noise is injected. We instead determine it from each model's denoising trajectory. (2) Reward saturation. Current methods rely on scoring models trained on human annotations; we find that such scores are extremely high and nearly indistinguishable on the latest SOTA open-source DMs, making advantage estimation largely ineffective. (3) Sample inefficiency. A single scalar reward collapses different failure modes into almost identical scores, leaving minimal gradient guidance for targeted improvement. To address these issues, we propose CAST (Causal Advantage-Structured Training), an RL fine-tuning method for pretrained DMs, which (1) identifies the denoising step at which each model fixes the objects and their spatial arrangement in the image and uses that timing to set the SDE window, (2) decomposes each prompt via Causal Scene Graphs (CSG) into verifiable-atoms, i.e., minimal semantic units such as an object, count, attribute, or spatial relation that can each be checked independently, and rewards each atom separately, and (3) projects the signed atom-level advantages into pixel space through teacher-forced attention and uses them to spatially weight the SDE policy objective. We fine-tune two of the strongest open-source DMs, FLUX.2-dev and Qwen-Image-2512, with CAST, and evaluate them on GenEval 2, a compositional benchmark, and on Qwen-Image-Bench for overall quality. Within almost the same training budget, CAST's improvement over the base model on the most challenging GenEval 2 prompts is up to 3.07x that of Flow-GRPO, while overall generation quality also improves.

AI.tldr: 提出 CAST，一种针对预训练扩散模型的强化学习微调方法，通过自适应确定 SDE 采样窗口、基于因果场景图的原子化奖励以及像素空间优势投影，解决了流匹配 RL 中的窗口选择、奖励饱和与样本低效三大问题。
AI.motivation: 在线强化学习已被扩展到流匹配以用于扩散模型图像生成，但现有范式存在三个局限：(1) 窗口选择依赖人工设定注入探索噪声的 SDE 采样窗口（去噪步）；(2) 奖励饱和——基于人工标注训练的评分模型在最新开源扩散模型上得分极高且几乎无法区分，导致优势估计基本失效；(3) 样本低效——单一标量奖励将不同失败模式压缩为近乎相同的分数，缺乏针对性改进的梯度指引。
AI.method: CAST（因果优势结构化训练）包含三点设计：(1) 从每个模型自身的去噪轨迹中识别其固定对象及其空间布局的去噪步，据此设定 SDE 窗口；(2) 通过因果场景图（CSG）将每个提示分解为可验证原子，即对象、计数、属性、空间关系等可独立检验的最小语义单元，并对每个原子分别奖励；(3) 通过教师强制注意力将带符号的原子级优势投影到像素空间，用其空间加权 SDE 策略目标。
AI.result: 作者用 CAST 微调了两个最强开源扩散模型 FLUX.2-dev 和 Qwen-Image-2512，并在组合性基准 GenEval 2 与整体质量基准 Qwen-Image-Bench 上评估。在几乎相同的训练预算下，CAST 在最难的 GenEval 2 提示上相对基座模型的提升最高达 Flow-GRPO 的 3.07 倍，同时整体生成质量也有所提升。
AI.conclusion: CAST 通过轨迹驱动的 SDE 窗口选择、原子化因果奖励分解与像素空间优势投影，有效缓解了扩散模型流匹配强化学习中的奖励饱和与梯度稀疏问题，在组合性生成上显著优于 Flow-GRPO，并兼顾整体质量。

title: Parameter symmetries determine representational geometry in overparameterized nonlinear networks
comment: To appear in NeurIPS 2026. 89 pages, 9 figures. Code: https://github.com/mrvnthss/symmetries-representational-geometry
summary: Representations are routinely used across machine learning, psychology, and neuroscience to draw inferences about the computations of biological and artificial systems. Such inferences presume a meaningful link between representational geometry and the computation being performed. For artificial neural networks, however, the extent to which function constrains representation remains unclear. One key obstacle is that these networks admit parameter symmetries: changes in parameterization that preserve function exactly while reshaping representational geometry. Here, we show that a broad class of parameter symmetries acts on representations through just three primitive feature transformations: addition, duplication, and scaling. This feature-level characterization yields a closed-form decomposition of representational geometry into essential and auxiliary components, which makes precise how degeneracy in representational geometry can grow with overparameterization even when function is held fixed. Finally, we show that implementation-level selection rules can resolve this degeneracy, yielding identifiable geometries in which features are weighted according to their contributions to the network's function. Together, our results delineate when representations can support inferences about computation, and when they cannot.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示神经网络参数对称性通过三种基本特征变换作用于表征，从而将表征几何分解为本质与辅助成分，阐明过参数化下表征简并性，并给出实现层面选择规则以获得可识别几何。
AI.motivation: 研究常假设表征几何与计算之间存在有意义的联系，但人工神经网络中函数在多大程度上约束表征仍不明确。主要障碍是参数对称性：改变参数可精确保持函数不变，却重塑表征几何。因此需厘清何时表征能支持关于计算的推断，何时不能。
AI.method: 作者分析一类广泛的参数对称性，证明它们通过加法、复制和缩放三种基本特征变换作用于表征。基于此特征层面的刻画，推导出表征几何的闭式分解，将其拆分为本质成分与辅助成分，并分析过参数化下简并性随参数增长的变化；最后引入实现层面的选择规则以消除简并。
AI.result: 发现广泛的参数对称性等价于三种基本特征变换；得到表征几何的闭式分解，精确刻画了在函数固定时表征简并性如何随过参数化增长；证明实现层面选择规则可消除简并，产生可识别几何，其中特征按其功能贡献加权。
AI.conclusion: 该工作界定了表征何时能够支持关于计算的推断、何时不能，为跨机器学习、心理学和神经科学中基于表征的推断提供了理论界限。

title: Trust Is Not a Score: Runtime Assurance Contracts for High-Risk AI Agents
comment: 16 pages, 2 figures, 5 tables. Ancillary files: decision log, executable transition model, LLM-labelled synthetic holdout. Synthetic mechanism study; no deployment claim
summary: Benchmarks, audits, and agent protocols describe performance, permissions, and repair, but not how observed evidence should change an agent's authority during a consequential task. We call this the assurance-transition gap. We propose a Runtime Assurance Contract (RAC), a policy-level formal schema binding autonomy boundaries, component eligibility, evidence state, transition policy, human-review capacity, and non-compensatory gates. Under RAC, soft metrics may inform routing, whereas a failed or unknown mandatory gate forces retry, switch, escalation, deferral, or stop; aggregate performance cannot authorize action. We define the contract, an evidence record, a permission rule, and five invariants, and illustrate them in clinical, industrial, and judicial failure probes. We then report a deterministic failure-injection study in agentic coding: 280 constructed cases evaluated by a gate conjunction, a score-only rule, and a restricted protocol baseline. At the published example weights and threshold, the score rule admits 80 of 100 block-required injections and all 40 review-required injections. Tuned in hindsight, it matches the conjunction on this corpus. For positive weights, a positive threshold, binary risk signals, zero-signal controls, and an injected case firing each signal alone, we show that exact agreement holds if and only if the threshold does not exceed the smallest weight. A separate set of 18 hand-authored traces checks version-pinned evidence and review transitions against simpler policy variants. In a further prospective synthetic holdout of 24 episodes, two blinded LLM judges assign identical labels to all 72 action attempts; RAC and a separately implemented full stateful baseline both match these labels. These studies test mechanisms on synthetic cases; they establish neither deployed safety nor cross-domain effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"运行时保障契约"(RAC)，一种策略级形式化模式，将自主性边界、组件资格、证据状态、转移策略、人工审查能力和非补偿性门控绑定起来，以弥合"保障转移缺口"——即证据在任务过程中应如何改变智能体权限的问题，并通过确定性失败注入实验和合成验证进行机制测试。
AI.motivation: 现有基准、审计和智能体协议能够描述性能、权限与修复，但无法说明在关键任务过程中，已观察到的证据应当如何改变智能体的权限，这构成了"保障转移缺口"。核心问题在于：聚合性能指标不应成为授权行动的依据，而当前缺乏一个正式机制来规定证据状态如何触发权限转移。
AI.method: 提出运行时保障契约(RAC)：一种策略级形式化模式，绑定自主性边界、组件资格、证据状态、转移策略、人工审查能力和非补偿性门控。定义契约、证据记录、权限规则及五条不变量。开展确定性失败注入研究(智能体编码场景共280个构造案例)，由门控合取、纯分数规则和受限协议基线评估；另进行18条手工撰写轨迹测试版本固定证据与审查转移；并用24个前瞻性合成留出样本，由两名盲审LLM评判者对全部72次行动尝试标注标签，与RAC及独立实现的全状态基线比对。
AI.result: 在公布的示例权重与阈值下，纯分数规则放行了100个需拦截注入中的80个，以及全部40个需审查注入。事后调优后，该规则在本语料上与合取门控一致。对于正权重、正阈值、二元风险信号、零信号对照以及单独触发每个信号的注入案例，证明精确一致成立当且仅当阈值不超过最小权重。在24个合成留出样本中，两名盲审LLM评判者对全部72次行动尝试标注完全一致的标签，RAC与独立实现的全状态基线均与这些标签匹配。18条手工轨迹检查了版本固定证据与审查转移对简单策略变体的表现。
AI.conclusion: RAC提供了在关键任务中基于证据状态驱动权限转移的正式机制，确立了非补偿性门控原则——聚合性能不能授权行动，强制门控失败或未知须触发重试、切换、升级、延迟或停止。研究结果表明其机制在合成案例上有效，但需注意这些研究仅测试了机制，既未确立实际部署安全性，也未证明跨域有效性。未来需在真实部署环境与跨领域中进一步验证。

title: ResARC: Residual-Aware AutoRegressive Coding for Ultra-Low Bitrate Image Compression
summary: Progressive autoregressive image codecs provide an appealing paradigm for generative compression by quantizing continuous latents into discrete tokens, transmitting coarse-to-fine prefix tokens and generating the remaining suffix tokens at the decoder. However, their reconstruction quality is fundamentally limited by two residuals introduced along this pipeline: the quantization residual, arising from information loss during discrete tokenization, and the generation residual, resulting from imperfect autoregressive generation of the suffix tokens. To address these limitations, we introduce ResARC, a residual-aware autoregressive codec that explicitly compensates for both residuals at the decoder. Specifically, we generate the quantization residual with a diffusion transformer conditioned on the autoregressive decoding context, while requiring no additional side information. In parallel, we compute the generation residual at the encoder and employ a learned Generation Residual Codec to efficiently compress and transmit it for decoder-side correction. The recovered residuals are then integrated with the reconstructed latent representation and decoded through an adapted VAE decoder. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ResARC achieves competitive perceptual similarity while substantially improving distributional fidelity over leading generative codecs across the ultra-low bitrate regime. Code and models will be released soon.

AI.tldr: ResARC是一种残差感知的自回归图像编解码器，在解码端同时补偿量化残差与生成残差，显著提升超低码率下的分布保真度。
AI.motivation: 渐进式自回归图像编解码器通过将连续潜变量量化为离散token、传输粗到细的前缀token并在解码端生成后缀token来实现生成式压缩。但其重建质量受限于两个残差：离散化带来的量化残差，以及后缀token自回归生成不完美造成的生成残差。
AI.method: 提出ResARC，在解码端显式补偿两种残差：(1) 用量化残差扩散Transformer以自回归解码上下文为条件生成量化残差，且无需额外边信息；(2) 在编码端计算生成残差，通过可学习的生成残差编解码器（Generation Residual Codec）高效压缩并传输，用于解码端校正。恢复的残差与重建潜表示融合，经适配的VAE解码器解码。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，在超低码率场景下，ResARC在保持有竞争力的感知相似度的同时，相比主流生成式编解码器显著提升了分布保真度。
AI.conclusion: 通过残差感知建模同时抑制量化与生成两类残差，ResARC为提升自回归生成式压缩的重建质量提供了有效途径。代码与模型即将开源。

title: Shared Phase and Retention Control for Efficient Adaptive Spectral Recurrence
summary: As new evidence arrives, a sequence model must update what it remembers and how memory influences predictions. While Transformers incur computation and cache costs scaling with context length, fixed-state recurrent models offer constant-memory inference. However, linear and spectral recurrences traditionally rely on static transitions, failing to dynamically revise how stored representations decay or rotate. While recent selective architectures introduce input-dependent transitions, they assign independent controls to every memory mode, coupling control cost to state capacity. We show that high-dimensional spectral memory does not require high-dimensional control, and introduce Shared Phase and Retention Control for Efficient Adaptive Spectral Recurrence (SPARC). SPARC employs just two input-dependent scalar signals to coordinate memory retention and phase rotation across heterogeneous complex modes, while preserving mode-specific baseline timescales and frequencies. Its diagonal affine recurrence supports parallel associative scans for sequence-level BPTT as well as exact structured Real-Time Recurrent Learning (RTRL) for online credit assignment. Across partially observable continuous control, POPGym, and sequence classification, SPARC achieves a 9.09% relative return improvement on Walker-P and a 1.36% relative accuracy gain on FordA over second-best methods. On an NVIDIA Blackwell GPU, our implementation reduces recurrent-mixer training latency by 18.2%-34.2% in fixed-token workloads and accelerates scans by 3.1x-4.7x over an optimized RG-LRU baseline. These results show that two shared control signals can efficiently govern adaptive spectral memory across online and full-sequence settings. Code is available at https://github.com/Botwwt/sparc.

AI.tldr: SPARC 用两个输入依赖的标量信号共享控制高维谱记忆的保留与相位旋转，兼顾常数内存、并行扫描与精确在线学习。
AI.motivation: 序列模型需随新证据更新记忆及记忆对预测的影响。Transformer 的计算与缓存随上下文增长，固定状态循环模型可常数内存推理，但线性与谱循环通常依赖静态转移，无法动态修正记忆的衰减或旋转；近期选择性架构虽引入输入依赖转移，却为每个记忆模式分配独立控制，导致控制成本随状态容量耦合上升。作者旨在证明高维谱记忆无需高维控制。
