summary: Developmental psychology holds that certain priors are given to infants prior to experience rather than induced from data, and that the influence of such priors is suppressed under strong, well-constrained conditions but reasserts itself under weak ones. We ask whether an analogous principle holds for the Transformer: can the activation function given to attention heads serve as an intrinsic inductive bias? We propose Mixture of Function Attention (MoFA), a parameter-free modification to multi-head attention that fixes a ratio of softmax and sigmoid heads before training. Across five ratios, a 124M-parameter GPT-2 model, and five seeds, we find that this given ratio has little effect in-distribution -- differences between ratios are statistically negligible for moderate mixtures and remain small even at the extremes -- but its influence re-emerges sharply under zero-shot distribution shift across 15 out-of-distribution domains. Perplexity gaps between ratios widen by more than an order of magnitude on several domains, and the best-performing ratio tracks a single axis of domain structure, separating short, informal text (softmax-favoring) from technical, long-form text (sigmoid-favoring), that explains 78.3% of the variance in domain response. This reorganization is visible at the head level: sigmoid heads show an accelerating drop in attention entropy as their ratio increases, while softmax heads respond more modestly, yielding a consistent division of labor between the two head types. Our results suggest that activation choice functions as a given prior whose influence is masked in-distribution and re-emerges out-of-distribution.

AI.tldr: 在多头注意力中固定 softmax 与 sigmoid 头比例（MoFA），发现该比例在同分布下影响可忽略，但在零样本分布偏移下影响显著放大，表现为注意力头的分工重组。
AI.motivation: 发展心理学认为某些先验是先天给定而非从数据中归纳的，且其影响在强约束条件下被抑制、在弱约束条件下重新显现。作者追问 Transformer 是否存在类似原理：赋予注意力头的激活函数能否作为一种内在归纳偏置。
AI.method: 提出 Mixture of Function Attention (MoFA)：对多头注意力做无参数修改，在训练前固定 softmax 头与 sigmoid 头的比例。使用 124M 参数的 GPT-2 模型、5 种比例、5 个随机种子进行实验，并在 15 个域外领域评估零样本分布偏移表现。
AI.result: 同分布下各比例差异在统计上可忽略（中等混合比例尤其如此，极端比例差异也较小）；零样本分布偏移下差异急剧重现，多个域上的困惑度差距扩大一个数量级以上。最佳比例沿单一域结构轴排列，区分短文本/非正式文本（偏好 softmax）与技术性长文本（偏好 sigmoid），解释 78.3% 的域响应方差。头级别上，sigmoid 头的注意力熵随其比例上升加速下降，softmax 头响应更温和，形成两种头类型间稳定的分工。
AI.conclusion: 激活函数选择可作为一种“给定先验”：其影响在同分布下被掩盖，而在分布外重新显现。这为 Transformer 中先验与数据关系的类比提供了证据，并揭示注意力头类型间的功能分工。

title: PTNO: Training Neural Operators with Noisy Monte Carlo Estimates for Particle Transport Problems
summary: Particle transport under multiple scattering is central to radiative transfer and plasma physics, yet high-fidelity Monte Carlo (MC) simulations must trace prohibitively many particles. Learning-based surrogates can amortize this cost, but typically train on expensive, well-converged MC solutions. We propose the Particle Transport Neural Operator (PTNO), a neural operator that learns particle transport surrogates directly from noisy, low-cost MC labels. Such labels pose two challenges: (1) high variance, which destabilizes standard supervised learning, and (2) a high dynamic range (HDR) spanning many orders of magnitude. For the first, we learn the solution operator from noisy labels of many configurations, amortizing MC cost and generalizing to unseen configurations. Because MC labels are unbiased, we show that the squared loss on them shares its minimizer with the loss on converged solutions, and our budget-allocation study over training scenes $M$, MC samples per render $N$, and independent renders per scene $K$ shows that many noisy scenes beat fewer converged ones. For the second, a nonlinear transform such as the logarithm biases noisy supervision. Instead, PTNO keeps labels in physical space and enforces positivity with a softplus output layer that represents small values effectively. We further train with a pointwise relative $L_2$ loss (PRelL2), the stop-gradient relative loss of HDR denoising and neural rendering, which normalizes each residual by the stop-gradient prediction instead of the noisy label. We demonstrate PTNO on neutron transport in fusion reactors and radiative transfer in participating media. On the two neutronics tasks, PTNO is $10^4$-$10^5\times$ faster than converged MC on the same CPU and $10^3$-$10^5\times$ cheaper than MC at matched accuracy; on the two radiative-transfer tasks, MC at matched accuracy costs $0.8$-$11\times$ as much as PTNO.

AI.tldr: 提出PTNO神经算子，可直接从噪声、低成本蒙特卡洛标签中学习粒子输运代理模型，解决高方差与高动态范围两大挑战，实现比收敛MC快10^4-10^5倍。
AI.motivation: 粒子输运在辐射传输和等离子体物理中核心，但高保真蒙特卡洛模拟需追踪过多粒子，成本极高。现有学习型代理模型通常依赖昂贵、已收敛的MC解进行训练，难以摊销成本。
AI.method: PTNO直接从带噪、低成本MC标签学习解算子。针对高方差：利用MC标签无偏性，证明其在平方损失下与收敛解共享极小值点，并通过训练场景数M、每渲染MC样本数N、每场景独立渲染数K的预算分配研究，证明多噪声场景优于少收敛场景。针对高动态范围：不采用对数等非线性变换（会引入偏差），而是在物理空间保留标签，用softplus输出层强制正性以有效表示小值；并采用逐点相对L2损失（PRelL2），以stop-gradient预测归一化残差。
AI.result: 在核反应堆中子输运与参与介质辐射传输上验证。两个中子学任务中，PTNO在相同CPU上比收敛MC快10^4-10^5倍，在匹配精度下比MC便宜10^3-10^5倍；两个辐射传输任务中，匹配精度的MC成本是PTNO的0.8-11倍。
AI.conclusion: PTNO证明了可直接从噪声、低成本MC标签学习高保真粒子输运代理模型，避免了昂贵的收敛解训练，显著降低成本并保持精度。

title: A Generalizable and Explainable Framework for Synthetic Video Detection Using First-Digit Gradient Statistics
summary: AI video generators have not only become harder to detect but are used to generate a diverse set of scenarios from landscapes to street views to animal videos. This creates a problem where CNN-based detectors are effective but offer no insight into their inner workings, while forensics-based detectors are often pretrained for a set scenario or become too complex to derive meaningful insights. We present a novel approach to AI video detection using Sobel gradient values analysed with the first-digit law. Using linear discriminant analysis, we visualise the discriminatory signal, while a multi-layer perceptron is used for classification. The detection method has no generator- or scenespecific features, and the model has no knowledge of container formats, codec, bitrate, or compression artefacts. The model is trained and tested on GenBuster-200K, GenBusterBench, GenVA, FaceForensics++ C23, and CelebDF. We also show how zero-shot detection fails even though the feature set carries a discriminatory signal.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于Sobel梯度值与首位数字定律（first-digit law）的AI视频检测方法，结合线性判别分析可视化判别信号，并用多层感知机分类，在多个数据集上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: AI视频生成器不仅越来越难以检测，且能生成从风景、街景到动物视频等多样场景。现有CNN检测器虽有效但缺乏可解释性，而取证类检测器往往针对特定场景预训练，或过于复杂难以得出有意义的见解。因此需要一个无生成器或场景特定特征、且具备可解释性的检测方案。
AI.method: 方法基于Sobel梯度值，利用首位数字定律进行分析。采用线性判别分析（LDA）可视化判别信号，使用多层感知机（MLP）进行分类。该检测方法不含生成器或场景特定特征，模型也不依赖容器格式、编解码器、比特率或压缩伪影信息。在GenBuster-200K、GenBusterBench、GenVA、FaceForensics++ C23和CelebDF上训练与测试。
AI.result: 模型在上述多个数据集上完成训练与测试，验证了方法的有效性。同时结果表明，尽管特征集携带判别信号，零样本检测（zero-shot detection）仍然会失败。
AI.conclusion: 基于Sobel梯度与首位数字定律的检测方法为AI视频检测提供了一种无需生成器或场景特定特征、且具备可解释性的新思路；但零样本泛化仍是局限。

title: Dynamics to decision: A mathematical theory of Lyapunov spectra and decision boundaries in deep classifiers
summary: A deep classifier is defined not only by the decision it produces, but also by the sequence of transformations through which that decision is formed. Treating this evolution as a dynamical system across layers provides a natural framework for asking how decision geometry emerges through depth and how far back we can trace a boundary's dynamical signature. We model a feed-forward classifier as a finite, nonautonomous discrete dynamical system, with layers playing the role of discrete time steps. We study the Finite-Time Maximum Lyapunov Exponent (FTMLE) of the data samples' dynamical trajectory through depths of the classifier. The FTMLE measures the rate of convergence/divergence of nearby trajectories. We move the observation endpoint backward from probabilities to logits and then to hidden representations. For Gaussian classes, we prove that probability-level FTMLE carries a clear geometric signature of the decision boundary, with its dominant direction aligned with the boundary normal. Moving one step backward to the logits, we prove this relationship is no longer universal but depends critically on how the classifier is trained, particularly on the choice of loss function. Moving further backward to the hidden representation, the connection becomes more conditional: boundary-related FTMLE can persist, but only under identifiable structural conditions. We propose geometry-aware fine-tuning for restructuring the classifier's hidden FTMLE, and propose conditions for guaranteed concentration of high hidden FTMLE near the decision boundary. Through our numerical results, we show the generality and validity of our theoretical results. Understanding the evolution of data samples as traveling through the layers of classifier provides a principled foundation for identifying where boundary-relevant sensitivity emerges and for developing layer-aware regularization strategies.

AI.tldr: 本文将前馈分类器建模为非自治离散动力系统，研究数据样本穿越各层轨迹的有限时间最大Lyapunov指数（FTMLE），从概率、logit到隐表征逐层回溯决策边界的动力学特征，并提出几何感知微调方法。
AI.motivation: 深度分类器不仅由最终决策定义，还由形成该决策的逐层变换序列定义。作者希望借助动力系统视角，理解决策几何如何在深度中涌现，以及能在多大程度上回溯边界的动力学特征，为识别边界敏感性和层感知正则化提供原则性基础。
AI.method: 将前馈分类器视为有限的、非自治的离散动力系统，层作为离散步；计算数据样本轨迹的FTMLE以衡量邻近轨迹的收敛/发散速率。观测端点从概率后移到logit，再到隐表征：对高斯类证明概率级FTMLE具有清晰的边界几何特征且主方向与边界法向对齐；对logit证明该关系不普适，依赖训练方式与损失函数；对隐表征证明关系更具条件性，仅在可识别的结构条件下持续存在。并据此提出几何感知微调及高隐层FTMLE在决策边界附近集中保证的条件。
AI.result: 理论证明：概率级FTMLE主方向与决策边界法向对齐；logit级该关系取决于损失函数与训练方式；隐表征级边界相关FTMLE仅在特定结构条件下保持。数值实验验证了理论结果的普遍性与有效性，并支持所提几何感知微调的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 把数据样本视作穿越分类器各层的"旅行"，为定位边界相关敏感性的涌现位置、以及设计层感知正则化策略提供了原则性框架。

title: Agent Error Dataset: Scaling 50,000 Error--Diagnosis Pairs for Failure Analysis and Error-Aware Post-Training
summary: An unsuccessful LLM agent rollout contains more information than its final reward: the observations available to the agent, the actions it chose, and the environment's responses. Reusing this experience for learning requires identifying a decision to revise and testing a concrete alternative. We introduce the Agent Error Dataset (AED), comprising 50,228 error-diagnosis pairs from 9,961 source tasks across 33 environments, 19 harness families, and 23 policy models in text-based agent systems. We retain source traces and execution metadata to support cross-setting failure analysis and re-diagnosis without repeating the original rollout. Our five-stage Agentic Error-to-Training (AET) pipeline collects natural failures, generates diagnoses and proposed corrections, and checks them against recorded evidence. Where replay is supported, we compare corrections with original-action retries from the same checkpoint under matched execution settings. We then construct separate training views for diagnosis and actor recovery. Across 3,062 matched replay pairs, first-proposal corrections raise verifier pass rates from 18.4% to 51.1%, a gain of 32.7 percentage points. Using a separately frozen diagnosis release, full-diagnosis fine-tuning on 1,656 source tasks raises Qwen3-8B's exact-step agreement with internal teacher labels from 47.2% to 63.6%, averaged over three seeds on a 943-case holdout. The strongest prompted reference in this comparison scores 54.7%, and mean agreement improves at each of four increasing training-set sizes. In a single-seed comparison of actor-training recipes, action-only repair training scores 6.67 percentage points higher on WebShop-lite than success-only training.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Agent Error Dataset (AED)，包含来自33个环境、19个harness家族、23个策略模型的50,228个错误诊断对，并构建五阶段Agentic Error-to-Training (AET)流水线，将失败经验转化为诊断与恢复训练数据。
AI.motivation: 失败的LLM agent rollout中蕴含的信息远超最终奖励——包括观测、动作和环境响应。复用这些经验进行学习需要识别待修正的决策并测试具体的替代方案，但缺乏系统化的数据集和流水线支持跨设定的失败分析与再诊断。
AI.method: 构建AED数据集，保留源轨迹与执行元数据；设计五阶段AET流水线：收集自然失败、生成诊断与修正建议、对照记录证据检查；在支持replay的场景下，将修正与同一检查点的原始动作重试在匹配执行设定下比较；随后为诊断和actor恢复构建独立训练视图。
AI.result: 在3,062个匹配replay对中，首次提议的修正将verifier通过率从18.4%提升至51.1%（+32.7个百分点）。在1,656个源任务上全诊断微调使Qwen3-8B与内部教师标签的exact-step一致率从47.2%提升至63.6%（943案例holdout，三seed平均），最强prompted基线为54.7%。单seed比较中，action-only修复训练在WebShop-lite上比success-only训练高6.67个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 失败rollout可用于有效训练：首次修正提议即可大幅提升通过率，全诊断微调显著提升agent与教师标签的一致率，且action-only修复训练优于仅成功训练。

title: KilometerVision: A New Frontier for Large-Scale Spatial Intelligence in VLMs
summary: We push the frontier of large-scale spatial intelligence in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) and introduce the first benchmark that probes geographical layout understanding from real-world videos, spanning up to 1km distances. Inspired by the cognitive science literature, we evaluate models against the hierarchical stages of human spatial awareness: anchoring via landmarks, connecting them through routes, and integrating these into global mental maps. Extensive experiments reveal a fundamental divergence in how current AI models process spatial information. Instead of utilising true path integration or forming geometric survey knowledge, we find that VLMs rely almost entirely on 2D visual recognition and text-matching to bypass complex spatial reasoning. The benchmark is publicly available at https://perception-test-challenge.github.io/kilometervision.html.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个针对公里级真实视频地理布局理解的VLM基准，借鉴认知科学中人类空间认知的三个层级（地标锚定、路径连接、全局心智地图）来评测模型，发现当前VLM几乎完全依赖2D视觉识别与文本匹配，绕过了真正的空间推理。
AI.motivation: 推动视觉语言模型在大尺度空间智能方面的前沿研究。现有评测缺乏针对真实世界视频、覆盖公里级距离的地理布局理解基准，因此需要构建首个此类基准来系统检验模型的空间认知能力。
AI.method: 受认知科学文献启发，构建涵盖最远1公里距离的真实世界视频基准，将人类空间意识分为三个层级进行评测：通过地标进行锚定、通过路线连接地标、以及整合为全局心智地图。
AI.result: 大量实验揭示了当前AI模型处理空间信息时的根本性分歧：模型并未使用真正的路径整合或形成几何测量知识，而是几乎完全依赖2D视觉识别和文本匹配来绕过复杂的空间推理。
AI.conclusion: 当前VLM缺乏真正的空间推理能力，主要依赖表面视觉与文本线索；该基准已公开可用，为后续研究提供了评测平台。

title: Importance-Aware Feature Sparsification for Wireless Split Learning
comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE Journal on Selected Areas in Communications
summary: Wireless split learning (SL) reduces on-device computation by offloading upper layers to a server, yet transmitting high-dimensional intermediate features at each iteration remains a major communication bottleneck. Existing methods select features at the client side using task-agnostic criteria such as magnitude, statistics, or clustering, which increases client-side processing and often degrades accuracy under non-independent and identically distributed (non-i.i.d.) client data. We propose importance-aware class-balanced sparsification (ICS), a lightweight approach in which the server ranks feature channels using Grad-CAM-based scores obtained from the true-class logit during backpropagation. The per-class scores are aggregated into a class-balanced, label-agnostic importance vector that mitigates head-class bias under label skew, and each client reuses this vector in the next round to retain the top-$N$ feature channels, incurring no additional client-side forward or backward passes. We further derive a non-asymptotic convergence bound that isolates the sparsification-induced error and characterizes how the sparsification ratio and mini-batch size jointly affect convergence under a fixed communication budget, and we analyze the communication and computational overhead of ICS against representative baselines. Beyond sequential CNN-based SL, we extend ICS to parallel split learning and to transformer-based models. Experiments show that ICS consistently outperforms the baselines, with larger gains under severe non-i.i.d. partitions.

AI.tldr: 提出重要性感知的类平衡稀疏化（ICS）方法，通过在服务器端用Grad-CAM打分筛选特征通道，减少无线分裂学习中的通信开销。
AI.motivation: 无线分裂学习（SL）虽能通过将上层卸载到服务器来减少端侧计算，但每轮迭代传输高维中间特征仍是主要通信瓶颈。现有客户端侧特征选择方法采用任务无关准则（如幅值、统计量或聚类），会增加客户端处理负担，且在非独立同分布（non-i.i.d.）客户端数据下往往导致精度下降。
AI.method: ICS是一种轻量方法：服务器在反向传播中使用真实类别logit的Grad-CAM分数对特征通道进行排序；将每类分数聚合成类平衡、标签无关的重要性向量，以缓解标签偏斜下的头部类别偏差；每个客户端在下一轮复用该向量，保留top-N特征通道，且不增加客户端额外的前向或反向传播。论文还推导了非渐近收敛界，隔离稀疏化引入的误差，刻画固定通信预算下稀疏率与mini-batch大小的联合影响，并分析了ICS相对代表性基线的通信与计算开销。此外，将ICS扩展到并行分裂学习和基于Transformer的模型。
AI.result: 实验表明ICS持续优于基线方法，在严重非i.i.d.划分下增益更大。
AI.conclusion: ICS通过服务器端类平衡重要性评分实现高效特征稀疏化，在降低通信开销的同时提升非i.i.d.场景下的精度，并具有良好的通用性（并行SL、Transformer模型）。

title: Unlearnable, or Unmeasured? On the Reliability of Difficulty Labels in RLVR
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Transitioning from Pre-Training to Post-Training. Project page: https://syed-nazmus-sakib.github.io/Unlearnable-RLVR/
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become an important approach for improving reasoning during post-training. Recent work suggests that some difficult prompts remain resistant to learning even when they occasionally produce correct solutions. We revisit this unlearnability phenomenon and find that the affected prompts do improve, at roughly one third of the learnable rate, while the difficulty-defined set used to study them is much less reproducible than expected. These difficulty labels are estimated from a limited number of sampled responses. Combining them across seeds can further change which prompts are selected instead of simply reducing measurement noise. We develop a sampling-based framework for quantifying this instability and determining how much evaluation is required for difficulty assignments to reproduce reliably. We also revisit the gradient-similarity evidence proposed to explain unlearnability and show that part of the observed separation arises because difficult prompts provide fewer correct rollouts from which their gradients can be estimated. Matching this sample count weakens the gradient difference but does not remove it. Overall, the slow-learning phenomenon survives our reanalysis, while both the prompts used to define it and the evidence used to explain it require more careful measurement.

AI.tldr: 该论文重新审视了RLVR中"难提示词不可学习"现象：发现这些提示词其实以约1/3可学习速率在改进，而基于难度定义的提示词集合可复现性远低于预期；难度标签受采样噪声影响，跨种子合并反而会改变选择结果；作者提出基于采样的框架来量化这种不稳定性并确定可靠复现难度标签所需的评估量；同时指出梯度相似性证据部分源于难提示词正确rollout较少，匹配样本数后梯度差异减弱但未消失。
AI.motivation: 近期研究提出可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）中某些困难提示词即便偶尔产生正确解也难以学习，作者对此现象提出质疑，希望重新验证其真实性、可复现性及解释证据的可靠性。
AI.method: 重新分析难提示词的学习动态；提出基于采样的框架量化难度标签的不稳定性并确定可靠复现所需的评估量；重新审视梯度相似性证据，并匹配正确rollout样本数进行对照分析。
AI.result: 难提示词实际上以约1/3的可学习速率改进；基于难度定义的提示词集合可复现性远低于预期，跨种子合并会改变被选中的提示词而非仅降低测量噪声；匹配样本数后梯度差异减弱但并未完全消失。
AI.conclusion: 慢学习现象在重新分析后依然存在，但用于定义该现象的提示词集合以及用于解释该现象的证据都需要更严谨的测量方法。

title: SPOON: Towards Coherent Compositional 3D Scene Generation from Uncalibrated Multi-view Images
summary: Compositional 3D scene generation aims to recover complete 3D object shapes and their spatial arrangement from visual observations. Recent image-conditioned 3D generators provide strong priors for producing high-quality object geometry, making the generation of complex scenes increasingly practical. A central challenge is therefore to spatially organize these generated assets into a globally coherent scene while remaining consistent with multi-view observations. Existing approaches either entangle scene layout with object generation or separately estimate spatial placement from view-specific observations, where pose hypotheses may remain ambiguous and inconsistent across views, often resulting in an incoherent object-camera soup. We introduce SPOON, a framework that reformulates multi-view compositional 3D generation as scene-level, geometry-grounded pose reasoning. Rather than treating view-specific object pose hypotheses independently, SPOON coordinates them using reconstruction-derived multi-view geometry through a Guide-Route-Reconcile paradigm. This progressively organizes object poses and camera configurations into a coherent scene-level spatial arrangement. Extensive experiments on ARSG-110K and MIDI-3D-Front demonstrate consistent improvements in object placement and scene composition across varying numbers of input views. On ARSG-110K, SPOON reduces scene-level and object-level Chamfer distances by 12.7% and 17.7%, respectively, compared with a strong baseline.

AI.tldr: SPOON将多视角组合式3D生成重构为场景级、几何接地的姿态推理问题，通过Guide-Route-Reconcile范式协调各视角的对象姿态，生成连贯的场景空间布局。
AI.motivation: 从视觉观测恢复完整3D对象形状及其空间排列是组合式3D场景生成的核心目标。现有方法要么将场景布局与对象生成纠缠在一起，要么独立地从各视角观测估计空间位置，导致姿态假设存在歧义且跨视角不一致，产生"对象-相机混杂"的不连贯结果。因此需要一种能在多视角下保持一致、全局连贯的空间组织方式。
AI.method: 提出SPOON框架，将多视角组合式3D生成重新表述为场景级的、基于几何的姿态推理。它不将各视角的对象姿态假设独立处理，而是通过重建得到的多视角几何来协调这些假设，采用Guide-Route-Reconcile（引导-路径-协调）范式，逐步将对象姿态与相机配置组织成连贯的场景级空间排列。
AI.result: 在ARSG-110K和MIDI-3D-Front数据集上的大量实验表明，在不同输入视角数量下，对象摆放与场景组合均取得一致提升。在ARSG-110K上，相比强基线，场景级和对象级Chamfer距离分别降低12.7%和17.7%。
AI.conclusion: SPOON通过场景级几何接地的姿态推理有效解决了多视角组合式3D生成中姿态歧义与跨视角不一致的问题，显著提升了对象放置和场景组合质量，具有较好的鲁棒性和泛化性。

title: In a Streaming World, Should You Stand Still? A Comprehensive Benchmark of Anomaly Detection in Streams
summary: Time series anomaly detection (TSAD) is increasingly deployed in streaming settings, where data arrive sequentially and may exhibit non-stationarity. As a result, several works from the recent literature propose streaming anomaly detection methods that rely on incremental updates to adapt over time. However, most of these approaches originate from the streaming outlier detection literature and largely ignore core characteristics of time series anomalies. Moreover, their empirical evaluation is typically conducted on synthetic or small-scale benchmarks with limited diversity, making it unclear whether streaming methods are truly advantageous in realistic TSAD scenarios. In this work, we carry out the first large-scale experimental study comparing streaming and static TSAD methods under a unified streaming evaluation benchmark. We consider a realistic setting in which an initial batch of data is available for model training, followed by online evaluation of both detection accuracy and computational efficiency. In addition, we propose a distribution-drift dataset of real time series, called TSB- drift, to isolate scenarios where streaming updates are theoretically justified. Our results show that, contrary to common assumptions, static TSAD methods significantly outperform streaming approaches in most streaming settings. Such finding highlights a critical gap between the design of existing streaming methods and the requirements of modern TSAD, and calls for a rethinking of how streaming capabilities should be integrated into TSAD.

AI.tldr: 本文通过大规模实验比较流式与静态时间序列异常检测方法，发现静态方法在多数场景下显著优于流式方法。
AI.motivation: 流式时间序列异常检测逐渐受到关注，但现有流式方法多源自流式离群点检测文献，忽视了时序异常的核心特性；且评估多在合成或小规模基准上进行，难以判断流式方法是否真正有优势。
AI.method: 构建统一的流式评估基准，设定初始批次数据用于训练、随后在线评估检测精度与计算效率；并提出基于真实时间序列的分布漂移数据集 TSB-drift，以隔离流式更新理论上合理的场景。
AI.result: 与普遍假设相反，在大多数流式设置中静态时间序列异常检测方法显著优于流式方法。
AI.conclusion: 该发现揭示了现有流式方法设计与现代时间序列异常检测需求之间的关键差距，呼吁重新思考如何将流式能力整合进时间序列异常检测。

title: Learning from Research: Toward Lifelong Agent Harness Evolution
summary: Language agents are expected to solve increasingly complex tasks, creating a growing need for continual improvement. One promising approach is to evolve the agent harness, the software that governs tool use, memory management, and task execution, while keeping the underlying language model fixed. Recent methods automate this process by using a meta coding agent to modify the harness based on execution feedback. However, relying on that agent's existing knowledge and observed failures can restrict exploration and make adaptation reactive. Inspired by how human experts learn from the research literature for new solutions, we introduce ScholarEvolve, a framework that automatically draws on state-of-the-art research to guide harness evolution. ScholarEvolve organizes the harness evolution directions into functional modules and uses topic modeling to identify distinct improvement strategies for each module. It implements these strategies and evaluates their combinations to improve task performance. Moreover, the framework is designed to incorporate new publications over time, allowing research advances to drive proactive lifelong evolution. Experiments demonstrate improvements on AppWorld and Tau2-Bench. ScholarEvolve raises Qwen3.5-27B task goal completion from 49.6% to 63.6% on AppWorld Challenge, and raises GPT-5.4-mini pass@1 from 72.7% to 81.9% on Tau2-Bench Telecom.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ScholarEvolve 框架，利用最新研究文献自动引导语言智能体"外壳"（harness）的进化，在固定底层模型的前提下提升复杂任务表现。
AI.motivation: 语言智能体任务日益复杂，需要在固定底层语言模型的情况下持续改进其外壳（负责工具使用、记忆管理与任务执行）。现有自动化方法让元编码智能体依据执行反馈修改外壳，但依赖其既有知识和已观测到的失败，探索空间有限、适应方式被动。受人类专家从研究文献中获取新思路的启发，作者希望让研究前沿主动引导外壳进化。
AI.method: ScholarEvolve 将外壳进化方向按功能模块组织，用主题建模为每个模块识别不同的改进策略；实现这些策略并评估其组合以提升任务表现；框架还被设计为可随时间纳入新发表的文献，使研究进展能够驱动主动的、终身式的进化。
AI.result: 在 AppWorld 与 Tau2-Bench 上取得提升：AppWorld Challenge 上 Qwen3.5-27B 的任务目标完成率从 49.6% 提升至 63.6%；Tau2-Bench Telecom 上 GPT-5.4-mini 的 pass@1 从 72.7% 提升至 81.9%。
AI.conclusion: 以研究文献驱动的外壳进化是一种有效且可持续的方向，能够在不改动底层模型的前提下显著提升语言智能体的任务完成能力，并具备随新文献持续进化的潜力。

title: Structural Limits of the Information-Theoretic Uncertainty Decomposition
summary: Uncertainty estimation in machine learning typically decomposes uncertainty into aleatoric uncertainty (AU) and epistemic uncertainty (EU) using the standard information-theoretic framework. However, in practice, two critical issues arise: entanglement (AU and EU are highly correlated) and epistemic collapse (EU magnitude shrinks with increasing model capacity). We analyze this framework on a functional level and discover that significant portions of the assumed AU, EU range are infeasible in finite settings, and cannot be attained with any class probabilities. We characterize how this infeasible region scales with the number of classes and Monte Carlo samples $N$ (e.g., from ensembles with $N$ members), revealing it is bounded by $\text{AU} \leq \log(2)/N$. Crucially, the infeasible region's boundary helps explain epistemic collapse: when model confidence is high, $\text{AU} > \text{EU}$ is guaranteed by this fundamental structural limitation. Our findings show that increasing ensemble size mitigates epistemic collapse by reducing the infeasible area. Lastly, we caution against interpreting AU and EU as independent quantities in low AU regimes, since we show they are coupled when $\text{AU} \leq \log(2)/N$.

AI.tldr: 论文从函数层面分析机器学习中AU与EU分解框架，发现有限条件下存在不可行区域，其边界受类别数与MC采样数N限制（AU ≤ log(2)/N），该边界可解释认知坍缩，并提示在低AU区AU与EU耦合、不可视为独立量。
AI.motivation: 标准信息论不确定性分解框架在实践中面临两个关键问题：AU与EU高度相关的纠缠，以及EU幅度随模型容量增加而缩小的认知坍缩。作者希望从函数层面剖析该框架的固有局限，解释上述现象的根源。
AI.method: 在函数层面对标准信息论不确定性分解框架进行理论分析，刻画假定AU、EU范围中在有限设置下不可达的不可行区域，并推导该区域随类别数与蒙特卡洛样本数N的缩放规律。
AI.result: 发现不可行区域边界受AU ≤ log(2)/N约束；当模型置信度高时，该结构性限制保证AU > EU，从而解释认知坍缩；增大集成规模可缩小不可行区域，缓解认知坍缩；并证明当AU ≤ log(2)/N时AU与EU相互耦合。
AI.conclusion: AU与EU的分解在有限条件下存在根本性结构限制，不应在低AU区将二者视为独立量；增大集成规模是缓解认知坍缩的有效途径。

title: QATFactory: A Versatile, Deployment-Aligned Framework for Quantization-aware Training and Distillation of LLMs
summary: Large language model (LLM) inference is increasingly moving toward lower precision to realize the throughput of hardware accelerators, but aggressive post-training quantization (PTQ) can degrade model quality. We present QATFactory, an open-source framework for deployment-aligned quantization-aware distillation (QAD) and reinforcement learning (QARL). QATFactory simulates deployment-time quantization while performing matrix multiplications in BF16, allowing models to adapt to quantization noise without requiring training hardware that natively supports the target format; for example, it supports NVFP4 training on H100 GPUs, which lack FP4 Tensor Cores. The framework supports NVFP4, MXFP4, and llama.cpp's Q4_K format; dense and mixture-of-experts models; and both full-parameter and LoRA-based training. It exports checkpoints directly to vLLM and llama.cpp without an additional lossy conversion step or added inference overhead. With QATFactory, we conduct extensive experiments on models ranging from 8B to 230B parameters and evaluate exported checkpoints in production inference engines. Across models and formats, QAD consistently improves deployed-model quality over strong PTQ baselines. On Qwen3.5-9B, QAD achieves average benchmark accuracies of 68.9% under NVFP4 and 66.0% under MXFP4, outperforming the best PTQ results of 65.4% and 56.4%, respectively. Through our experiments, we found that although both FP4 formats quantize weights and activations at deployment, the best training strategy is format-dependent: NVFP4 generally performs better when only weights are quantized during training, whereas MXFP4 benefits from quantizing both weights and activations. At a fixed training token budget, training on fewer 32K sequences improves average accuracy by 1.9 points over training on more 4K sequences. We release the complete QATFactory training code and the resulting checkpoints.

AI.tldr: QATFactory 是一个开源框架，通过部署对齐的量化感知蒸馏（QAD）与强化学习（QARL）在 BF16 硬件上模拟部署量化，使模型适配 NVFP4、MXFP4、Q4_K 等低精度格式，并在 8B–230B 模型上验证了导出后部署质量优于强 PTQ 基线。
AI.motivation: LLM 推理正走向低精度以发挥硬件加速器吞吐，但激进的训练后量化（PTQ）会损害模型质量；同时，直接训练目标低精度格式往往需要原生支持该格式的硬件，限制了可用性。
AI.method: 提出 QATFactory：在 BF16 中执行矩阵乘法、同时模拟部署期量化，从而无需原生支持目标格式的硬件即可让模型适应量化噪声（例如在无 FP4 Tensor Core 的 H100 上做 NVFP4 训练）。支持 NVFP4、MXFP4 与 llama.cpp 的 Q4_K；支持稠密与 MoE 模型；支持全参数与 LoRA 训练；checkpoint 可直接导出到 vLLM 和 llama.cpp，无需额外有损转换或增加推理开销。
AI.result: 在 8B 至 230B 参数模型上开展大量实验，并在生产推理引擎中评估导出 checkpoint。跨模型与格式，QAD 一致优于强 PTQ 基线。Qwen3.5-9B 上，QAD 在 NVFP4 下平均基准准确率 68.9%、MXFP4 下 66.0%，而最佳 PTQ 分别为 65.4% 和 56.4%。还发现最佳训练策略依赖格式：NVFP4 通常仅在训练中量化权重时更优，MXFP4 则需同时量化权重与激活；固定训练 token 预算下，用更少 32K 序列训练比更多 4K 序列平均准确率高 1.9 分。
AI.conclusion: QATFactory 提供了一种部署对齐、硬件友好的量化感知训练/蒸馏方案，能有效缩小低精度部署与高精度基线之间的质量差距；作者开源了完整训练代码与所得 checkpoint。

title: Belief-Aware Multi-Agent Path Finding under Map Uncertainty
summary: Multi-Agent Path Finding (MAPF) aims to find collision-free paths for multiple agents in a shared environment. Classical MAPF assumes that all static obstacles are known in advance, but real-world environments can change unexpectedly due to fallen objects, spills, or other local disturbances. When such changes are spatially correlated, an observation can inform traversability estimates beyond the observed location. Prior approaches address uncertainty in traversability through contingent plans or replanning based on direct observations, but do not leverage this spatial dependence to infer the traversability of nearby unobserved locations. As a result, they cannot use one observation to anticipate nearby unobserved obstacles that may cause costly rerouting later. We focus on Belief-Aware MAPF, where map discrepancies are fixed during execution but initially unknown, and observations can be informative beyond the observed location. We propose Multi-Agent Gaussian belief Inference for Coordination (MAGIC), a framework that updates a shared belief about traversability online based on agents' observations. MAGIC uses a Gaussian Markov Random Field and Gaussian Belief Propagation to approximately infer traversability and construct detour-aware costs for standard MAPF planners. Our experiments on MAPF benchmarks show that MAGIC reduces the executed sum of costs compared to existing approaches on 96.3% of instances, across several planner families and teams of up to 800 agents, demonstrating its applicability to large-scale MAPF problems.

AI.tldr: MAGIC是一个面向Belief-Aware MAPF的框架，通过高斯马尔可夫随机场与高斯信念传播在线更新共享可通行性信念，为传统MAPF规划器提供绕行感知代价，在96.3%的实例上降低了执行总代价。
AI.motivation: 经典MAPF假设所有静态障碍预先已知，但真实环境会出现落物、泼洒等突发局部扰动。当这些变化具有空间相关性时，一次观测可推断观测点之外的可通行性。现有方法依赖偶然规划或基于直接观测的重规划，未利用这种空间依赖，无法提前预判附近未观测障碍，导致后期代价高昂的绕行。
AI.method: 论文聚焦Belief-Aware MAPF：地图差异在执行期间才被修正，且初始未知，观测可提供超出观测位置的信息。提出MAGIC框架，基于智能体观测在线更新共享的可通行性信念；采用高斯马尔可夫随机场建模，并用高斯信念传播近似推断可通行性，进而为标准MAPF规划器构造绕行感知的代价函数。
AI.result: 在MAPF基准测试上，MAGIC在96.3%的实例中相较现有方法降低了执行总代价；实验覆盖多种规划器家族，智能体规模最多达800个，显示其可扩展至大规模MAPF问题。
AI.conclusion: 利用空间相关的可通行性信念推断，可让传统MAPF规划器提前规避未观测障碍，减少执行代价；MAGIC在多种规划器与大团队场景下均表现有效，具备大规模适用性。

title: GroundAnything: Reconciling Parallel Decoding with Precise Visual Grounding at Flash Speed
comment: 61 pages, including supplementary material. Project page: https://groundingpi.github.io/groundanything/ Code: [https://github.com/groundingpi/GroundAnything](https://github.com/groundingpi/GroundAnything) Model: https://huggingface.co/GroundingPI/GroundAnything, https://huggingface.co/GroundingPI/GroundAnything-VLM
summary: Autoregressive (AR) grounding models serialize spatial predictions, introducing sequential latency and imposing a causal order on output tokens. We view grounding as visual evidence extraction: objects, locations, and spatial relations are jointly constrained by the image and query, yet their dependencies do not imply an intrinsic left-to-right generation order. This distinction makes bidirectional diffusion a natural fit, allowing spatial hypotheses to emerge in parallel and be jointly refined through iterative denoising. We introduce GroundAnything, a 4B-parameter grounding foundation model that reconciles fast parallel decoding with precise localization through blockwise denoising. Training combines grounding pretraining from public datasets and dedicated data engines, direct AR-to-diffusion conversion with joint AR and diffusion objectives, supervised fine-tuning, and GRPO-based reinforcement post-training. Across 30 grounding benchmarks, our autoregressive variant, GroundAnything-VLM, establishes a new overall state of the art among similarly sized models at 72.42%, remaining competitive with GPT-6 Astra (71.35%). With entropy-guided decoding, GroundAnything also surpasses the prior state of the art at this scale, averaging 61.75% versus 53.32% for the fast MTP-based LocateAnything model. We further explore decoding strategies, showing that an optional self-speculative mode achieves a $4.51\times$ speedup over the AR counterpart with a 0.74 percentage-point drop in COCO F1mIoU. Infrastructure experiments show that progressive inference optimizations translate parallel decoding into practical speedups. These support efficient visual grounding in latency-sensitive real-world systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出4B参数的GroundAnything定位基础模型，用块级并行去噪取代自回归的串行解码，在30个基准上取得同规模最优结果。
AI.motivation: 自回归定位模型将空间预测序列化，带来顺序延迟，并对输出token强加因果的从左到右生成顺序。作者认为定位本质是视觉证据提取，物体、位置与空间关系由图像和查询联合约束，其依赖关系并不意味着存在内在的生成顺序，因此双向扩散更适合并行产生并迭代精炼空间假设。
AI.method: GroundAnything含4B参数，通过块级去噪兼顾快速并行解码与精确定位。训练流程包括：基于公开数据集与专用数据引擎的定位预训练、直接的AR到扩散转换与AR/扩散联合目标、监督微调、以及基于GRPO的强化后训练。另支持熵引导解码和可选的自推测解码模式。
AI.result: 在30个定位基准上，自回归版本GroundAnything-VLM以72.42%取得同规模模型的整体最优，与GPT-6 Astra（71.35%）保持竞争力；使用熵引导解码时GroundAnything平均61.75%，超过快速MTP模型LocateAnything的53.32%。自推测模式相对AR版本实现4.51倍加速，COCO F1mIoU仅下降0.74个百分点。基础设施实验表明渐进式推理优化可将并行解码转化为实际加速。
AI.conclusion: 并行扩散式定位在精度与效率上均具优势，可支撑延迟敏感的实时视觉定位系统。

title: What Streaming Anomaly Detection Finds (and Misses) in Industrial Time Series
summary: EDF relies on continuous monitoring of its power plants to detect anomalies as soon as they occur. Given the absence of a universally optimal streaming method in unsupervised settings, we compare streaming methods with state-of-the-art TSAD models deployed online on a real nuclear power plant dataset. This work also evaluates Automated Anomaly Detection in a streaming context. Results show higher consistency for online TSAD and strong robustness from ensembling strategies.

AI.tldr: 该论文在真实核电站数据集上，比较了流式方法与在线部署的最先进时间序列异常检测（TSAD）模型，并评估了流式场景下的自动化异常检测。结果显示在线TSAD一致性更高，且集成策略具有较强鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: EDF需要对电站进行持续监测以便在异常发生时及时发现。然而在无监督设定下，并不存在普遍最优的流式方法，因此需要在真实场景中系统比较各类流式与在线异常检测方法的表现。
AI.method: 在真实核电站数据集上，将流式方法与在线部署的最先进TSAD模型进行对比实验，并评估流式上下文中的自动化异常检测方案。
AI.result: 在线TSAD方法表现出更高的一致性；集成（ensembling）策略展现出较强的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 在无监督流式异常检测中并无普适最优方法，实践上可优先考虑在线TSAD模型并结合集成策略以提升检测的一致性与鲁棒性。

title: PivotOPD: Learning to Recover from Pivotal Mistakes in Multi-Turn Agents
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) is a promising approach for training language agents, providing dense teacher supervision on student-generated trajectories. However, in multi-turn interaction, an incorrect action changes the states the student encounters later, so errors compound across turns. In preliminary experiments across three Qwen3 models (8B to 235B), we find that more than half of the failed rollouts contain a pivotal mistake, an action that moves the agent farther from completing the task, and this mistake typically occurs early. These pivotal mistakes often remain recoverable: guiding the model for only a few turns after the pivotal turn can restore task success. We therefore propose PivotOPD, an on-policy distillation framework that jointly trains the student to prevent pivotal mistakes and to recover from the states they create. At each pivotal mistake, a teacher model provides a gold action and then names a recovery action at each of the next few turns. Preventive distillation uses the gold action with reverse KL to steer the student away from the pivotal mistake, while recovery distillation uses the recovery actions with forward KL to transfer recovery behaviors that the student rarely samples. Against 13 baselines on ALFWorld, WebShop, and Search-based QA, PivotOPD achieves the strongest average performance for both Qwen3-1.7B and Qwen3-8B students, improving over the strongest baseline on ALFWorld by +5.5% with the 1.7B student. The gains also transfer to another model family on the software engineering domain, where PivotOPD raises the resolve rate of a Nemotron-3.5 student on SWE-Bench Verified by +3.2%. Project page: https://research.nvidia.com/labs/lpr/pivotopd/

AI.tldr: 提出 PivotOPD 在线策略蒸馏框架，针对多轮交互中"关键错误"导致的误差累积问题，联合训练学生模型预防关键错误并从中恢复，在多个基准上超越 13 个基线。
AI.motivation: 在线策略蒸馏（OPD）能为语言智能体提供学生生成轨迹上的密集教师监督，但在多轮交互中，一个错误动作会改变后续状态，导致错误跨轮累积。初步实验发现超半数失败轨迹包含"关键错误"（使智能体偏离任务完成的动作），且通常发生在早期，但这些错误往往可恢复。
AI.method: 提出 PivotOPD 框架，在每个关键错误处：教师模型先给出金标准动作，随后在接下来数轮命名恢复动作。预防性蒸馏用金标准动作配合反向 KL 引导学生远离关键错误；恢复性蒸馏用恢复动作配合前向 KL，迁移学生极少采样到的恢复行为。
AI.result: 在 ALFWorld、WebShop 和基于搜索的 QA 上对比 13 个基线，PivotOPD 在 Qwen3-1.7B 与 Qwen3-8B 学生上均取得最强平均性能，1.7B 学生在 ALFWorld 上较最强基线提升 +5.5%。跨模型家族迁移到软件工程领域，使 Nemotron-3.5 学生在 SWE-Bench Verified 的解决率提升 +3.2%。
AI.conclusion: 通过同时针对关键错误的预防与恢复进行在线策略蒸馏，可有效缓解多轮交互中的误差累积，并在多种任务与模型家族上取得一致提升。

title: GroundingPI: A Grounding Foundation Model towards Physical Intelligence with Visual Primitives
comment: 64 pages, including supplementary material. Project page: https://groundingpi.github.io/ Code: https://github.com/groundingpi/GroundingPI Model: https://huggingface.co/GroundingPI/GroundingPI
summary: Precise grounding matters. It specifies which object is the target and where that object is, even in clutter and for tiny objects, and it has to be fast enough for closed-loop control. Yet vision-language-action (VLA) and world-action models (WAMs) take perception from general-purpose vision-language and video-generation backbones, which still fail in these settings. We introduce GroundingPI, a 4B grounding foundation model that generates points and boxes as quantized coordinates in a shared vocabulary. Training combines multimodal and spatial pretraining, supervised fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning with GRPO, using supervision from public datasets and dedicated data engines. Against 44 baselines across 34 grounding benchmarks spanning 11 perceptual capabilities, GroundingPI establishes a new state of the art, averaging 73.68%, above the larger GPT-6 Astra (71.54%). As a downstream visual backbone, GroundingPI improves performance on robotic manipulation and autonomous driving. On RoboTwin 2.0, it outperforms every mainstream backbone we evaluate in all four out-of-distribution settings, by up to 24.8% relative to the strongest backbone. On RoboCasa-GR1, GroundingPI trained with 50% of the demonstrations outperforms those baselines trained with 75%. On nuScenes, used as the visual backbone, GroundingPI attains an average open-loop L2 error of 0.296 m. We systematically analyze GroundingPI's pretraining in scale and data composition. Downstream autonomous driving and robotic manipulation improve as the pretraining is scaled. Analyzing the data recipe across these 11 perceptual capabilities shows dense grounding's substantial benefits for both, and OCR's potential as a catalyst for perceptual learning. These results support grounding as a perceptual foundation, and dedicated perceptual pretraining as a promising direction for foundation models of physical intelligence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 GroundingPI，一个 4B 的 grounding 基础模型，将点与框以共享词表中的量化坐标形式生成，整合多模态与空间预训练、SFT 及 GRPO 强化学习。它在 34 个基准、11 类感知能力上超越 44 个基线，平均 73.68%，并作为视觉骨干提升机器人与自动驾驶性能。
AI.motivation: 精确 grounding（定位目标及其位置）对杂乱场景、微小目标和闭环控制至关重要且需足够快，但现有 VLA 与 WAM 沿用通用视觉语言和视频生成骨干，在这些场景下表现不佳。作者希望验证 grounding 可作为感知基础，并探索专用感知预训练作为物理智能基础模型的方向。
AI.method: 构建 4B 的 grounding 基础模型 GroundingPI，将点与框生成为共享词表中的量化坐标；训练流程包括多模态与空间预训练、监督微调，以及使用 GRPO 的强化学习，监督来自公开数据集与专门的数据引擎；并系统分析预训练规模与数据组成。
AI.result: 在覆盖 11 类感知能力的 34 个 grounding 基准、对比 44 个基线上达到新的 SOTA，平均 73.68%，高于更大的模型（71.54%）。作为下游视觉骨干：RoboTwin 2.0 上在四种分布外设置中全面超越所有主流骨干，最高相对提升 24.8%；RoboCasa-GR1 上用 50% 演示训练即超过用 75% 演示训练的基线；nuScenes 上平均开环 L2 误差 0.296 m。缩放预训练可提升下游自动驾驶与机器人操作性能；密集 grounding 对二者均有显著收益，OCR 可能是感知学习的催化剂。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持 grounding 作为感知基础，并表明专用感知预训练是物理智能基础模型的有前景方向。

title: A differentiability framework for zigzag persistent homology via linear interpolation
summary: Persistent homology can be differentiated and incorporated into learning pipelines, but no analogous framework exists for zigzag persistence, which is needed when the underlying topological structure evolves non-monotonically over time. We develop such a framework for sequences of simplicial complexes obtained by thresholding time-dependent filtering values on a fixed complex. By assigning persistence diagram endpoints the real-valued times at which linearly interpolated filtering values cross the threshold, we transfer the continuity of the filtering values to the diagram points. This yields smooth local lifts of the resulting persistence-diagram-valued map, from which we derive differentials almost everywhere under mild regularity conditions on the parametrization of the filtering values. We prove local Lipschitz continuity outside an explicit measure-zero exclusion set; standard stochastic subgradient convergence guarantees therefore do not apply directly. We argue that, even without such guarantees, this exclusion set is small enough in practice to allow effective optimization. We test this empirically in two experiments: sensor network coverage optimization and dynamic graph classification.

AI.tldr: 该论文为zigzag持久性建立了一个可微分框架，通过将过滤值连续性传递到持久图点，推导出几乎处处可微性，并在两个实验中验证了实际优化效果。
AI.motivation: 持续同调可被微分并融入学习流程，但当底层拓扑结构随时间非单调演化时所需的zigzag持久性尚无类似的可微分框架，因此需要填补这一空白。
AI.method: 针对在固定复形上对时间依赖过滤值做阈值化得到的单纯复形序列，将持久图端点赋值为线性插值过滤值穿越阈值处的实数值时间，从而把过滤值的连续性转移到持久图点上；由此得到持久图值映射的平滑局部提升，并在过滤值参数化的温和正则条件下推导出几乎处处微分。
AI.result: 证明了在显式的零测度排除集之外具有局部Lipschitz连续性；因此标准随机次梯度收敛保证不直接适用。作者论证该排除集在实践中足够小，可支持有效优化，并在传感器网络覆盖优化和动态图分类两个实验中进行了实证测试。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为zigzag持久性提供了可微分与可优化框架，尽管缺乏标准收敛保证，但排除集足够小以在实践中实现有效优化，并通过两个实验验证了实用性。

title: How Much of a Harness Does a Strong Agent Need for Autonomous ML Engineering?
summary: Recent autonomous machine learning engineering (MLE) agents have made significant progress on public leaderboards. Often motivated by progress stagnation over long-horizon cycles and limited Large Language Model (LLM) primitives, modern MLE agents are deployed on top of increasingly elaborate machinery: multi-agent orchestrators, dedicated retrieval subagents, and more. While such harnesses expand, the use of more primitive but improved coding agents - where LLMs have direct access to the execution environment through read, write, and bash primitives - has received little attention in the field. In this paper we find that, under an equal time budget and the same frontier LLM backbone, open-source state-of-the-art harnesses provide no advantages over a single session of a minimal-harness coding agent baseline, pointing to the backbone as the primary driver for performance. Via a series of large-scale systematic ablation studies, we argue that the machinery layers become redundant in the coding agent setting. We conclude that the effort spent elaborating hand-crafted harnesses around strong models yields poor returns for current MLE benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 在相同时限与相同前沿LLM下，开源最先进的MLE智能体框架相比最小化框架的单次编码智能体并无优势，性能主要由底层模型决定，复杂框架层在编码智能体设定下变得冗余。
AI.motivation: 当前自主机器学习工程（MLE）智能体普遍依赖多智能体编排、专用检索子智能体等日益复杂的框架机制，动机多源于长周期迭代中的进展停滞以及对LLM原语的限制。但更基础、仅通过读写与bash原语直接访问执行环境的编码智能体这一路线却未获足够关注，本文意图检验这些复杂框架是否真正必要。
AI.method: 在相同时间预算与相同前沿LLM主干下，对比开源最先进的MLE智能体框架与最小框架（仅提供read、write、bash原语的单会话编码智能体）基线，并进行一系列大规模系统性消融实验。
AI.result: 开源最先进框架并未优于最小框架的单会话编码智能体基线，表明LLM主干才是性能的主要驱动因素；消融实验显示，在编码智能体设定下，各类框架机制层趋于冗余。
AI.conclusion: 围绕强模型手工构建复杂框架在当前MLE基准上回报甚微，研究与实践资源更应聚焦于底层模型能力本身。

title: FOMO: Forget the Concept, Don't Miss Out on the Scene in Selective Video Unlearning
summary:
The rapid advancement of generative video models has enabled the synthesis of increasingly realistic and temporally coherent videos, while also raising concerns about the generation of harmful content. The reliance on large-scale web datasets during training inevitably exposes these models to undesirable material, making concept unlearning an essential mitigation. Existing methods mainly target static visual concepts, such as objects, identities, or unsafe appearance, largely overlooking motion unlearning. Furthermore, these approaches often pay little attention to preserving the surrounding scene. As a result, successful concept removal may unintentionally alter the background, composition, or overall video dynamics. We argue that effective unlearning should ideally change only what is targeted, while minimizing unnecessary changes to the remaining scene. In this work, we introduce FOMO, to the best of our knowledge the first training-based selective video unlearning method that directly treats preservation of the original scene as a priority. We formulate unlearning around two complementary objectives: what to change and what to preserve. Our method localizes concept-related representations and modifies them, while the preservation mechanism maintains non-target scene information without requiring auxiliary data. Beyond simply erasing unwanted concepts, FOMO explicitly redirects the generation toward a specified safe alternative. We further extend this formulation to motion unlearning, where the concept is defined by temporal behavior rather than a fixed spatial region. Our solution achieves effective unlearning across unsafe content, object, and motion concepts, while achieving the best trade-off between concept removal and scene preservation.
  Code: https://github.com/gmum/FOMO
  Project Page https://gmum.github.io/FOMO

AI.tldr: FOMO是首个基于训练的选择性视频概念遗忘方法，将原始场景保持作为优先目标，通过"改变什么"与"保留什么"两个互补目标，实现对不安全内容、物体及运动概念的有效遗忘，并在概念移除与场景保持间取得最佳平衡。
AI.motivation: 生成视频模型能力增强带来有害内容生成风险，训练依赖大规模网络数据不可避免引入不良素材，概念遗忘成为必要缓解手段。现有方法主要针对静态视觉概念（物体、身份、不安全外观），忽视运动遗忘，且很少关注周围场景保持，导致概念移除时意外改变背景、构图或整体视频动态。
AI.method: 提出FOMO，首个训练式的选择性视频遗忘方法。围绕两个互补目标构建遗忘：要改变什么（定位概念相关表征并修改）与要保留什么（无需辅助数据即可保持非目标场景信息）。除简单擦除外，还显式将生成重定向至指定的安全替代内容，并扩展至运动遗忘——概念由时间行为而非固定空间区域定义。
AI.result: 在不安全内容、物体和运动概念上均实现有效遗忘，并在概念移除与场景保持之间达到最佳权衡。
AI.conclusion: 有效的遗忘应仅改变目标内容，同时尽量减少对剩余场景的不必要改变；FOMO通过显式优先场景保持的选择性遗忘，在多种概念类型上验证了其有效性，并公开了代码与项目主页。

title: Right Answer, Wrong Mechanism: Detecting Pernicious Divergence in Causal Interventions
comment: 13 pages, 1 figure, 6 tables. Beiming Liu and Minjie Chen contributed equally
summary: Causal interventions such as activation patching and distributed alignment search (DAS) are the main tool for making mechanistic claims about neural networks. Recent work showed that these interventions routinely push representations off the model's natural distribution, and that such divergence is sometimes harmless and sometimes pernicious: it can recruit pathways the model never uses on natural inputs, so that an intervention produces the expected answer through the wrong mechanism. No method currently tells the two cases apart. We make this question testable by planting hidden pathways inside pretrained language models; the pathways are silent on every benchmark prompt by construction, so which interventions depend on them is known exactly. Across 72 configurations and 100,800 interventions on GPT-2 small, we find three things. (i) Nearest-neighbour and local-PCA distances at the intervention site, as used in prior work, score below chance (AUROC 0.35-0.47) at picking out interventions that give the right answer through a planted pathway. (ii) Hidden-Pathway Contribution (HPC), a label-free test that clamps downstream units to the regime of natural runs with the same output and measures how much of the decision disappears, flags pathway-dominated interventions with AUROC >= 0.99 when the pathway shows up as unit-level out-of-regime activity, but fails when every unit stays within its natural range, which we identify as the open problem. (iii) Optimised interventions actively seek hidden pathways: on a gender task, DAS routes 90-95% of its successes through planted pathways for three of four families, and a downstream on-manifold penalty cuts this share to under 5% at a cost of 6-11 points of success rate. In unmodified GPT-2, successful interventions show almost no unit-level out-of-regime reliance.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究因果干预（如激活修补、DAS）是否让模型走"隐藏通路"，通过植入静默通路使问题可检验，并提出HPC检测方法。
AI.motivation: 现有因果干预常将表征推离自然分布，这种偏离有时无害、有时有害（会招募模型自然输入从不使用的通路，导致干预通过错误机制得出正确答案），而此前没有方法能区分这两种情况。
AI.method: 在预训练语言模型中植入隐藏通路（在基准提示上天然静默），从而精确知晓哪些干预依赖它们；在GPT-2 small上运行72种配置、100,800次干预；并设计无标签的Hidden-Pathway Contribution (HPC)检验，将下游单元钳制到同输出的自然运行区间，衡量决策消失程度。
AI.result: (i) 现有的最近邻与局部PCA距离在识别走隐藏通路的干预上低于随机（AUROC 0.35-0.47）；(ii) 当通路表现为单元级超范围活动时，HPC可高精度标记通路主导的干预（AUROC≥0.99），但当所有单元都在自然范围内时失效；(iii) 优化干预会主动寻找隐藏通路，如性别任务中DAS有90-95%的成功经植入通路，加入on-manifold惩罚可降至5%以下但损失6-11个百分点成功率；未修改的GPT-2中成功干预几乎无单元级超范围依赖。
AI.conclusion: 现有分布距离指标无法区分有害与无害的干预偏离，HPC在单元级超范围活动情形下有效，但"所有单元仍在自然范围内"的隐藏通路仍是未解难题；优化型干预倾向于利用隐藏通路。

title: Cogentic: Multi-Agent Orchestration for Automated Proof Discovery
summary: We present Cogentic, a multi-agent harness for automated proof discovery on open research problems. While frontier language models can generate strong mathematical ideas in a single shot, single-shot generation is often insufficient for open problems that require exploring multiple competing conjectures, overcoming subtle technical obstructions, and retaining intermediate progress over a long horizon. Cogentic addresses these challenges through an iterative prove--verify loop in which an orchestrator allocates a population of independent provers across distinct proof directions, subjects their output to adversarial verification by several specialized components, and promotes confirmed intermediate results into a persistent verified ledger that later rounds build on. The harness is designed to be able to solve research-level math and theoretical computer science problems. Using Gemini as the base model, Cogentic produced novel results on five open problems across online learning, auction theory, and mechanism design. Each result was independently verified by domain experts and is developed in full in companion papers. We list these results, and new ones as they are verified, at https://sites.google.com/view/cogentic .

AI.tldr: 提出多智能体框架Cogentic，通过迭代"证明—验证"循环自动攻克开放研究问题，用Gemini在五个开放问题上取得新结果并经专家验证。
AI.motivation: 前沿语言模型单次生成虽能产生不错数学想法，但对需要探索多重猜想、克服技术障碍、长期保留中间进展的开放问题仍不足，因此需要新框架。
AI.method: Cogentic采用迭代证明—验证循环：由编排器在不同证明方向上分配一组独立证明者群体，其输出经多个专门组件的对抗式验证，确认的中间结果被提升到持久化的已验证账本，供后续轮次使用。
AI.result: 以Gemini为基础模型，Cogentic在线学习、拍卖理论和机制设计五个开放问题上产生新颖结果，每个结果均经领域专家独立验证，并在配套论文中完整展开。
AI.conclusion: Cogentic是面向研究级数学与理论计算机科学问题的多智能体自动证明发现框架，相关结果及后续新增验证结果公布于项目网站。

title: Semantic Watermarking for Malicious Image Manipulation Detection
summary: The proliferation of high-fidelity generative editing models has made it possible to inject violent or sexual content into otherwise ordinary images while preserving visual plausibility, with concrete consequences for public discourse and vulnerable populations. We propose a robust semantic watermarking framework that reframes the watermark as a recoverable semantic reference rather than an opaque identifier. Our framework combines a $β$-VAE-based binary watermark (CLIP-VAE) with explicit channel-aware training---random bit-flip noise is injected during training so that the decoder learns graceful degradation under the noisy watermarking channel. As a downstream application, a lightweight module SDA-Net uses the recovered semantic embedding to expose not only whether but in which semantic direction an image has been altered. In a 5-way comparison against representative binary hashing baselines (SimHash, ITQ, HashNet, and their robust-MLP variants), CLIP-VAE achieves the highest reconstruction cosine similarity to the original CLIP embedding under realistic InstructPix2Pix bit-error rates, and uniquely supports direction-of-drift detection---a forensic complement to existing content-moderation pipelines.

AI.tldr: 提出基于β-VAE的鲁棒语义水印(CLIP-VAE)，将水印重构为可恢复的语义参考，并支持方向性篡改检测。
AI.motivation: 高保真生成编辑模型可在保持视觉合理性的同时向普通图像注入暴力或色情内容，对公共话语与弱势群体造成实际危害，需要鲁棒的水印方案以支撑内容取证与审核。
AI.method: 采用β-VAE的二进制水印（CLIP-VAE），在训练中注入随机比特翻转噪声以实现信道感知训练，使解码器在噪声信道下优雅退化；下游轻量模块SDA-Net利用恢复的语义嵌入，判断图像是否被改动及改动方向。
AI.result: 在与SimHash、ITQ、HashNet及其鲁棒MLP变体的5路对比中，CLIP-VAE在真实InstructPix2Pix比特错误率下取得最高的重建余弦相似度，并唯一支持漂移方向检测。
AI.conclusion: 将水印视为可恢复的语义参考，可在噪声信道下保持语义保真并额外提供改动方向检测，作为现有内容审核流程的取证补充。

title: Trust the Critic More
summary: Standard language model RL algorithms credit every token of a long rollout with the same advantage determined by the terminal reward. Actor-critic methods can provide finer-grained credit assignment, but learned critics are generally considered too inaccurate to trust when training LLMs with RL. In recent works, even when a critic is present, it is used only for baseline estimation, so every trajectory must be rolled out to its terminal reward. We introduce Actor-Critic with Action Chunking (AC2) that removes the need to roll every trajectory to completion. AC2 instead assigns credit to action chunks: short continuations of prefixes of past trajectories. A learned critic scores the state reached at the end of each action chunk, allowing the policy to update without observing a terminal reward. We make critic-based credit assignment reliable through three design choices. First, we introduce local readiness which uses critic-based updates on a problem only when the critic is sufficiently accurate on that particular problem. Second, when available, we provide the critic with a reference solution from a previous successful rollout. Third, we assign credit over action chunks of 10k tokens rather than individual tokens, giving the critic a more meaningful portion of the trajectory to evaluate. We train Qwen3-4B on FineProofs-RL using AC2 and evaluate on IMO-ProofBench. AC2 exceeds GRPO's peak validation score of 18.5% using 2.5x fewer decoding FLOPs. This gain comes from two sources, (1) AC2 requires 25% fewer training steps to reach this score, and (2) each step generates fewer tokens because the policy does not need to continue every trajectory to completion. Conceptually, we demonstrate that we can remove the need to roll out every trajectory to completion, opening up a large previously unexplored design space for LLM RL algorithms.

AI.tldr: 提出AC2方法，通过动作块信用分配与可靠性设计，让LLM强化学习无需将每条轨迹rollout到终点，显著降低计算成本。
AI.motivation: 标准LLM强化学习算法给长轨迹的每个token分配相同的终端奖励优势，信用分配粗糙；而actor-critic虽能细粒度分配，但学习到的critic在LLM训练中常被认为不可靠，因此现有工作即便有critic也只用于基线估计，仍须将每条轨迹rollout至终端奖励，计算代价高。
AI.method: 提出Actor-Critic with Action Chunking（AC2）：将信用分配给动作块（过去轨迹前缀的短延续），由学习到的critic对每个动作块末端状态打分，使策略无需观测终端奖励即可更新。三项可靠性设计：(1) local readiness，仅当critic在特定问题上足够准确时才用critic更新该问题；(2) 可用时为critic提供此前成功rollout的参考解；(3) 以10k token的动作块而非单个token分配信用。
AI.result: 在FineProofs-RL上训练Qwen3-4B，在IMO-ProofBench上评估：AC2超过GRPO的峰值验证分数18.5%，同时解码FLOPs减少2.5倍。收益来自两方面：(1)达到该分数所需训练步数减少25%；(2)每步生成token更少，因为策略无需将每条轨迹续写到终点。
AI.conclusion: 概念上证明了可以去除将每条轨迹rollout至终点的需求，为LLM强化学习算法开辟了此前未探索的广阔设计空间。

title: WorldAuditBench: Interactive 3D World Auditing with Multimodal Agents
summary: As interactive 3D worlds are increasingly used to study intelligent behavior, it becomes important to develop efficient pipelines for identifying anomalies in these simulated environments, such as floating objects, traversable walls, or objects inconsistent with the surrounding scene. Multimodal AI systems, including vision-language models (VLMs) and vision-language-action models (VLAs), have shown potential for automating this task. However, 3D world auditing is complex, requiring the close coupling of two distinct capabilities: action, to navigate the 3D world and search for anomalies systematically and efficiently; and visual reasoning, to understand the environment and identify anomalies from multimodal observations. It remains largely unexplored whether multimodal agents can effectively couple these two capabilities, using visual reasoning to identify potential anomalies while taking actions to validate them. In this paper, we introduce WorldAuditBench, a benchmark for 3D world auditing comprising 213 anomaly tasks across 13 environments built with Unreal Engine 5 and Three.js, spanning five anomaly families. We evaluate five frontier models under a fixed exploration budget using two auditing paradigms: VLA-based exploration followed by VLM-based anomaly identification, and an end-to-end VLM agent in which visual reasoning directly guides action selection. Across the evaluated models and two paradigms, success rates range from 6.6% to 42.3%, substantially below human performance (83.4%). Through the task of world auditing, WorldAuditBench provides a testbed for studying how multimodal agents couple action and visual reasoning in interactive 3D environments, while highlighting current limitations in their ability to gather and interpret evidence during exploration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出WorldAuditBench，一个用于3D世界审计的基准，包含13个环境、213个异常任务、五大异常类型，评估多模态智能体在导航搜索与视觉推理耦合方面的能力，发现最佳成功率仅42.3%，远低于人类的83.4%。
AI.motivation: 随着交互式3D世界被广泛用于研究智能行为，亟需高效的异常检测流程（如悬浮物体、可穿墙、与场景不一致的物体）。3D世界审计需要耦合两种能力：动作（系统高效导航搜索）与视觉推理（理解环境并识别异常）。多模态智能体能否有效耦合这两种能力尚不明确。
AI.method: 构建WorldAuditBench基准，含213个异常任务，覆盖13个由Unreal Engine 5和Three.js构建的环境，涵盖五类异常。在固定探索预算下评估五种前沿模型，采用两种审计范式：(1) VLA探索后接VLM异常识别；(2) 端到端VLM智能体，视觉推理直接指导动作选择。
AI.result: 在所有评估模型和两种范式下，成功率在6.6%至42.3%之间，远低于人类表现（83.4%）。
AI.conclusion: WorldAuditBench为研究多模态智能体如何在交互式3D环境中耦合动作与视觉推理提供了测试平台，同时揭示了当前模型在探索过程中收集与解读证据能力的局限。

title: ExpandDiff: Dynamic Range Expanding Diffusion for Single-Image HDR Reconstruction
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Submitted to ICASSP 2027. Code and supplementary material: https://memreandiran.github.io/expanddiff/
summary: Single-image HDR reconstruction requires inferring missing detail while preserving the visible content of an LDR image. Differences in sensor dynamic range and exposure cause LDR images to lose varying amounts of information in shadows and highlights. We present ExpandDiff, a conditional diffusion pipeline that jointly reconstructs clipped shadows and highlights. To account for this variation, we introduce Dynamic Clipping Synthesis (DCS), which randomly samples shadow and highlight clipping percentiles when constructing training inputs from HDR targets. A pixel-space diffusion model guided by spatially-adaptive normalization then predicts perceptually encoded HDR through a bounded output head, reconstructing both clipping directions in one sampling trajectory. On the SI-HDR benchmark, ExpandDiff variants improve HDR reconstruction accuracy by 3.43 dB in PU21-PSNR over the strongest evaluated competing method, and by 7.34 dB under two-sided clipping. The code and supplementary material are available at https://memreandiran.github.io/expanddiff/.

AI.tldr: 提出ExpandDiff条件扩散框架，通过动态裁剪合成与像素空间扩散联合重建单图HDR中被裁剪的阴影与高光，在SI-HDR基准上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 传感器动态范围与曝光差异导致LDR图像在阴影和高光处丢失不同数量的信息，单图HDR重建需在保留可见内容的同时推断缺失细节，而现有方法难以同时兼顾两侧裁剪的差异化损失。
AI.method: 1) 动态裁剪合成（DCS）：从HDR目标构建训练输入时，随机采样阴影与高光的裁剪百分位，以模拟多样的裁剪情况；2) 采用像素空间扩散模型，由空间自适应归一化（SPADE）引导；3) 使用有界输出头预测感知编码的HDR，在单次采样轨迹中同时重建两侧裁剪区域。
AI.result: 在SI-HDR基准上，ExpandDiff各变体相比最强对比方法，PU21-PSNR重建精度提升3.43 dB；在双侧裁剪条件下提升7.34 dB。
AI.conclusion: ExpandDiff通过联合建模阴影与高光裁剪并适配不同传感器/曝光条件，有效提升单图HDR重建精度，尤其在双侧裁剪场景下优势明显，代码与补充材料已开源。

title: Client and Training Data Selection for Computationally Efficient Synchronized Federated Learning
comment: Accepted for publication in the 29th Euromicro Conference on Digital System Design (DSD 2026)
summary: Federated learning (FL) is a promising paradigm of machine learning, which preserves user privacy by enabling learning without sharing raw data with a cloud server. Straggling clients have been a problem for FL as they introduce delays in aggregating the local models and hence, the convergence of the global model. Therefore, it is important to have a mechanism that ensures fast convergence of the global model as well as good FL participation rate. Another issue for the convergence of a model in FL is the non-independent and identically distributed (non-iid) data across the clients. Prior approaches based on probabilistic client selection do not work well under non-iid data especially when the number of clients is small. We show scenarios where such approaches fail and propose a joint client-training data selection algorithm for fast convergence of FL models. Our experiments on CIFAR-100 dataset show that convergence of the FL model can be significantly improved over prior works that can consider non-iid data and heterogeneous computation and higher model accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种联合客户端-训练数据选择算法，以在non-iid数据与异构计算条件下加速联邦学习的收敛并提升模型精度。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习通过不上传原始数据来保护隐私，但掉队客户端会拖慢本地模型聚合，影响全局模型收敛；同时客户端间的non-iid数据分布也是一大难题。已有基于概率的客户端选择方法在non-iid、客户端数量较少时表现不佳，因此需要一个既保证快速收敛又保持较高参与率的机制。
AI.method: 作者首先展示现有概率性客户端选择方法在non-iid场景下失败的案例，随后提出一种联合的客户端-训练数据选择算法，同时兼顾non-iid数据与异构计算能力。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-100数据集上的实验表明，相比能够处理non-iid数据和异构计算的前期工作，该方法显著改善了FL模型的收敛速度，并获得了更高的模型精度。
AI.conclusion: 联合选择客户端与其训练数据可有效应对non-iid分布和异构计算带来的挑战，加快联邦学习收敛并提升精度，同时维持良好的参与率。

title: Turbo Harness: Instance-Adaptive Harness Optimization
summary: Automating the search for effective harnesses is an important step toward enabling agents to recursively self-improve. Existing harness optimizations typically produce a single global harness that is applied uniformly across task instances. However, a harness that works well on average may not be optimal for every instance. We introduce Turbo Harness, a framework that can adapt a globally optimized harness to each instance by reusing information generated during the original optimization process. Specifically, Turbo Harness recycles artifacts produced during a completed global harness optimization run, and summarizes them into a structured playbook. We train a harness editor to leverage this prior optimization experience to generate instance-specific patches to the global harness. At inference time, the editor uses the instance and the playbook to construct a tailored harness in which the execution model operates. Through numerical experiments, we show that Turbo Harness consistently outperforms existing harness optimization baselines across seven benchmarks spanning interactive agent tasks, software engineering, and long-horizon terminal tasks.

AI.tldr: Turbo Harness 通过复用全局 harness 优化过程产生的信息，为每个任务实例生成定制化的 harness 补丁，在七项基准上持续超越现有基线。
AI.motivation: 现有 harness 优化通常只产出一个全局统一的 harness，在所有任务实例上统一应用。但一个平均表现良好的 harness 未必对每个实例都最优，因此需要面向实例的自适应能力。
AI.method: Turbo Harness 复用一次已完成的全局 harness 优化运行中产生的产物，将其总结为结构化 playbook；然后训练一个 harness editor，利用该先前的优化经验为全局 harness 生成实例特定的补丁。推理时，editor 结合当前实例与 playbook 构建定制化 harness，供执行模型在其中运行。
AI.result: 数值实验表明，Turbo Harness 在涵盖交互式智能体任务、软件工程和长时程终端任务的七个基准上，持续优于现有 harness 优化基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过回收并复用全局优化过程中的经验来自动化实例级 harness 适配，是提升智能体任务表现的有效途径，也是迈向智能体递归自我改进的重要一步。

title: D-Scope: Decomposing and Steering Diffusion Transformers with Sparse Autoencoders
summary: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) reveal visual structure in diffusion transformers (DiTs), but interpreting a feature does not establish whether it can be used to control generation. We introduce D-Scope (Diffusion Scope), a framework that connects feature interpretation to generation control through shared visual evidence. D-Scope aggregates SigLIP~2 embeddings of highly activating image patches into visual centroids. Matching target text descriptions against these visual centroids in the shared image-text embedding space then enables retrieval of individual features without per-feature text annotations. The underlying patches provide evidence for inspecting each selection, while spatially masked interventions test the corresponding decoder direction at varying strengths under fixed generation conditions. We characterize 150 SAEs across two model families and five layers, and introduce a benchmark of 100 target concepts with ten contexts each spanning under-specified and explicit-conflict conditions. Our empirical results show that high reconstruction fidelity can coexist with low dictionary utilization and limited visual-evidence coverage. Under per-case best-of-sweep strength selection, contrastive retrieval yields larger mean regional SigLIP~2 gains than direct retrieval across the tested steering configurations, without consistently improving outside-region preservation. D-Scope provides an inspectable framework for evaluating sparse DiT features through their visual evidence and the effects of their decoder directions on generation. The demo is available at https://jiahaozhang-public.github.io/d-scope/.

AI.tldr: 提出 D-Scope 框架，将扩散 Transformer 中稀疏自编码器的特征解释与其对生成的控制能力相连接，通过共享视觉证据实现特征检索与干预评测。
AI.motivation: 稀疏自编码器虽能揭示 DiT 的视觉结构，但"能解释一个特征"并不等于"能用该特征控制生成"，二者之间缺乏可靠的联系与评估手段。
AI.method: 将高激活图像块的 SigLIP~2 嵌入聚合为视觉质心；在共享图文嵌入空间用目标文本描述匹配视觉质心，从而无需逐特征文本标注即可检索特征；用底层图像块作为选择依据，并对解码器方向进行空间掩码干预，在固定生成条件下改变强度。
AI.result: 评测两个模型家族、五个层级的 150 个 SAE，并提出含 100 个目标概念、每个概念 10 种上下文（涵盖欠指定与显式冲突）的基准。结果显示：高重建保真度可与低字典利用率、有限的视觉证据覆盖共存；在逐例最优强度选择下，对比式检索比直接检索带来更大的区域 SigLIP~2 增益，但未一致改善区域外保持。
AI.conclusion: D-Scope 提供了一个可检验的框架，通过视觉证据及解码器方向对生成的影响来评估稀疏 DiT 特征。

title: From Benchmarks to Production: Transferring Time Series Anomaly Detection Methods for Electricity Production Monitoring
summary: Accurate forecasting of electricity production is essential for maintaining the operational efficiency and strategic planning of energy utilities. In industrial settings, such forecasts are generated daily to ensure supply-demand balance and optimal management of production assets. However, the increasing complexity of modern power systems and data flows poses significant challenges for ensuring the reliability and consistency of these forecasts. This paper addresses the problem of anomaly detection in short-term production forecasts at EDF, formulated as identifying atypical intra-day patterns that may signal data quality issues or operational irregularities. We introduce TAMIS, a scalable and interpretable system that analyzes daily production time series to automatically detect anomalous days based on deviations from historical patterns learned from past data. Designed for human-in-the-loop workflows, TAMIS surfaces top-ranked anomalies through an automated daily newsletter, enabling efficient expert review and continuous monitoring. An extensive experimental evaluation on real-world industrial data demonstrates that TAMIS achieves the best accuracy-efficiency trade-off compared to baseline methods. To foster further research and reproducibility, we publicly release the anonymized application datasets used in our study.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TAMIS，一个用于电力短期生产预测异常检测的可扩展、可解释系统，能自动识别日生产时间序列中的异常日，并通过每日简报支持人工审核，在真实工业数据上取得最佳精度-效率权衡。
AI.motivation: 电力生产预测对能源企业的运营效率与战略规划至关重要，工业场景需每日生成预测以平衡供需和管理生产资产。然而现代电力系统与数据流日益复杂，预测的可靠性与一致性面临挑战，因此需要检测短期预测中的异常。
AI.method: 将问题定义为识别可能反映数据质量问题或运营异常的非典型日内模式。提出TAMIS系统，分析每日生产时间序列，基于从历史数据学到的模式偏离来自动检测异常日；系统面向人在环工作流，通过每日自动简报呈现排名靠前的异常，便于专家审查和持续监控。
AI.result: 在真实工业数据上的大量实验表明，与基线方法相比，TAMIS实现了最佳的精度-效率权衡。为促进研究与可复现性，作者公开了研究中使用的匿名化应用数据集。
AI.conclusion: TAMIS是一个可扩展、可解释的短期电力生产预测异常检测系统，适用于人工审核流程，并在工业实际数据中验证有效，同时公开数据集以支持后续研究。

title: Life-Bench: A Benchmark and Knowledge Graph Framework for Multimodal Personalization Beyond Concept Recognition
summary: As large language models increasingly power personal assistants, users expect them to reason over multimodal life histories, from recognizing people to understanding events to aggregating patterns, yet existing benchmarks primarily target concept-level recognition. We introduce Life-Bench, a fully synthetic, human-verified multimodal benchmark of over 11,800 question-answer pairs across 10 tasks, organized by required evidence scope: concept identification, event understanding, and aggregated reasoning. The benchmark's photo-centric personal histories are distributionally aligned with real user accounts under embedding statistic. The interconnected structure of personal data invites graph-based solutions; we propose LifeGraph, a personal knowledge graph framework providing structured retrieval with on-demand access to source visual evidence, showing particular promise on event and aggregated tasks. Systematic evaluation of four retrieval paradigms on Life-Bench demonstrates that accuracy degrades sharply with evidence scope, falling below 0.40 on aggregated tasks, and that no single paradigm dominates across categories. Performance beyond concept recognition remains modest for all evaluated methods, establishing personalization over multimodal histories as an open challenge and Life-Bench as a testbed for future progress.

AI.tldr: 提出Life-Bench多模态基准（超1.18万问答对，10项任务），按证据范围分为概念识别、事件理解与聚合推理，并配套提出LifeGraph个人知识图谱框架；评测显示随着证据范围扩大准确率急剧下降，聚合任务低于0.40，无单一范式全面占优。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型正被用作个人助理，用户期望其能对多模态"人生历史"进行推理（识人、理解事件、聚合模式），但现有基准多局限于概念级识别，缺乏对更广证据范围推理能力的评测。
AI.method: 构建Life-Bench：完全合成、经人工验证的多模态基准，含10项任务、1.18万+问答对，按证据范围分为概念识别、事件理解、聚合推理三类；其以照片为中心的个人历史在嵌入统计上与真实用户账户分布对齐。同时提出LifeGraph——个人知识图谱框架，提供结构化检索并可按需访问原始视觉证据。在Life-Bench上系统评测四种检索范式。
AI.result: 准确率随证据范围扩大而急剧下降，聚合任务上低于0.40；没有任何单一范式在所有类别中占优；LifeGraph在事件与聚合任务上表现尤为有前景；所有方法在概念识别之外的表现均较为有限。
AI.conclusion: 多模态历史数据的个性化推理仍是开放挑战，Life-Bench可作为推动未来进展的测试平台。

title: Introduction to Computer Vision
comment: 217 pages. For online notes and code, see https://sbirchfield.github.io/cvintro
summary: This book presents a code-first introduction to computer vision, spanning classical 2D image processing, classical 3D vision, and deep learning. Organized as 44 short chapters across three parts, the book builds each topic from first principles: image arithmetic and morphology; convolution, pyramids, and frequency-domain filtering; feature detection, optical flow, and stereo; projective geometry, camera calibration, and structure from motion; and the full arc of modern deep learning, from a single neuron through convolutional networks, backpropagation, classic architectures, transfer learning, object detection, and semantic and instance segmentation, concluding with engineering considerations like mixed-precision and parallel training. Every technique is implemented directly in Python and NumPy or PyTorch and checked numerically against the corresponding OpenCV or PyTorch library function, so readers see not just the mathematics but its concrete behavior on real and synthetic data. The material was distilled with AI assistance from freely available online course notes, condensing extensive working code into concise mathematical exposition while preserving verified, reproducible results throughout. It is intended as a self-contained reference for students and practitioners who want to understand computer vision algorithms and their Python implementations.

AI.tldr: 本书以代码优先的方式系统介绍计算机视觉，涵盖经典2D图像处理、经典3D视觉与深度学习三部分，共44个短章节，所有算法均用Python/NumPy或PyTorch实现并与OpenCV/PyTorch函数做数值校验。
AI.motivation: 为希望理解计算机视觉算法及其Python实现的学生和从业者提供一份自包含的参考书，使他们不仅看到数学推导，还能看到算法在真实与合成数据上的具体行为。
AI.method: 采用代码优先、从第一性原理出发的组织方式，分三部分共44个短章节：2D图像处理（图像运算与形态学、卷积、金字塔、频域滤波、特征检测、光流、立体视觉）；3D视觉（射影几何、相机标定、运动恢复结构）；深度学习（从单神经元到卷积网络、反向传播、经典架构、迁移学习、目标检测、语义与实例分割，以及混合精度与并行训练等工程实践）。每个技术直接用Python和NumPy或PyTorch实现，并与对应的OpenCV或PyTorch库函数做数值对照校验。材料借助AI辅助从公开在线课程笔记提炼，将大量可运行代码压缩为简洁的数学阐述，同时保留可复现的验证结果。
AI.result: 形成了一套覆盖经典与深度学习计算机视觉的完整内容体系，所有实现均通过数值校验，确保结果可复现；并将冗长的代码浓缩为简洁的数学讲解。
AI.conclusion: 该书可作为自包含的参考资源，帮助读者在数学原理与Python实现两个层面掌握计算机视觉算法。

title: Jacobian Rank Collapse in Decision-Focused Learning
comment: 53 pages, 21 figures, 32 tables. Includes theoretical proofs and supplementary experiments
summary:
Decision-focused learning (DFL) trains predictors through downstream objectives, but a different loss need not provide an independent parameter-update direction. We characterize this restriction through the predictor Jacobian, using sparse index tracking to distinguish the covariance entries read by the optimizer from the parameter directions available to learning. Rank-one Jacobians make nonzero per-example gradients collinear; a conditional spectral bound describes near-collinearity. A batch-subspace characterization and counterexamples show why these local statements imply neither common minimizers nor collinear batch updates.
  Experiments examine when geometry translates into decision quality. Across 38 one-parameter equity configurations, DFL gains over MSE remain below 1.8%; a 385-parameter conditional predictor also has pointwise rank one. In validation-tuned shortest-path and knapsack experiments, full-capacity SPO+ reduces mean regret by 11.6% and 10.6%, respectively; only knapsack survives correction across eight comparisons. The capacity contrast persists on fresh datasets across batch orders and training budgets. Holding expressivity fixed, invertible coordinate scaling lowers spectral effective rank and ordinary SGD gains; compensating for the scaling restores the original trajectories. Financial forward-target controls separate forecast accuracy from decision quality; a matched neural comparison finds no aggregate DFL advantage in the tested architecture. These findings distinguish local rank restrictions, coordinate-dependent optimization and predictive accuracy. Predictor geometry helps explain available learning directions, while held-out decision quality remains the test of practical benefit.

AI.tldr: 本文通过预测器雅可比（predictor Jacobian）刻画决策聚焦学习（DFL）的参数更新几何，指出秩一雅可比使逐样本梯度共线，但局部秩限制既不能推出共同极小值，也不能推出批次更新共线；实验表明几何限制是否转化为决策质量提升依赖具体任务。
AI.motivation: DFL 通过下游目标训练预测器，但不同损失函数未必提供独立的参数更新方向。作者希望从预测器雅可比的几何角度，厘清 DFL 可用的学习方向究竟受到何种限制，以及这种局部限制何时真正影响决策质量。
AI.method: 以预测器雅可比为核心工具，用稀疏指数追踪区分优化器读取的协方差项与学习可用的参数方向；提出秩一雅可比导致逐样本梯度共线，并给出条件谱界刻画近似共线。进一步给出批次子空间刻画与反例，说明局部结论不能推出共同极小值或批次更新共线。实验涵盖 38 组单参数公平性配置、385 参数条件预测器、验证集调参的最短路与背包任务（含 SPO+ 全容量对比、八次比较校正、新数据集与不同批次顺序/训练预算），并通过可逆坐标缩放、金融前向目标对照和匹配神经网络比较进行验证。
AI.result: 38 组单参数公平性配置中 DFL 相对 MSE 的增益低于 1.8%；385 参数条件预测器仍呈逐点秩一。验证集调参的最短路与背包实验中，全容量 SPO+ 分别降低平均遗憾 11.6% 和 10.6%，但八次比较校正后仅背包任务显著。容量差异在新数据集、不同批次顺序和训练预算下持续存在。固定表达能力时，可逆坐标缩放降低谱有效秩并提升普通 SGD 增益，补偿缩放后恢复原轨迹。金融前向目标对照将预测精度与决策质量分离，匹配神经网络比较未发现在所测架构中 DFL 的总体优势。
AI.conclusion: 研究区分了局部秩限制、依赖坐标的优化与预测精度三件事：预测器几何有助于解释可用的学习方向，而实际的实践收益仍须以留出集上的决策质量作为检验标准。

title: SAGE: Salient Factor Discovery and Generation with Visual Foundation Representations
summary: Given a target dataset, such as faces with eyeglasses, and a background dataset, such as faces without, contrastive analysis separates \textit{salient} factors specific to the target from \textit{common} content shared by both. We aim for salient representations that capture target-specific detail in each image, such as the shape, color, and position of the glasses, so that they reveal subtypes without subtype labels and guide the generation of new examples of a discovered subtype, even one with no name or text description. We introduce SAGE, which learns both factors directly in the high-dimensional spatial latent of a frozen representation autoencoder and conditions a diffusion transformer on the learned salient representation of a reference image. On Digits-ImageNet and FFHQ eyeglasses, SAGE combines high-fidelity \textit{reconstruction} (rFID below $2$) with unsupervised \textit{subtype discovery}, recovering the digits better than baselines (probe accuracy $0.950$ vs.\ at most $0.281$) and revealing eyewear types, finer sunglasses styles, and mislabeled images; salient-conditioned \textit{generation} raises Digits-ImageNet subtype accuracy over the unfactorized latent ($90.5\%$ vs.\ $27.7\%$) and diversity on both datasets. On retinal OCT, SAGE's salient space separates three diseases using only normal/disease labels.

AI.tldr: SAGE 在冻结的表示自编码器的高维空间潜码中直接学习显著/共有因子，并以显著表示条件化扩散 Transformer，实现高保真重建、无监督子类发现与可控生成。
AI.motivation: 目标数据集（如戴眼镜人脸）与背景数据集（如不戴眼镜人脸）之间的对比分析，需要分离目标特有的"显著因子"（眼镜形状、颜色、位置等）与两者共享的"共有内容"。作者希望显著表示既能捕获每张图像的目标特有关键细节，又能无标签地揭示子类，并支持对未命名、无文本描述的新子类的生成。
AI.method: 提出 SAGE：在冻结的表示自编码器（frozen representation autoencoder）的高维空间潜码中直接学习显著与共有两类因子；并以其学习到的参考图像显著表示作为条件，驱动扩散 Transformer（diffusion transformer）生成。
AI.result: 在 Digits-ImageNet 与 FFHQ 眼镜数据上，SAGE 兼顾高保真重建（rFID 低于 2）与无监督子类发现：数字恢复能力远超基线（探针准确率 0.950 对最高 0.281），并揭示眼镜类型、更细的太阳镜风格及误标图像；显著条件生成将 Digits-ImageNet 子类准确率从非解耦潜码的 27.7% 提升到 90.5%，并在两个数据集上提升多样性。在视网膜 OCT 上，仅用正常/疾病标签，其显著空间即可区分三种疾病。
AI.conclusion: SAGE 表明，在冻结自编码器的高维空间潜码中直接进行对比式因子分解，可同时获得高质量重建、可解释的无监督子类发现以及可控的显著条件生成，并在医学影像上具备泛化潜力。

title: A Time-Aware Bag-of-Receptive-Fields for Interpretable Irregular Time Series Classification
summary: Irregular time series, characterized by non-uniform sampling intervals, missing observations, and variable lengths, are ubiquitous in healthcare, mobility, and environmental monitoring, yet effective and interpretable classifiers for this setting are limited. Existing approaches often rely on imputation, which can obscure the temporal structure of the data, or require complex neural architectures that are opaque and difficult to explain. In this work, we extend the Bag-Of-Receptive-Fields (BORF), a fast, deterministic, and interpretable transform for time series, to the irregular setting. Our key contribution is a time-weighted normalization scheme in which each observation is weighted proportionally to its associated time delta, making pattern extraction sensitive to the actual temporal distribution of samples rather than only their index position. This requires deriving an efficient sliding-window recurrence for the time-weighted standard deviation, preserving the linear time complexity of BORF. We benchmark the resulting method against state-of-the-art irregular time series classifiers on datasets from the PYRREGULAR repository, demonstrating competitive classification performance with the added benefit of human-interpretable explanations.

AI.tldr: 本文将BORF变换扩展到不规则时间序列，提出按时间间隔加权的时间加权归一化方案，并推导出滑动窗口递推算法以保持线性复杂度，在PYRREGULAR数据集上取得有竞争力的分类性能且具有可解释性。
AI.motivation: 不规则时间序列（采样间隔非均匀、观测缺失、长度可变）在医疗、移动性和环境监测中普遍存在，但缺乏有效且可解释的分类器。现有方法依赖插补（会掩盖时间结构）或复杂且不透明的神经网络架构。
AI.method: 将快速、确定性且可解释的Bag-Of-Receptive-Fields（BORF）变换扩展到不规则时间序列。核心贡献是时间加权归一化方案：每个观测按其时间间隔（time delta）成比例加权，使模式提取对样本的实际时间分布敏感，而不只依赖索引位置。为此推导了时间加权标准差的滑动窗口递推公式，保持BORF的线性时间复杂度。
AI.result: 在PYRREGULAR仓库数据集上与最先进的不规则时间序列分类器进行基准对比，展现出有竞争力的分类性能，并额外提供人类可解释的解释。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在保持线性复杂度和可解释性的同时，在不规则时间序列分类任务上达到与现有先进方法相当的性能。

title: FANVIDv2: Evaluating Video Super-Resolution by Face and Licence-Plate Recognition Under Compound Degradation
summary: Video super-resolution (VSR) is normally judged by PSNR and SSIM on clips that were downsampled bicubically, although in surveillance its purpose is to make faces and licence plates \emph{recognisable}. We present FANVIDv2, a benchmark that scores VSR by what a recognition pipeline can do with its output. FANVIDv2 provides $320\times180$ low-resolution (LR) clips with high-resolution (HR) references for 48 public figures (with one HR gallery image each) and 375 licence-plate clips covering 360 distinct plate strings. LR clips are generated with a randomised compound degradation (blur, resize jitter, sensor noise, JPEG compression, final downsampling) rather than bicubic downsampling alone. Two metrics score recognition \emph{inside} detections: FaceRecBox rewards a face only if it is localised and correctly identified, and TextRecBox scores plate transcriptions by normalised edit distance weighted by localisation quality. With a 2.3\,M-parameter VSR baseline (RCDM), FaceRecBox rises from 0.6864 to 0.7222, identity accuracy on matched faces from 84.35\% to 86.93\%, and TextRecBox from 0.3088 to 0.3667; a residual-map gated variant (RCDM-RMGF) reaches 0.3801 on plates. We describe the degradation model, the baseline architectures and the scorers in detail, and release annotations, metadata, download and degradation scripts and evaluation code.

AI.tldr: 提出 FANVIDv2 视频超分基准，以识别管线表现（人脸与车牌识别）而非 PSNR/SSIM 评估 VSR，并给出基线结果。
