AI.tldr: 本文分析了逐层有限步 Muon 更新（含 Nesterov 动量）在耦合非凸目标上的收敛性，在不依赖精确极分解或全局正交化、无界梯度、对称噪声或奇异值下界假设下，建立了期望平均 Frobenius 梯度范数的 O(T^{-1/4}) 收敛界。
AI.motivation: 实际 Muon 优化器对每个参数矩阵单独执行有限步 Newton–Schulz 迭代并保持动量，而非使用精确极分解或一次性全局正交化。现有理论通常用精确极因子或全局正交化替代这些逐层更新，无法刻画实际算法的有限步、逐层、耦合非凸行为。本文动机是对真实的实用 Muon 更新进行联合分析，给出不依赖过强假设的收敛保证。
AI.method: 在梯度依赖的 (L_0, L_1, q)-光滑性以及条件无偏、逐层方差有界的随机梯度下，直接对逐层有限步 Newton–Schulz 更新与动量进行联合分析，保留 Nesterov 递推。证明遵循下降不等式，并将动量跟踪误差分解为初始化、噪声与漂移三部分。对原型五步五次标量映射解析验证所需界，并允许满足同样界的步依赖系数。补充给出更强谱条件下核范数结果以刻画秩依赖。
AI.result: 在给定假设下得到期望平均 Frobenius 梯度范数的 O(T^{-1/4}) 上界；该界不要求随机梯度有界、噪声对称，也不要求非零输出奇异值有统一正下界；当块数与问题常数固定时，常数不含显式矩阵维度或秩因子。此外，补充的核范数结果在更强谱条件下量化了秩依赖。
AI.conclusion: 本文为实用 Muon 的逐层有限步更新提供了直接的耦合非凸收敛分析，证明其可达 O(T^{-1/4}) 收敛率，且所需假设较已有工作更弱；消失速率依赖耦合的学习率与动量调度，包含标准单系数 Nesterov 规则，同时对步依赖系数情形亦成立。

title: StreamRig: Exploiting Intra-Rig Geometry for Streaming Multi-Camera Odometry
summary: Mobile robots and vehicles carry synchronized multi-camera rigs, yet many streaming 3D foundation models are designed for monocular input, leaving efficient use of rig geometry a challenge. We present StreamRig, a freeze-and-stream framework that builds causal streaming odometry for calibrated rigs on a frozen multi-view 3D foundation model. The frozen front-end jointly perceives the synchronized views using rig calibration. A Rig-Resampler compresses their features, a CausalBridge applies causal attention with a key-value cache, and a lightweight head regresses rig poses. A periodic re-anchoring protocol supports stable pose estimation over long sequences. Only these modules are trained, 74.6M parameters in total, with relative poses as the sole supervision. Our two-stage training strategy combines group relocalization pretraining with causal rig training to transfer the geometric priors of the frozen front-end and the alignment ability of the pretrained modules to streaming odometry. We evaluate on NCLT, TartanGround, KITTI-360, and our self-collected humanoid-robot dataset ZJH, where training uses only simulation and real-world evaluation is zero-shot. Across all four datasets, StreamRig achieves lower translation and rotation drift than the evaluated non-oracle monocular streaming and rig-aware offline models, while maintaining low inference cost. Ablations and controlled camera-count experiments identify the sources of these gains. We further examine how longer training windows affect inference over longer horizons. Code has been released at https://github.com/WeiYuFei0217/StreamRig.

AI.tldr: StreamRig 是一个基于冻结多视角 3D 基础模型的因果流式里程计框架，通过轻量模块实现标定相机阵列的高效位姿估计。
AI.motivation: 移动机器人和车辆常配备多相机阵列，但许多流式 3D 基础模型面向单目输入设计，难以高效利用阵列几何信息。
AI.method: 冻结前端联合感知标定视图；Rig-Resampler 压缩特征，CausalBridge 使用因果注意力与键值缓存，轻量头回归位姿；周期性重锚定协议保持长序列稳定。仅训练 74.6M 参数模块，以相对位姿为唯一监督；两阶段训练结合组重定位预训练与因果阵列训练。
AI.result: 在 NCLT、TartanGround、KITTI-360 及自采人形机器人数据集 ZJH 上，训练仅用仿真、真实评估为零样本，StreamRig 的平移与旋转漂移低于非 oracle 单目流式与阵列感知离线模型，且推理成本低；消融与相机数量实验验证增益来源，并考察更长训练窗口对长时域推理的影响。
AI.conclusion: StreamRig 能有效利用标定多相机阵列几何，在冻结 3D 基础模型上实现高效稳定的流式里程计，代码已开源。

title: Hybrid Methods for Robust Tabular Data Imputation
summary: Missing data are a fundamental challenge in statistical analysis and machine learning, as the choice of imputation method substantially impacts downstream inference. In this work, we propose two hybrid imputation methods called NuclearForest and SoftForest, which combine nuclear-norm-based low-rank initialization using Singular Value Thresholding (SVT) and SoftImpute, respectively, with a non-iterative Random Forest refinement. For the SVT-based component, we further introduce an adaptive step-size rule, prove adaptive step-size bounds, and establish convergence for the corresponding zero-initialized iteration. The low-rank initialization provides a structured warm start that captures the global covariance patterns in the data, while the subsequent Random Forest step recovers residual nonlinear signals encoding local dependencies. We conduct an extensive benchmark on diverse datasets from different application domains, comparing the proposed methods with seven established imputation methods under the Missing Completely at Random (MCAR), Missing at Random (MAR), and Missing Not at Random (MNAR) mechanisms across varying missingness rates. Our results demonstrate that NuclearForest and SoftForest match or exceed the imputation fidelity of state-of-the-art iterative methods such as MissForest, while significantly reducing computational cost. In particular, they achieve speedups of approximately 5.81 times and 9.52 times over MissForest by replacing iterative cycles with a single refinement step. Our approach effectively exploits the low-rank structure of real-world tabular data and accommodates mixed-type variables, providing an efficient and robust solution for data imputation in bioinformatics, economics, and beyond.

AI.tldr: 提出 NuclearForest 和 SoftForest 两种混合插补方法，结合低秩初始化与随机森林精炼，在保真度上媲美 MissForest 且大幅提速。
AI.motivation: 缺失数据是统计分析与机器学习的核心挑战，插补方法的选择会显著影响后续推断，需要兼顾精度与计算效率的解决方案。
AI.method: 将基于核范数的低秩初始化（分别使用奇异值阈值 SVT 和 SoftImpute）与非迭代随机森林精炼相结合；对 SVT 组件引入自适应步长规则，证明步长界并建立零初始化迭代的收敛性。
AI.result: 在 MCAR、MAR、MNAR 三种机制及不同缺失率下，跨领域数据集的基准测试显示，两种方法达到或超过 MissForest 等迭代式最优方法的插补保真度，同时计算成本显著降低，速度分别提升约 5.81 倍和 9.52 倍。
AI.conclusion: 该方法有效利用真实表格数据的低秩结构并支持混合类型变量，为生物信息学、经济学等领域提供高效稳健的插补方案。

title: ComputerSD: Online Self-Distillation from Real-Time Feedback for Computer-Use Agents
summary: Online training enables computer-use agents (CUAs) to improve through interaction with executable environments. However, existing methods primarily rely on sparse outcome rewards, which provide no supervision for intermediate actions. On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) offers token-level learning signals through privileged rescoring, but directly applying it to CUA online training presents two challenges: fixed guidance may become misaligned with the student's current state, and guidance-induced probability shifts may conflict with step-level correctness. We introduce ComputerSD, an online self-distillation method for CUAs that converts real-time feedback from executed GUI transitions into guidance for policy learning. A fine-tuned GUI analyzer produces guidance and a step-level value score after each action; the guidance provides privileged context, while the score regulates the resulting OPSD signals. ComputerSD jointly optimizes token-level OPSD and trajectory-level GRPO in a fully asynchronous training framework. On OSWorld-Verified, ComputerSD outperforms outcome-only GRPO by 1.9 and 4.1 percentage points on the general-purpose Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking and specialized EvoCUA-8B backbones, respectively. Evaluation in out-of-distribution settings further supports the generalizability of ComputerSD. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of learning from real-time feedback through online self-distillation for CUAs.

AI.tldr: 提出 ComputerSD，一种面向计算机使用智能体的在线自蒸馏方法，将GUI转换的实时反馈转化为策略学习指导。
AI.motivation: 现有CUA在线训练主要依赖稀疏的结果奖励，无法为中间动作提供监督。虽然在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）能通过特权重打分提供token级信号，但直接应用于CUA存在两个问题：固定指导可能与学生当前状态失配；指导引起的概率偏移可能与步骤级正确性冲突。
AI.method: ComputerSD利用微调的GUI分析器在每步动作后生成指导与步骤级价值分数：指导提供特权上下文，分数用于调节OPSD信号。方法联合优化token级OPSD与轨迹级GRPO，并在全异步训练框架中进行。
AI.result: 在OSWorld-Verified上，ComputerSD相比仅用结果奖励的GRPO，在通用骨干Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking上提升1.9个百分点，在专用骨干EvoCUA-8B上提升4.1个百分点；在分布外设置下也验证了泛化性。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，通过在线自蒸馏从实时反馈中学习，对计算机使用智能体是有效的。

title: Parameterization method of reservoir properties for ensemble-based data assimilation using intermediate latent space of StyleGAN
summary: Ensemble smoothers are the most successful and efficient techniques currently available for history matching. However, because these methods rely on Gaussian assumptions, their performance is severely degraded when the prior geology is described in terms of complex facies distributions (non-Gaussian). In this way, for these methods, we need to apply efficient parameterization techniques. Currently, the most efficient methods for performing parameterization are deep learning models. However, given the variety of existing deep learning models, studies have not identified which is most suitable for use with ensemble-based methods, although some important models had already been evaluated. Based on a recent literature review, the most promising models selected were VAE-GAN, Latent Diffusion, and StyleGAN models. As a novel aspect of this work, data assimilation with the second generation of StyleGAN (StyleGAN2) model was performed using the latent z-space and intermediate w-space, separately. They were applied in two 2D case studies: one categorical (three facies) and the other continuous. The results demonstrated that all three models are highly efficient, with the StyleGAN2 model standing out for generating samples with geological realism and achieving excellent data matching in the cases studied. Our findings show that performing data assimilation with StyleGAN2 using the intermediate space (w-space) yielded better results than the traditional application in the latent space (z-space). This is due to the fact that ESMDA uses linear updates and the w-space is much more linear and disentangled than the highly entangled z-space, thereby ensuring that the updated vectors remain close to realistic geological patterns. These results were validated using main geostatistical and history matching metrics.

AI.tldr: 比较VAE-GAN、潜在扩散与StyleGAN2在地质历史拟合中的参数化效果，发现StyleGAN2的w空间表现最佳。
AI.motivation: 集成平滑器依赖高斯假设，面对非高斯复杂相分布时性能下降，需借助深度学习参数化，但尚不清楚哪种模型最适合集成方法。
AI.method: 基于文献筛选出VAE-GAN、Latent Diffusion和StyleGAN2三种模型，首次分别用StyleGAN2的潜在z空间和中间w空间进行数据同化，并在两个二维案例（三类相分类与连续变量）中应用。
AI.result: 三种模型均高效，StyleGAN2在样本地质真实性与数据匹配上最优；使用w空间比z空间结果更好，因ESMDA为线性更新而w空间更线性、解耦。
AI.conclusion: StyleGAN2配合w空间参数化是集成平滑器历史拟合的有效方案，结论经主要地质统计与历史拟合指标验证。

title: Looped Diffusion Transformer
summary: Improving text-to-image models has traditionally relied on increasing model size or the number of denoising steps. In this work, we explore an alternative way to scale computation by repeatedly running shared Transformer blocks within each denoising step, effectively increasing computational depth while keeping the parameter count fixed. This looped computation enables iterative refinement of internal representations without explicit reasoning tokens. However, naive looping fails to consistently improve image quality. We trace this problem to weak supervision across intermediate loops and unregulated attention updates that progressively erode local information. To overcome these challenges, we propose Looped Diffusion Transformer (Looped-DiT), which combines deep supervision across intermediate loops with self-modulating attention to stabilize looped feature updates. Under matched-parameter and matched-compute settings, Looped-DiT consistently outperforms non-looped baselines. Notably, a 260M-parameter looped model can surpass a model 6.5x larger across multiple text-to-image benchmarks while requiring 4.9x lower inference compute. Beyond this performance gain, we find that looped computation can offer a more effective form of iterative computation for diffusion models, with increasing loop depth yielding larger gains than adding more denoising steps under a fixed inference budget. Furthermore, deeper loops can progressively correct mistakes made in earlier loops, exhibiting behaviors suggestive of latent reasoning. Together, these results show that looped computation offers a promising way to scale visual generation models.

AI.tldr: 提出Looped-DiT，通过在去噪步骤内循环运行共享Transformer块来扩展计算深度，结合深层监督与自调制注意力，在固定参数下超越更大模型。
AI.motivation: 传统提升文生图模型依赖增大模型规模或去噪步数，本文探索以固定参数量通过循环计算增加深度来扩展计算量的替代路径，但朴素循环无法稳定提升图像质量，原因是中间循环监督不足及注意力无约束更新侵蚀局部信息。
AI.method: Looped-DiT在每个去噪步骤内重复运行共享Transformer块，实现内部表示的迭代精炼而无需显式推理token；引入中间循环的深层监督和自调制注意力以稳定循环特征更新。
AI.result: 在匹配参数与匹配计算设置下持续优于非循环基线；260M循环模型在多个文生图基准上超越6.5倍大的模型，推理计算低4.9倍；固定推理预算下增加循环深度比增加去噪步数收益更大，深层循环可逐步修正早期错误。
AI.conclusion: 循环计算为扩散模型提供了更有效的迭代计算形式，展现出潜在推理行为，是扩展视觉生成模型的有前景方向。

title: MIND: Marginal-Invariant Neural Dependency Diffusion for Mixed-Type Tabular Generation
summary: This paper proposes MIND, a marginal-invariant neural dependency diffusion model for mixed-type tabular data. MIND does not directly learn the joint distribution in the original heterogeneous feature space. Instead, it first maps different variable types into a unified latent dependency space via column-wise marginal transport. A conditional diffusion model then learns cross-column relationships. Copula-tangent denoising separates known marginal components from learnable dependency residuals. Rank projection during the sampling phase further mitigates marginal shift in reverse diffusion. Experiments across nine diverse tabular benchmarks show that MIND consistently improves marginal fidelity and dependency preservation over existing unified approaches. By explicitly isolating marginal modelling from dependency learning, MIND achieves a strong and stable balance among marginal fidelity, joint dependency preservation, and downstream prediction utility. This work supports separating marginal and dependency modelling as a principled and highly effective paradigm for complex mixed-type tabular generation.

AI.tldr: MIND是一种边际不变神经依赖扩散模型，通过将边际建模与依赖学习解耦，在混合类型表格数据生成中同时提升边际保真度与联合依赖保持。
AI.motivation: 原始异构特征空间中混合类型表格数据的联合分布学习困难，边际与依赖耦合导致建模不稳定，现有统一建模方法难以平衡边际保真度与依赖保持。
AI.method: 先通过列向边际传输将不同变量类型映射到统一潜在依赖空间；再用条件扩散模型学习跨列关系；引入copula-tangent去噪分离已知边际成分与可学习依赖残差；采样阶段用秩投影缓解反向扩散中的边际漂移。
AI.result: 在九个多样化表格基准上，MIND相较现有统一方法持续提升边际保真度与依赖保持，并在边际保真度、联合依赖保持和下游预测效用间取得强且稳定的平衡。
AI.conclusion: 将边际建模与依赖学习显式分离，是复杂混合类型表格生成中一种有原则且高效的范式。

title: GLARE: Generating Listening Heads with Appropriate Reactions
comment: Accepted in NeurIPS 2026. Project page: https://github.com/lzk901372/glare
summary: While talking head generation has advanced rapidly, generating natural listener behavior in dyadic conversations, which know when to react, how to react, and with what type of response, remains underexplored. Existing dyadic datasets lack fine-grained listener reaction annotations, and prevailing evaluation metrics inherited from talking-head and video generation measure visual realism rather than whether a listener reacted appropriately. We address these gaps along three aspects. First, we curate a listening-head-specific dataset built from RealTalk and Seamless Interaction, comprising approximately 147 hours of paired speaker-listener videos with 64,557 event-level reaction annotations across six categories: nodding, head shaking, smiling, laughing, frowning, and surprised. Second, we introduce an audio-driven baseline built on a flow-matching transformer, namely GLARE, with prosody conditioning derived from Qwen2-Audio and a temporal reaction loss that explicitly supervises frame-wise reactions. Third, we propose a reaction-oriented evaluation protocol that jointly measures reaction occurrence (R-F1), temporal alignment (R-tIoU), asymmetric temporal deviation (R-ATD), and reaction-region visual quality (R-FID), giving a more behaviorally grounded assessment than visual-quality-only metrics. Experiment results show consistent gains over prior listening-head methods in both visual fidelity and reaction-level metrics, suggesting that reaction-aware data, modeling, and evaluation are critical for natural listening behavior.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对双向对话中听者行为生成研究不足的问题，构建了听者反应数据集、提出音频驱动生成基线GLARE，并设计了面向反应的评估协议，在视觉保真度与反应级指标上均优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有说话头生成进展迅速，但在双向对话中生成自然的听者行为（何时反应、如何反应、以何种反应类型）仍研究不足。现有双向数据集缺乏细粒度的听者反应标注，且沿用自说话头与视频生成的评估指标主要衡量视觉真实感，而非听者反应是否恰当。论文旨在从数据、建模、评估三方面弥补这些空白。
AI.method: 第一，基于RealTalk与Seamless Interaction构建面向听者头的专用数据集，包含约147小时配对说话者-听者视频，以及64,557条事件级反应标注，涵盖点头、摇头、微笑、大笑、皱眉、惊讶六类。第二，提出音频驱动的基线模型GLARE，基于流匹配变换器，采用来自Qwen2-Audio的韵律条件，并引入显式监督逐帧反应的时间反应损失。第三，提出面向反应的评估协议，联合度量反应发生（R-F1）、时间对齐（R-tIoU）、非对称时间偏差（R-ATD）与反应区域视觉质量（R-FID）。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，相比先前的听者头方法，GLARE在视觉保真度和反应级指标上均取得了一致提升，表明反应感知的数据、建模与评估对自然听者行为至关重要。
AI.conclusion: 反应感知的数据、建模与评估三者缺一不可，是生成自然听者行为的关键；本工作为听者头生成提供了数据集、基线模型与更贴近行为本质的评估框架。

title: Certification-Based Differentially Private Learning
summary: Differential privacy (DP) in machine learning is typically achieved by adding noise to model parameters (private learning) or to model outputs (private prediction). Recent work uses formal methods, namely abstract interpretation, to provide tighter privacy guarantees, but only for private prediction in classification settings. In this work, we investigate the use of formal methods as a general tool for tighter privacy analysis. First, we generalize the abstract gradient training (AGT) framework to private prediction in continuous, unbounded regression. Second, by reducing learning in parameterized models to a regression problem over the parameter space, we introduce Abstract Gradient Sampling (AGS), an algorithm that enables reachability-based analysis to provide guarantees for private learning. In both private prediction and private learning, we provide tightened privacy accounting for the AGT framework and a theoretical analysis demonstrating when our smooth sensitivity upper-bounds yield favourable privacy-utility trade-off. In practice, we validate that our regression bounds are tighter than global-sensitivity baselines on regression benchmarks, and, notably, yield the first finite privacy guarantees in settings where global prediction sensitivity is a priori unbounded. We also find that under matched conditions, our private learning algorithm can outperform standard private learners.

AI.tldr: 本文将形式化方法（抽象解释）推广为更紧致的差分隐私分析工具：一方面把抽象梯度训练（AGT）扩展到连续无界回归的私有预测；另一方面通过将参数化模型的学习归约为参数空间上的回归问题，提出抽象梯度采样（AGS），实现基于可达性分析的私有学习保证。
AI.motivation: 现有差分隐私机器学习通常对模型参数（私有学习）或模型输出（私有预测）加噪，且已有的形式化方法（抽象解释）虽能提供更紧致的隐私保证，但仅适用于分类场景下的私有预测。作者希望将形式化方法发展为通用的更紧致隐私分析工具，并覆盖连续无界回归及私有学习场景。
AI.method: 第一，将抽象梯度训练（AGT）框架推广到连续无界的回归私有预测；第二，通过把参数化模型的学习归约为参数空间上的回归问题，提出抽象梯度采样（AGS）算法，使基于可达性的分析能够为私有学习提供保证。同时给出AGT框架更紧致的隐私核算，并进行理论分析以说明平滑敏感度上界在何种条件下带来有利的隐私-效用权衡。
AI.result: 实验验证：在回归基准上，所提回归边界比全局敏感度基线更紧；在全局预测敏感度先验无界的场景下，首次给出有限隐私保证；在相同条件下，私有学习算法可优于标准私有学习器。
AI.conclusion: 形式化方法可作为更通用的工具，为私有预测与私有学习提供更紧致的隐私分析；其在无界回归与敏感度无界等困难场景中具有优势，并可提升隐私-效用权衡表现。

title: Atomizer-IO: Beyond Pixels, Patches and Grids
summary: Most vision architectures assume that observations lie on a regular grid, an effective abstraction for natural images but a restrictive one for sensing data whose channels, temporal sampling, spatial resolution, and geometry can vary. Generic set-based architectures remove the grid, but also remove useful spatial inductive biases. We introduce Atomizer-IO, an architecture that places observations first and derives structure from their physical relationships. Building on top of an atomic representation of the data, each observation is described by its measurement and acquisition metadata, while local cross-attention maps observations to anchor points that can be arbitrarily placed. We evaluate this design by progressively relaxing the grid assumption, from varying input raster configurations and incomplete channel sets to flexible output density and, ultimately, inputs without a raster grid. Atomizer-IO is competitive with flexible EO-specific architectures on most tasks, while offering post-training control over inference cost and competitive compute--performance trade-offs. The same formulation extends without architectural redesign to unordered 3D point clouds, showing that the atomic interface generalizes beyond regular raster inputs. These results suggest that pixels, patches, and grids do not need to define the interface of a sensing architecture.

AI.tldr: 提出Atomizer-IO架构，以观测为第一性、从物理关系中推导结构，摆脱规则网格假设，通过局部交叉注意力将观测映射到任意放置的锚点，在EO任务和3D点云上验证其通用性。
AI.motivation: 多数视觉架构假设观测位于规则网格上，这对自然图像是有效抽象，但对通道、时间采样、空间分辨率和几何均可变化的传感数据则过于受限。集合式架构虽去除了网格，却也丢失了有用的空间归纳偏置。作者希望在保留空间归纳偏置的同时去除网格假设。
AI.method: Atomizer-IO采用"观测优先"的设计：基于数据的原子表示，每个观测由其测量值和采集元数据描述；局部交叉注意力将观测映射到可任意放置的锚点，从而从物理关系中推导结构。评估时逐步放宽网格假设，包括变化的栅格配置、不完整通道集、灵活的输出密度，以及最终无栅格输入。
AI.result: Atomizer-IO在大多数任务上与灵活的地球观测（EO）专用架构具有竞争力，同时提供训练后对推理成本的控制以及有竞争力的计算-性能权衡。同一公式无需架构重新设计即可扩展到无序3D点云，表明原子接口可推广到规则栅格输入之外。
AI.conclusion: 像素、图块和网格不必定义传感架构的接口。以观测为先、从物理关系推导结构的原子接口能够泛化到多种非网格输入模态。

title: PEG-Tab: Sampling-Time Record Repair and Release Control for Tabular Synthesis
summary: Pretrained tabular generators can reproduce training records even when aggregate utility remains high. When retraining is unavailable or too costly, sampling and release are the remaining intervention points. We present PEG-Tab (Post-Training Energy Guidance for Tabular Synthesis), a post-training repair and release-control framework for frozen tabular generators. For each generated row, a generator-native operator creates two alternatives. A shared calibrated score compares the three candidates, favours lower-risk records, and applies a final release check. We instantiate this interface for GReaT, CTGAN, TVAE, and TabDDPM without updating their parameters. Across five datasets and four generator families, PEG-Tab reduces mean Near Copy from $0.078$ to $0.027$ and lowers aggregate Exact Copy to zero. Relative to a $3\times$ post hoc filter, it retains higher utility in 12 of 16 transfer settings and Pareto-dominates the filter in eight. Gains are concentrated in copy and proximity-related risks.

AI.tldr: PEG-Tab 是一种针对冻结表格生成器的后训练修复与发布控制框架，通过在采样与释放阶段介入，降低生成记录的近复制与精确复制风险，同时保持较高的数据效用。
AI.motivation: 预训练表格生成器即使在整体效用较高时，也可能重现训练记录。当重新训练不可行或成本过高时，采样与释放成为仅剩的干预点，因此需要一种无需更新生成器参数的后处理方法。
AI.method: 针对每个生成行，利用生成器原生算子构造两个备选样本；通过共享的校准分数对三个候选进行比较，偏好低风险记录，并进行最终的发布检查。该方法在 GReaT、CTGAN、TVAE 和 TabDDPM 上实例化，且不更新其参数。
AI.result: 在五个数据集和四类生成器家族上，PEG-Tab 将平均近复制率从 0.078 降至 0.027，并将整体精确复制率降至零。相比 3 倍的后处理过滤方法，它在 16 个迁移设置中有 12 个保持更高效用，并在 8 个设置中帕累托支配该过滤器，收益主要集中在复制与邻近相关风险上。
AI.conclusion: PEG-Tab 作为一种后训练修复与发布控制框架，能够在不重新训练和不修改生成器参数的前提下有效降低表格合成中的复制风险，并在效用与风险之间取得优于后处理过滤的权衡。

title: Towards Better Exploration in Sequential Test-Time Scaling
summary: Test-time scaling improves language model reasoning by spending additional compute at inference. However, both classes of existing methods often fail to continue improving over long timescales. Parallel methods repeatedly sample independent answers from the model, scaling poorly on problems the model is unlikely to solve in a single attempt. In contrast, sequential methods build on previous answers to access new ideas, yet so far have not been shown to reach answers beyond those found by parallel scaling. First, we show that sequential scaling often stops improving because it becomes prematurely trapped in an attractor: a set of answers that prevents exploration of different answers once entered. Across 27 combinations of scaling methods, models, and benchmarks, we find that 53.8% of sequential scaling trajectories enter an attractor within four iterations. Second, we show that a simple model-mixing intervention helps escape attractors. This reduces the attractor hit rate by 21.2 percentage points on average, expands solution coverage beyond a compute-matched parallel baseline, and improves accuracy of recursive self-aggregation by at least 2.2 percentage points. Our results motivate refocusing long-horizon test-time scaling from parallel methods to sequential methods that improve previous answers.

AI.tldr: 测试时扩展在长时程下难以持续改进；序列扩展常因过早陷入"吸引子"而停滞，模型混合干预可有效逃离吸引子并提升性能。
AI.motivation: 并行方法在模型单次难以解决的问题上扩展性差，序列方法虽能基于先前答案探索新思路，但此前未能超越并行扩展的效果。论文希望理解序列扩展为何在长时程下停止改进，并找到改进途径。
AI.method: 首先分析序列扩展的停滞机制，提出"吸引子"概念（一旦进入便阻止探索其他答案的答案集合），在27种扩展方法、模型与基准组合中统计轨迹进入吸引子的比例；随后提出一种简单的模型混合干预来帮助逃离吸引子。
AI.result: 53.8%的序列扩展轨迹在四次迭代内进入吸引子；模型混合将吸引子命中率平均降低21.2个百分点，扩展了超越等算力并行基线的解覆盖范围，并使递归自聚合准确率至少提升2.2个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 长时程测试时扩展应重新聚焦于能改进先前答案的序列方法，而非并行方法；模型混合是逃离吸引子的有效手段。

title: I Have a Stream: Making Self-Supervised Learning Work on Continuous Video
summary: Self-supervised learning draws inspiration from infant visual development, yet standard training pipelines bear little resemblance to it: images are independently sampled and globally shuffled across epochs. We study self-supervised learning from continuous video streams, where frames are consumed in temporal order using strict sliding-window batches, without global reshuffling or multi-epoch replay. To this end, we construct WT++, a 95-hour urban walking-tour video dataset for streaming pretraining. Combined with a comprehensive evaluation suite we find that contrastive and distillation-based methods struggle in this setting, while MAE is more robust but still falls short of standard i.i.d. pretraining. We find that high inter-batch similarity, caused by sliding-window consumption across consecutive batches, does not explain this gap. The main challenge is high intra-batch similarity, where frames within each batch are near-duplicates. To mitigate this, we propose StreamMAE, which preserves the core MAE reconstruction objective while adapting the input pipeline with stream-aware regularization and motion-biased crop selection. StreamMAE outperforms streaming baselines, matches i.i.d. MAE trained on the same video data, remains competitive with ImageNet-pretrained MAE, and scales positively as the pretraining stream grows from 12 to 95 hours.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究从连续视频流中进行自监督预训练，构建了95小时城市步行视频数据集WT++，发现逐帧时序消费、严格滑窗批次的设定下，批内高相似度是主要挑战，为此提出StreamMAE，在不改变MAE重建目标的前提下加入流感知正则与运动偏置裁剪，性能可媲美同数据i.i.d. MAE及ImageNet预训练的MAE，并随流时长增加正向扩展。
AI.motivation: 自监督学习虽受婴儿视觉发展启发，但标准训练流程（图像独立采样、跨epoch全局打乱）与之差异很大。作者希望研究更贴近真实连续视觉流的自监督预训练设定，即在时间顺序下以严格滑窗批次消费帧，不做全局重排或多轮重复。
AI.method: 构建WT++数据集（95小时城市步行导览视频）用于流式预训练，并设计评估套件；在此基础上分析对比学习与蒸馏方法的表现，指出批内相似度高为主要困难；提出StreamMAE，保留MAE重建目标，改造输入流程，引入流感知正则化和运动偏置裁剪选择。
AI.result: 对比学习和蒸馏方法在该流式设定下表现不佳；MAE更稳健但仍不及标准i.i.d.预训练；批间相似度高并不能解释差距，主要挑战是批内近似重复导致的高相似度；StreamMAE优于流式基线，匹配同视频数据的i.i.d. MAE，与ImageNet预训练MAE仍有竞争力，并随预训练流从12小时扩展到95小时呈现正向scaling。
AI.conclusion: 连续视频流式自监督预训练是可行且可扩展的，关键障碍在于批内高相似度；通过流感知正则与运动偏置裁剪，StreamMAE在严格时序滑窗设定下缩小了与i.i.d.预训练的差距，并在更长数据流上继续受益。

title: Free Everywhere, Exact on Trees: PPO's Dropped Correction Buys Sample Efficiency Under Aggressive Reuse
summary: Common policy improvement methods, including TRPO, PPO, and GRPO, estimate policy improvement under the behavioral policy's state-visitation distribution rather than the improved policy's own. The substitution makes the objective estimable from the behavioral policy's rollouts but adds a bias growing with policy divergence, hence the trust region or clip, and hence no reuse of a batch far off-policy. We show that under history-injective dynamics, where each state is reached by exactly one history, the dropped state-visitation ratio equals the product of per-step policy ratios along the sampled prefix, on every trajectory and not only in expectation. The ratio is therefore restored exactly, from log-probabilities PPO already computes. Autoregressive generation and canonical-order constructive optimization are both history-injective. The exact correction pays importance-sampling variance that grows with the horizon, so we generalize it to a one-parameter family with PPO ($α{=}0$) and the full correction ($α{=}1$) as endpoints: a single bias--variance knob. A gradient-level analysis of the unclipped surrogate identifies two channels the correction acts through and three conditions under which it carries signal; an enumerable testbed confirms the conditions' predictions. On hard credit-assignment scheduling tasks, a short corrected warmup with aggressive early sample reuse learns faster than PPO and than the same reuse uncorrected; the marginal gain grows with task difficulty ($+0.02$ to $+0.09$ learning-curve AUC), and the early win over PPO tracks the prefix bias that reuse incurs. A correction held throughout, or applied where clipping already contains the reuse bias, is null to harmful.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出TRPO/PPO/GRPO等在行为策略的状态访问分布下估计策略改进会引入偏差，并在history-injective动态下证明了被丢弃的状态访问比率可精确还原为逐步策略比率之积，从而提出一个带单参数α的偏差-方差调节校正族（PPO与完全校正为两端点）。
AI.motivation: 常见策略改进方法（TRPO、PPO、GRPO）在行为策略的状态访问分布下估计目标，虽然可从行为策略的rollout中估计，但会引入随策略发散增长的偏差，因此需要trust region或clip，也导致无法远离on-policy地复用旧batch。作者希望精确恢复被丢弃的状态访问比率以消除该偏差。
AI.method: 作者证明在history-injective动态（每个状态仅由唯一历史到达）下，被丢弃的状态访问比率等于沿采样前缀的逐步策略比率之积，且对每条轨迹精确成立而非仅期望意义；该比率可由PPO已计算的log-probabilities直接恢复（自回归生成与规范序构造性优化均满足history-injective）。由于精确校正会带来随horizon增长的importance-sampling方差，作者将其推广为单参数族：α=0为PPO，α=1为完全校正，作为偏差-方差调节旋钮。并对未clip的surrogate做梯度级分析，识别校正作用的两条通道及三条携带信号的条件，用可枚举testbed验证。
AI.result: 在可枚举testbed上实验证实了条件预测。在困难credit-assignment调度任务上，短时校正warmup配合激进的早期样本复用比PPO学得更快，也比未校正的同种复用更快；边际增益随任务难度增加（学习曲线AUC +0.02至+0.09），且早期对PPO的优势与复用带来的prefix bias相关。而全程施加校正，或在clip已包含复用偏差处施加校正，则效果为零甚至有害。
AI.conclusion: 被丢弃的状态访问比率在history-injective动态下可被精确还原，从而将PPO推广为一个带单参数偏差-方差权衡的校正族。校正应在早期复用阶段以短warmup形式使用才有正收益，全程或冗余施加则无效或有害。

title: Image Classifiers are Efficient Self-Supervised Video Representation Learners
summary: We introduce VideoMSN, a Masked Siamese Network framework for efficient self-supervised spatio-temporal representation learning in videos. Instead of relying on heavy 3D architectures or reconstruction-based autoencoders for learning with unlabeled data, we repurpose standard image Vision Transformers by representing videos as super images which are grids composed of frames sampled from videos. From each super image, we construct two views: one with spatial patch masking and the other with temporal frame masking, ensuring no information leakage across frames. A shared Vision Transformer (ViT) encoder aligns their embeddings using a masked Siamese loss, capturing both motion and appearance cues without reconstruction. Our decoder-free formulation leverages an image foundation model towards efficient video representation learning. Starting from pretrained DINO-v3 and DeiT-v3 image encoders, VideoMSN achieves state-of-the-art performance on Kinetics-400, UCF101, and HMDB51 while requiring up to $32\times$ fewer and $160\times$ fewer video pretraining epochs compared to prior video self-supervised learning methods. Our proposed approach also shows strong performance in low-shot classification, confirming the transferability of the learned representations in a label-scarce scenario. Project Page: https://cvir.github.io/projects/videomsn.

AI.tldr: VideoMSN：用图像ViT与掩码孪生网络高效学习视频时空表示的免解码器自监督框架，在多个基准上达到SOTA且预训练更省。
AI.motivation: 现有视频自监督方法多依赖重的3D架构或基于重建的自动编码器，计算开销大、预训练成本高。作者希望复用标准图像ViT与图像基础模型，实现高效的视频时空表示学习，避免重建与解码器。
AI.method: 将视频表示为“超级图像”（由采样帧组成的网格），并在其上构造两个视图：一个做空间patch掩码，一个做时间帧掩码，且保证帧间无信息泄漏；用共享ViT编码器对两视图嵌入做掩码孪生损失对齐，从而同时捕获运动与外观线索，无需重建和解码器；从预训练的DINO-v3与DeiT-v3图像编码器出发进行训练。
AI.result: 在Kinetcis-400、UCF101、HMDB51上达到SOTA；相比已有视频自监督方法，视频预训练轮数分别最多减少约32倍和160倍；在低样本分类场景下也表现强劲，验证了标签稀缺时的迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: 用图像ViT+掩码孪生网络即可高效进行视频自监督表示学习，免解码器设计兼顾性能与训练效率，并具备良好的低样本迁移性，为复用图像基础模型做视频理解提供了有效路径。

title: RiboUnmix: Learning Shared Translational Dynamics from Biased and Noisy Ribo-seq Measurements
summary: Ribosome profiling (Ribo-seq) measures ribosome distributions along mRNAs, but observed occupancy profiles also contain experiment-specific distortions and stochastic variability. Consequently, models that accurately predict measured profiles may reproduce technical effects rather than recover the underlying biology. We ask whether jointly modeling datasets collected under different experimental conditions can reveal shared, sequence-dependent patterns of ribosome occupancy. We introduce RiboUnmix, a probabilistic multi-dataset framework in which each expected measured profile is represented as a shared sequence-dependent signal modulated by a dataset-specific multiplicative factor. A negative-binomial observation model captures variability across replicates. We evaluate RiboUnmix on a controlled synthetic benchmark combining programmed translation kinetics, ribosome traffic, stochastic count sampling, and sequence-dependent experimental distortions. Because the underlying kinetics and distortions are known, recovery of the shared profile and dataset-specific effects can be assessed separately. Both inferred components correlate strongly with their targets, demonstrating that RiboUnmix can disentangle shared kinetic patterns from experimental effects. Across four organism-specific real-data benchmarks, RiboUnmix outperforms sequence-to-profile baselines in predicting measured profiles. Models trained independently on subsets of 114 HEK-derived datasets recover concordant shared profiles for held-out transcripts, and experiments varying the number and composition of training datasets show that the learned representation remains stable. RiboUnmix thus converts variation across experiments into evidence for reproducible sequence-dependent patterns of ribosome occupancy, supporting biological hypothesis generation from diverse Ribo-seq datasets.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出RiboUnmix，一个概率多数据集框架，通过将每个实验的测量核糖体占据谱建模为共享的序列依赖信号乘以数据集特异性因子，并采用负二项观测模型，从而从多样Ribo-seq实验中分离出可重复的序列依赖模式。
AI.motivation: Ribo-seq测量的核糖体占据谱中包含实验特异性失真和随机变异性，因此仅预测测量谱的模型可能复现的是技术效应而非真实生物学信号。作者希望探究：联合建模不同实验条件下的数据集，能否揭示共享的、序列依赖的核糖体占据模式。
AI.method: 提出RiboUnmix，一个概率多数据集框架。每个期望测量谱表示为共享的序列依赖信号，受数据集特异性乘性因子调制；使用负二项观测模型捕获重复样本间的变异性。采用包含程序化翻译动力学、核糖体交通、随机计数采样和序列依赖实验失真的合成基准进行评估，由于底层动力学与失真是已知的，可分别评估共享谱与数据集特异性效应的恢复情况。
AI.result: 在合成基准上，推断出的两个组分均与目标强相关，证明RiboUnmix能够分离共享动力学模式与实验效应。在四个生物体特异的真实数据基准上，RiboUnmix在预测测量谱方面优于序列到谱的基线方法。独立训练于114个HEK数据集子集的模型对留出转录本恢复出高度一致的共享谱；改变训练数据集数量和组成的实验表明所学表示保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: RiboUnmix将实验间的变异转化为可重复序列依赖核糖体占据模式的证据，支持从多样化Ribo-seq数据集进行生物学假设生成。

title: AssemblyWorld: Rethinking 3D Assembly with General-Purpose Agents
summary: The task of 3D assembly requires translating an understanding of parts and their relationships into precise spatial arrangements. Can pretrained general-purpose agents assemble objects through visual interaction without additional assembly-specific fine-tuning? To investigate this question, we introduce AssemblyWorld, an interactive 3D environment in which agents inspect rendered views and manipulate supplied rigid parts, guided by images or assembly manuals when available. Agents perceive part geometry through 2D views rather than direct access to mesh vertices or faces, while their resulting assemblies are evaluated geometrically. Building on this environment, we construct AssemblyWorldBench, comprising 100 assembly tasks across 80 objects spanning furniture, industrial assembly, and fracture reassembly. Evaluating eight agent systems reveals substantial differences in their capabilities. The strongest system achieves 80.9% part accuracy but 59.4% complete-assembly success. The evaluated open-source systems lag substantially behind their stronger closed-source peers in both execution reliability and assembly accuracy. Analyses of visual references, interaction trajectories, and failures show how agents revise assemblies while leaving residual positioning errors. AssemblyWorld provides a common setting for both assessing the capabilities of interactive assembly agents and characterizing the gap between approximate structure recovery and precise reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 论文提出交互式3D装配环境 AssemblyWorld 及基准 AssemblyWorldBench，评估通用预训练智能体能否仅凭视觉交互完成物体装配，发现其可恢复大致结构但难以实现精确重建。
AI.motivation: 探究预训练通用智能体是否能在不进行装配专项微调的情况下，通过视觉交互完成3D装配任务，并系统刻画其能力边界与不足。
AI.method: 构建 AssemblyWorld 交互式3D环境：智能体仅通过2D渲染视图感知部件几何（不直接访问网格顶点/面），在图像或装配手册引导下操作刚性部件，并对装配结果进行几何评估；基于此构建 AssemblyWorldBench，包含80个物体、100个装配任务，覆盖家具、工业装配与断裂重装三类场景，评测8个智能体系统。
AI.result: 最强系统部件准确率达80.9%，但完整装配成功率仅59.4%；开源系统在执行可靠性与装配精度上均明显落后于较强的闭源系统；通过视觉参考、交互轨迹与失败案例分析，发现智能体会迭代修正装配，但仍残留定位误差。
AI.conclusion: AssemblyWorld 为评估交互式装配智能体提供了统一平台，并揭示了"近似结构恢复"与"精确重建"之间的能力差距。

title: Beyond Uniform Compression: Budgeted Transmission Allocation for Extreme Federated Learning
summary: Federated learning faces severe communication bottlenecks when clients upload high-dimensional model updates. Existing methods often compress these updates uniformly across all layers. This uniform approach ignores the heterogeneous value of different parameter blocks and wastes limited bandwidth on insensitive layers. To address this issue, we propose Layer-wise Budgeted Adaptive Transmission (LBAT). LBAT reframes federated communication under extreme uplink budgets as a resource allocation problem. Our framework dynamically estimates the transmission value of different layers utilising local training signals. It then employs an exact byte dynamic programming allocator to determine optimal rank and bit configurations under strict budgets. We validate LBAT on highly heterogeneous federated tabular prediction and data generation tasks. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LBAT consistently outperforms uniform rank, uniform quantisation, and fixed compression baselines across various extreme budget regimes. Furthermore, it achieves significantly better communication and utility tradeoffs while preserving essential distributional fidelity.

AI.tldr: 提出层级别预算自适应传输方法LBAT，通过动态评估各层传输价值并结合字节级动态规划分配器优化秩与比特配置，在极端上行带宽下显著提升联邦学习的通信与效用权衡。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习中客户端上传高维模型更新面临严重通信瓶颈。现有方法对所有层进行统一压缩，忽略了不同参数块的异质价值，将有限带宽浪费在不敏感的层上，因此需要一种能够区分各层重要性的自适应传输方案。
AI.method: LBAT将极端上行预算下的联邦通信问题重构为资源分配问题。框架利用本地训练信号动态估计不同层的传输价值，并采用精确的字节动态规划分配器，在严格预算约束下确定最优的秩与比特配置。
AI.result: 在高度异质的联邦表格预测与数据生成任务上进行验证。实验表明，LBAT在多种极端预算场景下持续优于统一秩、统一量化及固定压缩基线，并实现了显著更优的通信与效用权衡，同时保持关键的分布保真度。
AI.conclusion: LBAT通过层级别自适应资源分配有效缓解了联邦学习的通信瓶颈，在极端带宽条件下兼顾通信效率与模型效用，是一种优于统一压缩策略的传输方案。

title: ViTeX-Bench: Benchmarking High-Fidelity Video Scene Text Editing
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 (Evaluations and Datasets Track). 27 pages (10-page main text), 5 figures, 12 tables. Project page: https://vitex-bench.github.io/
summary: Recent video generation is increasingly realistic and controllable, yet video editing remains less developed, particularly for precise local edits that must preserve the original scene dynamics. Video scene text editing replaces text on scene surfaces, such as storefront signs, whiteboards, and product labels, while preserving the surrounding content, motion, and camera dynamics. Although scene text editing is well studied for images, video scene text editing that achieves high visual quality, temporal consistency, and edit locality remains underexplored. Existing resources offer limited paired real-video data, and general video-editing metrics do not directly measure whether the requested text remains correct over time. We introduce ViTeX-Bench, a benchmark suite comprising ViTeX-Dataset and a three-axis evaluation protocol. The dataset contains 387 real-world 720p videos with text-region masks and editing instructions: 230 provide reviewed, pipeline-generated paired edits for training, and 157 form a frozen evaluation split. The protocol evaluates text correctness, visual and temporal quality, and edit locality through 13 metrics, with one primary metric per axis and a Pareto comparison of their trade-offs. OCR calibration, human evaluation, and annotation-sensitivity analyses support the interpretation of these scores. Across eight baselines from four editing families, accurate text, temporal stability, and scene preservation remain difficult to achieve together. We also release ViTeX-Edit-14B, an open-source reference editor fine-tuned on the paired training split with motion-aligned glyph-video conditioning. It achieves CharAcc 0.688, the highest mean among the evaluated video-native editors, and the lowest comparable text-crop Warp among raw editor outputs. ViTeX-Bench provides a reproducible foundation for studying these trade-offs in video scene text editing.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 ViTeX-Bench，一个面向视频场景文本编辑的基准套件，包含数据集与三轴评估协议，并发布开源参考编辑器 ViTeX-Edit-14B。
AI.motivation: 视频生成日益成熟，但视频编辑（尤其是需保持原场景动态的精确局部编辑）仍不发达。视频场景文本编辑需替换店面招牌、白板、产品标签等表面文字，同时保留周边内容、运动与相机动态，但该任务研究不足：现有资源缺乏配对的真实视频数据，通用视频编辑指标也无法直接衡量所请求文本在时间上是否保持正确。
AI.method: 构建 ViTeX-Bench，含 ViTeX-Dataset 与三轴评估协议。数据集包含 387 个真实 720p 视频，附文本区域掩码与编辑指令：230 个为经审核、流水线生成的配对编辑用于训练，157 个构成冻结评估集。协议通过 13 项指标评估文本正确性、视觉与时间质量、编辑局部性，每轴一个主指标并进行权衡的 Pareto 比较；另辅以 OCR 校准、人工评估与标注敏感性分析。同时发布 ViTeX-Edit-14B，基于配对训练集微调，采用运动对齐的字形—视频条件。
AI.result: 在四类编辑家族的八个基线中，同时实现准确文本、时间稳定与场景保仍很困难。ViTeX-Edit-14B 在参评的视频原生编辑器中取得最高平均 CharAcc 0.688，并在原始编辑器输出中取得最低的可比文本裁剪 Warp。
AI.conclusion: ViTeX-Bench 为研究视频场景文本编辑中的上述权衡提供了可复现的基础。

title: From Modes to Memories: Characterizing the Scale-Space Dynamics of Diffusion Models
summary: Diffusion models are typically viewed as stochastic processes that transform noise into data. We take a complementary perspective: a diffusion model defines a family of deterministic dynamical systems indexed by noise scale. At each fixed scale $σ$, we treat the denoiser as a self-map and study its dynamics. For an exact denoiser, fixed points correspond to critical points of the smoothed data density, while attractors correspond to its modes; as $σ$ increases, sample-level modes merge into progressively coarser ones. This suggests a geometric view of memorization: examples that receive excess probability mass due to duplication or overfitting, as well as outliers, should remain distinguishable under stronger smoothing than ordinary examples. We quantify this persistence by the critical scale $σ_c$, the largest noise scale at which an example is retained by the fixed-scale dynamics. In conditional models, the same construction extends naturally to image--caption pairs. Experiments in controlled settings and on large-scale models show that $σ_c$ tracks memorization arising from duplication, overfitting, and outliers, and identifies both memorized and partially memorized examples in Stable Diffusion. Moreover, $σ_c$ yields interpretable measures of the image spatial distribution and caption dependence of memorization.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出将扩散模型视为按噪声尺度σ索引的确定性动力系统族，用去噪器作为自映射研究其动力学，并提出"临界尺度σ_c"这一指标来量化和识别记忆化样本。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型通常被视为将噪声变换为数据的随机过程。作者希望从互补的确定性动力学视角理解扩散模型，特别是解释和量化模型中的记忆化现象（由重复、过拟合和离群样本引起），并提供一个几何化的记忆化解释框架。
AI.method: 对每个固定噪声尺度σ，将去噪器视为自映射并研究其动力学，此时不动点对应平滑后数据密度的临界点，吸引子对应其众数。随σ增大，样本级众数逐渐合并为更粗粒度的模式。据此定义临界尺度σ_c，即样本被固定尺度动力学保留的最大噪声尺度，用以衡量其"持续性"。在条件模型中，该构造自然扩展到图文对。
AI.result: 在受控实验和大规模模型上，σ_c能追踪由重复、过拟合和离群样本引起的记忆化，并能识别Stable Diffusion中完全记忆和部分记忆的样本。此外，σ_c提供了对图像空间分布和标题依赖性的可解释度量。
AI.conclusion: 通过确定性动力学视角，扩散模型可被理解为按噪声尺度索引的动力系统族，临界尺度σ_c为记忆化现象提供了统一、可量化的几何刻画，兼具理论意义和实际识别能力。

title: Physis-Lang: Self-Evolving Language as a Physical Representation for Video World Model
summary: Video world models are expected to predict how the physical world evolves, yet they often produce visually plausible videos that violate basic physical principles. Existing approaches commonly assume that natural language is insufficient to represent the physical knowledge required for reliable generation, and therefore introduce additional visual, latent, numerical, or planning-based signals. We revisit this assumption and introduce Physis-Lang, a self-evolving framework that treats physical language as a shared and optimizable representation across data curation, model training, and video generation. Physis-Lang represents physical processes through language that describes their relevant entities, causes, interactions, governing principles, temporal evolution, and effects. To improve this representation, we construct PhysCapBench, which decomposes physical processes into atomic assertions and evaluates captions using recall and precision. An agentic loop iteratively analyzes assertion-level errors and refines the instruction used to produce physical captions. Physis-Lang further converts model deficiencies into textual descriptions and uses language-guided retrieval to identify visually diverse videos that cover missing physical processes. Experiments on four widely used physical video benchmarks with Wan and Cosmos backbones demonstrate consistent improvements in physical plausibility. Notably, starting from open-source Cosmos3-Nano backbones, our Physis-Lang-enhanced models surpass the leading proprietary Veo 3.1 model.

AI.tldr: 提出Physis-Lang，一个将"物理语言"作为数据整理、模型训练与视频生成共享可优化表示的自演化框架，无需额外视觉/数值/规划信号即可提升视频世界模型的物理合理性。
AI.motivation: 视频世界模型常生成视觉上逼真但违背基本物理原理的视频。现有方法普遍认为自然语言不足以表达可靠生成所需的物理知识，因而引入额外的视觉、潜变量、数值或规划信号。本文重新审视这一假设。
AI.method: Physis-Lang用语言描述物理过程的实体、成因、交互、支配原理、时间演化与效果；构建PhysCapBench，将物理过程分解为原子断言，用召回率与精确率评估字幕；通过智能体循环迭代分析断言级错误并优化生成物理字幕的指令；将模型缺陷转化为文本描述，并用语言引导检索找到覆盖缺失物理过程的多样化视频。
AI.result: 在四个广泛使用的物理视频基准上，基于Wan和Cosmos骨干网络均取得一致的物理合理性提升；从开源Cosmos3-Nano骨干出发，Physis-Lang增强的模型超越了领先的专有模型Veo 3.1。
AI.conclusion: 自然语言足以作为表示可靠物理生成所需知识的共享可优化表示，物理语言驱动的自演化框架能有效提升视频世界模型的物理合理性。

title: Graph Residual Conjugate Diffusion: SNR-Equalized Heat Flow for Graph Signals
summary: Diffusion models generate data by reversing a forward corruption process that typically approaches a simple Gaussian prior. Recent work has extended this framework to signals supported on fixed graphs, e.g., road-network traffic and sensor-network measurements. Many graph signals have nonuniform spectral energy, whereas isotropic corruption adds the same conditional noise variance to every graph-frequency mode. Driving all modes to near-zero terminal signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) requires strong corruption, which increases the noise range that must be covered under a fixed sampling budget. We introduce Graph Residual Conjugate Diffusion (GRCD), which replaces the shared clock of graph heat diffusion with a mode-dependent clock that gives every graph-Fourier mode the same conditional SNR. GRCD fits a zero-mean graph-spectral Gaussian reference on the training split and stops at a finite terminal SNR at which the propagated reference still carries the fitted spectral variances. The Gaussian component has an exact modewise propagator in the probability-flow ODE, so sampling advances it analytically and integrates only the learned residual score numerically. We evaluate GRCD on five settings (METR-LA traffic, Molene weather, and three stochastic block models) against seven comparators under a matched protocol: Graph-Aware Diffusion (GAD), EDM (graph backbone), two adaptations of Whitened Score Diffusion (WSD), and three preconditioning controls. At four function evaluations (NFEs), GRCD lowers averaged maximum mean discrepancy (aMMD) by 22 to 36 times over the best comparator on all five settings, reaching 0.054 on METR-LA, where it clears an aMMD 0.1 target with 87% less sampling wall-clock time than the cheapest comparator that reaches it. Fitting the terminal reference reduces aMMD by 2.7 to 7.3 times at finite terminal SNR, while the factors shrink to 1.00 to 1.01 near zero.

AI.tldr: 提出图残差共轭扩散（GRCD），用模式依赖时钟使各图傅里叶模式条件SNR一致，并仅在有限终端SNR处拟合零均值图谱高斯参考，高斯分量在概率流ODE中解析推进、只对学习残差分数数值积分，在五个图信号数据集上以极少NFE大幅超越七个对比方法。
AI.motivation: 图信号（如路网流量、传感器网络测量）的谱能量非均匀，而各向同性加噪对所有图频模式添加相同条件噪声方差，迫使所有模式降到近零终端SNR需要强扰动，从而在固定采样预算下扩大了所需覆盖的噪声范围，造成采样效率低下。
AI.method: GRCD将图热扩散的共享时钟替换为模式依赖时钟，使每个图傅里叶模式具有相同的条件SNR；在训练集上拟合零均值图谱高斯参考，并在有限终端SNR处停止，此时传播的参考仍携带拟合的谱方差；高斯分量在概率流ODE中有精确的逐模式传播子，因此采样时解析推进高斯部分，仅对学习到的残差分数做数值积分。
AI.result: 在METR-LA交通、Molene天气及三个随机块模型共五个设置上，与七个对比方法（GAD、EDM图骨干、WSD两种改型及三个预处理控制）在匹配协议下比较：4次函数评估时，GRCD在所有设置上将平均最大均值差异（aMMD）较最佳对比降低22至36倍，METR-LA上达0.054，并以比达到0.1目标的最廉价对比少87%的采样墙钟时间达标。拟合终端参考在有限终端SNR下将aMMD降低2.7至7.3倍，而在近零SNR时该倍数收缩至1.00至1.01。
AI.conclusion: 模式依赖时钟与有限终端SNR下的图谱高斯参考拟合能显著提升图扩散模型的采样效率与生成质量，尤其在极少函数评估次数下优势明显；其收益主要来源于在有限终端SNR处拟合参考，且在终端SNR趋近零时收益消失。

title: Multimodal Flow: Unified Flow Modeling of Language and Vision in Embedding Spaces
comment: 18 pages, 5 figures, 10 tables. Code and model: https://github.com/hustvl/Multimodal-Flow
summary: We present Multimodal Flow, a fully continuous generative model of language and vision. Most unified multimodal models either model both language and quantized images as discrete tokens or combine discrete language prediction with continuous image generation. The former introduces a visual quantization bottleneck. The latter requires modality-dependent objectives and sampling procedures. Fully continuous modeling avoids these trade-offs and enables a shared generative process, but remains underexplored for multimodal pretraining. Multimodal Flow introduces a unified continuous architecture that integrates multimodal continuous representations with a shared chunk-causal flow backbone. It organizes text blocks and images as ordered continuous hyperchunks, preserving textual token order and visual spatial structure. The backbone learns a single vector field over these hyperchunks through Flow Matching. Joint attention enables cross-modal interaction, while modality-specific feed-forward networks process each modality. The model predicts multiple target chunks in parallel during training and generates hyperchunks sequentially at inference. We instantiate MF-1 and pretrain it on multimodal data. Across 0.6B, 1.2B, and 1.6B scales, continued pretraining consistently improves multimodal modeling. With only 150B pretraining tokens, MF-1 achieves an average score of 82.8 across GenEval and DPG-Bench and 75.3 across VQAv2, MMBench, and POPE, remaining competitive with unified models trained on substantially more data. Under matched data, optimization, and parameter budgets, Multimodal Flow further outperforms representative hybrid and discrete models. These results establish continuous chunk-based embedding flow modeling as a new fully continuous paradigm for unified multimodal modeling. The related code and model are publicly released at https://github.com/hustvl/Multimodal-Flow.

AI.tldr: 提出Multimodal Flow（MF-1），一种完全连续的语言-视觉统一生成模型，将文本块与图像组织为连续的"hyperchunks"，通过共享的chunk-causal Flow Matching骨干学习统一向量场，避免视觉量化瓶颈与模态依赖目标，仅用150B token即在生成与理解任务上取得竞争力表现。
AI.motivation: 现有统一多模态模型存在两类局限：一是将语言与量化图像都建模为离散token，引入视觉量化瓶颈；二是用离散语言预测搭配连续图像生成，需要模态依赖的目标函数与采样流程。完全连续建模可避免上述权衡并共享生成过程，但在多模态预训练中仍缺乏探索。
AI.method: 构建统一连续架构，将多模态连续表示与共享的chunk-causal flow骨干结合；把文本块和图像组织为有序的连续hyperchunk，保留文本token顺序与视觉空间结构；骨干通过Flow Matching在这些hyperchunk上学习单一向量场；采用联合注意力实现跨模态交互，并用模态专属前馈网络处理各模态；训练时并行预测多个目标chunk，推理时顺序生成hyperchunk。实例化为MF-1并在多模态数据上预训练。
AI.result: 在0.6B、1.2B、1.6B三种规模上，持续预训练均稳定提升多模态建模能力。仅用150B预训练token，MF-1在GenEval与DPG-Bench上平均得分82.8，在VQAv2、MMBench与POPE上平均75.3，与使用远多数据的统一模型相比仍具竞争力。在数据、优化与参数预算匹配条件下，Multimodal Flow优于代表性的混合模型与离散模型。
AI.conclusion: 连续chunk-based嵌入流建模可作为一种新的完全连续范式用于统一多模态建模，兼具生成与理解能力且数据效率高。相关代码与模型已开源。

title: NodeGround: A Node Classification Benchmark in the Graph Foundation Model Era
summary: Can a pretrained graph model replace training and tuning a separate predictor for each dataset? Answering this requires evaluating prediction quality alongside computational cost. We present NodeGround, a node classification benchmark that puts graph foundation models (GFMs) and dataset-specific supervised learning under a common evaluation framework. The benchmark spans 51 datasets and evaluates six GFMs alongside 15 supervised methods under two label-availability regimes. Shared data partitions, validation-only model selection, controlled hyperparameter searches, and multiple predictive metrics make comparisons systematic, while workflow measurements account for adaptation, training, tuning, and inference. The results favor carefully tuned graph neural networks overall. GraphPFN reaches third place by Elo when more labels are available, yet its relative strengths vary substantially with dataset properties. Efficiency comparisons further qualify the benefits of pretrained reuse: GVT and GraphPFN appear on the Pareto frontiers when supervised methods are represented by their default and fully tuned configurations. Adding intermediate tuning budgets removes this advantage for GVT and leaves GraphPFN extending the estimated frontier in the label-rich setting alone. Thus, reusing pretrained parameters does not yet provide a broadly reliable route to either stronger predictions or cheaper workflows. We release the evaluation pipeline, run-level records, and an open leaderboard at https://github.com/nums-ai/nodeground.

AI.tldr: NodeGround基准（51数据集，6个GFM vs 15个监督方法）表明：图基础模型尚未能普遍替代逐数据集的训练与调参。
AI.motivation: 检验预训练图模型能否取代针对每个数据集单独训练与调参的预测器，需同时评估预测质量与计算成本。
AI.method: 提出NodeGround节点分类基准，统一评测框架，覆盖51个数据集、6个图基础模型与15个监督方法、两种标签可用性设定；共享数据划分、仅用验证集做模型选择、受控超参搜索、多预测指标，并测量自适应、训练、调参与推理的工作流开销。
AI.result: 整体上精心调参的GNN更优；标签较多时GraphPFN按Elo排名第三，其相对优势随数据集属性变化明显。效率上，当监督方法取默认与完全调参配置时，GVT与GraphPFN位于Pareto前沿；加入中等调参预算后GVT优势消失，GraphPFN仅在标签丰富设定下延伸前沿。
AI.conclusion: 复用预训练参数目前尚不能可靠地带来更强预测或更低成本的工作流；已开源评测流程、运行级记录与排行榜。

title: Beyond Missing Rates: Rethinking Incomplete Multi-View Clustering with Protocol Divergence
comment: Accepted by NeurIPS 2026 as a poster paper
summary: Incomplete multi-view clustering (IMVC) is typically evaluated by retraining separate models under different missing-view configurations. Evaluations indexed only by nominal missing rate can overlook differences in observation structure across missing-view protocols. We show that missing-data protocols with identical nominal missing rates can induce substantially different learning regimes, differing by approximately 50-fold in the proportion of fully observed samples. We formalize this phenomenon as protocol divergence, which quantifies structural disparities among missing-view protocols beyond marginal missing rates. Furthermore, we analyze support-gated reconstruction mechanisms and show that their optimization contribution is inherently limited by the frequency of eligible observations under explicit normalization and optimization conditions. Based on these observations, we propose CRAFT (Co-occurrence-free Robust Attention-masked Fusion Transformer), a train-once framework that combines representation learning with an architecture designed to process missing-view inputs. CRAFT combines (i) per-sample forward computation using each sample's observed views and shared parameters, and (ii) mask-aware fusion over nonempty observed-view subsets. The deployment evaluation starts from training data with all views available and reuses one final checkpoint per dataset and seed across missing-view protocols without retraining. Experiments on CUB and MultiFashion show that CRAFT achieves the strongest performance in 12 out of 13 information-matched settings. Additional deployment experiments across seven benchmarks and sixteen missing configurations demonstrate substantial computational savings through checkpoint reuse while maintaining competitive clustering performance. Code and evaluation tools: https://github.com/dk23lhl/CRAFT and https://github.com/dk23lhl/imvc-audit.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"协议分歧"(protocol divergence)概念，揭示相同名义缺失率下不同缺失视图协议会导致截然不同的学习状态；并据此提出免共现、可一次训练多协议复用的CRAFT框架。
AI.motivation: 现有不完全多视图聚类(IMVC)评估通常针对每种缺失视图配置重新训练独立模型，且仅以名义缺失率作为指标，忽略了不同缺失协议在观测结构上的差异。作者发现名义缺失率相同、但完全观测样本比例可相差约50倍的协议会造成显著不同的学习状态，因此需要新的度量方式和更鲁棒、可复用的建模框架。
AI.method: 1) 形式化"协议分歧"，量化超越边际缺失率的缺失视图协议间结构性差异；2) 分析支持门控重建机制，证明在显式归一化与优化条件下其优化贡献受有效观测频率的限制；3) 提出CRAFT(免共现鲁棒注意力掩码融合Transformer)——一次性训练框架：对每个样本仅使用其观测视图与共享参数做前向计算，并在非空的观测视图子集上进行掩码感知融合。
AI.result: 在CUB和MultiFashion上，CRAFT在13个信息匹配设置中的12个取得最佳性能；在7个基准、16种缺失配置的部署实验中，通过检查点复用大幅节省计算量，同时保持有竞争力的聚类性能。
AI.conclusion: 名义缺失率不足以刻画缺失视图协议的本质差异；CRAFT通过样本级前向计算与掩码感知融合，实现一次训练、跨协议复用检查点，在不重新训练的前提下兼顾性能与计算效率，并提供开源代码与评估工具。

title: GFD-OPD: Guidance-Folded On-Policy Distillation of Diffusion Models Across Scales
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) has demonstrated two important capabilities in language models: compressing large teachers into smaller students and merging expert models into a single model. Existing diffusion OPD, however, mostly focus on the latter, with teachers and students sharing the same backbone and scale. We investigate large-to-small diffusion opd from large teachers to a small student and find that the standard recipe fails. To find the underlying cause, we propose Fixed-State KL, an effective and fair way to measure the distribution gap between student and teacher during OPD training for diffusion models. We are the first to clarify why large-to-small OPD is challenging for diffusion models: a smaller student struggles to perfectly match the distribution of a larger teacher, while classifier-free guidance can accumulate and amplify the distributional discrepancies between the student's conditional and unconditional branches and those of the teacher. To solve this problem, we propose GFD-OPD, a simple yet effective method that reduces the student-teacher gap while avoiding the error amplification of the CFG composition. Across numerous experiments, GFD outperforms previous baselines in both training efficiency and final performance, achieving state-of-the-art results on all benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文研究扩散模型的大教师到小学生在线策略蒸馏（OPD），发现标准方法失效，提出Fixed-State KL度量分布差距，并指出问题根源在于学生难以匹配大教师分布且CFG会放大差距，进而提出GFD-OPD方法，取得最优效果。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散模型OPD多聚焦于教师与学生骨干和规模相同的专家合并，而大教师到小学生的扩散OPD研究不足，且标准蒸馏配方在此场景下失效，需探究原因并解决。
AI.method: 提出Fixed-State KL，用于公平有效地度量扩散模型OPD训练中学生与教师的分布差距；据此分析大教师到小学生OPD困难的根源；并基于此提出GFD-OPD方法，减小师生差距同时避免CFG组合带来的误差放大。
AI.result: 在大量实验中，GFD在训练效率和最终性能上均优于已有基线，并在所有基准上达到state-of-the-art。
AI.conclusion: 大教师到小学生的扩散OPD之所以困难，源于学生无法完美匹配大教师分布以及CFG放大分布差异；GFD-OPD通过缩小差距并抑制CFG误差放大有效解决该问题，实现最优性能。

title: A library for differentiable signal processing and machine learning on the sphere
summary: The two-dimensional sphere embedded in three-dimensional Euclidean space S2, plays a central role in a variety of scientific and engineering domains, including geophysics, planetary science, geodesy, atmospheric physics, quantum chemistry, cosmology, and virtual reality, among many others. As machine learning increasingly permeates these fields, the demand grows for robust tools that process and model functions on the sphere, while respecting the inherent topological and symmetry properties of the domain. We present torch-harmonics, a comprehensive library that offers efficient, differentiable implementations of advanced signal processing and machine learning (ML) methods for spherical data. These include the spherical harmonic transform (SHT), the spherical analogue of the Fourier transform, vector spherical harmonics, discrete-continuous and spectral convolutions, as well as both global and neighborhood spherical attention mechanisms. Beyond traditional representations, torch-harmonics provides the building blocks for state-of-the-art spherical ML architectures such as spherical transformers in order to enable scalable, rotationally-aware learning and inference in modern scientific and engineering applications.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了 torch-harmonics，一个面向球面数据的高效、可微分信号处理与机器学习库。
AI.motivation: 球面 S2 在地球物理、行星科学、大气物理、量子化学、宇宙学、虚拟现实等领域具有核心地位。随着机器学习渗透这些领域，亟需能够处理球面函数并尊重其拓扑与对称性的工具。
AI.method: torch-harmonics 提供先进的球面信号处理与机器学习方法的可微分实现，包括球谐变换（SHT，傅里叶变换在球面上的对应）、向量球谐、离散-连续与谱卷积，以及全局和邻域球面注意力机制。
AI.result: 该库为球面 Transformer 等最先进球面机器学习架构提供了构建模块，从而支持可扩展、旋转感知的学习与推理。
AI.conclusion: torch-harmonics 面向现代科学与工程应用，为其提供可扩展、旋转感知的球面机器学习学习与推理能力。

title: CNCGEN: A Dataset and Framework for Machining Process Planning and Toolpath Generation from B-rep Models
summary: Learning to generate machining process plans and toolpaths from B-rep CAD requires coupling discrete operation decisions with continuous tool motion as the workpiece evolves. Correctly predicting an operation sequence does not by itself ensure correct material removal, because each toolpath acts on the stock left by preceding cuts. We formulate this problem around persistent manufacturing objects: object identity determines the target of an operation, while the evolving stock state conditions the generation of its toolpath. Based on this formulation, we propose CNCGEN, a dataset and learning framework for three-axis machining. CNCGEN-Dataset contains approximately 50k geometrically verified synthetic machining flows and 800 held-out real CNC records. Each flow aligns B-rep geometry with object-referenced operations, parameterized toolpaths, intermediate stock states, and verification outcomes, enabling supervision of the correspondence between planning decisions and their geometric effects. CNCGEN generates operations and toolpaths for selected objects step by step, updating a compact machining state to guide subsequent predictions. During training, a learned surrogate verifier provides material-removal feedback that links local predictions to their geometric consequences. Experiments on synthetic and held-out real CNC records show that CNCGEN improves the resulting workpiece geometry and reduces residual material and overcut compared with adapted CNC generation baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CNCGEN，一个面向三轴加工的数据集与学习框架，围绕"持久制造对象"将离散工序决策与连续刀具运动耦合建模，通过逐步生成工序与刀具轨迹并更新加工状态，提升工件几何质量。
AI.motivation: 从 B-rep CAD 直接生成加工工艺计划与刀具路径，需要把离散的工序决策与连续的刀具运动耦合起来，因为工件在加工中不断演变。仅预测正确的工序顺序并不保证材料去除正确，每条刀具路径都作用在前序切削后留下的毛坯上。因此需要一种能同时考虑对象身份、目标以及演变毛坯状态的建模方式。
AI.method: 作者围绕"持久制造对象"进行问题建模：对象身份决定工序目标，演变的毛坯状态约束刀具路径生成。在此基础上提出 CNCGEN 数据集与学习框架。CNCGEN-Dataset 包含约 5 万条经几何验证的合成加工流程及 800 条留出的真实 CNC 记录，每条流程对齐 B-rep 几何、以对象为参照的工序、参数化刀具路径、中间毛坯状态与验证结果。方法逐步为选定对象生成工序与刀具路径，并更新紧凑的加工状态以引导后续预测；训练时使用学习到的代理验证器提供材料去除反馈，将局部预测与其几何后果关联。
AI.result: 在合成数据与留出的真实 CNC 记录上，相比适配的 CNC 生成基线，CNCGEN 改善了生成工件的几何质量，并降低了残余材料与过切。
AI.conclusion: CNCGEN 通过持久制造对象与耦合工序—刀具路径的逐步生成范式，结合代理验证器的材料去除反馈，有效提升了加工流程生成中的几何正确性，为从 CAD 生成加工计划提供了数据集与框架支持。

title: Stable Transformers for Graph Generation
summary: Graph generative models increasingly rely on Graph Transformers (GT) to capture complex dependencies among nodes and edges. While deeper architectures should provide greater expressive capacity and a broader receptive field, their effectiveness can decline with depth: repeated self-attention progressively contracts node representations, impeding information flow and gradient propagation. We analyse this phenomenon from a dynamical systems perspective, focusing on how the denoiser's spectral dynamics affect graph generation. We show that standard GT denoisers become increasingly dissipative as depth grows, leading to vanishing gradients and representation collapse. To isolate the effect of these dynamics, we construct a permutation-equivariant GT with inherently stable, non-dissipative transport. We also introduce a damping mechanism that continuously interpolates between non-dissipative and increasingly contractive regimes, enabling a direct assessment of how dissipation influences generation. Experiments on synthetic and molecular graph generation benchmarks show that the gap between these regimes widens with depth: non-dissipative dynamics preserve representation diversity and gradient flow, sustaining strong generative performance, whereas greater contraction progressively impairs it. These findings identify the denoiser's dynamical regime as a key design factor for deep graph generative models.

AI.tldr: 本文从动力系统视角分析深度图Transformer生成模型中"越深越差"的现象，指出其源于去噪器随深度增加而愈发耗散，导致梯度消失与表示坍缩；并通过构造非耗散、置换等变的GT及可调阻尼机制验证了这一结论。
AI.motivation: 图生成模型日益依赖图Transformer来捕捉节点与边之间的复杂依赖。理论上更深的架构应带来更强的表达能力与更大的感受野，但实际效果会随深度下降：重复的自注意力不断收缩节点表示，阻碍信息流动与梯度传播。论文希望揭示这一"深度失效"现象的机理。
AI.method: 作者从动力系统角度切入，聚焦去噪器的谱动力学对图生成的影响。为隔离动力学的作用，构造了一个置换等变、内在稳定且非耗散的图Transformer；并引入阻尼机制，可在非耗散与渐强收缩两种机制之间连续插值，从而直接评估耗散程度对生成的影响。
AI.result: 在合成图与分子图生成基准上，两种动力学机制的差距随深度增大而扩大：非耗散动力学能保持表示多样性与梯度流动，维持较强的生成性能；而收缩越强，性能退化越明显。
AI.conclusion: 去噪器的动力学机制是深度图生成模型的关键设计因素，控制耗散程度有助于缓解深层模型的表示坍缩与梯度消失问题。

title: The Nixtlaverse: An Open-Source Ecosystem for Forecasting
comment: 18 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables. Submitted to the International Journal of Forecasting. Code and benchmark artifact: https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.33399445
summary: Large forecasting applications often combine statistical, machine-learning, and neural models. These families solve the same problem but differ in fitted state, training procedures, and how they parallelize work. Forecasting software must therefore either hide these differences behind a single estimator interface, or keep the families in separate packages, forcing users to rewrite data preparation and evaluation for every package. We present the Nixtlaverse, an ecosystem of open-source Python libraries for time series forecasting, as a case study of a third design: all libraries share the same long-format panel data and keyed forecast outputs, while every model family keeps its own specialized implementation. We demonstrate this design through three use cases on the public M5 competition data. First, we evaluate statistical, machine-learning, and neural models, and an external engine from a separate ecosystem, in a single rolling-origin evaluation with per-series and hierarchy-weighted metrics. Second, we profile runtime and peak memory from 100 to 30,490 series and locate each family's bottleneck: statistical fitting scales approximately linearly in the number of series, feature construction dominates machine-learning memory, and neural training time is nearly independent of panel size under a fixed training budget. Third, we reconcile the forecasts of multiple engines, including the external one, over all 42,840 series of the M5 hierarchy, with sparse reconciliation where dense implementations exhausted memory. These use cases establish the costs, boundaries, and utility of shared data and output contracts. The Nixtlaverse has seen substantial public distribution, scholarly reuse, and adoption through other forecasting frameworks, and is released under permissive open-source licenses with public datasets, reproducible examples, and verifiable benchmark artifacts.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍 Nixtlaverse——一个共享长格式面板数据与键控预测输出、但各模型家族保留专用实现的时间序列预测开源库生态系统，并通过 M5 数据的三个用例验证其设计价值。
AI.motivation: 大型预测应用常融合统计、机器学习与神经模型，但三类模型在拟合状态、训练流程与并行方式上存在差异。现有软件要么用单一估计器接口隐藏差异，要么将其分散到独立包中，迫使用户为每个包重写数据准备与评估代码。作者希望探索第三种设计路径。
AI.method: 提出 Nixtlaverse：所有库共享相同的长格式面板数据和键控预测输出，同时每个模型家族保留各自的专用实现。在公开 M5 竞赛数据上开展三个用例：(1) 在单一滚动原点评估中比较统计、机器学习、神经模型及一个外部生态引擎，并使用逐序列与分层加权指标；(2) 对 100 至 30,490 条序列进行运行时间与峰值内存剖析；(3) 在 M5 全部 42,840 条序列上，对多个引擎（含外部引擎）的预测进行 reconciliation，并在稠密实现内存耗尽时采用稀疏 reconciliation。
AI.result: 剖析发现：统计拟合时间随序列数近似线性增长；特征构建主导机器学习内存占用；固定训练预算下神经训练时间几乎与面板规模无关。稀疏 reconciliation 成功处理了全部 42,840 条序列，而稠密实现会内存耗尽。Nixtlaverse 已获得大量公开分发、学术复用，并被其他预测框架采纳。
AI.conclusion: 这些用例确立了共享数据与输出契约的成本、边界与效用。Nixtlaverse 以宽松开源许可证发布，提供公开数据集、可复现示例与可验证的基准工件。

title: Validity-Preserving Hierarchical RL for Joint Routing and Switch Placement in EDA
summary: Routing and switch placement are fundamental combinatorial optimization problems in chip design, requiring the joint optimization of routing topology and physical placement under strict structural, geometric and logical constraints. Existing approaches typically rely on carefully engineered heuristics that incorporate strong problem-specific biases to navigate the enormous space of possible designs. In this work, we introduce a hierarchical reinforcement learning framework for joint routing and switch placement at the level of logical communication routes. Starting from a minimal routing graph, our method progressively constructs increasingly expressive solutions through three coupled operations: switch expansion, switch placement, and route refinement. These operations preserve routing validity by construction, restricting exploration to feasible configurations where every communicating initiator-target pair has one assigned loop-free route. We explore the induced solution space using Gumbel Monte Carlo Tree Search, showing that neural-guided search substantially improves solution quality over non-learning optimization methods. Furthermore, pretraining across floorplans provides a strong initialization for fine-tuning on unseen instances.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种分层强化学习框架，用于芯片设计中路由与交换机的联合优化，通过三类耦合操作在逻辑通信路由层面逐步构造解，并用Gumbel蒙特卡洛树搜索进行搜索。
AI.motivation: 路由与交换机布放是芯片设计中的基础组合优化问题，需要在结构、几何和逻辑约束下联合优化路由拓扑与物理布局，解空间巨大。现有方法多依赖人工设计的启发式规则，引入强问题特定偏置来搜索，泛化性和解质量受限。
AI.method: 从最小路由图出发，通过三个耦合操作逐步构造更丰富的解：交换机扩展、交换机布放和路由精化。这些操作在构造上保持路由有效性，将探索限制在每个通信的发起者-目标对都有唯一无环路由的可行配置内。使用Gumbel蒙特卡洛树搜索探索诱导出的解空间，并结合神经网络引导搜索；同时通过跨floorplan预训练为未见实例的微调提供初始化。
AI.result: 神经引导搜索显著提升了求解质量，优于非学习的优化方法；跨floorplan预训练能为未见实例的微调提供强初始化。
AI.conclusion: 该分层强化学习框架为路由与交换机联合布放提供了有效的学习型优化途径，兼顾可行性保证与搜索质量，并具备一定的跨实例迁移能力。

title: Revisiting On-policy Adversarial Black-Box Distillation: Calibrating Groupwise Reward Geometry for Effective Advantage Construction
summary: Black-box distillation is a practical route for transferring capabilities from API-accessible large language models that expose only text outputs into smaller student models. Recent on-policy adversarial methods such as GAD improve over SeqKD by forming an adversarial loop between a critic and a student, where the critic provides rewards for GRPO-based student policy optimization over the student's sampled responses. However, GRPO computes advantages from the within-group relative rewards of student samples for the same prompt, whereas the critic is trained primarily to distinguish teacher responses from student responses. This objective mismatch can produce reward groups with collapsed scale or fragile margins, leading to brittle grouped optimization signals. We propose Groupwise Reward Geometry Conditioning (GRGC), a two-stage framework that improves advantage construction by shaping student-side reward groups during both critic training and policy optimization. To improve critic-side conditioning, Gaussian groupwise Optimal Transport calibration regularizes the critic during training to produce reward groups with non-collapsed spread and smooth rank-wise gaps by matching sorted prompt-wise rewards to group-centered Gaussian quantiles. Building on this conditioned reward geometry, policy-side group power modulation reshapes the prompt-wise reward groups before they are converted into advantages, preserving the critic-induced ordering while increasing optimization-relevant margin separability. Extensive experiments across diverse teachers, student model families and scales, and training datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of GRGC on both in-distribution and out-of-distribution evaluations, while introducing negligible overhead over GAD. The code is available at https://github.com/2018cx/GRGC.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GRGC，一种两阶段黑盒蒸馏框架，通过在critic训练与策略优化中塑造学生侧奖励组几何结构，缓解GAD中目标错配导致的奖励组塌缩问题，在多种教师、学生模型和数据上提升分布内外表现且开销极小。
AI.motivation: 黑盒蒸馏中，GAD等在线对抗方法通过critic与学生形成对抗循环，用GRPO优化学生策略。但GRPO基于同组学生样本的相对奖励计算优势，而critic主要学习区分教师与学生响应，二者目标错配会使奖励组尺度塌缩或边际脆弱，导致分组优化信号不稳定。
AI.method: 提出Groupwise Reward Geometry Conditioning（GRGC）两阶段框架。critic侧：采用高斯组内最优传输校准，将排序后的逐prompt奖励匹配到以组为中心的Gaussian分位数，正则化critic以获得非塌缩分布和光滑的秩次间隔；策略侧：在此基础上进行组功率调制，在奖励转为优势前重塑逐prompt奖励组，保留critic诱导的排序同时增强与优化相关的边际可分性。
AI.result: 在多种教师模型、学生模型族与规模、训练数据集上的广泛实验表明，GRGC在分布内和分布外评估中均有效，且相对GAD仅引入可忽略的额外开销。
AI.conclusion: GRGC通过条件化critic与策略两侧的奖励组几何，改善了黑盒蒸馏中GRPO式优势构建的稳定性，是一种高效、通用的黑盒蒸馏改进方案。

title: How Does Local Landscape Geometry Evolve in Language Model Pre-Training?
summary: The scale and expense of pre-training language models make efficient hyperparameter tuning essential, yet a principled guidance is still missing. In this work, we analyze language model pre-training dynamics from a local landscape geometry perspective. Our study reveals two distinct phases. In Phase I, sharpness of the local landscape is initially high, leading to instability and loss plateaus under large learning rates (LRs). The landscape shifts from sharp to flatter regions early in training. This dynamic explains the necessity of LR warmup and further suggests that larger peak LRs require proportionally longer warmup periods. In Phase II, the local landscape is governed by the gradient noise scale. Our theory identifies a depth flatness trade-off: high noise from smaller batches widens the loss basin, whereas reduced noise from larger batches deepens it. This theory motivates a dynamic batch-size (BS) scheduler that begins with a small BS and increases it late in training. Together, we provide a unified view of loss landscape evolution, which translates into actionable tuning strategies for large-scale pre-training.

AI.tldr: 本文从局部损失景观几何视角分析语言模型预训练动态，揭示两个阶段，并据此提出学习率预热与动态批大小调度策略。
AI.motivation: 预训练语言模型规模大、成本高，高效超参数调优至关重要，但目前缺乏有原则的指导。作者希望从损失景观几何角度解释预训练动态，为超参数调优提供理论依据。
AI.method: 作者从局部景观几何角度分析预训练动态，将其划分为两个阶段。阶段I分析景观锐度从高到平缓的变化，解释LR预热必要性及峰值LR与预热时长的关系；阶段II分析梯度噪声尺度对景观的支配作用，提出深度-平坦度权衡理论，并据此设计动态批大小调度器。
AI.result: 研究发现阶段I中初始高锐度导致大学习率下不稳定和损失平台，景观早期由锐转平，这解释了LR预热的必要性，并表明更大的峰值LR需要成比例更长的预热期。阶段II中梯度噪声尺度主导景观，小批量高噪声拓宽损失盆地，大批量低噪声加深盆地。
AI.conclusion: 作者提供了损失景观演化的统一视角，并转化为大规模预训练的可操作调优策略：LR预热与从小批量开始、后期增大的动态批大小调度。

title: Riemannian Flow Models with Reinforcement Learning for Molecular Crystal Structure Prediction
summary: Crystal structure governs material properties, making crystal structure prediction (CSP) a fundamental problem in materials science. Generative models are a promising approach for solving this problem, but the prevalence of polymorphism, coupled with large unit cells and complex packing geometry, makes the molecular CSP task challenging for existing models. To address this, we introduce Coarse-Grained Open Materials Generation (CG-OMatG), an equivariant Riemannian flow-based generative model. CG-OMatG predicts molecular crystal structures \textit{via} a coarse-grained, hierarchical representation. CG-OMatG treats molecules as rigid bodies---performing both inter- and intra-molecular message passing to construct a geometric representation for molecular packings---and learns to reconstruct molecule centroid positions, orientations, and lattice parameters, conditioned on chemical species and conformer geometry. We train the model on subsets of the Open Molecular Crystals (OMC25) and Cambridge Structural Database (CSD) datasets. Further, we fine-tune the model \textit{via} policy gradient reinforcement learning to steer the model towards generating low-energy candidate structures. We validate the generated structures on the CSP blind test benchmark, assessing agreement with experimentally determined crystals using COMPACK packing-similarity analysis. CG-OMatG exhibits strong performance for generative molecular crystal structure prediction, paving the way for accelerated polymorph screening and organic solid-state materials discovery.

AI.tldr: 提出等变黎曼流生成模型CG-OMatG，通过粗粒度层次化表示预测分子晶体结构，并在CSP盲测基准上验证性能。
AI.motivation: 晶体结构决定材料性质，晶体结构预测（CSP）是材料科学的基础问题。现有生成模型难以应对分子CSP任务中的多晶型、大晶胞和复杂堆积几何等挑战。
AI.method: CG-OMatG是一个等变黎曼流（Riemannian flow）生成模型，采用粗粒度、层次化表示。它将分子视为刚体，同时进行分子间与分子内消息传递以构建分子堆积的几何表示，并学习重建分子质心位置、取向和晶格参数，条件为化学物种与构象几何。模型在OMC25和CSD数据集子集上训练，并通过策略梯度强化学习微调以生成低能候选结构。
AI.result: 在CSP盲测基准上验证生成结构，采用COMPACK堆积相似性分析与实验测定晶体进行一致性比较，CG-OMatG在生成式分子晶体结构预测上表现出强性能。
AI.conclusion: CG-OMatG为分子晶体结构预测提供了有效方法，有望加速多晶型筛选与有机固态材料发现。

title: Reliability-Aware Checkpoint Selection for Domain Generalization
summary: Checkpoint selection in domain generalization often relies on source-validation accuracy, yet the selected checkpoint need not provide reliable probabilities on unseen target domains. Source-target distribution shifts can alter accuracy rankings, while accuracy alone does not measure predictive probability quality. We identify an empirical selection opportunity within fixed training trajectories: reselecting among checkpoints with near-optimal source accuracy can improve mean target probability quality with small observed changes in mean target accuracy. We study accuracy-constrained reliability selection (AC), which retains checkpoints within a tolerance of the best source-validation accuracy and ranks them by source reliability. Our reference rule aggregates within-set normalized negative log-likelihood (NLL) and class-wise calibration error (CwECE) using $D_\infty$. AC uses no target data and requires neither additional training nor weight averaging. We evaluate five domain generalization training algorithms on three benchmarks, using PACS to develop the objectives and a 0.5-percentage-point tolerance. In exploratory aggregation comparisons on 360 OfficeHome and TerraIncognita runs, the reference rule reduces mean target soft-bin squared-gap ECE and CwECE by 0.240% and 0.182%, respectively, and NLL by 0.030 relative to Source-Acc. Mean target accuracy changes by +0.213 percentage points. These results identify opportunities for reliability-aware reselection, while the additional benefit of joint over single-objective ranking remains unresolved.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出准确率约束的可靠性选择（AC）方法：在固定训练轨迹中，保留源验证准确率接近最优的检查点，并按源可靠性排序，以在几乎不损失目标准确率的情况下提升目标域概率质量。
AI.motivation: 域泛化中的检查点选择通常依赖源验证准确率，但分布偏移会改变准确率排序，且准确率无法衡量预测概率质量，因此所选检查点未必在未见目标域上给出可靠概率。
AI.method: AC保留源验证准确率在最佳值容差内（开发用0.5个百分点）的检查点，再用源可靠性排序；参考规则以$D_\infty$聚合组内归一化的负对数似然（NLL）与类校准误差（CwECE）。该方法不使用目标数据，也不需要额外训练或权重平均。
AI.result: 在三个基准、五种域泛化训练算法上评估；在360次OfficeHome与TerraIncognita运行的探索性聚合比较中，参考规则相对Source-Acc将目标soft-bin平方间隔ECE与CwECE分别降低0.240%和0.182%，NLL降低0.030，目标准确率变化为+0.213个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 结果说明在固定训练轨迹内进行可靠性感知重选存在机会；但联合排序相对单目标排序的额外收益仍未解决。

title: GraphMAS: A Systematic Benchmark of Multi-Agent Coordination for Graph Learning
summary: LLM-based multi-agent systems coordinate specialized reasoning through aggregation, interaction, and adaptive control, yet their potential for graph learning remains unexplored. Graph learning is a natural setting for such systems because useful evidence may arise from heterogeneous local, long-range, global structural, and semantic perspectives whose relevance varies across instances. Existing LLM-based graph learning approaches primarily rely on single-agent reasoning, while multi-agent coordination has been studied mainly in general reasoning settings. Consequently, it remains unclear whether multiple specialized agents can improve graph learning and how coordination strategies should be designed and evaluated. To address this gap, we introduce GraphMAS, a systematic benchmark of multi-agent coordination for graph learning. GraphMAS builds a shared pool of graph reasoning specialists and organizes coordination along two dimensions, inter-agent interaction and runtime adaptivity, yielding four paradigms and seven representative coordination methods. Under a unified protocol, we evaluate these methods across seven text-attributed graphs, three domains, and two graph learning tasks. We find that heterogeneous graph perspectives are complementary, and that coordinating specialists improves over individual specialists and single-agent graph reasoning, with gains from decomposing reasoning across specialists rather than from broader evidence access alone. However, richer inter-agent interaction does not reliably help, whereas instance-adaptive specialist selection yields the strongest accuracy-efficiency trade-off. We further show that coordination can be learned over a fixed specialist pool and transfers to held-out graphs. GraphMAS therefore provides a controlled evaluation framework and empirical principles for understanding when and how multi-agent coordination benefits graph learning.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 GraphMAS，一个面向图学习的多智能体协调系统性基准，囊括 4 种范式、7 种协调方法，在 7 个文本属性图、3 个领域、2 类任务上统一评测。
AI.motivation: 图学习天然需要来自局部、长程、全局结构与语义等异构视角的证据，且各视角的重要性因实例而异；然而现有基于 LLM 的图学习方法多依赖单智能体推理，多智能体协调主要研究通用推理场景，因此尚不清楚多专门化智能体能否提升图学习，以及协调策略应如何设计与评估。
AI.method: 构建共享的图推理专家池，并从两个维度组织协调：智能体间交互与运行时自适应性，由此得到 4 种范式和 7 种代表性协调方法，并在统一协议下进行评测。
AI.result: 异构图视角具有互补性；协调专家优于单个专家和单智能体图推理，且收益来自将推理分解到不同专家而非仅获取更广证据。更丰富的智能体间交互并不稳定带来提升，而实例自适应的专家选择取得最佳的准确率—效率权衡；协调可在固定专家池上学习并迁移到未见图。
AI.conclusion: GraphMAS 提供了一个可控的评测框架与经验性原则，用于理解多智能体协调在何时、以何种方式有益于图学习。

title: Prototype-Rule Neurosymbolic Regularization for Rank-Constrained Tensor Neural Networks under Label Scarcity
summary: Rank-constrained tensor neural networks reduce the parameterization of high-order inputs, but they do not explicitly constrain class geometry in the learned representation. This study investigates whether a differentiable prototype-rule can provide a complementary inductive bias for Rank-R tensor learning under limited supervision. The proposed framework augments the Rank-R objective with prototype-based regularization and optionally fuses prototype evidence with neural logits at inference. Four hyperspectral benchmarks are evaluated with four Rank-R configurations under both seven-fold stratification and spatially separated folds that mitigate leakage; a separate spatial study varies the class support budget from 2 to 20 samples. Under spatial evaluation, full neurosymbolic inference changes Macro-F1 score by +8.82 percentage points on Botswana, +5.49 on Indian Pines, +1.59 on Pavia University, and -0.62 on Salinas. Most of the benefit arises from training-time regularization, whereas inference fusion is small and dataset dependent.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨可微原型规则能否为秩约束张量学习提供互补归纳偏置。方法在Rank-R目标上加入原型正则，并可选地在推理时融合原型证据与神经logits。在四个高光谱基准上评估，空间评估下完整神经符号推理对Macro-F1的改变为：Botswana +8.82、Indian Pines +5.49、Pavia University +1.59、Salinas -0.62，收益主要来自训练期正则。
AI.motivation: 秩约束张量神经网络虽能降低高阶输入参数量，但并未显式约束所学表示的类别几何结构。作者希望探究在有限监督下，可微原型规则能否为Rank-R张量学习提供互补的归纳偏置。
